sanskrit: अग्न आ याहि वीतये गृणानो हव्यदातये । नि होता सत्सि बर्हिषि ॥१॥
translation: Come, Agni, praised with song, to feast and sacrificial offering: sit As Hotar on the holy grass!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वमग्ने यज्ञानाꣳ होता विश्वेषाꣳ हितः । देवेभिर्मानुषे जने ॥२॥
translation: O Agni, thou hast been ordained Hotar of every sacrifice, By Gods, among the race of men.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्निं दूतं वृणीमहे होतारं विश्ववेदसम् । अस्य यज्ञस्य सुक्रतुम् ॥३॥
translation: Agni we choose as envoy, skilled performer of this holy rite, Hotar, possessor of all wealth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्निर्वृत्राणि जङ्घनद्द्रविणस्युर्विपन्यया । समिद्धः शुक्र आहुतः ॥४॥
translation: Served with oblation, kindled, bright, through love of song may Agni, bent On riches, smite the Vritras dead!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्रेष्ठं वो अतिथिꣳ स्तुषे मित्रमिव प्रियम् । अग्ने रथं न वेद्यम् ॥५॥
translation: I laud your most beloved guest like a dear friend, O Agni, him Who, like a chariot, wins us wealth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वं नो अग्ने महोभिः पाहि विश्वस्या अरातेः । उत द्विषो मर्त्यस्य ॥६॥
translation: Do thou, O Agni, with great might guard us from all malignity, Yea, from the hate of mortal man!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एह्यू षु ब्रवाणि तेऽग्न इत्थेतरा गिरः । एभिर्वर्धास इन्दुभिः ॥७॥
translation: O Agni, come; far other songs of praise will I sing forth to thee. Wax mighty with these Soma-drops!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ ते वत्सो मनो यमत्परमाच्चित्सधस्थात् । अग्ने त्वां कामये गिरा ॥८॥
translation: May Vatsa draw thy mind away even from thy loftiest dwelling place! Agni, I yearn for thee with song.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वामग्ने पुष्करादध्यथर्वा निरमन्थत । मूर्ध्नो विश्वस्य वाघतः ॥९॥
translation: Agni, Atharvan brought thee forth by rubbing from the sky, the head Of all who offer sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्ने विवस्वदा भरास्मभ्यमूतये महे । देवो ह्यसि नो दृशे ॥१०
translation: O Agni, bring us radiant light to be our mighty succour, for Thou art our visible deity!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नमस्ते अग्न ओजसे गृणन्ति देव कृष्टयः । अमैरमित्रमर्दय ॥११॥
translation: O Agni, God, the people sing reverent praise to thee for strength: With terrors trouble thou the foe
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: दूतं वो विश्ववेदसꣳ हव्यवाहममर्त्यम् । यजिष्ठमृञ्जसे गिरा ॥१२॥
translation: I seek with song your messenger, oblation-bearer, lord of wealth, Immortal, best at sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उप त्वा जामयो गिरो देदिशतीर्हविष्कृतः । वायोरनीके अस्थिरन् ॥१३॥
translation: Still turning to their aim in thee the sacrificer’s sister hymns Have come to thee before the wind.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उप त्वाग्ने दिवेदिवे दोषावस्तर्धिया वयम् । नमो भरन्त एमसि ॥१४॥
translation: To thee, illuminer of night, O Agni, day by day with prayer, Bringing thee reverence, we come.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: जराबोध तद्विविड्ढि विशेविशे यज्ञियाय । स्तोमꣳ रुद्राय दृशीकम् ॥१५
translation: Help, thou who knowest lauds, this work, a lovely hymn in Rudra’s praise, Adorable in every house!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्रति त्यं चारुमध्वरं गोपीथाय प्र हूयसे । मरुद्भिरग्न आ गहि ॥१६॥
translation: To this fair sacrifice to drink the milky draught art thou called forth: O Agni, with the Maruts come!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अश्वं न त्वा वारवन्तं वन्दध्या अग्निं नमोभिः । सम्राजन्तमध्वराणाम् ॥१७॥
translation: With homage will I reverence thee, Agni, like a long-tailed steed, Imperial lord of holy rites.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: और्वभृगुवच्छुचिमप्नवानवदा हुवे । अग्निꣳ समुद्रवाससम् ॥१८॥
translation: As Aurva and as Bhrigu called, as Apnavana called, I call The radiant Agni robed with sea.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्निमिन्धानो मनसा धियꣳ सचेत मर्त्यः । अग्निमिन्धे विवस्वभिः ॥१९॥
translation: When he enkindles Agni, man should with his heart attend the song: I kindle Agni till he glows.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आदित्प्रत्नस्य रेतसो ज्योतिः पश्यन्ति वासरम् । परो यदिध्यते दिवि ॥२०॥
translation: Then, verily, they see the light refulgent of primeval seed, Kindled on yonder side of heaven. 4
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्निं वो वृधन्तमध्वराणां पुरूतमम् । अच्छा नप्त्रे सहस्वते ॥२१॥
translation: Hither, for powerful kinship, I call Agni, him who prospers you, Most frequent at our solemn rites.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्निस्तिग्मेन शोचिषा यꣳ सद्विश्वं न्या३त्रिणम् । अग्निर्नो वꣳसते रयिम् ॥२२॥
translation: May Agni with his pointed blaze cast down each fierce devouring fiend: May Agni win us wealth by war!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्ने मृड महाꣳ अस्यय आ देवयुं जनम् । इयेथ बर्हिरासदम् ॥२३॥
translation: Agni, be gracious; thou art great: thou hast approached the pious man, Hast come to sit on sacred grass.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्ने रक्षा णो अꣳहसः प्रति स्म देव रीषतः । तपिष्ठैरजरो दह ॥२४॥
translation: Agni, preserve us,from distress consume our enemies, O God, Eternal, with thy hottest flames
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्ने युङ्क्ष्वा हि ये तवाश्वासो देव साधवः । अरं वहन्त्याशवः ॥२५॥
translation: Harness, O Agni, O thou God, thy steeds which are most excellent! The fleet ones bring thee rapidly.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नि त्वा नक्ष्य विश्पते द्युमन्तं धीमहे वयम् । सुवीरमग्न आहुत ॥२६॥
translation: Lord of the tribes, whom all must seek, we worshipped Agni set thee down, Refulgent, rich in valiant men.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्निर्मूर्धा दिवः ककुत्पतिः पृथिव्या अयम् । अपाꣳ रेताꣳसि जिन्वति ॥२७॥
translation: Agni is head and height of heaven, the master of the earth is he He quickeneth the waters’ seed.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इममू षु त्वमस्माकꣳ सनिं गायत्रं नव्याꣳसम् । अग्ने देवेषु प्र वोचः ॥२८॥
translation: O Agni, graciously announce this our good fortune of the Gods, And this our newest hymn of praise!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तं त्वा गोपवनो गिरा जनिष्ठदग्ने अङ्गिरः । स पावक श्रुधी हवम् ॥२९॥
translation: By song, O Agni, Angiras! Gopavana hath brought thee forth Hear thou my call, refulgent one!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: परि वाजपतिः कविरग्निर्हव्यान्यक्रमीत् । दधद्रत्नानि दाशुषे ॥३०॥
translation: Agni, the Sage, the Lord of Strength, hath moved around the sacred gifts, Giving the offerer precious things.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उदु त्यं जातवेदसं देवं वहन्ति केतवः । दृशे विश्वाय सूर्यम् ॥३१॥
translation: His heralds bear him up aloft, the God who knoweth all that lives, The Sun, that all may look on him.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: कविमग्निमुप स्तुहि सत्यधर्माणमध्वरे । देवममीवचातनम् ॥३२॥
translation: Praise Agni in the sacrifice, the Sage whose holy laws are true The God who driveth grief away.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: शं नो देवीरभिष्टये शं नो भवन्तु पीतये । शं योरभि स्रवन्तु नः ॥३३॥
translation: Kind be the Goddesses to lend us help, and kind that we may drink: May their streams bring us health and wealth
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: कस्य नूनं परीणसि धियो जिन्वसि सत्पते । गोषाता यस्य ते गिरः ॥३४॥
translation: Lord of the brave, whose songs dost thou in thine abundance now inspire, Thou whose hymns help to win the kine?
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यज्ञायज्ञा वो अग्नये गिरागिरा च दक्षसे । प्रप्र वयममृतं जातवेदसं प्रियं मित्रं न शꣳसिषम् ॥३५॥
translation: Sing to your Agni with each song, at every sacrifice for strength. Come, let us praise the wise and, everlasting God even as a well-beloved friend,
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पाहि नो अग्न एकया पाह्यू३त द्वितीयया । पाहि गीर्भिस्तिसृभिरूर्जां पते पाहि चतसृभिर्वसो ॥३६॥
translation: Agni, protect thou us by one, protect us by the second song, Protect us by three hymns, O Lord of power and might, bright God, by four hymns guard us well!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: बृहद्भिरग्ने अर्चिभिः शुक्रेण देव शोचिषा । भरद्वाजे समिधानो यविष्ठ्य रेवत्पावक दीदिहि ॥३७॥
translation: O Agni, with thy lofty beams, with thy pure brilliancy, O God, Kindled, most youthful one! by Bharadvaja’s hand, shine on us richly, holy Lord!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वे अग्ने स्वाहुत प्रियासः सन्तु सूरयः । यन्तारो ये मघवानो जनानामूर्वं दयन्त गोनाम् ॥३८॥
translation: O Agni who art worshipped well, dear let our princes be to thee, Our wealthy patrons who are governors of men, who part, as gifts, the stall of kine!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्ने जरितर्विश्पतिस्तपानो देव रक्षसः । अप्रोषिवान्गृहपते महाꣳ असि दिवस्पायुर्दुरोणयुः ॥३९॥
translation: Agni, praise-singer! Lord of men, God! burning up the Rakshasas, Mighty art thou, the ever-present, household-lord! home-friend and guardian from the sky.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्ने विवस्वदुषसश्चित्रꣳ राधो अमर्त्य । आ दाशुषे जातवेदो वहा त्वमद्या देवाꣳ उषर्बुधः ॥४०॥
translation: Immortal Jatavedas, thou bright-hued refulgent gift of Dawn, Agni, this day to him who pays oblations bring the Gods who waken with the morn!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वं नश्चित्र ऊत्या वसो राधाꣳसि चोदय । अस्य रायस्त्वमग्ने रथीरसि विदा गाधं तुचे तु नः ॥४१॥
translation: Wonderful, with thy favouring help, send us thy bounties, gracious Lord. Thou art the charioteer, Agni, of earthly wealth: find rest and safety for our seed!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वमित्सप्रथा अस्यग्ने त्रातरृतः कविः । त्वां विप्रासः समिधान दीदिव आ विवासन्ति वेधसः ॥४२॥
translation: Famed art thou, Agni, far and wide, preserver, righteous, and a Sage. The holy singers, O enkindled radiant one, ordainers, call on thee to come.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ नो अग्ने वयोवृधꣳ रयिं पावक शꣳस्यम् । रास्वा च न उपमाते पुरुस्पृहꣳ सुनीती सुयशस्तरम् ॥४३॥
translation: O holy Agni, give us wealth famed among men and strengthening life! Bestow on us, O helper, that which many crave, more glorious still through righteousness! 5
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यो विश्वा दयते वसु होता मन्द्रो जनानाम् । मधोर्न पात्रा प्रथमान्यस्मै प्र स्तोमा यन्त्वग्नये ॥४४॥
translation: To him, who dealeth out all wealth, the sweet-toned Hotar-priest of men, To him like the first vessels filled with savoury juice, to Agni let the lauds go forth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एना वो अग्निं नमसोर्जो नपातमा हुवे । प्रियं चेतिष्ठमरतिꣳ स्वध्वरं विश्वस्य दूतममृतम् ॥४५॥
translation: With this mine homage I invoke Agni for you, the Son of Strength, Dear, wisest envoy, skilled in noble sacrifice, immortal messenger of all.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: शेषे वनेषु मातृषु सं त्वा मर्तास इन्धते । अतन्द्रो हव्यं वहसि हविष्कृत आदिद्देवेषु राजसि ॥४६॥
translation: Thou liest in the logs that are thy mothers: mortals kindle thee. Alert thou bearest off the sacrifleer’s gift, and then thou shinest to the Gods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अदर्शि गातुवित्तमो यस्मिन्व्रतान्यादधुः । उपो षु जातमार्यस्य वर्धनमग्निं नक्षन्तु नो गिरः ॥४७॥
translation: He hath appeared, best prosperer, in whom men lay their holy acts: So may our songs of praise come nigh to Agni who was born to give the Arya strength!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्निरुक्थे पुरोहितो ग्रावाणो बर्हिरध्वरे । ऋचा यामि मरुतो ब्रह्मणस्पते देवा अवो वरेण्यम् ॥४८॥
translation: Chief Priest is Agni at the laud, as stones and grass at sacrifice. Gods! Maruts! Brahmanaspati! I crave with song the help that is most excellent.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्निमीडिष्वावसे गाथाभिः शीरशोचिषम् । अग्निꣳ राये पुरुमीढ श्रुतं नरोऽग्निः सुदीतये छर्दिः ॥४९॥
translation: Pray Agni of the piercing flame, with sacred songs, to be our help; For wealth, famed Agni, Purumilha and ye men! He is Suditi’s sure defence.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: श्रुधि श्रुत्कर्ण वह्निभिर्देवैरग्ने सयावभिः । आ सीदतु बर्हिषि मित्रो अर्यमा प्रातर्यावभिरध्वरे ॥५०॥
translation: Hear, Agni who hast ears to hear, with all thy train of escort Gods! With those who come at dawn let Mitra, Aryaman sit on the grass at sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र दैवोदासो अग्निर्देव इन्द्रो न मज्मना । अनु मातरं पृथिवीं वि वावृते तस्थौ नाकस्य शर्मणि ॥५१॥
translation: Agni of Divodasa, God, comes forth like Indra in his might. Rapidly hath he moved along his mother earth: he stands in high heaven’s dwelling-place.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अध ज्मो अध वा दिवो बृहतो रोचनादधि । अया वर्धस्व तन्वा गिरा ममा जाता सुक्रतो पृण ॥५२॥
translation: Whether thou come from earth or from the lofty lucid realm of heaven, Wax stronger in thy body through my song of praise: fill full all creatures, O most wise!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: कायमानो वना त्वं यन्मातॄरजगन्नपः । न तत्ते अग्ने प्रमृषे निवर्तनं यद्दूरे सन्निहाभुवः ॥५३॥
translation: If, loving well the forests, thou wentest to thy maternal floods, Not to be scorned, Agni, is that return of thine when, from afar, thou now art here.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नि त्वामग्ने मनुर्दधे ज्योतिर्जनाय शश्वते । दीदेथ कण्व ऋतजात उक्षितो यं नमस्यन्ति कृष्टयः ॥५४॥
translation: O Agni, Manu stablished thee a light for all the race of men: With Kanva hast thou blazed, Law-born and waxen strong, thou whom the people reverence.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: देवो वो द्रविणोदाः पूर्णां विवष्ट्वासिचम् । उद्वा सिञ्चध्वमुप वा पृणध्वमादिद्वो देव ओहते ॥५५॥
translation: The God who giveth wealth accept your full libation poured to, him! Pour ye it out, then fill the vessel full again, for so the God regardeth you.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्रैतु ब्रह्मणस्पतिः प्र देव्येतु सूनृता । अच्छा वीरं नर्यं पङ्क्तिराधसं देवा यज्ञं नयन्तु नः ॥५६॥
translation: Let Brahmanaspati come forth, let Sunrita the Goddess come, And Gods bring to our rite which yields a fivefold gift the hero, lover of mankind!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ऊर्ध्व ऊ षु ण ऊतये तिष्ठा देवो न सविता । ऊर्ध्वो वाजस्य सनिता यदञ्जिभिर्वाघद्भिर्विह्वयामहे ॥५७॥
translation: Stand up erect to lend us aid, stand up like Savitar the God, Erect as strength-bestower when we call on thee with priests who balm our offerings!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र यो राये निनीषति मर्तो यस्ते वसो दाशत् । स वीरं धत्ते अग्न उक्थशꣳसिनं त्मना सहस्रपोषिणम् ॥५८॥
translation: The man who bringeth gifts to thee, bright God who fain wouldst lead to wealth, Winneth himself a brave son, Agni! skilled in lauds, one prospering in a thousand ways.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र वो यह्वं पुरूणां विशां देवयतीनाम् । अग्निꣳ सूक्तेभिर्वचोभिर्वृणीमहे यꣳसमिदन्य इन्धते ॥५९॥
translation: With hymns and holy eulogies we supplicate your Agni, Lord Of many families who duly serve the Gods, yea, him whom others too inflame.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अयमग्निः सुवीर्यस्येशे हि सौभगस्य । राय ईशे स्वपत्यस्य गोमत ईशे वृत्रहथानाम् ॥६०॥
translation: This Agni is the Lord of great prosperity and hero, strength, Of wealth with noble offspring and with store of kine, the Lord of battles with the foe.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वमग्ने गृहपतिस्त्वꣳ होता नो अध्वरे । त्वं पोता विश्ववार प्रचेता यक्षि यासि च वार्यम् ॥६१॥
translation: Thou, Agni, art the homestead’s Lord, our Hotar-priest at sacrifice. Lord of all boons, thou art the Potar, passing wise. Pay worship, and enjoy the good!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सखायस्त्वा ववृमहे देवं मर्तास ऊतये । अपां नपातꣳ सुभगꣳ सुदꣳससꣳ सुप्रतूर्तिमनेहसम् ॥६२॥
translation: We as thy friends have chosen thee, mortals a God, to be our help. The Waters’ Child, the blessed, the most mighty one, swift conqueror, and without a peer.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ जुहोता हविषा मर्जयध्वं नि होतारं गृहपतिं दधिध्वम् । इडस्पदे नमसा रातहव्यꣳ सपर्यता यजतं पस्त्यानाम् ॥६३
translation: Present oblations, make him splendid: set ye as Hotar in his place the Home’s Lord, worshipped With gifts and homage where they pour libations! Honour him meet for reverence in our houses.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: चित्र इच्छिशोस्तरुणस्य वक्षथो न यो मातरावन्वेति धातवे । अनूधा यदजीजनदधा चिदा ववक्षत्सद्यो महि दूत्यां३चरन् ॥६४॥
translation: Verily wondrous is the tender youngling’s growth who never draweth nigh to drink his 6 mother’s milk. As soon as she who hath no udder bore him, he, faring on his. great errand, suddenly grew strong.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इदं त एकं पर उ त एकं तृतीयेन ज्योतिषा सं विशस्व । संवेशनस्तन्वे३चारुरेधि प्रियो देवानां परमे जनित्रे ॥६५॥
translation: Here is one light for thee, another yonder: enter the third and, be therewith united. Beautiful be thy union with the body, beloved in the Gods’ sublimest birthplace!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इमꣳ स्तोममर्हते जातवेदसे रथमिव सं महेमा मनीषया । भद्रा हि नः प्रमतिरस्य सꣳसद्यग्ने सख्ये मा रिषामा वयं तव ॥६६॥
translation: For Jatavedas, worthy of our praise, will we frame with our mind this eulogy as ‘twere a car; For good, in his assembly, is this care of ours. Let us not, in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मूर्धानं दिवो अरतिं पृथिव्या वैश्वानरमृत आ जातमग्निम् । कविꣳ सम्राजमतिथिं जनानामासन्नः पात्रं जनयन्त देवाः ॥६७॥
translation: Agni Vaisvanara, born in course of Order, the messenger of earth, the head of heaven, The Sage, the sovran, guest of men, our vessel fit for their mouth, the Gods have generated.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वि त्वदापो न पर्वतस्य पृष्ठादुक्थेभिरग्ने जनयन्त देवाः । तं त्वा गिरः सुष्टुतयो वाजयन्त्याजिं न गिर्ववाहो जिग्युरश्वाः ॥६८॥
translation: Even as the waters from the mountain ridges, so sprang the; Gods, through lauds, from thee, O Agni. To thee speed hymns and eulogies, as horses haste, bearing him who loves the song, to battle.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ वो राजानमध्वरस्य रुद्रꣳ होतारꣳ सत्ययजꣳ रोदस्योः । अग्निं पुरा तनयित्नोरचित्ताद्धिरण्यरूपमवसे कृणुध्वम् ॥६९॥
translation: Win to protect you, Rudra, lord of worship, priest of both worlds, effectual sacrificer, Agni, invested with his golden colours, before the thunder strike and lay you senseless!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्धे राजा समर्यो नमोभिर्यस्य प्रतीकमाहुतं घृतेन । नरो हव्येभिरीडते सबाध आग्निरग्रमुषसामशोचि ॥७०॥
translation: The King whose face is decked with oil is kindled with homage offered by his faithful servant. The men, the priests adore him with oblations. Agni hath shone forth at the flush of morning.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र केतुना बृहता यात्यग्निरा रोदसी वृषभो रोरवीति । दिवश्चिदन्तादुपमामुदानडपामुपस्थे महिषो ववर्ध ॥७१॥
translation: Agni advanceth with his lofty banner: through earth and heaven the Bull hath loudly bellowed He hath come nigh from the sky’s farthest limit: the Steer hath waxen in the waters’ bosom.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्निं नरो दीधितिभिररण्योर्हस्तच्युतं जनयत प्रशस्तम् । दूरेदृशं गृहपतिमथव्युम् ॥७२॥
translation: From the two fire-sticks have the men engendered with thoughts, urged by the hand, the glorious Agni, Far-seen, with pointed flame, Lord of the Homestead.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अबोध्यग्निः समिधा जनानां प्रति धेनुमिवायतीमुषासम् । यह्वा इव प्र वयामुज्जिहानाः प्र भानवः सस्रते नाकमच्छ ॥७३॥
translation: Agni is wakened by the people’s fuel to meet the Dawn who cometh like a milch-cow. Like young trees shooting up on high their branches, his flames. are mounting to the vault of heaven.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र भूर्जयन्तं महां विपोधां मूरैरमूरं पुरां दर्माणम् । नयन्तं गीर्भिर्वना धियं धा हरिश्मश्रुं न वर्मणा धनर्चिम् ॥७४॥
translation: Set forth the gleaming one, the song-inspirer, not foolish with. the foolish, fort-destroyer, Who leadeth with his hymns to thought of conquest, gold-bearded, richly splendid with his armour
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: शुक्रं ते अन्यद्यजतं ते अन्यद्विषुरूपे अहनी द्यौरिवासि । विश्वा हि माया अवसि स्वधावन्भद्रा ते पूषन्निह रातिरस्तु ॥७५॥
translation: Thou art like heaven: one form is bright, one holy, like Day and Night dissimilar in colour. All magic powers thou aidest, self-dependent! Auspicious bethy bounty here, O Pushan!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इडामग्ने पुरुदꣳसꣳ सनिं गोः शश्वत्तमꣳ हवमानाय साध । स्यान्नः सूनुस्तनयो विजावाग्ने सा ते सुमतिर्भूत्वस्मे ॥७६॥
translation: As holy food, Agni, to thine invoker give wealth in cattle, lasting, rich in marvels! To us be born a son and spreading offspring. Agni, be this thy gracious will to us-ward!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र होता जातो महान्नभोविन्नृषद्मा सीददपां विवर्ते । दधद्यो धायी सुते वयाꣳसि यन्ता वसूनि विधते तनूपाः ॥७७॥
translation: Stablished to fill the juice with vital vigour, giver of wealth, guard of his servant’s body, The great Priest, born, who knows the clouds, abider with men, is seated in the waters’ eddy.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र सम्राजमसुरस्य प्रशस्तं पुꣳसः कृष्टीनामनुमाद्यस्य । इन्द्रस्येव प्र तवसस्कृतानि वन्दद्वारा वन्दमाना विवष्टु ॥७८॥
translation: Let the song, honouring the best, with longing honour the Asura’s most famous sovran, The deeds of him the mighty, deeds like Indra’s, the manly one in whom the folk must triumph!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अरण्योर्निहितो जातवेदा गर्भ इवेत्सुभृतो गर्भिणीभिः । दिवेदिव ईड्यो जागृवद्भिर्हविष्मद्भिर्मनुष्येभिरग्निः ॥७९॥
translation: In the two kindling-blocks lies Jatavedas like the well-cherished germ in pregnant women,- - Agni who day by day must be entreated by men who watch provided with oblations.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सनादग्ने मृणसि यातुधानान्न त्वा रक्षाꣳसि पृतनासु जिग्युः । अनु दह सहमूरान्कयादो मा ते हेत्या मुक्षत दैव्यायाः ॥८०॥
translation: Agni, from days of old thou slayest demons: never shall Rakshasas in fight o’ercome thee. Burn up the foolish ones, raw flesh devourers: let none of them escape thine heavenly arrow! 7
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्न ओजिष्ठमा भर द्युम्नमस्मभ्यमध्रिगो । प्र नो राये पनीयसे रत्सि वाजाय पन्थाम् ॥८१॥
translation: Bring us most mighty splendour thou, Agni, resistless on thy way: Prepare for us the path that leads to glorious opulence and strength!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यदि वीरो अनु ष्यादग्निमिन्धीत मर्त्यः । आजुह्वद्धव्यमानुषक्शर्म भक्षीत दैव्यम् ॥८२
translation: May the brave man, if full of zeal he serve and kindle Agni’s flame, Duly presenting sacred gifts, enjoy the Gods’ protecting help.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वेषस्ते धूम ऋण्वति दिवि सं च्छुक्र आततः । सूरो न हि द्युता त्वं कृपा पावक रोचसे ॥८३॥
translation: Thy bright smoke lifts itself aloft, and far-extended shines in heaven, For, Purifier! like the Sun thou beamest with thy radiant glow.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वꣳहि क्षैतवद्यशोऽग्ने मित्रो न पत्यसे । त्वं विचर्षणे श्रवो वसो पुष्टिं न पुष्यसि ॥८४॥
translation: Thou, Agni, even as Mitra, hast a princely glory of thine own. Bright, active God, thou makest fame increase like means of nourishment.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्रातरग्निः पुरुप्रियो विश स्तवेतातिथिः । विश्वे यस्मिन्नमर्त्ये हव्यं मर्तास इन्धते ॥८५॥
translation: At dawn let Agni, much-beloved, guest of the house, be glorified, In whom, the everlasting one, all mortals make their offerings blaze.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यद्वाहिष्ठं तदग्नये बृहदर्च विभावसो । महिषीव त्वद्रयिस्त्वद्वाजा उदीरते ॥८६॥
translation: Most moving song be Agni’s: shine on high, O rich in radiant light! Like the chief consort of a King riches and strength proceed from thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विशोविशो वो अतिथिं वाजयन्तः पुरुप्रियम् । अग्निं वो दुर्यं वचः स्तुषे शूषस्य मन्मभिः ॥८७॥
translation: Exerting all our strength with thoughts of power we glorify in speech Agni your dear familiar friend, the darling guest in every house.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: बृहद्वयो हि भानवेऽर्चा देवायाग्नये । यं मित्रं न प्रशस्तये मर्तासो दधिरे पुरः ॥८८॥
translation: His beam hath lofty power of life: sing praise to Agni, to the God Whom men have set in foremost place, like Mitra for their eulogy!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अगन्म वृत्रहन्तमं ज्येष्ठमग्निमानवम् । य स्म श्रुतर्वन्नार्क्षे बृहदनीक इध्यते ॥८९॥
translation: To noblest Agni, friend of man, chief Vritra-slayer, have we come- Who with Srutarvan, Riksha’s son, in lofty presence is inflamed.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: जातः परेण धर्मणा यत्सवृद्भिः सहाभुवः । पिता यत्कश्यपस्याग्निः श्रद्धा माता मनुः कविः ॥९०
translation: Born as the loftiest Law commands, comrade of those who grew with him. Agni, the sire of Kasyapa by faith, the mother, Manu, Sage.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सोमꣳ राजानं वरुणमग्निमन्वारभामहे । आदित्यं विष्णुꣳ सूर्यं ब्रह्माणं च बृहस्पतिम् ॥९१॥
translation: We in King Soma place our trust, in Agni, and in Varuna, The Aditya, Vishnu, Surya, and the Brahman-priest Brihaspati.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इत एत उदारुहन्दिवः पृष्ठान्या रुहन् । प्र भूर्जयो यथा पथोद्यामङ्गिरसो ययुः ॥९२
translation: Hence have these men gone up on high and mounted to the heights of heaven: On! conquer on the path by which Angirasas travelled to the skies!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: राये अग्ने महे त्वा दानाय समिधीमहि । ईडिष्वा हि महे वृषन् द्यावा होत्राय पृथिवी ॥९३
translation: That thou mayst send us ample wealth, O Agni, we will kindler thee: So, for the great oblation, Steer, pray Heaven and Earth to come to us!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: दधन्वे वा यदीमनु वोचद्ब्रह्मेति वेरु तत् । परि विश्वानि काव्या नेमिश्चक्रमिवाभुवत् ॥९४॥
translation: He runs when one calls after him, This is the prayer of him who prays. He holds all knowledge in his grasp even as the felly rounds the wheel.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्रत्यग्ने हरसा हरः शृणाहि विश्वतस्परि । यातुधानस्य रक्षसो बलं न्युब्ज वीर्यम् ॥९५॥
translation: Shoot forth, O Agni, with thy flame: demolish them on every side! Break down the Yatudhana’s strength, the vigour of the Rakshasa!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वमग्ने वसूꣳरिह रुद्राꣳ आदित्याꣳ उत । यजा स्वध्वरं जनं मनुजातं घृतप्रुषम् ॥९६॥
translation: Worship the Vasus, Agni! here, the Rudras and Adityas, all Who know fair sacrifices, sprung from Mann, scattering blessings down! 8
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पुरु त्वा दाशिवाꣳ वोचेऽरिरग्ने तव स्विदा । तोदस्येव शरण आ महस्य ॥९७॥
translation: Agni, thy faithful servant I call upon thee with many a gift, As in the keeping of the great inciting God.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र होत्रे पूर्व्यं वचोऽग्नये भरता बृहत् । विपां ज्योतीꣳषि बिभ्रते न वेधसे ॥९८॥
translation: To Agni, to the Hotar-priest offer your best, your lofty speech, To him ordainer-like who bears the light of songs.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्ने वाजस्य गोमत ईशानः सहसो यहो । अस्मे देहि जातवेदो महि श्रवः ॥९९॥
translation: O Agni, thou who art the lord of wealth in kine, thou Son of Strength, Bestow on us, O Jatavedas, high renown
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्ने यजिष्ठो अध्वरे देवान् देवयते यज । होता मन्द्रो वि राजस्यति स्रिधः ॥१००॥
translation: Most skilled in sacrifice, bring the Gods, O Agni, to the pious, man: A joyful Priest, thy splendour drives our foes afar
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: जज्ञानः सप्त मातृभिर्मेधामाशासत श्रिये । अयं ध्रुवो रयीणां चिकेतदा ॥१०१॥
translation: Taught by seven mothers at his birth was he, for glory of the wise. He, firm and sure, hath set his mind on glorious wealth
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उत स्या नो दिवा मतिरदितिरूत्यागमत् । सा शन्ताता मयस्करदप स्रिधः ॥१०२॥
translation: And in the day our prayer is this: May Aditi come nigh to help, With loving-kindness bring us weal and chase our foes
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ईडिष्वा हि प्रतीव्याँ३ यजस्व जातवेदसम् । चरिष्णुधूममगृभीतशोचिषम् ॥१०३॥
translation: Worship thou Jatavedas, pray to him who willingly accepts, Whose smoke wanders at will, and none may grasp his flame
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: न तस्य मायया च न रिपुरीशीत मर्त्यः । यो अग्नये ददाश हव्यदातये ॥१०४॥
translation: No mortal man can e’er prevail by arts of magic over him Who hath served Agni well, the oblation-giving God.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अप त्यं वृजिनꣳ रिपुꣳ स्तेनमग्ने दुराध्यम् । दविष्ठमस्य सत्पते कृधी सुगम् ॥१०५॥
translation: Agni, drive thou the wicked foe, the evil-hearted thief away, Far, far, Lord of the brave! and give us easy paths!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: श्रुष्ट्यग्ने नवस्य मे स्तोमस्य वीर विश्पते । नि मायिनस्तपसा रक्षसो दह ॥१०६॥
translation: O hero Agni, Lord of men, on hearing this new laud of mine Burn down the Rakshasas, enchanters, with thy flame!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र मꣳहिष्ठाय गायत ऋताव्ने बृहते शुक्रशोचिषे । उपस्तुतासो अग्नये ॥१०७॥
translation: Sing forth to him the holy, most munificent, sublime with his refulgent glow, To Agni, ye Upastutas
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र सो अग्ने तवोतिभिः सुवीराभिस्तरति वाजकर्मभिः । यस्य त्वꣳ सख्यमाविथ ॥१०८॥
translation: Agni, he conquers by thine aid that brings him store of valiant sons and does great deeds, Whose bond of friendship is thy choice
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तं गूर्धया स्वर्णरं देवासो देवमरतिं दधन्विरे । देवत्रा हव्यमूहिषे ॥१०९॥
translation: Sing praise to him the Lord of light! The Gods have made the God to be their messenger, To bear oblation to the Gods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मा नो हृणीथा अतिथिं वसुरग्निः पुरुप्रशस्त एषः । यः सुहोता स्वध्वरः ॥११०॥
translation: Anger not him who is our guest! He is the bright God Agni, praised by many a man, God Hotar, skilled in sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: भद्रो नो अग्निराहुतो भद्रा रातिः सुभग भद्रो अध्वरः । भद्रा उत प्रशस्तयः ॥१११॥
translation: May Agni, worshipped, bring us bliss: may the gift, blessed one! and sacrifice bring bliss. Yea, may our eulogies bring bliss.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यजिष्ठं त्वा ववृमहे देवं देवत्रा होतारममर्त्यम् । अस्य यज्ञस्य सुक्रतुम् ॥११२॥
translation: Thee have we chosen skilfullest in sacrifice, immortal Priest among the Gods, Wise finisher of this holy rite.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तदग्ने द्युम्नमा भर यत्सासाहा सदने कं चिदत्रिणम् । मन्युं जनस्य दूढ्यम् ॥११३॥
translation: Bring us that splendour, Agni, which may overcome each greedy fiend in our abode, And the malicious wrath of men!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यद्वा उ विश्पतिः शितः सुप्रीतो मनुषो विशे । विश्वेदग्निः प्रति रक्षाꣳसि सेधति ॥११४॥
translation: Soon as the eager Lord of men is friendly unto Manu’s race Agni averteth from us all the Rakshasas!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तद्वो गाय सुते सचा पुरुहूताय सत्वने । शं यद्गवे न शाकिने ॥११५॥
translation: Sing this, beside the flowing juice, to him your hero, much-invoked, To please him as a mighty Bull
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यस्ते नूनꣳ शतक्रतविन्द्र द्युम्नितमो मदः । तेन नूनं मदे मदेः ॥११६॥
translation: O Satakratu Indra, now rejoice with that carouse of thine 9 Which is most glorious of all!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: गाव उप वदावटे महि यज्ञस्य रप्सुदा । उभा कर्णा हिरण्यया ॥११७॥
translation: Ye cows, protect the fount: the two mighty ones bless the sacrifice. The handles twain are wrought of gold.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अरमश्वाय गायत श्रुतकक्षारं गवे । अरमिन्द्रस्य धाम्ने ॥११८॥
translation: Sing praises that the horse may come; sing, Srutakaksha, that the cow May come, that Indra’s might may come
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तमिन्द्रं वाजयामसि महे वृत्राय हन्तवे । स वृषा वृषभो भुवत् ॥११९॥
translation: We make this Indra very strong to strike, the mighty Vritra dead: A vigorous hero shall he be.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वमिन्द्र बलादधि सहसो जात ओजसः । त्वꣳ सन्वृषन्वृषेदसि ॥१२०॥
translation: Based upon strength and victory and power, O Indra, is thy birth: Thou, mighty one! art strong indeed,
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यज्ञ इन्द्रमवर्धयद्यद्भूमिं व्यवर्तयत् । चक्राण ओपशं दिवि ॥१२१॥
translation: The sacrifice made Indra great when he unrolled the earth, and made Himself a diadem in heaven.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यदिन्द्राहं यथा त्वमीशीय वस्व एक इत् । स्तोता मे गोसखा स्यात् ॥१२२॥
translation: If I, O Indra, were, like thee, the single ruler over wealth My worshipper should be rich in kine.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पन्यंपन्यमित्सोतार आ धावत मद्याय । सोमं वीराय शूराय ॥१२३॥
translation: Pressers, blend Soma juice for him, each draught most excellent, for him The brave, the hero, for his joy.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इदं वसो सुतमन्धः पिबा सुपूर्णमुदरम् । अनाभयिन्ररिमा ते ॥१२४॥
translation: Here is the Soma juice expressed. O Vasu, drink till thou art full: Undaunted God, we give it thee
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उद्घेदभि श्रुतामघं वृषभं नर्यापसम् । अस्तारमेषि सूर्य ॥१२५॥
translation: Surya, thou mountest up to meet the hero famous for his wealth, Who hurls the bolt and works for man.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यदद्य कच्च वृत्रहन्नुदगा अभि सूर्य । सर्वं तदिन्द्र ते वशे ॥१२६॥
translation: Whatever, Vritra-slayer! thou, Surya hast risen upon to-day, That, Indra, all is in thy power.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: य आनयत्परावतः सुनीती तुर्वशं यदुम् । इन्द्रः स नो युवा सखा ॥१२७॥
translation: That Indra is our youthful friend, who with his trusty guidanceled Turvasa, Yadu from afar.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मा न इन्द्राभ्या३दिशः सूरो अक्तुष्वा यमत् । त्वा युजा वनेम तत् ॥१२८॥
translation: O Indra, let not ill designs surround us in the sunbeams’ light This may we gain with thee for friend!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एन्द्र सानसिꣳ रयिꣳ सजित्वानꣳ सदासहम् । वर्षिष्ठमूतये भर ॥१२९॥
translation: Indra, bring wealth that gives delight, the victor’s ever-conquering wealth, Most excellent, to be our aid
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रं वयं महाधन इन्द्रमर्भे हवामहे । युजं वृत्रेषु वज्रिणम् ॥१३०॥
translation: In mighty battle we invoke Indra, Indra is lesser fight, The friend who bends his bolt at fiends.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अपिबत्कद्रुवः सुतमिन्द्रः सहस्रबाह्वे । तत्राददिष्ट पौꣳस्यम् ॥१३१॥
translation: In battle of a thousand arms Indra drank Kadru’s Soma juice There he displayed his manly might.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वयमिन्द्र त्वायवोऽभि प्र नोनुमो वृषन् । विद्धी त्वा३स्य नो वसो ॥१३२॥
translation: Faithful to thee, we sing aloud, heroic Indra, songs to thee Mark, O good Lord, this act of ours!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ घा ये अग्निमिन्धते स्तृणन्ति बर्हिरानुषक् । येषामिन्द्रो युवा सखा ॥१३३॥
translation: Hitherward! they who light the flame and straightway trim the sacred grass, Whose friend is Indra ever young.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: भिन्धि विश्वा अप द्विषः परि बाधो जही मृधः । वसु स्पार्हं तदा भर ॥१३४॥
translation: Drive all our enemies away, smite down the foes who press around, And bring the wealth for which we long!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इहेव शृण्व एषां कशा हस्तेषु यद्वदान् । नि यामं चित्रमृञ्जते ॥१३५॥
translation: I Hear, as though ‘twere close at hand, the cracking of the whips they hold: They gather splendour on their way.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इम उ त्वा वि चक्षते सखाय इन्द्र सोमिनः । पुष्टावन्तो यथा पशुम् ॥१३६॥
translation: Indra, these friends of ours, supplied with Soma, wait and look to thee As men with fodder to the herd.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: समस्य मन्यवे विशो विश्वा नमन्त कृष्टयः । समुद्रायेव सिन्धवः ॥१३७॥
translation: Before his hot displeasure all the peoples, all the men bow down, As rivers bow them to the sea.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: देवानामिदवो महत्तदा वृणीमहे वयम् । वृष्णामस्मभ्यमूतये ॥१३८॥
translation: We choose unto ourselves that high protection of the mighty Gods, That it may help and succour us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सोमानाꣳ स्वरणं कृणुहि ब्रह्मणस्पते । कक्षीवन्तं य औशिजः ॥१३९॥
translation: O Brahmanaspati, make thou Kakshivan Ausija a loud 10 Chanter of flowing Soma juice!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: बोधन्मना इदस्तु नो वृत्रहा भूर्यासुतिः । शृणोतु शक्र आशिषम् ॥१४०॥
translation: Much honoured with libations may the Vritra-slayer watch for us: May Sakra listen to our prayer
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अद्य नो देव सवितः प्रजावत्सावीः सौभगम् । परा दुःष्वप्न्यꣳ सुव ॥१४१॥
translation: Send us this day, God Savitar, prosperity with progeny Drive thou the evil dream away!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: क्वा३स्य वृषभो युवा तुविग्रीवो अनानतः । ब्रह्मा कस्तꣳ सपर्यति ॥१४२॥
translation: Where is that ever-youthful Steer, strong-necked and never yet bent down? What Brahman ministers to him?
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उपह्वरे गिरीणाꣳ सङ्गमे च नदीनाम् । धिया विप्रो अजायत ॥१४३॥
translation: There where the mountains downward slope, there at the meeting of the streams The Sage was manifest by song.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र सम्राजं चर्षणीनामिन्द्रꣳ स्तोता नव्यं गीर्भिः । नरं नृषाहं मꣳहिष्ठम् ॥१४४॥
translation: Praise Indra whom our songs must laud, sole sovran of mankind, the chief Most liberal who controlleth men.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अपादु शिप्र्यन्धसः सुदक्षस्य प्रहोषिणः । इन्द्रोरिन्द्रो यवाशिरः ॥१४५॥
translation: Indra whose jaws are strong hath drunk of worshipping Sudaksha’s draught, The Soma juice with barley brew.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इमा उ त्वा पुरूवसोऽभि प्र नोनुवुर्गिरः । गावो वत्सं न धेनवः ॥१४६॥
translation: O Lord of ample wealth, these songs of praise have called aloud to thee, Like milch-kine lowing to their calves!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अत्राह गोरमन्वत नाम त्वष्टुरपीच्यम् । इत्था चन्द्रमसो गृहे ॥१४७॥
translation: Then straight they recognized the mystic name of the creative Steer, There in the mansion of the Moon.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यदिन्द्रो अनयद्रितो महीरपो वृषन्तमः । तत्र पूषाभुवत्सचा ॥१४८॥
translation: When Indra, strongest hero, brought the streams, the mighty waters down, Pushan was standing by his side.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: गौर्धयति मरुताꣳ श्रवस्युर्माता मघोनाम् । युक्ता वह्नी रथानाम् ॥१४९॥
translation: The Cow, the streaming mother of the liberal Maruts, pours her milk, Harnessed to draw their chariots on.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उप नो हरिभिः सुतं याहि मदानां पते । उप नो हरिभिः सुतम् ॥१५०॥
translation: Come, Lord of rapturous joys, to our libation with thy bay steeds, come With bay steeds to the flowing juice
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इष्टा होत्रा असृक्षतेन्द्रं वृधन्तो अध्वरे । अच्छावभृथमोजसा ॥१५१॥
translation: Presented strengthening gifts have sent Indra away at sacrifice, With night, unto the cleansing bath.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अहमिद्धि पितुष्परि मेधामृतस्य जग्रह । अहꣳ सूर्य इवाजनि ॥१५२॥
translation: I from my Father have received deep knowledge of eternal Law: I was born like unto the Sun.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: रेवतीर्नः सधमाद इन्द्रे सन्तु तुविवाजाः । क्षुमन्तो याभिर्मदेम ॥१५३॥
translation: With Indra splendid feasts be ours, rich in all strengthening things, wherewith, Wealthy in food, we may rejoice
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सोमः पूषा च चेततुर्विश्वासाꣳ सुक्षितीनाम् । देवत्रा रथ्योर्हिता ॥१५४
translation: Soma and Pushan, kind to him who travels to the Gods, provide Dwellings all happy and secure.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पान्तमा वो अन्धस इन्द्रमभि प्र गायत । विश्वासाहꣳ शतक्रतुं मꣳहिष्ठं चर्षणीनाम् ॥१५५॥
translation: Invite ye Indra with a song to drink your draught of Soma steeds, juice, All-conquering Satakratu, most munificent of all who live
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र व इन्द्राय मादनꣳ हर्यश्वाय गायत । सखायः सोमपाव्ने ॥१५६॥
translation: Sing ye a song, to make him glad, to Indra, Lord of tawny The Soma-drinker, O my friends!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वयमु त्वा तदिदर्था इन्द्र त्वायन्तः सखायः । कण्वा उक्थेभिर्जरन्ते ॥१५७॥
translation: This, even this, O Indra, we implore: as thy devoted friends The Kanvas praise thee with their hymns!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्राय मद्वने सुतं परि ष्टोभन्तु नो गिरः । अर्कमर्चन्तु कारवः ॥१५८॥
translation: For Indra, lover of carouse, loud be our songs about the juice Let poets sing the song of praise.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अयं त इन्द्र सोमो निपूतो अधि बर्हिषि । एहीमस्य द्रवा पिब ॥१५९॥
translation: Here, Indra, is thy Soma draught, made pure upon the sacred grass: Run hither, come and drink thereof
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सुरूपकृत्नुमूतये सुदुघामिव गोदुहे । जुहूमसि द्यविद्यवि ॥१६०॥
translation: As a good cow to him who milks, we call the doer of good deeds To our assistance duy by day.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभि त्वा वृषभा सुते सुतꣳ सृजामि पीतये । तृम्पा व्यश्नुही मदम् ॥१६१॥
translation: Hero, the Soma being shed, I pour the juice for thee to drink Sate thee and finish thy carouse! 11
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: य इन्द्र चमसेष्वा सोमश्चमूषु ते सुतः । पिबेदस्य त्वमीशिषे ॥१६२॥
translation: The Soma, Indra, which is shed in saucers and in cups for thee, Drink thou, for thou art lord thereof!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: योगेयोगे तवस्तरं वाजेवाजे हवामहे । सखाय इन्द्रमूतये ॥१६३॥
translation: In every need, in every fray we call, as friends, to succour us, Indra, the mightiest of all.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ त्वेता नि षीदतेन्द्रमभि प्र गायत । सखायः स्तोमवाहसः ॥१६४॥
translation: O come ye hither, sit ye down: to Indra sing ye forth your song, Companions, bringing hymns of praise
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इदꣳ ह्यन्वोजसा सुतꣳ राधानां पते । पिबा त्वा३स्य गिर्वणः ॥१६५॥
translation: So, Lord of affluent gifts, this juice hath been expressed for thee with strength: Drink of it, thou who lovest song!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: महाꣳ इन्द्रः पुरश्च नो महित्वमस्तु वज्रिणे । द्यौर्न प्रथिना शवः ॥१६६॥
translation: Great is our Indra from of old; greatness be his, the Thunderer Wide as the heaven extends his might.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ तू न इन्द्र क्षुमन्तं चित्रं ग्राभꣳ सं गृभाय । महाहस्ती दक्षिणेन ॥१६७॥
translation: Indra, as one with mighty arm, gather for us with thy right hand Manifold and nutritious spoil!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभि प्र गोपतिं गिरेन्द्रमर्च यथा विदे । सूनुꣳ सत्यस्य सत्पतिम् ॥१६८॥
translation: Praise, even as he is known, with song Indra the guardian of the kine, The Son of Truth, Lord of the brave.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: कया नश्चित्र आ भुवदूती सदावृधः सखा । कया शचिष्ठया वृता ॥१६९॥
translation: With what help will he come to us, wonderful, ever-waxing friend? With what most mighty company?
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्यमु वः सत्रासाहं विश्वासु गीर्ष्वायतम् । आ च्यावयस्यूतये ॥१७०॥
translation: Thou speedest down to succour us this ever-conquering God of yours Him who is drawn to all our songs.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सदसस्पतिमद्भुतं प्रियमिन्द्रस्य काम्यम् । सनिं मेधामयासिषम् ॥१७१॥
translation: To the assembly’s wondrous Lord, the lovely friend of Indra, I Had prayed for wisdom and successs.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ये ते पन्था अधो दिवो येभिर्व्यश्वमैरयः । उत श्रोषन्तु नो भुवः ॥१७२॥
translation: May all thy paths beneath the sky whereby thou speddest Vyasva on, Yea, let all spaces hear our voice
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: भद्रंभद्रं न आ भरेषमूर्जꣳ शतक्रतो । यदिन्द्र मृडयासि नः ॥१७३॥
translation: Bring to us all things excellent, O Satakratu, food and strength, For, Indra, thou art kind to us!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अस्ति सोमो अयꣳ सुतः पिबन्त्यस्य मरुतः । उत स्वराजो अश्विना ॥१७४॥
translation: Here is the Soma ready pressed: of this the Maruts, yea, of this, Self-luminous the Asvins drink.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ईङ्खयन्तीरपस्युव इन्द्रं जातमुपासते । वन्वानासः सुवीर्यम् ॥१७५॥
translation: Tossing about, the active ones came nigh to Indra at his birth, Winning themselves heroic might.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नकि देवा इनीमसि न क्या योपयामसि । मन्त्रश्रुत्यं चरामसि ॥१७६॥
translation: Never, O Gods, do we offend, nor are we ever obstinate We walk as holy texts command.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: दोषो आगाद्बृहद्गाय द्युमद्गामन्नाथर्वण । स्तुहि देवꣳ सवितारम् ॥१७७॥
translation: Evening is come: sing loudly thou Atharvan’s nobly singing son: Give praise to Savitar the God!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एषो उषा अपूर्व्या व्युच्छति प्रिया दिवः । स्तुषे वामश्विना बृहत् ॥१७८॥
translation: Now Morning with her earliest light shines forth, dear daughter of the Sky: High, Asvins, I extol your praise.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रो दधीचो अस्थभिर्वृत्राण्यप्रतिष्कुतः । जघान नवतीर्नव ॥१७९॥
translation: Armed with the bones of dead Dadhyach, Indra, with unresisted might The nine-and-ninety Vritras slew.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रेहि मत्स्यन्धसो विश्वेभिः सोमपर्वभिः । महाꣳ अभिष्टिरोजसा ॥१८०॥
translation: Come, Indra, and delight thee with the juice at all our Soma feasts, Protector, mighty in thy strength
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ तू न इन्द्र वृत्रहन्नस्माकमर्धमा गहि । महान्महीभिरूतिभिः ॥१८१॥
translation: O thou who slayest Vritras, come, O Indra, hither to our side, Mighty one, with thy mighty aids!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ओजस्तदस्य तित्विष उभे यत्समवर्तयत् । इन्द्रश्चर्मेव रोदसी ॥१८२॥
translation: That might of his shone brightly forth when Indra brought together, like A skin, the worlds of heaven and earth,
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अयमु ते समतसि कपोत इव गर्भधिम् । वचस्तच्चिन्न ओहसे ॥१८३॥
translation: This is thine own Thou drawest near, as turns a pigeon to his mate: Thou carest, too, for this our prayer.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वात आ वातु भेषजꣳ शम्भु मयोभु नो हृदे । प्र न आयूꣳषि तारिषत् ॥१८४॥
translation: May Vata breathe his balm on us, healthful, delightful to our heart: May he prolong our days of life 12
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यꣳ रक्षन्ति प्रचेतसो वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा । न किः स दभ्यते जनः ॥१८५॥
translation: Ne’er is he injured whom the Gods Varuna, Mitra, Aryam. The excellently wise, protect.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: गव्यो षु णो यथा पुराश्वयोत रथया । वरिवस्या महोनाम् ॥१८६॥
translation: According to our wish for kine, for steeds and chariots, as of old, Be gracious to our wealthy chiefs
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इमास्त इन्द्र पृश्नयो घृतं दुहत आशिरम् । एनामृतस्य पिप्युषीः ॥१८७॥
translation: Indra, these spotted cows yield thee their butter and the milky draught, Aiders, thereby, of sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अया धिया च गव्यया पुरुणामन्पुरुष्टुत । यत्सोमेसोम आभुवः ॥१८८॥
translation: That thou much-lauded! many-named! mayst, with this thought, that longs for milk, Come to each Soma sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पावका नः सरस्वती वाजेभिर्वाजिनीवती । यज्ञं वष्टु धियावसुः ॥१८९॥
translation: May bright Sarasvati, endowed with plenteous wealth and spoil, enriched With prayer, desire the sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: क इमं नाहुषीष्वा इन्द्रꣳ सोमस्य तर्पयात् । स नो वसून्या भरात् ॥१९०
translation: Why ‘mid the Nahusha tribes shall sate this Indra with his Soma juice? He shall bring precious things to us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ याहि सुषुमा हि त इन्द्र सोमं पिबा इमम् । एदं बर्हिः सदो मम ॥१९१॥
translation: Come, we have pressed the juice for thee; O Indra, drink this Soma here: Sit thou on this my sacred grass
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: महि त्रीणामवरस्तु द्युक्षं मित्रस्यार्यम्णः । दुराधर्षं वरुणस्य ॥१९२॥
translation: Great, unassailable must be the heavenly favour of the Three, Varuna, Mitra, Aryaman.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वावतः पुरूवसो वयमिन्द्र प्रणेतः । स्मसि स्थातर्हरीणाम् ॥१९३॥
translation: We, Indra, Lord of ample wealth, our guide, depend on one like thee, Thou driver of the tawny steeds! 13
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उत्त्वा मन्दन्तु सोमाः कृणुष्व राधो अद्रिवः । अव ब्रह्मद्विषो जहि ॥१९४॥
translation: Let Soma juices make thee glad! Display thy bounty, Thunderer: Drive off the enemies of prayer!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: गिर्वणः पाहि नः सुतं मधोर्धाराभिरज्यसे । इन्द्र त्वादातमिद्यशः ॥१९५॥
translation: Drink our libation, Lord of hymns! with streams of meath thou art bedewed: Yea, Indra, glory is thy gift.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सदा व इन्द्रश्चर्कृषदा उपो नु स सपर्यन् । न देवो वृतः शूर इन्द्रः ॥१९६
translation: Indra hath ever thought of you and tended you with care. The God, Heroic Indra, is not checked.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ त्वा विशन्त्विन्दवः समुद्रमिव सिन्धवः । न त्वामिन्द्राति रिच्यते ॥१९७॥
translation: Let the drops pass within thee as the rivers flow into the sea O Indra, naught excelleth thee!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रमिद्गाथिनो बृहदिन्द्रमर्केभिरर्किणः । इन्द्रं वाणीरनूषत ॥१९८॥
translation: Indra, the singers with high praise, Indra reciters with their lauds, Indra the choirs have glorified.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्र इषे ददातु न ऋभुक्षणमृभुꣳ रयिम् । वाजी ददातु वाजिनम् ॥१९९॥
translation: May Indra give, to aid us wealth handy that rules the skilful ones! Yea, may the Strong give potent wealth
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रो अङ्ग महद्भयमभी षदप चुच्यवत् । स हि स्थिरो विचर्षणिः ॥२००॥
translation: Verily Indra, conquering all, drives even mighty fear away, For firm is he and swift to act.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इमा उ त्वा सुतेसुते नक्षन्ते गिर्वणो गिरः । गावो वत्सं न धेनवः ॥२०१॥
translation: These songs with every draught we pour come, lover of the song, to thee As milch-kine hasten to their calves.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रा नु पूषणा वयꣳ सख्याय स्वस्तये । हुवेम वाजसातये ॥२०२॥
translation: Indra and Wishan will we call for friendship and prosperity, And for the winning of the spoil.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: न कि इन्द्र त्वदुत्तरं न ज्यायो अस्ति वृत्रहन् । न क्येवं यथा त्वम् ॥२०३॥
translation: O Indra, Vritra-slayer, naught is better, mightier than thou Verily there is none like thee!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तरणिं वो जनानां त्रदं वाजस्य गोमतः । समानमु प्र शꣳ सिषम् ॥२०४॥
translation: Him have I magnified, our Lord in common, guardian of your folk, Discloser of great wealth in kine.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: असृग्रमिन्द्र ते गिरः प्रति त्वामुदहासत । सजोषा वृषभं पतिम् ॥२०५॥
translation: Songs have outpoured themselves to thee, Indra, the strong, the guardian Lord, And with one will have risen to thee!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सुनीथो घा स मर्त्यो यं मरुतो यमर्यमा । मित्रास्पान्त्यद्रुहः ॥२०६॥
translation: Good guidance hath the mortal man whom Arya-man, the Marut host, And Mitras, void of guile, protect.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यद्वीडाविन्द्र यत्स्थिरे यत्पर्शाने पराभृतम् । वसु स्पार्हं तदा भर ॥२०७॥
translation: Bring us the wealth for which we long, O Indra, that which is concealed In strong firm place precipitous.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: श्रुतं वो वृत्रहन्तमं प्र शर्धं चर्षणीनाम् । आशिषे राधसे महे ॥२०८॥
translation: Him your best Vritra-slayer, him the famous champion of mankind I urge to great munificence.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अरं त इन्द्र श्रवसे गमेम शूर त्वावतः । अरꣳ शक्र परेमणि ॥२०९
translation: Indra, may we adorn thy fame, fame of one like thee, hero! deck, Sakra! thy fame at highest feast!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: धानावन्तं करम्भिणमपूपवन्तमुक्थिनम् । इन्द्र प्रातर्जुषस्व नः ॥२१०॥
translation: Indra, accept at break of day our Soma mixt with roasted corn, With groats, with cake, with eulogies!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अपां फेनेन नमुचेः शिर इन्द्रोदवर्तयः । विश्वा यदजय स्पृधः ॥२११॥
translation: With waters’ foam thou torest off, Indra, the head of Namuchi, When thou o’ercamest all the foes.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इमे त इन्द्र सोमाः सुतासो ये च सोत्वाः । तेषां मत्स्व प्रभूवसो ॥२१२
translation: Thine are these Soma juices, thine, Indra, those still to be expressed: Enjoy them, Lord of princely wealth!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तुभ्यꣳ सुतासः सोमाः स्तीर्णं बर्हिर्विभावसो । स्तोतृभ्य इन्द्र मृडय ॥२१३॥
translation: For thee, O Indra, Lord of light, Somas are pressed and grass is strewn: Be gracious to thy worshippers! 14
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ व इन्द्रं कृविं यथा वाजयन्तः शतक्रतुम् । मꣳहिष्ठꣳ सिञ्च इन्दुभिः ॥२१४॥
translation: We seeking strength, with Soma drops fill full your Indra like a well, Most liberal, Lord of boundless might.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अतश्चिदिन्द्र न उपा याहि शतवाजया । इषा सहस्रवाजया ॥२१५॥
translation: O Indra, even from that place come unto us with food that gives A hundred, yea, a thousand powers!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ बुन्दं वृत्रहा ददे जातः पृच्छाद्वि मातरम् । क उग्राः के ह शृण्विरे ॥२१६॥
translation: The new-born Vritra-slayer asked his mother, as he seized his shaft, Who are the, fierce and famous ones?
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: बृबदुक्थꣳ हवामहे सृप्रकरस्नमूतये । साधः कृण्वन्तमवसे ॥२१७॥
translation: Let us call him to aid whose hands stretch far, the highly-lauded, who Fulfils the work to favour us
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ऋजुनीती नो वरुणो मित्रो नयति विद्वान् । अर्यमा देवैः सजोषाः ॥२१८॥
translation: Mitra who knoweth leadeth us, and Varuna who guideth straight, And Aryaman in accord with Gods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: दूरादिहेव यत्सतोऽरुणप्सुरशिश्वितत् । वि भानुं विश्वथातनत् ॥२१९॥
translation: When, even as she were present here, red Dawn hath shone from far away, She spreadeth light on every side.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ नो मित्रावरुणा घृतैर्गव्यूतिमुक्षतम् । मध्वा रजाꣳसि सुक्रतू ॥२२०॥
translation: Varuna, Mitra, sapient pair, pour fatness on our pastures, pour Meath on the regions of the air!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उदु त्ये सूनवो गिरः काष्ठा यज्ञेष्वत्नत । वाश्रा अभिज्ञु यातवे ॥२२१॥
translation: And, at our sacrifices, these, sons, singers, have enlarged their bounds, So that the cows must walk knee-deep.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इदं विष्णुर्वि चक्रमे त्रेधा नि दधे पदम् । समूढमस्य पाꣳसुले ॥२२२॥
translation: Through all this world strode Vishnu: thrice his foot he planted, and the whole Was gathered in his footstep’s dust.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अतीहि मन्युषाविणꣳ सुषुवाꣳसमुपेरय । अस्य रातौ सुतं पिब ॥२२३॥
translation: Pass by the wrathful offerer; speed the man who pours libation, drink The juice which he presents to thee!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: कदु प्रचेतसे महे वचो देवाय शस्यते । तदिध्यस्य वर्धनम् ॥२२४
translation: What is the word addressed to him, God great and excellently wise? For this is what exalteth him.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उक्थं च न शस्यमानं नागो रयिरा चिकेत । न गायत्रं गीयमानम् ॥२२५॥
translation: His wealth who hath no store of kine hath ne’er found out recited laud, Nor song of praises that is sung.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्र उक्थेभिर्मन्दिष्ठो वाजानां च वाजपतिः । हरिवान्त्सुतानाꣳ सखा ॥२२६
translation: Lord of each thing that giveth strength, Indra delighteth most in lauds, Borne by bay steeds, libations’ friend.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ याह्युप नः सुतं वाजेभिर्मा हृणीयथाः । महाꣳ इव युवजानिः ॥२२७॥
translation: With wealth to our libation come, be not thou angry with us, like A great man with a youthful bride.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: कदा वसो स्तोत्रं हर्यत आ अव श्मशा रुधद्वाः । दीर्घꣳ सुतं वाताप्याय ॥२२८॥
translation: When, Vasu, wilt thou love the laud? Now let the Channel bring the stream. The juice is ready to ferment.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ब्राह्मणादिन्द्र राधसः पिबा सोममृतूꣳरनु । तवेदꣳ सख्यमस्तृतम् ॥२२९॥
translation: After the Seasons. Indra, drink the Soma from the Brahman’s gift: Thy friendship is invincible! S. O Indra, lover of the song, we are the singers of thy praise O Soma-drinker, quicken us!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वयं घा ते अपि स्मसि स्तोतार इन्द्र गिर्वणः । त्वं नो जिन्व सोमपाः ॥२३०॥
translation: O Indra, in each fight and fray give to our bodies manly strength: Strong Lord, grant ever-conquering might!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एन्द्र पृक्षु कासु चिन्नृम्णं तनूषु धेहि नः । सत्राजिदुग्र पौꣳस्यम् ॥२३१
translation: For so thou art the brave man’s friend; a hero, too, art thou, and strong: So may thine heart be won to us!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एवा ह्यसि वीरयुरेवा शूर उत स्थिरः । एवा ते राध्यं मनः ॥२३२॥
translation: Like kine unmilked we call aloud, hero, to thee, and sing thy praise, Looker on heavenly light, Lord of this moving world, Lord, Indra, of what moveth not!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभि त्वा शूर नोनुमोऽदुग्धा इव धेनवः । ईशानमस्य जगतः स्वर्दृशमीशानमिन्द्र तस्थुषः ॥२३३॥
translation: That we may win us wealth and power we poets, verily, call on thee: In war men call on thee, Indra, the hero’s Lord, in the steed’s race-course call on thee:
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वामिद्धि हवामहे सातौ वाजस्य कारवः । त्वां वृत्रेष्विन्द्र सत्पतिं नरस्त्वां काष्ठास्वर्वतः ॥२३४॥
translation: To you will I sing Indra’s praise who gives good gifts as well we know; The praise of Maghavan who, rich in treasure, aids his singers with wealth thousandfold.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभि प्र वः सुराधसमिन्द्रमर्च यथा विदे । यो जरितृभ्यो मघवा पुरूवसुः सहस्रेणेव शिक्षति ॥२३५॥
translation: As cows low to their calves in stalls, so with our songs we glorify This Indra, even your wondrous God who checks attack, who takes delight in precious juice. 15
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तं वो दस्ममृतीषहं वसोर्मन्दानमन्धसः । अभि वत्सं न स्वसरेषु धेनव इन्द्रं गीर्भिर्नवामहे ॥२३६॥
translation: Loud singing at the sacred rite where Soma flows we priests invoke With haste, that he may help, as the bard’s cherisher, Indra who findeth wealth for you
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तरोभिर्वो विदद्वसुमिन्द्रꣳ सबाध ऊतये । बृहद्गायन्तः सुतसोमे अध्वरे हुवे भरं न कारिणम् ॥२३७॥
translation: With Plenty for his true ally the active man will gain the spoil. Your Indra, much-invoked, I bend with song, as bends a wright his wheel of solid wood.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तरणिरित्सिषासति वाजं पुरन्ध्या युजा । आ व इन्द्रं पुरुहूतं नमे गिरा नेमिं तष्टेव सुद्रुवम् ॥२३८॥
translation: Drink, Indra, of the savoury juice, and cheer thee with our milky draught! Be, for our weal, our friend and sharer of the feast, and let thy wisdom guard us well!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पिबा सुतस्य रसिनो मत्स्वा न इन्द्र गोमतः । आपिर्नो बोधि सधमाद्ये वृधे३ऽस्माꣳ अवन्तु ते धियः ॥२३९॥
translation: For thou--come to the worshipper!--wilt find great wealth to make us rich. Fill thyself full, O Maghavan, for gain of kine, full, Indra, for the gain of steeds!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वꣳ ह्येहि चेरवे विदा भगं वसुत्तये । उद्वावृषस्व मघवन्गविष्टय उदिन्द्राश्वमिष्टये ॥२४०॥
translation: Vasishtha will not overlook the lowliest one among you all Beside our Soma juice effused to-day let all the Maruts drink with eager haste!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: न हि वश्चरमं च न वसिष्ठः परिमꣳसते । अस्माकमद्य मरुतः सुते सचा विश्वे पिबन्तु कामिनः ॥२४१॥
translation: Glorify naught besides, O friends; so shall no sorrow trouble you! Praise only mighty Indra when the juice is shed, and say your lauds repeatedly!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मा चिदन्यद्वि शꣳसत सखायो मा रिषण्यत । इन्द्रमित्स्तोता वृषणꣳ सचा सुते मुहुरुक्था च शꣳसत ॥२४२॥
translation: No one by deed attains to him who works and strengthens evermore: No, not by sacrifice, to Indra. praised of all, resistless, daring, bold in might. 2 He without ligature, before making incision in the neck, Closed up the wound again, most wealthy Maghavan, who healeth the dissevered parts.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: न किष्टं कर्मणा नशद्यश्चकार सदावृधम् । इन्द्रं न यज्ञैर्विश्वगूर्तमृभ्वसमधृष्टं धृष्णुमोजसा ॥२४३॥
translation: A thousand and a hundred steeds are harnessed to thy golden car: Yoked by devotion, Indra, let the long-maned bays bring thee to drink the Soma juice!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: य ऋते चिदभिश्रिषः पुरा जत्रुभ्य आतृदः । सन्धाता सन्धिं मघवा पुरूवसुर्निष्कर्ता विह्रुतं पुनः ॥२४४॥
translation: Come hither, Indra, with bay steeds, joyous, with tails like peacock’s plumes! Let no men check thy course as fowlers stay the bird: pass o’er them as o’er desert lands!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ त्वा सहस्रमा शतं युक्ता रथे हिरण्यये । ब्रह्मयुजो हरय इन्द्र केशिनो वहन्तु सोमपीतये ॥२४५॥
translation: Thou as a God, O mightiest, verily blessest mortal man. O Maghavan, there is no comforter but thou: Indra, I speak my words to thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ मन्द्रैरिन्द्र हरिभिर्याहि मयूररोमभिः । मा त्वा के चिन्नि येमुरिन्न पाशिनोऽति धन्वेव ताꣳ इहि ॥२४६॥
translation: O Indra, thou art far-renowned, impetuous Lord of power and might. Alone, the never-conquered guardian of mankind, thou smitest down resistless foes.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वमङ्ग प्र शꣳसिषो देवः शविष्ठ मर्त्यम् । न त्वदन्यो मघवन्नस्ति मर्डितेन्द्र ब्रवीमि ते वचः ॥२४७॥
translation: Indra for worship of the Gods, Indra while sacrifice proceeds, Indra, as warriors in the battle-shock, we call, Indra that we may win the spoil.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वमिन्द्र यशा अस्यृजीषी शवसस्पतिः । त्वं वृत्राणि हꣳस्यप्रतीन्येक इत्पुर्वनुत्तश्चर्षणीधृतिः ॥२४८॥
translation: May these my songs of praise exalt thee, Lord, who hast abundant wealth! Men skilled in holy hymns, pure, with the hues of fire, have sung them with their lauds to thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रमिद्देवतातय इन्द्रं प्रयत्यध्वरे । इन्द्रꣳ समीके वनिनो हवामह इन्द्रं धनस्य सातये ॥२४९॥
translation: These songs of ours exceeding sweet, these hymns of praise ascend to thee, Like ever-conquering chariots that display their strength gain wealth and give unfailing help.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इमा उ त्वा पुरूवसो गिरो वर्धन्तु या मम । पावकवर्णाः शुचयो विपश्चितोऽभि स्तोमैरनूषत ॥२५०॥
translation: Even as the wild-bull, when he thirsts, goes to the desert’s watery pool, Come to us quickly both at morning and at eve, and with the Kanvas drink thy fill!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उदु त्ये मधुमत्तमा गिर स्तोमास ईरते । सत्राजितो धनसा अक्षितोतयो वाजयन्तो रथा इव ॥२५१॥
translation: Indra, with all thy saving helps assist us, Lord of power and might! For after thee we follow even as glorious bliss, thee, hero, finderout of wealth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यथा गौरो अपा कृतं तृष्यन्नेत्यवेरिणम् । आपित्वे नः प्रपित्वे तूयमा गहि कण्वेषु सु सचा पिब ॥२५२॥
translation: O Indra, Lord of light, what joys thou broughtest from the Asuras, Prosper therewith, O Maghavan, him who lauds that deed, and those whose grass is trimmed for thee!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: शग्ध्यू३षु शचीपत इन्द्र विश्वाभिरूतिभिः । भगं न हि त्वा यशसं वसुविदमनु शूर चरामसि ॥२५३॥
translation: To Aryaman and Mitra sing a reverent song, O pious one, A pleasant hymn to Varuna who shelters us: sing ye a laud unto the Kings!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: या इन्द्र भुज आभरः स्वर्वाꣳ असुरेभ्यः । स्तोतारमिन्मघवन्नस्य वर्धय ये च त्वे वृक्तबर्हिषः ॥२५४॥
translation: Men with their lauds are urging thee, Indra, to drink the Soma first. The Ribhus in accord have lifted up their voice, and Rudras sung thee as the first.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र मित्राय प्रार्यम्णे सचथ्यमृतावसो । वरूथ्ये३ वरुणे छन्द्यं वचः स्तोत्रꣳ राजसु गायत ॥२५५॥
translation: Sing to your lofty Indra, sing, Maruts, a holy hymn of praise Let Satakratu, Vritra-slayer, slay the foe with hundred-knotted thunderbolt! 16
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभि त्वा पूर्वपीतय इन्द्र स्तोमेभिरायवः । समीचीनास ऋभवः समस्वरन्रुद्रा गृणन्त पूर्व्यम् ॥२५६॥
translation: To Indra sing the lofty hymn, Maruts! that slays the Vritras best, Whereby the holy ones created for the God the light divine that ever wakes.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र व इन्द्राय बृहते मरुतो ब्रह्मार्चत । वृत्रꣳ हनति वृत्रहा शतक्रतुर्वज्रेण शतपर्वणा ॥२५७॥
translation: O Indra, give us wisdom as a sire gives wisdom to his sons Guide us, O much-invoked, in this our way: may we still live and look upon the light!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: बृहदिन्द्राय गायत मरुतो वृत्रहन्तमम् । येन ज्योतिरजनयन्नृतावृधो देवं देवाय जागृवि ॥२५८॥
translation: O Indra, turn us not away: be present with us at our feast For thou art our protection, yea, thou art our kin: O Indra, turn us not away!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्र क्रतुं न आ भर पिता पुत्रेभ्यो यथा । शिक्षा णो अस्मिन्पुरुहूत यामनि जीवा ज्योतिरशीमहि ॥२५९॥
translation: We compass these like waters, we whose grass is trimmed and Soma pressed. Here where the filter pours its stream, thy worshippers round thee, O Vritra-slayer, sit.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मा न इन्द्र परा वृणग्भवा नः सधमाद्ये । त्वं न ऊती त्वमिन्न आप्यं मा न इन्द्र परा वृणक् ॥२६०॥
translation: All strength and valour that is found, Indra, in tribes of Nahushas, And all the splendid fame that the Five Tribes enjoy, bring, yea, all manly powers at once!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वयं घ त्वा सुतावन्त आपो न वृक्तबर्हिषः । पवित्रस्य प्रस्रवणेषु वृत्रहन्परि स्तोतार आसते ॥२६१॥
translation: Yea, verily thou art a Bull, our guardian, rushing like a bull: Thou, mighty one, art celebrated as a Bull, famed as a Bull both near and far.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यदिन्द्र नाहुषीष्वा ओजो नृम्णं च कृष्टिषु । यद्वा पञ्च क्षितीनां द्युम्नमा भर सत्रा विश्वानि पौꣳस्या ॥२६२॥
translation: Whether, O Sakra, thou be far, or, Vritra-slayer, near at hand, Thence by heaven-reaching songs he who bath pressed the juice invites thee with thy long- maned steeds.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सत्यमित्था वृषेदसि वृषजूतिर्नोऽविता । वृषा ह्युग्र शृण्विषे परावति वृषो अर्वावति श्रुतः ॥२६३॥
translation: In the wild raptures of the juice sing to your hero with high laud, to him the wise, To Indra glorious in his name, the mighty one, even as the hymn alloweth it!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यच्छक्रासि परावति यदर्वावति वृत्रहन् । अतस्त्वा गीर्भिर्द्युगदिन्द्र केशिभिः सुतावाꣳ आ विवासति ॥२६४॥
translation: O Indra, give us for our weal a triple refuge, triply strong! Bestow a dwelling-place on our rich lords and me, and keep thy dart afar from these!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभि वो वीरमन्धसो मदेषु गाय गिरा महा विचेतसम् । इन्द्रं नाम श्रुत्यꣳ शाकिनं वचो यथा ॥२६५॥
translation: Turning, as ‘twere, to meet the Sun enjoy from Indra all good things! When he who will be born is born with power we look to treasures as our heritage.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्र त्रिधातु शरणं त्रिवरूथꣳ स्वस्तये । छर्दिर्यच्छ मघवद्भ्यश्च मह्यं च यावया दिद्युमेभ्यः ॥२६६॥
translation: The godless mortal gaineth not this food, O thou whose life is long! But one who yokes the bright-hued horses, Etasas; then Indra yokes his tawny steeds.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: श्रायन्त इव सूर्यं विश्वेदिन्द्रस्य भक्षत । वसूनि जातो जनिमान्योजसा प्रति भागं न दीधिमः ॥२६७॥
translation: Draw near unto our Indra who must be invoked in every fight! Come, thou most mighty Vritra-slayer, meet for praise, come to, libations and to hymns!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: न सीमदेव आप तदिषं दीर्घायो मर्त्यः । एतग्वा चिद्य एतशो युयोजत इन्द्रो हरी युयोजते ॥२६८॥
translation: Thine, Indra, is the lowest wealth, thou cherishest the midmost wealth, Thou ever rulest all the highest: in the fray for cattle none resisteth thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ नो विश्वासु हव्यमिन्द्रꣳ समत्सु भूषत । उप ब्रह्माणि सवनानि वृत्रहन्परमज्या ऋचीषम ॥२६९॥
translation: Where art thou? Whither art thou gone? For many a place attracts thy mind. Haste, warrior, fort-destroyer, Lord of battle’s din! haste, holy songs have sounded forth!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तवेदिन्द्रावमं वसु त्वं पुष्यसि मध्यमम् । सत्रा विश्वस्य परमस्य राजसि न किष्ट्वा गोषु वृण्वते ॥२७०॥
translation: Here, verily, yesterday we let the thunder-wielder drink his fill. Bring him the juice poured forth in sacrifice to-day. Now range you by the glorious one!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: क्वेयथ क्वेदसि पुरुत्रा चिद्धि ते मनः । अलर्षि युध्म खजकृत्पुरन्दर प्र गायत्रा अगासिषुः ॥२७१॥
translation: He who as sovran Lord of men moves with his chariots unrestrained, The Vritra-slayer, vanquisher of fighting hosts, pre-eminent, is praised in song.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वयमेनमिदा ह्योपीपेमेह वज्रिणम् । तस्मा उ अद्य सवने सुतं भरा नूनं भूषत श्रुते ॥२७२॥
translation: Indra, give us security from that whereof we are afraid Help us, O Maghavan, let thy favour aid us thus; drive away foes and enemies!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यो राजा चर्षणीनां याता रथेभिरध्रिगुः । विश्वासां तरुता पृतनानां ज्येष्ठं यो वृत्रहा गृणे ॥२७३॥
translation: Strong pillar thou, Lord of the home! armour of Soma-offerers! The drop of Soma breaketh all the strongholds down, and Indra is the Rishis’ friend.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यत इन्द्र भयामहे ततो नो अभयं कृधि । मघवञ्छग्धि तव तन्न ऊतये वि द्विषो वि मृधो जहि ॥२७४॥
translation: Verily, Surya, thou art great; truly, Aditya, thou art great! O most admired for greatness of thy majesty, God, by thy greatness thou art great!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वास्तोष्पते ध्रुवा स्थूणाꣳ सत्रꣳ सोम्यानाम् । द्रप्सः पुरां भेत्ता शश्वतीनामिन्द्रो मुनीनाꣳ सखा ॥२७५॥
translation: Indra! thy friend, when fair of form and rich in chariots, steeds, and kine, Hath ever vital power that gives him strength, and joins the company with radiant men.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: बण्महाꣳ असि सूर्य बडादित्य महाꣳ असि । महस्ते सतो महिमा पनिष्टम मह्ना देव महाꣳ असि ॥२७६॥
translation: O Indra, if a hundred heavens and if a hundred earths were thine,-- No, not a hundred suns could match thee at thy birth, not both the worlds, O Thunderer!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अश्वी रथी सुरूप इद्गोमाꣳ यदिन्द्र ते सखा । श्वात्रभाजा वयसा सचते सदा चन्द्रैर्याति सभामुप ॥२७७॥
translation: Though, Indra, thou art called by men eastward and west ward, north and south, Thou chiefly art with Anava and Turvasa, brave champion urged by men to come. 17
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यद्द्याव इन्द्र ते शतꣳ शतं भूमीरुत स्युः । न त्वा वज्रिन्त्सहस्रꣳ सूर्या अनु न जातमष्ट रोदसी ॥२७८॥
translation: Indra whose wealth is in thyself, what mortal will attack this man? The strong will win the spoil on the decisive day through faith in thee, O Maghavan!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यदिन्द्र प्रागपागुदग्न्यग्वा हूयसे नृभिः । सिमा पुरू नृषूतो अस्यानवेऽसि प्रशर्ध तुर्वशे ॥२७९॥
translation: First, Indra! Agni! hath this Maid come footless unto those with feet. Stretching her head and speaking loudly with her tongue, she hath gone downward thirty steps.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: कस्तमिन्द्र त्वा वसवा मर्त्यो दधर्षति । श्रद्धा हि ते मघवन्पार्ये दिवि वाजी वाजꣳ सिषासति ॥२८०॥
translation: Come, Indra, very near to us with aids of firmly-based resolve Come, most auspicious, with thy most auspicious help; good kinsman, with good kinsmen come!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्राग्नी अपादियं पूर्वागात्पद्वतीभ्यः । हित्वा शिरो जिह्वया रारपच्चरत्त्रिꣳशत्पदा न्यक्रमीत् ॥२८१॥
translation: Call to your aid the eternal one who shoots and none may shoot at him, Inciter, swift, victorious, best of charioteers, unconquered, Tugriya’s strengthener!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्र नेदीय एदिहि मितमेधाभिरूतिभिः । आ शंतम शंतमाभिरभिष्टिभिरा स्वापे स्वापिभिः ॥२८२॥
translation: Let none, no, not thy worshippers, delay thee far away from us Even from faraway come thou unto our feast, or listen if’ already here!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इत ऊती वो अजरं प्रहेतारमप्रहितम् । आशुं जेतारꣳ हेतारꣳ रथीतममतूर्तं तुग्रियावृधम् ॥२८३॥
translation: For Indra Soma-drinker, armed with thunder, press the Soma juice; Make ready your dressed meats: cause him to favour us! The giver blesses him who gives.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मो षु त्वा वाघतश्च नारे अस्मन्नि रीरमन् । आरात्ताद्वा सधमादं न आ गहीह वा सन्नुप श्रुधि ॥२८४॥
translation: We call upon that Indra who, most active, ever slays the foe With boundless spirit, Lord of heroes, manliest one, help thou and prosper us in fight!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सुनोत सोमपाव्ने सोममिन्द्राय वज्रिणे । पचता पक्तीरवसे कृणुध्वमित्पृणन्नित्पृणते मयः ॥२८५॥
translation: Ye rich in strength, through your great power vouchsafe us blessings day and night! The offerings which we bring to you shall never fail gifts brought by us shall never fail.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यः सत्राहा विचर्षणिरिन्द्रं तꣳ हूमहे वयम् । सहस्रमन्यो तुविनृम्ण सत्पते भवा समत्सु नो वृधे ॥२८६॥
translation: Whenever mortal worshipper will sing a bounteous giver’s praise, Let him with song inspired laud Varuna who supports the folk who follow varied rites.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: शचीभिर्नः शचीवसू दिवा नक्तं दिशस्यतम् । मा वाꣳ रातिरुप दसत्कदाचनास्मद्रातिः कदाचन ॥२८७॥
translation: Drink milk to Indra in the joy of Soma juice, Medhyatithi! To golden Indra ever close to his bay steeds, the thunder-armed, the golden one!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यदा कदा च मीढुषे स्तोता जरेत मर्त्यः । आदिद्वन्देत वरुणं विपा गिरा धर्त्तारं विव्रतानाम् ॥२८८
translation: Both boons,-may Indra, hitherward turned listen to this prayer of ours, And mightiest Maghavar, with thought inclined to us come near to drink the Soma juice!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पाहि गा अन्धसो मद इन्द्राय मेध्यातिथे । यः सम्मिश्लो हर्योर्यो हिरण्यय इन्द्रो वज्री हिरण्ययः ॥२८९॥
translation: Not for an ample price dost thou, Stone-caster! give thyself away, Not for a thousand, Thunderer! nor ten thousand, nor a hundred, Lord of countless wealth!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उभयꣳ शृणवच्च न इन्द्रो अर्वागिदं वचः । सत्राच्या मघवान्त्सोमपीतये धिया शविष्ठ आ गमत् ॥२९०॥
translation: O Indra, thou art more to me than sire or niggard brother is. Thou and my mother, O good Lord, appear alike, to give me wealth abundantly. 18
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: महे च न त्वाद्रिवः परा शुल्काय दीयसे । न सहस्राय नायुताय वज्रिवो न शताय शतामघ ॥२९१॥
translation: These Soma juice mixt with curd have been expressed for Indra here: Come with thy bay steeds, Thunder-wielder, to our home, to drink them till they make thee glad!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वस्याꣳ इन्द्रासि मे पितुरुत भ्रातुरभुञ्जतः । माता च मे छदयथः समा वसो वसुत्वनाय राधसे ॥२९२
translation: Indra, these Somas with their lauds have been prepared for thy delight. Drink of the pleasant juice and listen to our songs; lover of song, reward the hymn!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इम इन्द्राय सुन्विरे सोमासो दध्याशिरः । ताꣳ आ मदाय वज्रहस्त पीतये हरिभ्यां याह्योक आ ॥२९३॥
translation: I call on thee, Sabardugha, this day, inspirer of the psalm. Indra, the richly-yielding milch-cow who provides unfailing food in ample stream.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इम इन्द्र मदाय ते सोमाश्चिकित्र उक्थिनः । मधोः पपान उप नो गिरः शृणु रास्व स्तोत्राय गिर्वणः ॥२९४
translation: Indra, the strong and lofty hills are powerless to bar thy way None stays that act of thine when thou wouldst fain give wealth to one like me who sings thy praise.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ त्वा३द्य सबर्दुघाꣳ हुवे गायत्रवेपसम् । इन्द्रं धेनुꣳ सुदुघामन्यामिषमुरुधारामरङ्कृतम् ॥२९५॥
translation: Who knows what vital power he wins, drinking beside the flowing juice? This is the fair-cheeked. God who, joying in the draught, breaks down the castles in his strength.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: न त्वा बृहन्तो अद्रयो वरन्त इन्द्र वीडवः । यच्छिक्षसि स्तुवते मावते वसु न किष्टदा मिनाति ते ॥२९६॥
translation: What time thou castest from his seat and punishest the riteless man, Strengthen for opulence, O Indra Maghavan, our plant desired by many a one!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: क ईं वेद सुते सचा पिबन्तं कद्वयो दधे । अयं यः पुरो विभिनत्त्योजसा मन्दानः शिप्र्यन्धसः ॥२९७॥
translation: Let Tvashtar, Brahmanaspati, Parjanya guard our heavenly word, Aditi with her sons, the brothers, guard for us the invincible, the saving word!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यदिन्द्र शासो अव्रतं च्यावया सदसस्परि । अस्माकमꣳशुं मघवन्पुरुस्पृहं वसव्ये अधि बर्हय ॥२९८
translation: Ne’er art thou fruitless, Indra, ne’er dost thou desert the worshipper: But now, O Maghavan, thy bounty as a God is poured forth ever more and more.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वष्टा नो दैव्यं वचः पर्जन्यो ब्रह्मणस्पतिः । पुत्रैर्भ्रातृभिरदितिर्नु पातु नो दुष्टरं त्रामणं वचः ॥२९९॥
translation: Best slayer of the Vritras, yoke thy bay steeds, Indra, far away Come with the high ones hither, Maghavan, to us, mighty, to, drink the Soma juice!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: कदा चन स्तरीरसि नेन्द्र सश्चसि दाशुषे । उपोपेन्नु मघवन्भूय इन्नु ते दानं देवस्य पृच्यते ॥३००॥
translation: O Thunderer, zealous worshippers gave thee drink this time yesterday: So, Indra, listen here to him who offers lauds: come near unto, our dwelling-place!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: युङ्क्ष्वा हि वृत्रहन्तम हरी इन्द्र परावतः । अर्वाचीनो मघवन्त्सोमपीतय उग्र ऋष्वेभिरा गहि ॥३०१॥
translation: Advancing, sending forth her rays, the daughter of the Sky is seen. The mighty one lays bare the darkness with her eye, the friendly Lady makes the light.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वामिदा ह्यो नरोऽपीप्यन्वज्रिन्भूर्णयः । स इन्द्र स्तोमवाहस इह श्रुध्युप स्वसरमा गहि ॥३०२॥
translation: These morning sacrifices call you, Asvins, at the break of day. For help have I invoked you rich in power and might: for, house by house, ye visit all.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्रत्यु अदर्श्यायत्यू३च्छन्ती दुहिता दिवः । अपो मही वृणुते चक्षुषा तमो ज्योतिष्कृणोति सूनरी ॥३०३॥
translation: Where are ye, Gods? What mortal man, O Asvins, glows with zeal for you, Urging you with the crushing stone and with the stalk of Soma thus or otherwise?
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इमा उ वां दिविष्टय उस्रा हवन्ते अश्विना । अयं वामह्वेऽवसे शचीवसू विशं विशꣳ हि गच्छथः ॥३०४
translation: This sweetest Soma juice hath been expressed for you at morning rites. Asvins, drink this prepared ere yesterday and give treasures to him who offers it!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: कुष्ठः को वामश्विना तपानो देवा मर्त्यः । घ्नता वामश्नया क्षपमाणोꣳशुनेत्थमु आद्वन्यथा ॥३०५
translation: Let me not, still beseeching thee with might and sound of Soma drops, Anger at sacrifice a fierce wild creature! Who would not beseech the almighty one!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अयं वां मधुमत्तमः सुतः सोमो दिविष्टिषु । तमश्विना पिबतं तिरोअह्न्यं धत्तꣳ रत्नानि दाशुषे ॥३०६॥
translation: Adhvaryu, let the Soma flow, for Indra longs to drink thereof. He even now hath yoked his vigorous bay steeds: the Vritraslayer hath come nigh.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ त्वा सोमस्य गल्दया सदा याचन्नहं ज्या । भूर्णिं मृगं न सवनेषु चुक्रुधं क ईशानं न याचिषत् ॥३०७॥
translation: Bring thou all this unto the good, O Indra, to the old and young! For, Maghavan, thou art rich in treasures from of old, to be invoked in every fight.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अध्वर्यो द्रावया त्वꣳ सोममिन्द्रः पिपासति । उपो नूनं युयुजे वृषणा हरी आ च जगाम वृत्रहा ॥३०८॥
translation: If I, O Indra, were the lord of riches ample as thine own, I would support the singer, God who scatterest wealth! and not abandon him to woe.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभीषतस्तदा भरेन्द्र ज्यायः कनीयसः । पुरूवसुर्हि मघवन्बभूविथ भरेभरे च हव्यः ॥३०९॥
translation: Thou in thy battles, Indra, art subduer of all hostile bands. Father art thou, all-conquering, cancelling the curse, thou victor of the vanquisher! 19
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यदिन्द्र यावतस्त्वमेतावदहमीशीय । स्तोतारमिद्दधिषे रदावसो न पापत्वाय रꣳसिषम् ॥३१०॥
