translation: For in thy might thou stretchest out beyond the mansions of the sky. The earthly region, Indra, comprehends thee not. Thou hast waxed mighty over all.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वमिन्द्र प्रतूर्तिष्वभि विश्वा असि स्पृधः । अशस्तिहा जनिता वृत्रतूरसि त्वं तूर्य तरुष्यतः ॥३११॥
translation: Pressed is the juice divine with milk commingled: thereto hath Indra ever been accustomed. We wake thee, Lord of bays, with sacrifices: mark this our laud in the wild joys of Soma!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र यो रिरिक्ष ओजसा दिवः सदोभ्यस्परि । न त्वा विव्याच रज इन्द्र पार्थिवमति विश्वं ववक्षिथ ॥३१२॥
translation: A home is made for thee to dwell in, Indra: O much-invoked one, with the men go thither! Thou, that thou mayest guard us and increase us, givest us wealth and joyest in the Somas.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: असावि देवं गोऋजीकमन्धो न्यस्मिन्निन्द्रो जनुषेमुवोच । बोधामसि त्वा हर्यश्व यज्ञैर्बोधा न स्तोममन्धसो मदेषु ॥३१३॥
translation: The well thou clavest, settest free the fountains, and gavest rest to floods that were obstructed. Thou, Indra, laying the great mountain open, slaying the Ddnava, didst loose the torrents.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: योनिष्ट इन्द्र सदने अकारि तमा नृभिः पुरूहूत प्र याहि । असो यथा नोऽविता वृधश्चिद्ददो वसूनि ममदश्च सोमैः ॥३१४॥
translation: When we have pressed the juice we laud thee, Indra, most valorous! even about to win the booty. Bring us prosperity, and by thy great wisdom, under thine own protection, may we conquer!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अदर्दरुत्समसृजो वि खानि त्वमर्णवान्बद्बधानाꣳ अरम्णाः । महान्तमिन्द्र पर्वतं वि यद्वः सृजद्धारा अव यद्दानवान्हन् ॥३१५॥
translation: Thy right hand have we grasped in ours, O Indra, longing, thou very Lord of wealth, for treasures. Because we know thee, hero, Lord of cattle: vouchsafe us mighty and resplendent riches!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सुष्वाणास इन्द्र स्तुमसि त्वा सनिष्यन्तश्चित्तुविनृम्ण वाजम् । आ नो भर सुवितं यस्य कोना तना त्मना सह्यामात्वोताः ॥३१६॥
translation: Men call on Indra in the armed encounter that he may make the hymns they sing decisive. Hero in combat and in love of glory, give us a portion of the stall of cattle!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: जगृह्मा ते दक्षिणमिन्द्र हस्तं वसूयवो वसुपते वसूनाम् । विद्मा हि त्वा गोपतिꣳ शूर गोनामस्मभ्यं चित्रं वृषणꣳ रयिं दाः ॥३१७॥
translation: Like birds of beauteous wing the Priyamedhas, Rishis, imploring, have come nigh to Indra. Dispel the darkness and fill full our vision: deliver us as men whom snares entangle!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रं नरो नेमधिता हवन्ते यत्पार्या युनजते धियस्ताः । शूरो नृषाता श्रवसश्च काम आ गोमति व्रजे भजा त्वं नः ॥३१८॥
translation: They gaze on thee with longing in their spirit, as on a strongwinged bird that mounteth sky-ward; On thee with wings of gold, Varuna’s envoy, the Bird that hasteneth to the home of Yama.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वयः सुपर्णा उप सेदुरिन्द्रं प्रियमेधा ऋषयो नाधमानाः । अप ध्वान्तमूर्णुहि पूर्धि चक्षुर्मुमुग्ध्या३स्मान्निधयेव बद्धान् ॥३१९॥
translation: First in the ancient time was Prayer engendered: Vena disclosed the bright ones from the summit, Laid bare this world’s lowest and highest regions, womb of the existent and the non-existent.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नाके सुपर्णमुप यत्पतन्तꣳ हृदा वेनन्तो अभ्यचक्षत त्वा । हिरण्यपक्षं वरुणस्य दूतं यमस्य योनौ शकुनं भुरण्युम् ॥३२०॥
translation: They have prepared and fashioned for this hero words never matched, most plentiful, most auspicious, For him the ancient, great, strong, energetic, the very mighty wielder of the thunder.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ब्रह्म जज्ञानं प्रथमं पुरस्ताद्वि सीमतः सुरुचो वेन आवः । स बुध्न्या उपमा अस्य विष्ठाः सतश्च योनिमसतश्च विवः ॥३२१॥
translation: The black drop sank in Ansumati’s bosom, advancing with ten thousand round about it. Indra with might longed for it as it panted: the hero-hearted King laid down his weapons.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अपूर्व्या पुरुतमान्यस्मै महे वीराय तवसे तुराय । विरप्शिने वज्रिणे शन्तमानि वचाꣳस्यस्मै स्थविराय तक्षुः ॥३२२॥
translation: Flying in terror from the snort of Vritra all deities who were thy friends forsook thee. So, Indra, with the Maruts be thy friendship: in all these battles thou shalt be the victor.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अव द्रप्सो अꣳशुमतीमतिष्ठदीयानः कृष्णो दशभिः सहस्रैः । आवत्तमिन्द्रः शच्या धमन्तमप स्नीहितिं नृमणा अधद्राः ॥३२३॥
translation: The old hath waked the young Moon from his slumber who runs his circling course with many round him. Behold the God’s high wisdom in its greatness: he who died yesterday to-day is living.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वृत्रस्य त्वा श्वसथादीषमाणा विश्वे देवा अजहुर्ये सखायः । मरुद्भिरिन्द्र सख्यं ते अस्त्वथेमा विश्वा: पृतना जयासि ॥३२४॥
translation: Then, at thy birth, thou wast the foeman, Indra, of those the seven who ne’er had met a rival. The hidden pair, heaven and the earth, thou foundest, and to the mighty worlds thou gavest pleasure.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विधुं दद्राणꣳ समने बहूनाꣳ युवानꣳ सन्तं पलितो जगार । देवस्य पश्य काव्यं महित्वाद्या ममार स ह्यः समान ॥३२५॥
translation: A friend we count thee, sharp-edged, thunder-wielder, Steer strong of body, overthrowing many. Thou, helping, causest pious tribes to conquer: Indra, I laud the, heavenly Vritra-slayer.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वꣳ ह त्यत्सप्तभ्यो जायमानोऽशत्रुभ्यो अभवः शत्रुरिन्द्र । गूढे द्यावापृथिवी अन्वविन्दो विभुमद्भ्यो भुवनेभ्यो रणं धाः ॥३२६॥
translation: Bring to the wise, the great, who waxeth mighty your offerings,. and make ready your devotion! Go forth to many tribes as man’s controller! 20
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मेडिं न त्वा वज्रिणं भृष्टिमन्तं पुरुधस्मानं वृषभꣳ स्थिरप्स्नुम् । करोष्यर्यस्तरुषीर्दुवस्युरिन्द्र द्युक्षं वृत्रहणं गृणीषे ॥३२७
translation: Call we on Maghavan, auspicious Indra, best hero in this fight where spoil is gathered, Strong, listening to give us aid in battles, who slays the Vritras, wins and gathers riches!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र वो महे महेवृधे भरध्वं प्रचेतसे प्र सुमतिं कृणुध्वम् । विशः पूर्वीः प्र चर चर्षणिप्राः ॥३२८॥
translation: Prayers have been offered up-through love of glory: Vasishtha, honour Indra in the battle! He who with fame extends through all existence hears words which I, his faithful servant, utter.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: शुनꣳ हुवेम मघवानमिन्द्रमस्मिन्भरे नृतमं वाजसातौ । शृण्वन्तमुग्रमूतये समत्सु घ्नन्तं वृत्राणि सञ्जितं धनानि ॥३२९॥
translation: May the sweet Soma juices make him happy to cast his quoit that lies in depth of waters! Thou from the udder which o’er earth is fastened hast poured the milk into the kine and herbage.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उदु ब्रह्माण्यैरत श्रवस्येन्द्रꣳ समर्ये महया वसिष्ठ । आ यो विश्वानि श्रवसा ततानोपश्रोता म ईवतो वचाꣳसि ॥३३०॥
translation: This vigorous one whom deities commission, the conqueror of cars, the strong and mighty, Swift, fleet to battle, with uninjured fellies, even Tarkshya for our weal will we call hither.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: चक्रं यदस्याप्स्वा निषत्तमुतो तदस्मै मध्विच्चच्छद्यात् । पृथिव्यामतिषितं यदूधः पयो गोष्वदधा ओषधीषु ॥३३१॥
translation: Indra the rescuer, Indra the helper, hero who listens at each invocation, Sakra I call, Indra invoked of many. May Indra Maghavan accept our presents!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्यमू षु वाजिनं देवजूतꣳ सहोवानं तरुतारं रथानाम् । अरिष्टनेमिं पृतनाजमाशुꣳ स्वस्तये तार्क्ष्यमिहा हुवेम ॥३३२॥
translation: Indra whose right hand wields the bolt we worship, driver of bay steeds seeking sundered courses. Shaking his beard with might he hath arisen, terrible with his weapons, with his bounty.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्रातारमिन्द्रमवितारमिन्द्रꣳ हवेहवे सुहवꣳ शूरमिन्द्रम् । हुवे नु शक्रं पुरुहूतमिन्द्रमिदꣳ हविर्मघवा वेत्विन्द्रः ॥३३३॥
translation: The ever-slaying, bold and furious Indra, the bright bolt’s Lord, the strong, the great, the boundless, Who slayeth Vritra and acquireth booty, giver of blessings, Maghavan the bounteous.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यजामह इन्द्रं वज्रदक्षिणꣳ हरीणाꣳ रथ्यां३विव्रतानाम् । प्र श्मश्रुभिर्दोधुवदूर्ध्वधा भुवद्वि सेनाभिर्भयमानो वि राधसा ॥३३४॥
translation: The man who lies in wait and fights against us, deeming himself a giant or a hero,-- By battle or with strength destroy him, Indra! With thy help, manly-souled! may we be victors!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सत्राहणं दाधृषिं तुम्रमिन्द्रं महामपारं वृषभꣳ सुवज्रम् । हन्ता यो वृत्रꣳ सनितोत वाजं दाता मघानि मघवा सुराधाः ॥३३५॥
translation: He whom men call when striving with their foemen, or speeding onward in array of battle, Whom bards incite where heroes win the booty, or in the way to waters, He is Indra.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यो नो वनुष्यन्नभिदाति मर्त उगणा वा मन्यमानस्तुरो वा । क्षिधी युधा शवसा वा तमिन्द्राभी ष्याम वृषमणस्त्वोताः ॥३३६
translation: On a high car, O Parvata and Indra, bring pleasant viands, with brave heroes, hither! Enjoy our presents, Gods, at sacrifices: wax strong by hymns, rejoice in our oblation!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यं वृत्रेषु क्षितय स्पर्धमाना यं युक्तेषु तुरयन्तो हवन्ते । यꣳ शूरसातौ यमपामुपज्मन्यं विप्रासो वाजयन्ते स इन्द्रः ॥३३७
translation: In ceaseless flow hath he poured forth his praises, as waters from the ocean’s depth, to Indra, Who to his car on both its sides securely hath fixed the earth and heaven as with an axle.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रापर्वता बृहता रथेन वामीरिष आ वहतꣳ सुवीराः । वीतꣳ हव्यान्यध्वरेषु देवा वर्धेथां गीर्भीरिडया मदन्ता ॥३३८॥
translation: May our friends turn thee hitherward to friendship! Mayst thou approach us even o’er many rivers! May the Disposer, radiant in this mansion with special lustre, bring the father’s offspring!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्राय गिरो अनिशितसर्गा अपः प्रैरयत्सगरस्य बुध्नात् । यो अक्षेणेव चक्रियौ शचीभिर्विष्वक्तस्तम्भ पृथिवीमुत द्याम् ॥३३९॥
translation: Who yokes to-day unto the pole of Order the strong and passionate steers of checkless spirit, Health-bringing, bearing in their mouths no fodder? Long shall he live who richly pays their service.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ त्वा सखायः सख्या ववृत्युस्तिरः पुरू चिदर्णवां जगम्याः । पितुर्नपातमा दधीत वेधा अस्मिन्क्षये प्रतरां दीद्यानः ॥३४०॥
translation: The singers hymn thee, they who chant the psalm of praise are lauding thee. The Brahmans have exalted thee, O Satakratu, like a pole.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: को अद्य युङ्क्ते धुरि गा ऋतस्य शिमीवतो भामिनो दुर्हृणायून् । आसन्नेषामप्सुवाहो मयोभून्य एषां भृत्यामृणधत्स जीवात् ॥३४१॥
translation: All sacred-songs have magnified Indra expansive as the sea, Best of all warriors borne on cars, the Lord of heroes, Lord of strength.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: गायन्ति त्वा गायत्रिणोऽर्चन्त्यर्कमर्किणः । ब्रह्माणस्त्वा शतक्रत उद्वꣳशमिव येमिरे ॥३४२॥
translation: This poured libation, Indra, drink, immortal, gladdening, excellent: Streams of the bright have flowed to thee here at the seat of holy Law.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रं विश्वा अवीवृधन्त्समुद्रव्यचसं गिरः । रथीतमꣳ रथीनां वाजानाꣳ सत्पतिं पतिम् ॥३४३॥
translation: Stone-darting Indra, wondrous God, what wealth thou hast not given me here, That bounty, treasure-finder! bring, filling full both thy hands, to us!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इममिन्द्र सुतं पिब ज्येष्ठममर्त्यं मदम् । शुक्रस्य त्वाभ्यक्षरन्धारा ऋतस्य सादने ॥३४४॥
translation: O Indra, hear Tiraschi’s call, the call of him who serveth thee! Satisfy him with wealth of kine and valiant offspring! Great art thou. 21
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यदिन्द्र चित्र म इह नास्ति त्वादातमद्रिवः । राधस्तन्नो विदद्वस उभयाहस्त्या भर ॥३४५॥
translation: This Soma hath been pressed for thee, O Indra: bold one, mightiest, come! May Indra-vigour fill thee full, as Surya fills mid-air with rays
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: श्रुधी हवं तिरश्च्या इन्द्र यस्त्वा सपर्यति । सुवीर्यस्य गोमतो रायस्पूर्धि महाꣳ असि ॥३४६॥
translation: Come hither, Indra, with thy bays, come thou to Kanva’s eulogy! Ye by command of yonder Dyaus, God bright by day! have gone to heaven.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: असावि सोम इन्द्र ते शविष्ठ धृष्णवा गहि । आ त्वा पृणक्त्विन्द्रियꣳ रजः सूर्यो न रश्मिभिः ॥३४७॥
translation: Song-lover! like a charioteer come songs to thee when Soma flows. Together, they have called to thee as mother-kine unto their calves.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एन्द्र याहि हरिभिरुप कण्वस्य सुष्टुतिम् । दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो ॥३४८॥
translation: Come now and let us glorify pure Indra with pure Sama hymn! Let milk-blent juice delight him made stronger with pure, pure songs of praise!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ त्वा गिरो रथीरिवास्थुः सुतेषु गिर्वणः । अभि त्वा समनूषत गावो वत्सं न धेनवः ॥३४९॥
translation: That which, most wealthy, makes you rich, in splendours most illustrious, Soma is pressed: thy gladdening drink, Indra libation’s Lord! is this.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एतो न्विन्द्रꣳ स्तवाम शुद्धꣳ शुद्धेन साम्ना । शुद्धैरुक्थैर्वावृध्वाꣳसꣳ शुद्धैराशीर्वान्ममत्तु ॥३५०॥
translation: Bring forth oblations to the God who knoweth all who fain would drink, The wanderer, lagging not behind the hero, coming nigh with speed!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यो रयिं वो रयिन्तमो यो द्युम्नैर्द्युम्नवत्तमः । सोमः सुतः स इन्द्र तेऽस्ति स्वधापते मदः ॥३५१॥
translation: To us the mighty, lying in all vital power, who resteth in the deep, who standeth in the east. Drive thou the awful word away.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्रत्यस्मै पिपीषते विश्वानि विदुषे भर । अरङ्गमाय जग्मयेऽपश्चादध्वने नरः ॥३५२॥
translation: Even as a car to give us aid, we draw thee nigh to favour us, Strong in thy deeds, quelling attack, Indra, Lord, mightiest! of the brave.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ नो वयोवयःशयं महान्तं गह्वरेष्ठां महान्तं पूर्विनेष्ठाम् । उग्रं वचो अपावधीः ॥३५३
translation: With powers of mighty ones hath he, the friend, the ancient, been equipped, Through whom our father Manu made prayers efficacious with the Gods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ त्वा रथं यथोतये सुम्नाय वर्तयामसि । तुविकूर्मिमृतीषहमिन्द्रꣳ शविष्ठ सत्पतिम् ॥३५४॥
translation: What time the swift and shining steeds, yoked to the chariots, draw them on, Drinking the sweet delightful juice, there men perform their glorious acts.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स पूर्व्यो महोनां वेनः क्रतुभिरानजे । यस्य द्वारा मनुः पिता देवेषु धिय आनजे ॥३५५॥
translation: Him for your sake I glorify as Lord of Strength who wrongeth none, Indra the hero, mightiest, all-conquering and omniscient.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यदी वहन्त्याशवो भ्राजमाना रथेष्वा । पिबन्तो मदिरं मधु तत्र श्रवाꣳसि कृण्वते ॥३५६
translation: I with my praise have glorified strong Dadhikravan, conquering steed Sweet may he make our mouths: may he prolong the days we have to live!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्यमु वो अप्रहणं गृणीषे शवसस्पतिम् । इन्द्रं विश्वासाहं नरꣳ शचिष्ठं विश्ववेदसम् ॥३५७॥
translation: Render of forts, the young, the wise, of strength unmeasured, was he born, Sustainer of each sacred rite, Indra, the Thunderer, much-extolled.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: दधिक्राव्णो अकारिषं जिष्णोरश्वस्य वाजिनः । सुरभि नो मुखा करत्प्र न आयूꣳषि तारिषत् ॥३५८॥
translation: Offer the triple sacred draught to Indu hero-worshipper! With hymn and plenty he invites you to complete the sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पुरां भिन्दुर्युवा कविरमितौजा अजायत । इन्द्रो विश्वस्य कर्मणो धर्त्ता वज्री पुरुष्टुतः ॥३५९॥
translation: Those whom they call the attendant pair of Kasyapa who knows the light, Lords of each holy duty when the wise have honoured sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्रप्र वस्त्रिष्टुभमिषं वन्दद्वीरायेन्दवे । धिया वो मेधसातये पुरन्ध्या विवासति ॥३६०॥
translation: Sing, sing ye forth your songs of praise, men, Priya-medhas, sing your songs: Yea, let young children sing their lauds: yea, glorify our firm stronghold!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: कश्यपस्य स्वर्विदो यावाहुः सयुजाविति । ययोर्विश्वमपि व्रतं यज्ञं धीरा निचाय्य ॥३६१
translation: To Indra must a laud be said, a joy to him who freely gives, That Sakra may be joyful in our friendship and the juice we pour.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अर्चत प्रार्चता नरः प्रियमेधासो अर्चत । अर्चन्तु पुत्रका उत पुरमिद्धृष्ण्वर्चत ॥३६२॥
translation: Your Lord of might that ne’er hath bent, that ruleth over all mankind, I call, that he, as he is wont, may aid the chariots and the men.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उक्थमिन्द्राय शꣳस्यं वर्धनं पुरुनिष्षिधे । शक्रो यथा सुतेषु नो रारणत्सख्येषु च ॥३६३॥
translation: Even he who is thine own, through thought of Heaven, of mortal man who toils, He with the help of lofty Dyaus comes safe through straits of enmity.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विश्वानरस्य वस्पतिमनानतस्य शवसः । एवैश्च चर्षणीनामूती हुवे रथानाम् ॥३६४॥
translation: Wide, Indra Satakratu, spreads the bounty of thine ample grace: So, good and liberal giver, known to all men, send us splendid wealth!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स घा यस्ते दिवो नरो धिया मर्तस्य शमतः । ऊती स बृहतो दिवो द्विषो अꣳहो न तरति ॥३६५॥
translation: Bright Ushas, when thy times return, all quadrupeds and bipeds stir, And round about flock winged birds from all the boundaries of heaven.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विभोष्ट इन्द्र राधसो विभ्वी रातिः शतक्रतो । अथा नो विश्वचर्षणे द्युम्नꣳ सुदत्र मꣳहय ॥३६६॥
translation: Ye Gods who yonder have your home amid the luminous realm of heaven, What count ye right? what endless life? What is the ancient call on you?
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वयश्चित्ते पतत्रिणो द्विपाच्चतुष्पादर्जुनि । उषः प्रारन्नृतूꣳरनु दिवो अन्तेभ्यस्परि ॥३६७॥
translation: We offer laud and psalm wherewith men celebrate their holy rites. They govern at the sacred place and bear the sacrifice to Gods. 22
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अमी ये देवा स्थन मध्य आ रोचने दिवः । कद्ध ऋतं कदमृतं का प्रत्ना व आहुतिः ॥३६८॥
translation: Heroes of one accord brought forth and formed for kingship Indra who wins the victory in all encounters, For power, in firmness, in the field, the great destroyer, fierce and exceeding strong,rstalwart and full of vigour.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ऋचꣳ साम यजामहे याभ्यां कर्माणि कृण्वते । वि ते सदसि राजतो यज्ञं देवेषु वक्षतः ॥३६९॥
translation: I trust in thy first wrathful deed, O Indra, when thou slewest Vritra and didst work to profit man; When the two world-halves fled for refuge unto thee, and earth even trembled at thy strength, O Thunder-armed!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विश्वाः पृतना अभिभूतरं नरः सजूस्ततक्षुरिन्द्रं जजनुश्च राजसे । क्रत्वे वरे स्थेमन्यामुरीमुतोग्रमोजिष्ठं तरसं तरस्विनम् ॥३७०॥
translation: Come all with might together to the Lord of heaven, the only one who is indeed the guestof men. He is the first: to him who fain would come to us all pathways turn; he is in truth the only one.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: श्रत्ते दधामि प्रथमाय मन्यवेऽहन्यद्दस्युं नर्यं विवेरपः । उभे यत्वा रोदसी धावतामनु भ्यसाते शुष्मात्पृथिवी चिदद्रिवः ॥३७१॥
translation: Thine, Indra, praised of many, excellently rich, are we who trusting in thy help draw near to thee. For none but thou, song-lover, shall receive our lauds: as Earth loves all her creatures, welcome this our hymn!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: समेत विश्वा ओजसा पतिं दिवो य एक इद्भूरतिथिर्जनानाम् । स पूर्व्यो नूतनमाजिगीषन् तं वर्त्तनीरनु वावृत एक इत् ॥३७२॥
translation: High hymns have sounded forth the praise of Maghavan, supporter of mankind, of Indra meet for lauds; Him who hath waxen mighty, much-invoked with prayers, immortal one whose praise each day is sung aloud.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इमे त इन्द्र ते वयं पुरुष्टुत ये त्वारभ्य चरामसि प्रभूवसो । न हि त्वदन्यो गिर्वणो गिरः सघत्क्षोणीरिव प्रति तद्धर्य नो वचः ॥३७३॥
translation: In perfect unison have all your longing hymns that find the light of heaven sounded forth Indra’s praise. As wives embrace their lord, the comely bridegroom, so they compass Maghavan about that he may help.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: चर्षणीधृतं मघवानमुक्थ्या३मिन्द्रं गिरो बृहतीरभ्यनूषत । वावृधानं पुरुहूतꣳ सुवृक्तिभिरमर्त्यं जरमाणं दिवेदिवे ॥३७४॥
translation: Make glad with songs that Ram whom many men invoke, worthy hymns of praise, Indra the sea of wealth; Whose boons spread like the heavens, the - lover of mankind: sing praise to him the Sage, most liberal for our good!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अच्छा व इन्द्रं मतयः स्वर्युवः सध्रीचीर्विश्वा उशतीरनूषत । परि ष्वजन्त जनयो यथा पतिं मर्यं न शुन्ध्युं मघवानमूतये ॥३७५॥
translation: I glorify that Ram who finds the light of heaven, whose hundred strong and mighty ones go forth with him. With prayers may I turn hither Indra to mine aid;-the car which like a swift steed hasteth to the call!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभि त्यं मेषं पुरुहूतमृग्मियमिन्द्रं गीर्भिर्मदता वस्वो अर्णवम् । यस्य द्यावो न विचरन्ति मानुषं भुजे मꣳहिष्ठमभि विप्रमर्चत ॥३७६॥
translation: Filled full of fatness, compassing all things that be, wide, spacious, dropping meath, beautiful in their form, The heaven and the earth by Varuna’s decree, unwasting, rich in germs, stand parted each from each.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्यꣳसु मेषं महया स्वर्विदꣳ शतं यस्य सुभुवः साकमीरते । अत्यं न वाजꣳ हवनस्यदꣳ रथमिन्द्रं ववृत्यामवसे सुवृक्तिभिः ॥३७७॥
translation: As like the Morning, thou hast filled, O Indra, both the earth. and heaven, So as the mighty one, great King of all the mighty race of men, the Goddess mother brought thee forth, the blessed mother gave thee life.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: घृतवती भुवनानामभिश्रियोर्वी पृथ्वी मधुदुघे सुपेशसा । द्यावापृथिवी वरुणस्य धर्मणा विष्कभिते अजरे भूरिरेतसा ॥३७८॥
translation: Sing, with oblation, praise to him who maketh glad, who with. Rijisvan drove the dusky brood away! Let us, desiring help, call him for friendship, him the strong, the Marut-girt, whose right hand wields the bolt! I. When Somas flow thou makest pure, Indra, thy mind that merits laud For gain of strength that ever grows: for great is he. 23
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उभे यदिन्द्र रोदसी आपप्राथोषा इव । महान्तं त्वा महीनाꣳ सम्राजं चर्षणीनाम् । देवी जनित्र्यजीजनद्भद्रा जनित्र्यजीजनत् ॥३७९॥
translation: Sing forth to him whom many men invoke, to him whom many laud: Invite the potent Indra with your songs of praise
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र मन्दिने पितुमदर्चता वचो यः कृष्णगर्भा निरहन्नृजिश्वना । अवस्यवो वृषणं वज्रदक्षिणं मरुत्वन्तꣳ सख्याय हुवेमहि ॥३८०॥
translation: We sing this strong and wild delight of thine which conquer; in the fray, Which, Caster of the Stone! gives room and shines like gold,
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्र सुतेषु सोमेषु क्रतुं पुनीष उक्थ्यम् । विदे वृधस्य दक्षस्य महाꣳ हि षः ॥३८१॥
translation: Whether thou drink the Soma by Vishnu’s or Trita Aptya’s side, Or with the Maruts, Indra! quaff the following drops.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तमु अभि प्र गायत पुरुहूतं पुरुष्टुतम् । इन्द्रं गीर्भिस्तविषमा विवासत ॥३८२॥
translation: Come, priest, and of the savoury juice pour forth a yet more gladdening draught: So is the hero praised who ever prospers us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तं ते मदं गृणीमसि वृषणं पृक्षु सासहिम् । उ लोककृत्नुमद्रिवो हरिश्रियम् ॥३८३॥
translation: Pour out the drops for Indra; let him drink the meath of Soma juice! He through his majesty sends forth his bounteous gifts.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यत्सोममिन्द्र विष्णवि यद्वा घ त्रित आप्त्ये । यद्वा मरुत्सु मन्दसे समिन्दुभिः ॥३८४॥
translation: Come, sing we praise to Indra, friends! the hero who deserves the laud, Him who with none to aid o’ercomes all tribes of men.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एदु मधोर्मदिन्तरꣳ सिञ्चाध्वर्यो अन्धसः । एवा हि वीरस्तवते सदावृधः ॥३८५॥
translation: Sing ye a psalm to Indra, sing a great song to the lofty Sage, To him who maketh prayer, inspired who loveth laud!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एन्दुमिन्द्राय सिञ्चत पिबाति सोम्यं मधु । प्र राधाꣳसि चोदयते महित्वना ॥३८६॥
translation: He who alone bestoweth wealth on mortal man who offereth gifts Is Indra only, potent Lord whom none resist.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एतो न्विन्द्रꣳ स्तवाम सखायः स्तोम्यं नरम् । कृष्टीर्यो विश्वा अभ्यस्त्येक इत् ॥३८७॥
translation: Companions, let us learn a prayer to Indra, to the Thunderer, To glorify your bold and most heroic friend! 24
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्राय साम गायत विप्राय बृहते बृहत् । ब्रह्मकृते विपश्चिते पनस्यवे ॥३८८॥
translation: Indra, this might of thine I praise most highly for the sacrifice That thou, O Lord of Power, dost slay Vritra with might
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: य एक इद्विदयते वसु मर्ताय दाशुषे । ईशानो अप्रतिष्कुत इन्द्रो अङ्ग ॥३८९॥
translation: For thee this Soma hath been pressed, in whose wild joy thou madest once Sambara Divodasa’s prey: O Indra, drink!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सखाय आ शिषामहे ब्रह्मेन्द्राय वज्रिणे । स्तुष ऊ षु वो नृतमाय धृष्णवे ॥३९०॥
translation: Come unto us, O Indra, dear, still conquering, unconcealable! Wide as a mountain spread on all sides, Lord of heaven!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: गृणे तदिन्द्र ते शव उपमां देवतातये । यद्धꣳसि वृत्रमोजसा शचीपते ॥३९१॥
translation: Joy, mightiest Indra, that perceives, sprung from deep Soma draughts, whereby Thou smitest down the greedy fiend,-that joy we crave!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यस्य त्यच्छम्बरं मदे दिवोदासाय रन्धयन् । अयꣳ स सोम इन्द्र ते सुतः पिब ॥३९२॥
translation: Adityas, very mighty ones, grant to our children and our seed This lengthened term of life that they may live long days!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एन्द्र नो गधि प्रिय सत्राजिदगोह्य । गिरिर्न विश्वतः पृथुः पतिर्दिवः ॥३९३॥
translation: Though knowest, Indra, Thunder-armed! how to avoid destructive powers, As one secure from pitfalls each returning day.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: य इन्द्र सोमपातमो मदः शविष्ठ चेतति । येना हꣳसि न्या३त्रिणं तमीमहे ॥३९४॥
translation: Drive ye disease and strife away, drive ye away malignity: Adityas, keep us far removed from sore distress!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तुचे तुनाय तत्सु नो द्राघीय आयुर्जीवसे । आदित्यासः समहसः कृणोतन ॥३९५॥
translation: Drive Soma, Indra, Lord of bays! and let it cheer thee: the stone, like a well-guided courser,
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वेत्था हि निरृतीनां वज्रहस्त परिवृजम् । अहरहः शुन्ध्युः परिपदामिव ॥३९६॥
translation: Still, Indra, from all ancient time rivalless ever and companionless art thou: Thou seekest friendship but in war.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अपामीवामप स्रिधमप सेधत दुर्मतिम् । आदित्यासो युयोतना नो अꣳहसः ॥३९७॥
translation: Him who of old hath broucht to us this and that blessing, him I magnify for you, Even Indra, O my friends, for help.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पिबा सोममिन्द्र मन्दतु त्वा यं ते सुषाव हर्यश्वाद्रिः । सोतुर्बाहुभ्याꣳ सुयतो नार्वा ॥३९८॥
translation: Fail not when marching onward: come hither, like-spirited, stay not far away Ye who can tame even what is firm!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभ्रातृव्यो अना त्वमनापिरिन्द्र जनुषा सनादसि । युधेदापित्वमिच्छसे ॥३९९॥
translation: Come hither to the dropping juice, O Lord of cornland. Lord of horses, Lord of kine: Drink thou the Soma, Soma’s Lord!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यो न इदमिदं पुरा प्र वस्य आनिनाय तमु व स्तुषे । सखाय इन्द्रमूतये ॥४००॥
translation: Hero, may we, with thee for friend, withstand the man who pants against us in his wrath, In fight with people rich in kine!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ गन्ता मा रिषण्यत प्रस्थावानो माप स्थात समन्यवः । दृढा चिद्यमयिष्णवः ॥४०१॥
translation: Yea, kin by common ancestry, the Maruts, even the oxen, close united friends! Are licking one another’s back.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ याह्ययमिन्दवेऽश्वपते गोपत उर्वरापते । सोमꣳ सोमपते पिब ॥४०२॥
translation: O Indra, bring great strength to us, bring valour, Satakratu, thou most active, bring A hero conquering in war!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वया ह स्विद्युजा वयं प्रति श्वसन्तं वृषभ ब्रुवीमहि । सꣳस्थे जनस्य गोमतः ॥४०३॥
translation: So, Indra, friend of song, do we draw nigh to thee with longing; we have streamed to thee Coming like floods that follow floods
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: गावश्चिद्घा समन्यवः सजात्येन मरुतः सबन्धवः । रिहते ककुभो मिथः ॥४०४॥
translation: Sitting like birds beside thy meath, mingled with milk, which gladdeneth and exalteth thee, Indra, to thee we sing aloud.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वं न इन्द्रा भर ओजो नृम्णꣳ शतक्रतो विचर्षणे । आ वीरं पृतनासहम् ॥४०५॥
translation: We call on thee, O matchless one! We, seeking help, possessing nothing firm ourselves, Call on thee, wondrous, Thunder-armed.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अधा हीन्द्र गिर्वण उप त्वा काम ईमहे ससृग्महे । उदेव ग्मन्त उदभिः ॥४०६॥
translation: The juice of Soma thus diffused, sweet to the taste the bright cows drink, Who travelling in splendour close to mighty Indra’s side rejoice, good in their own supremacy. 25
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सीदन्तस्ते वयो यथा गोश्रीते मधौ मदिरे विवक्षणे । अभि त्वामिन्द्र नोनुमः ॥४०७॥
translation: Thus hath the Soma, gladdening draught, produced the prayer that giveth joy: Thou, mightiest, Thunder-armed, hast driven by force the Dragon from the earth, lauding thine own supremacy.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वयमु त्वामपूर्व्य स्थूरं न कच्चिद्भरन्तोऽवस्यवः । वज्रिञ्चित्रꣳ हवामहे ॥४०८॥
translation: By men hath Indra been advanced, the Vritra-slayer, to joy and strength. Him only we invoke for help in battles whether great or small: be he our aid in deeds of might!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स्वादोरित्था विषूवतो मधोः पिबन्ति गौर्यः । या इन्द्रेण सयावरीर्वृष्णा मदन्ति शोभथा वस्वीरनु स्वराज्यम् ॥४०९॥
translation: Unconquered strength is only thine, Indra, Stonecaster, Thunder-armed! When thou with thy surpassing power smotest to death that guileful beast, lauding thine own supremacy.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इत्था हि सोम इन्मदो ब्रह्म चकार वर्धनम् । शविष्ठ वज्रिन्नोजसा पृथिव्या निः शशा अहिमर्चन्ननु स्वराज्यम् ॥४१०॥
translation: Go forward, meet the foe, be bold; thy bolt of thunder is not checked! Manliness, Indra, is thy strength. Slay Vritra, make the waters thine, lauding thine own supremacy!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रो मदाय वावृधे शवसे वृत्रहा नृभिः । तमिन्महत्स्वाजिषूतिमर्भे हवामहे स वाजेषु प्र नोऽविषत् ॥४११॥
translation: When war and battles are on foot, booty is offered to the bold. Yoke thou thy wildly-rushing bays. Whom wilt thou slay, and whom enrich? Do thou, O Indra, make us rich!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्र तुभ्यमिदद्रिवोऽनुत्तं वज्रिन्वीर्यम् । यद्ध त्यं मायिनं मृगं तव त्यन्माययावधीरर्चन्ननु स्वराज्यम् ॥४१२॥
translation: Wcll have they eaten and rejoiced; the friends have risen and passed away: The sages luminous in themselves have praised thee with their latest hymn. Now, Indra, yoke thy two bay steeds!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्रेह्यभीहि धृष्णुहि न ते वज्रो नि यꣳसते । इन्द्र नृम्णꣳहि ते शवो हनो वृत्रं जया अपोऽर्चन्ननु स्वराज्यम् ॥४१३॥
translation: Graciously listen to our songs. Maghavan, be not negligent! When wilt thou make us glorious? Make this, only this thine end and aim. Now, Indra! yoke thy two bay steeds.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यदुदीरत आजयो धृष्णवे धीयते धनम् । युङ्क्ष्वा मदच्युता हरी कꣳ हनः कं वसौ दधोऽस्माꣳ इन्द्र वसौ दधः ॥४१४॥
translation: Within the waters runs the Moon, he with the beauteous wings in heaven. Ye lightnings with your golden wheels, men find not your abiding-place. Mark this my woe, ye Earth and Sky!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अक्षन्नमीमदन्त ह्यव प्रिया अधूषत । अस्तोषत स्वभानवो विप्रा नविष्ठया मती योजा न्विन्द्र ते हरी ॥४१५॥
translation: To meet your treasure-bringing car, the mighty car most dear to us. Asvins, the Rishi is prepared, your worshipper, with songs of praise. Lovers of sweetness, hear my call!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उपो षु शृणुही गिरो मघवन्मातथा इव । कदा नः सूनृतावतः कर इदर्थयास इद्योजा न्विन्द्र ते हरी ॥४१६॥
translation: O Agni, God, we kindle thee, refulgent, wasting not away, That this more glorious fuel may send forth for thee its shine to heaven. Bring food to those who sing thy praise!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: चन्द्रमा अप्स्वा३न्तरा सुपर्णो धावते दिवि । न वो हिरण्यनेमयः पदं विन्दन्ति विद्युतो वित्तं मे अस्य रोदसी ॥४१७॥
translation: With offerings of our own we choose thee, Agni, as our Hotar priest, Piercing and brightly shining-at your glad carouse-served with trimmed grass at sacrifice. Thou waxest great.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्रति प्रियतमꣳ रथं वृषणं वसुवाहनम् । स्तोता वामश्विनावृषि स्तोमेभिर्भूषति प्रति माध्वी मम श्रुतꣳ हवम् ॥४१८॥
translation: O heavenly Dawn, awaken us to ample opulence to-day, Even as thou didst waken us with Satyasravas, Vayya’s son, high born! delightful with thy steeds!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ ते अग्न इधीमहि द्युमन्तं देवाजरम् । युद्ध स्या ते पनीयसी समिद्दीदयति द्यवीषꣳ स्तोतृभ्य आ भर ॥४१९॥
translation: Send us a mind that brings delight, send energy and mental power. Then-at your glad carouse-let men joy in thy love, sweet juice! as kine in pasturage. Thou waxest great,
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आग्निं न स्ववृक्तिभिर्होतारं त्वा वृणीमहे । शीरं पावकशोचिषं वि वो मदे यज्ञेषु स्तीर्णबर्हिषं विवक्षसे ॥४२०॥
translation: Great, as his nature is, through power, terrible, he hath waxed in strength, Lord of bay steeds, strong-jawed, sublime, he in joined hands for glory’s sake hath grasped his iron thunderbolt.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: महे नो अद्य बोधयोषो राये दिवित्मती । यथा चिन्नो अबोधयः सत्यश्रवसि वाय्ये सुजाते अश्वसूनृते ॥४२१॥
translation: He, Indra, verily will mount the powerful car that finds the kine, Who thinks upon the well-filled bowl, the tawny coursers’ harnesser. Now, Indra, yoke thy two bay steeds!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: भद्रं नो अपि वातय मनो दक्षमुत क्रतुम् । अथा ते सख्ये अन्धसो वि वो मदे रणा गावो न यवसे विवक्षसे ॥४२२॥
translation: I think of Agni who is kind, whom, as their home, the milch-kine seek: Whom fleet-foot coursers seek as home, and strong enduring steeds as home. Bring food to those who sing thy praise! 26
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: क्रत्वा महाꣳ अनुष्वधं भीम आ वावृते शवः । श्रिय ऋष्व उपाकयोर्नि शिप्री हरिवान् दधे हस्तयोर्वज्रमायसम् ॥४२३॥
translation: No peril, no severe distress, ye Gods, affects the mortal man Whom Aryaman and Mitra lead, and Varuna, of one accord, beyond his foes.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स घा तं वृषणꣳ रथमधि तिष्ठाति गोविदम् । यः पात्रꣳ हारियोजनं पूर्णमिन्द्र चिकेतति योजा न्विन्द्र ते हरी ॥४२४॥
translation: Flow forth, O Soma, flow thou onward, sweet to Indra’s Mitra’s, Pushan’s, Bhaga’s taste.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्निं तं मन्ये यो वसुरस्तं यं यन्ति धेनवः । अस्तमर्वन्त आशवोऽस्तं नित्यासो वाजिन इषꣳ स्तोतृभ्य आ भर ॥४२५॥
translation: Run forth to battle, conquering the Vritras; thou speedest to quell the foes like one exacting debts.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: न तमꣳहो न दुरितं देवासो अष्ट मर्त्यम् । सजोषसो यमर्यमा मित्रो नयति वरुणो अति द्विषः ॥४२६॥
translation: Flow onward, Soma, as a mighty sea, as Father of the Gods, to every form.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: परि प्र धन्वेन्द्राय सोम स्वादुर्मित्राय पूष्णे भगाय ॥४२७॥
translation: Flow onward, Soma, flow for mighty strength, as a strong courser, bathed, to win the prize.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पर्यू षु प्र धन्व वाजसातये परि वृत्राणि सक्षणिः । द्विषस्तरध्या ऋणया न ईरसे ॥४२८॥
translation: Fair Indu hath flowed on for rapturous joy, sage, for good fortune, in the waters’ lap.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवस्व सोम महान्त्समुद्रः पिता देवानां विश्वाभि धाम ॥४२९॥
translation: In thee, effused. O Soma, we rejoice ourselves for great supremacy in fight: Thou, Pavamana, enterest into mighty deeds.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवस्व सोम महे दक्षायाश्वो न निक्तो वाजी धनाय ॥४३०॥
translation: Who are these radiant men in serried rank, Rudra’s young heroes, too, with noble steeds?
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्दुः पविष्ट चारुर्मदायापामुपस्थे कविर्भगाय ॥४३१॥
translation: Agni, with hymns may we now accomplish that which thou lovest, Strength, like a horse, auspicious strength with service.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अनु हि त्वा सुतꣳ सोम मदामसि महे समर्यराज्ये । वाजाꣳ अभि पवमान प्र गाहसे ॥४३२॥
translation: The strong youths have come forth to view, to show their strength, God Savitar’s quickening energy: Ye warrior horsemen, win the heavens.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: क ईं व्यक्ता नरः सनीडा रुद्रस्य मर्या अथा स्वश्वाः ॥४३३॥
translation: Soma, flow splendid with thy copious stream in due succession through the ample fleece.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्ने तमद्याश्वं न स्तोमैः क्रतुं न भद्रꣳ हृदिस्पृशम् । ऋध्यामा त ओहैः ॥४३४॥
translation: Giver from all sides, bring to us from every side, thou whom as strongest we entreat!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आविर्मर्या आ वाजं वाजिनो अग्मन् देवस्य सवितुः सवम् । स्वर्गाꣳ अर्वन्तो जयत ॥४३५
translation: This Brahman, comer at due time, named Indra, is renowned and praised.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवस्व सोम द्युम्नी सुधारो महाꣳ अवीनामनुपूर्व्यः ॥४३६॥
translation: The Brahmans with their hymns exalting Indra increased his strength that he might slaughter Ahi.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विश्वतोदावन्विश्वतो न आ भर यं त्वा शविष्ठमीमहे ॥४३७
translation: Anavas wrought a chariot for thy courser, and Tvashtar, much-invoked! the bolt that gitters:
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एष ब्रह्मा य ऋत्विय इन्द्रो नाम श्रुतो गृणे ॥४३८॥
translation: Rest, wealth to him who longs for wealth! the riteless stirs not his love nor wins his way to riches.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ब्रह्माण इन्द्रं महयन्तो अर्कैरवर्धयन्नहये हन्तवा उ ॥४३९॥
translation: The cows are ever pure and all-supporting, the Gods are ever free from stain and blemish.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अनवस्ते रथमश्वाय तक्षुस्त्वष्टा वज्रं पुरुहूत द्युमन्तम् ॥४४०॥
translation: With all thy beauty come! The kine approaching with full udders follow on thy path.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: शं पदं मघꣳ रयीषिणे न काममव्रतो हिनोति न स्पृशद्रयिम् ॥४४१
translation: May we, inhabiting a meath-rich dwelling, increase our wealth, and think of thee, O Indra!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सदा गावः शुचयो विश्वधायसः सदा देवा अरेपसः ॥४४२
translation: The Maruts with fair hymns chant out their praise-song: this Indra, famed and youthful, shouts accordant.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ याहि वनसा सह गाव सचन्त वर्तनिं यदूधभिः ॥४४३॥
translation: Sing to your Indra, mightiest Vritra-slayer, sing to the Sage the song that he accepteth!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उप प्रक्षे मधुमति क्षियन्तः पुष्येम रयिं धीमहे त इन्द्र ॥४४४॥
translation: Observant Agni hath appeared, oblation-bearer with his car.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अर्चन्त्यर्कं मरुतः स्वर्का आ स्तोभति श्रुतो युवा स इन्द्रः ॥४४५॥
translation: O Agni, be our nearest friend, yea, our protector and our kind deliverer!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र व इन्द्राय वृत्रहन्तमाय विप्राय गाथं गायत यं जुजोषते ॥४४६॥
translation: Like wondrous Bhaga, Agni deals treasure among the mighty.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अचेत्यग्निश्चिकितिर्हव्यवाड्न सुमद्रथः ॥४४७॥
translation: Far off or present even now, send forth thy shouting first of all!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्ने त्वं नो अन्तम उत त्राता शिवो भुवो वरूथ्यः ॥४४८॥
translation: Dawn drives away her sister’s gloom, and through her excellence makes her retrace her path.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: भगो न चित्रो अग्निर्महोनां दधाति रत्नम् ॥४४९
translation: May we, with Indra and the Gods to aid us, bring these existing worlds to full completion!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विश्वस्य प्र स्तोभ पुरो वा सन्यदि वेह नूनम् ॥४५०
translation: Like streams of water on their way, let bounties, Indra, flow from thee!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उषा अप स्वसुष्टमः सं वर्त्तयति वर्तनिꣳ सुजातता ॥४५१
translation: With this may we obtain strength god-appointed, happy with brave sons through a hundred winters!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इमा नु कं भुवना सीषधेमेन्द्रश्च विश्वे च देवाः ॥४५२॥
translation: With strength let Mitra, Varuna swell oblations; do thou prepare for us rich food, O Indra!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वि स्रुतयो यथा पथ इन्द्र त्वद्यन्तु रातयः ॥४५३॥
translation: Indra is King of all the world. 27
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अया वाजं देवहितꣳ सनेम मदेम शतहिमाः सुवीराः ॥४५४॥
translation: At the Trikadrukas the great and strong enjoyed the barley-brew. With Vishnu did he drink the pressed-out Soma juice, even as he would. That hath so heightened him the great, the wide to do his mighty work. So did the God attend the God, true Indu Indra who is true.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ऊर्जा मित्रो वरुणः पिन्वतेडाः पीवरीमिषं कृणुही न इन्द्र ॥४५५
translation: This God who sees for thousands of mankind, the light, the thought of poets, and the Law, The brilliant one, hath sent forth hither all the Dawns: spotless, one-minded, zealous in their home they dwell, with thought upon the Steer.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रो विश्वस्य राजति ॥४५६॥
translation: Come to us, Indra, from afar, conducting us, as, to the gatherings, a Lord of heroes, as an archer King, the heroes’ Lord! We come with gifts of pleasant food, with flowing juice, invoking thee, as sons invite a sire, that we may win the spoil, thee, bounteousest, for gain of spoil.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्रिकद्रुकेषु महिषो यवाशिरं तुविशुष्मस्तृम्पत्सोममपिबद्विष्णुना सुतं यथावशम् । स ईं ममाद महि कर्म कर्त्तवे महामुरुꣳ सैनꣳ सश्चद्देवो देवꣳ सत्य इन्दुः सत्यमिन्द्रम् ॥४५७॥
translation: Loudly I call that Indra Maghavan, the mighty, resistless, evermore possessing many glories. Holy, most liberal, may he lead us on to riches, through songs, and, thunder-armed make all our pathways pleasant!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अयꣳ सहस्रमानवो दृशः कवीनां मतिर्ज्योतिर्विधर्म । ब्रध्नः समीचीरुषसः समैरयदरेपसः सचेतसः स्वसरे मन्युमन्तश्चिता गोः ॥४५८॥
translation: Heard be our prayer! In thought I honour Agni first: now straightway we elect this heavenly company, Indra and Vayu we elect. For when our latest thought is raised and on Vivasvan centred well, then do our holy songs go forward on their way, our songs as ‘twere unto the Gods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एन्द्र याह्युप नः परावतो नायमच्छा विदथानीव सत्पतिरस्ता राजेव सत्पतिः । हवामहे त्वा प्रयस्वन्तः सुतेष्वा पुत्रासो न पितरं वाजसातये मꣳहिष्ठं वाजसातये ॥४५९॥
translation: To Vishnu, to the mighty whom the Maruts follow, let your hymns born in song go forth, Evayamarut! To the strong, very holy band adorned with bracelets, that rushes on in joy and ever roars for vigour!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तमिन्द्रं जोहवीमि मघवानमुग्रꣳ सत्रा दधानमप्रतिष्कुतꣳ श्रवाꣳसि भूरि । मꣳहिष्ठो गीर्भिरा च यज्ञियो ववर्त्त राये नो विश्वा सुपथा कृणोतु वज्री ॥४६०॥
translation: With this his golden splendour purifying him, be with his own allies subdues all enemies, as Sura with his own allies. Cleansing himself with stream of juice he shines forth yellow-hued and red, when with the praisers he encompasses all, forms, with praisers having seven mouths.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अस्तु श्रौषट्पुरो अग्निं धिया दध आ नु त्यच्छर्धो दिव्यं वृणीमह इन्द्रवायू वृणीमहे । यद्ध क्राणा विवस्वते नाभा सन्दाय नव्यसे । अध प्र नूनमुप यन्ति धीतयो देवाꣳअच्छा न धीतयः ॥४६१॥
translation: I praise this God, parent of heaven and earth, exceeding wise, possessed of real energy, giver of treasure, thinker dear to all, Whose splendour is sublime, whose light shone brilliant in, creation, who, wise and golden- handed, in his beauty mader the sky.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र वो महे मतयो यन्तु विष्णवे मरुत्वते गिरिजा एवयामरुत् । प्र शर्धाय प्र यज्यवे सुखादये तवसे भन्ददिष्टये धुनिव्रताय शवसे ॥४६२॥
translation: Agni I deem our Hotar-priest, munificent wealth-giver, Son of Strength, who, knoweth all that is, even as the Sage who, knoweth all. Lord of fair rites, a God with form erected turning to the Gods, he, when the flame hath sprung forth from the holy oil, the offered fatness, longs for it as it glows bright.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अया रुचा हरिण्या पुनानो विश्वा द्वेषाꣳसि तरति सयुग्वभिः सूरो न सयुग्वभिः । धारा पृष्ठस्य रोचते पुनानो अरुषो हरिः । विश्वा यद्रूपा परियास्यृक्वभिः सप्तास्येभिरृक्वभिः ॥४६३॥
translation: This, Indra! dancer! was thy hero deed, thy first and ancient work, worthy to be told forth in heaven, Even thine who furtheredst life with a God’s own power, freeing the floods. All that is godless may he conquer with his might, and, Lord of Hundred Powers, find for us strength and food!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभि त्यं देवꣳ सवितारमोण्योः कविक्रतुमर्चामि सत्यसवꣳ रत्नधामभि प्रियं मतिम् ऊर्ध्वा यस्यामतिर्भा अदिद्युतत्सवीमनि हिरण्यपाणिरमिमीत सुक्रतुः कृपा स्वः ॥४६४॥
translation: High is thy juice’s birth: though set it heaven, on earth it hath obtained dread sheltering power and great renown.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्निꣳ होतारं मन्ये दास्वन्तं वसोः सूनुꣳ सहसो जातवेदसं विप्रं न जातवेदसम् । य ऊर्ध्वया स्वध्वरो देवो देवाच्या कृपा । घृतस्य विभ्राष्टिमनु शुक्रशोचिष आजुह्वानस्य सर्पिषः ॥४६५॥
translation: In sweetest and most gladdening stream flow pure, O Soma, on thy way, pressed out for Indra, for his drink!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तव त्यन्नर्यं नृतोऽप इन्द्र प्रथमं पूर्व्यं दिवि प्रवाच्यं कृतम् । यो देवस्य शवसा प्रारिणा असु रिणन्नपः । भुवो विश्वमभ्यदेवमोजसा विदेदूर्जꣳ शतक्रतुर्विदेदिषम् ॥४६६॥
translation: Flow onward mighty with thy stream, inspiriting the Maruts’ Lord, winning all riches with thy power!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उच्चा ते जातमन्धसो दिवि सद्भूम्या ददे । उग्र शर्म महि श्रवः ॥४६७॥
translation: Flow onward with that juice of thine most excellent, that brings delight, slaying the 28 wicked, dear to Gods!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स्वादिष्ठया मदिष्ठया पवस्व सोम धारया । इन्द्राय पातवे सुतः ॥४६८॥
translation: Three several words are uttered: kine are lowing, cows who give the milk; the tawny-hued goes bellowing on.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वृषा पवस्व धारया मरुत्वते च मत्सरः । विश्वा दधान ओजसा ॥४६९॥
translation: For Indra girt by Maruts, flow, thou Indu, very rich in meath, to seat thee in the place of song!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यस्ते मदो वरेण्यस्तेना पवस्वान्धसा । देवावीरघशꣳसहा ॥४७०॥
translation: Strong, mountain-born, the stalk hath been pressed in the streams for rapturous joy. Hawk- like he settles in his home.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तिस्रो वाच उदीरते गावो मिमन्ति धेनवः । हरिरेति कनिक्रदत् ॥४७१॥
translation: Gold-hued! as one who giveth strength flow on for Gods to drink, a draught for Vayu and the Marut host!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रायेन्दो मरुत्वते पवस्व मधुमत्तमः । अर्कस्य योनिमासदम् ॥४७२॥
translation: Soma, the dweller on the hills, effused, hath flowed into the sieve. All-bounteous art thou in carouse.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: असाव्यꣳशुर्मदायाप्सु दक्षो गिरिष्ठाः । श्येनो न योनिमासदत् ॥४७३॥
translation: The Sage of heaven whose heart is wise, when laid between both hands, with roars, gives us delightful powers of life.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवस्व दक्षसाधनो देवेभ्यः पीतये हरे । मरुद्भ्यो वायवे मदः ॥४७४॥
translation: The rapture-shedding Somas have flowed forth in our assembly, pressed to glorify our liberal lords.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: परि स्वानो गिरिष्ठाः पवित्रे सोमो अक्षरत् । मदेषु सर्वधा असि ॥४७५॥
translation: The Somas, skilled in song, the waves, have led the water forward, like buffaloes speeding to the woods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: परि प्रिया दिवः कविर्वयाꣳसि नप्त्योर्हितः । स्वानैर्याति कविक्रतुः ॥४७६॥
translation: Indu flow on, a mighty juice; glorify us among the folk: drive all our enemies away!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र सोमासो मदच्युतः श्रवसे नो मघोनाम् । सुता विदथे अक्रमुः ॥४७७॥
translation: For thou art strong by splendour: we, O Pavamana, call on thee, the brilliant looker on the light.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र सोमासो विपश्चितोऽपो नयन्त ऊर्मयः । वनानि महिषा इव ॥४७८॥
translation: Indu, enlightener, dear, the thought of poets, hath flowed clearly, like a charioteer who starts the steed.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवस्वेन्दो वृषा सुतः कृधी नो यशसो जने । विश्वा अप द्विषो जहि ॥४७९॥
translation: Through our desire of heroes, kine, and horses, potent Soma drops, brilliant and swift, have been effused. God, working with mankind, flow on; to Indra go thy gladdening juice: to Vayu mount as Law commands! From heaven hath Pavamana made, as ‘twere, the marvellous thunder, and the lofty light of all mankind.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वृषा ह्यसि भानुना द्युमन्तं त्वा हवामहे । पवमान स्वर्दृशम् ॥४८०॥
translation: Pressed for the gladdening draught the drops flow forth abundantly with song, flow onward with the stream of meath.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्दुः पविष्ट चेतनः प्रियः कवीनां मतिः । सृजदश्वꣳ रथीरिव ॥४८१॥
translation: Reposing on the river’s wave, the Sage hath widely flowed around, bearing the bard whom many love. 29
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: असृक्षत प्र वाजिनो गव्या सोमासो अश्वया । शुक्रासो वीरयाशवः ॥४८२॥
translation: The Gods have come to Indu well-descended, beautified with milk, the active crusher of the foe.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवस्व देव आयुषगिन्द्रं गच्छतु ते मदः । वायुमा रोह धर्मणा ॥४८३॥
translation: Active, while being purified, he hath assailed all enemies: they deck the Sage with holy hymns.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवमानो अजीजनद्दिवश्चित्रं न तन्यतुम् । ज्योतिर्वैश्वानरं बृहत् ॥४८४॥
translation: Pouring all glories hither, he, effused, hath passed within the jar: Indu on Indra is bestowed.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: परि स्वानास इन्दवो मदाय बर्हणा गिरा । मधो अर्षन्ति धारया ॥४८५॥
translation: From the two press-boards is the juice sent, like a car-horse, to the sieve: the steed steps forward to the goal.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: परि प्रासिष्यदत्कविः सिन्धोरूर्मावधि श्रितः । कारुं बिभ्रत्पुरुस्पृहम् ॥४८६॥
translation: Impetuous, bright, have they come forth, unwearied in their speed, like bulls, driving the black skin far away.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उपो षु जातमप्तुरं गोभिर्भङ्गं परिष्कृतम् । इन्दुं देवा अयासिषुः ॥४८७॥
translation: Soma, thou flowest chasing foes, finder of wisdom and delight: drive thou the godless folk afar! Flow onward with that stream wherewith thou gavest splendour to the Sun, speeding the waters kind to man!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पुनानो अक्रमीदभि विश्वा मृधो विचर्षणिः । शुम्भन्ति विप्रं धीतिभिः ॥४८८॥
translation: Flow onward thou who strengthenedst Indra to slaughter Vritra who compassed and stayed the mighty floods!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आविशन्कलशꣳ सुतो विश्वा अर्षन्नभि श्रियः । इन्दुरिन्द्राय धीयते ॥४८९॥
translation: Flow onward, Indu, with this food for him who in thy wild delights battered the nine-and- ninety down!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: असर्जि रथ्यो यथा पवित्रे चम्वोः सुतः । कार्ष्मन्वाजी न्यक्रमीत् ॥४९०॥
translation: Flow, pressed, into the filter, speed the heavenly one who winneth wealth, who bringeth booty through our juice!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र यद्गावो न भूर्णयस्त्वेषा अयासो अक्रमुः । घ्नन्तः कृष्णामप त्वचम् ॥४९१॥
translation: The tawny Bull hath bellowed, fair as mighty Mitra to behold: he gleams and flashes with the Sun.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अपघ्नन्पवसे मृधः क्रतुवित्सोम मत्सरः । नुदस्वादेवयुं जनम् ॥४९२॥
translation: We choose to-day that chariot-steed of thine, the strong, that brings us bliss, the guardian, the desire of all.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अया पवस्व धारया यया सूर्यमरोचयः । हिन्वानो मानुषीरपः ॥४९३॥
translation: Adhvaryu, to the filter lead the Soma juice expressed with stones: make thou it pure for Indra’s drink.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स पवस्व य आविथेन्द्रं वृत्राय हन्तवे । वव्रिवाꣳसं महीरपः ॥४९४॥
translation: Swift runs this giver of delight, even the stream of flowingjuice: Swift runs this giver of delight.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अया वीती परि स्रव यस्त इन्दो मदेष्वा । अवाहन्नवतीर्नव ॥४९५॥
translation: Pour hitherward, O Soma, wealth in thousands and heroic strength, and keep renown secure for us! -6. The ancient living ones have come unto a newer resting-place. They made the Sun that he might shine.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: परि द्युक्षꣳ सनद्रयिं भरद्वाजं नो अन्धसा । स्वानो अर्ष पवित्र आ ॥४९६॥
translation: Soma, flow on exceeding bright with loud roar to the reservoirs, resting in wooden vats, thy home!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अचिक्रदद्वृषा हरिर्महान्मित्रो न दर्शतः । सꣳ सूर्येण दिद्युते ॥४९७॥
translation: O Soma, thou, art strong and bright, potent, O God, with potent sway: thou, mighty one, ordainest laws.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ ते दक्षं मयोभुवं वह्निमद्या वृणीमहे । पान्तमा पुरुस्पृहम् ॥४९८॥
translation: For food, flow onward with thy stream, cleansed and made bright by sapient men: Indu. with sheen approach the milk!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अध्वर्यो अद्रिभिः सुतꣳ सोमं पवित्र आ नय । पुनाहीन्द्राय पातवे ॥४९९॥
translation: Soma, flow on with pleasant stream, strong and devoted to the Gods, our friend, unto the woollen sieve.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तरत्स मन्दी धावति धारा सुतस्यान्धसः । तरत्स मन्दी धावति ॥५००॥
translation: By this solemnity, Soma, thou, though great, hast been increased: in joy thou, verily 30 actest like a bull!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ पवस्व सहस्रिणꣳ रयिꣳ सोम सुवीर्यम् । अस्मे श्रवाꣳसि धारय ॥५०१
translation: Most active and benevolent, this Pavamana sent to us for lofty friendship meditates.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अनु प्रत्नास आयवः पदं नवीयो अक्रमुः । रुचे जनन्त सूर्यम् ॥५०२॥
translation: Indu, to us for this great rite, bearing as ‘twere thy wave to Gods, unwearied, thou art flowing on.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अर्षा सोम द्युमत्तमोऽभि द्रोणानि रोरुवत् । सीदन्योनौ वनेष्वा ॥५०३॥
translation: Chasing our foemen, driving off the godless, Soma floweth on, going to Indra’s settled place.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वृषा सोम द्युमाꣳ असि वृषा देव वृषव्रतः । वृषा धर्माणि दध्रिषे ॥५०४॥
translation: Cleansing thee, Soma, in thy stream, thou flowest in a watery robe: giver of wealth, thou sittest in the place of Law, O God, a fountain made of gold.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इषे पवस्व धारया मृज्यमानो मनीषिभिः । इन्दो रुचाभि गा इहि ॥५०५॥
translation: Hence sprinkle forth the juice effused, Soma, the best of sacred gifts, who, friend of man, hath run amid the water-streams! He hath pressed Soma out with stones.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मन्द्रया सोम धारया वृषा पवस्व देवयुः । अव्या वारेभिरस्मयुः ॥५०६॥
translation: Expressed by stones, O Soma, and urged through the long wool of the sheep, thou, entering the press-boards even as men a fort, gold-hued hast settled in the vats.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अया सोम सुकृत्यया महान्त्सन्नभ्यवर्धथाः । मन्दान इद्वृषायसे ॥५०७॥
translation: O Soma,--for the feast of Gods, river-like he hath swelled with surge, sweet with the liquor of the stalk, as one who wakes, into the vat that drops with meath.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अयं विचर्षणिर्हितः पवमानः स चेतति । हिन्वान आप्यं बृहत् ॥५०८॥
translation: Pressed out by pressers, Soma goes over the fleecy backs of sheep, goes, even as with a mare, in tawny-coloured stream, goes in a sweetly-sounding stream.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र न इन्दो महे तु न ऊर्मिं न बिभ्रदर्षसि । अभि देवाꣳ अयास्यः ॥५०९॥
translation: O Soma, Indu, every day thy friendship hath been my delight. Many fiends follow me help me, thou tawny-hued: pass on beyond these barriers!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अपघ्नन्पवते मृधोऽप सोमो अराव्णः । गच्छन्निन्द्रस्य निष्कृतम् ॥५१०॥
translation: Deft-handed! thou when purified liftest thy voice amid the sea. Thou, Pavamana, makest riches flow to us, yellow, abundant, much desired.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पुनानः सोम धारयापो वसानो अर्षसि । आ रत्नधा योनिमृतस्य सीदस्युत्सो देवो हिरण्ययः ॥५११॥
translation: The living drops of Soma juice pour, as they flow, the gladdening drink, intelligent drops above the station of the sea, exhilarating, dropping meath.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: परीतो षिञ्चता सुतꣳ सोमो य उत्तमꣳ हविः । दधन्वान् यो नर्यो अप्स्वा३न्तरा सुषाव सोममद्रिभिः ॥५१२॥
translation: Soma, while thou art cleansed, most dear and watchful in the sheep’s long wool, most like to Angiras! thou hast become a sage. Sprinkle our sacrifice with mead!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ सोम स्वानो अद्रिभिस्तिरो वाराण्यव्यया । जनो न पुरि चम्वोर्विशद्धरिः सदो वनेषु दध्रिषे ॥५१३॥
translation: Soma, the gladdening juice, flows pressed for Indra with his Marut host: he hastens o’er the fleece with all his thousand streams: him, him the men make pure and bright.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र सोम देववीतये सिन्धुर्न पिप्ये अर्णसा । अꣳशोः पयसा मदिरो न जागृविरच्छा कोशं मधुश्चुतम् ॥५१४॥
translation: Flow on, best winner of the spoil, to precious gifts of every sort! Thou art a sea according to the highest law, joy-giver, Soma! to the Gods
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सोम उ ष्वाणः सोतृभिरधि ष्णुभिरवीनाम् । अश्वयेव हरिता याति धारया मन्द्रया याति धारया ॥५१५॥
translation: Over the cleansing sieve have flowed the Pavamanas in a stream, girt by the Maruts, gladdening, steeds with Indra’s strength, for wisdom and for dainty food.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तवाहꣳ सोम रारण सख्य इन्दो दिवेदिवे । पुरूणि बभ्रो नि चरन्ति मामव परिधीꣳरति ताꣳ इहि ॥५१६॥
translation: Run onward to the reservoir and seat thee: cleansed by the men speed forward to the battle! Making thee glossy like an able courser, forth to the sacred grass with reins they lead thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मृज्यमानः सुहस्त्या समुद्रे वाचमिन्वसि । रयिं पिशङ्गं बहुलं पुरुस्पृहं पवमानाभ्यर्षसि ॥५१७॥
translation: The God declares the deities’ generations, like Uaana, proclaiming lofty wisdom. With brilliant kin, far-ruling, sanctifying, the wild boar, singing with his foot, advances.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभि सोमास आयवः पवन्ते मद्यं मदम् । समुद्रस्याधि विष्टपे मनीषिणो मत्सरासो मदच्युतः ॥५१८॥
translation: Three are the voices that the car-steed utters: he speaks the lore of prayer, the thought of Order. To the cows’ master come the cows inquiring: the hymns with eager longing come to Soma.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पुनानः सोम जागृविरव्या वारैः परि प्रियः । त्वं विप्रो अभवोऽङ्गिरस्तम मध्वा यज्ञं मिमिक्ष णः ॥५१९॥
translation: Made pure by this man’s urgent zeal and impulse, the God hath with his juice the Gods pervaded. Pressed, singing, to the sieve he goes, as passes the Hotar to enclosures holding cattle.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्राय पवते मदः सोमो मरुत्वते सुतः । सहस्रधारो अत्यव्यमर्षति तमी मृजन्त्यायवः ॥५२०॥
translation: Father of holy hymns Soma flows onward, the father of the earth, father of heaven; Father of Agni, Surya’s generator, the father who begat Indra and Vishnu
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवस्व वाजसातमोऽभि विश्वानि वार्या । त्वꣳ समुद्रः प्रथमे विधर्मन् देवेभ्यः सोम मत्सरः ॥५२१॥
translation: To him, praiseworthy, sacred tones have sounded, Steer of the triple height, the life- bestower. Dwelling in wood, like Varuna, a river, lavishing treasure, he distributes blessings.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवमाना असृक्षत पवित्रमति धारया । मरुत्वन्तो मत्सरा इन्द्रिया हया मेधामभि प्रयाꣳसि च ॥५२२॥
translation: Guard of all being, generating creatures, loud roared the sea as highest law commanded. 31 Strong, in the filter, on the fleecy summit, pressed from the stone, Soma hath waxen mighty.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र तु द्रव परि कोशं नि षीद नृभिः पुनानो अभि वाजमर्ष । अश्वं न त्वा वाजिनं मर्जयन्तोऽच्छा बर्ही रशनाभिर्नयन्ति ॥५२३॥
translation: Loud neighs the tawny steed when started, settling deep in the wooden vessel while they cleanse him. Led by the men he makes the milk his raiment; then shall he, of himself, engender worship.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र काव्यमुशनेव ब्रुवाणो देवो देवानां जनिमा विवक्ति । महिव्रतः शुचिबन्धुः पावकः पदा वराहो अभ्येति रेभन् ॥५२४॥
translation: This thine own Soma, rich in meath, O Indra, the Strong, hath flowed into the Strong One’s filter. The swift steed, bounteous, giving hundreds, thousands, hath reached the sacred grass which never fails him.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तिस्रो वाच ईरयति प्र वह्निरृतस्य धीतिं ब्रह्मणो मनीषाम् । गावो यन्ति गोपतिं पृच्छमानाः सोमं यन्ति मतयो वावशानाः ॥५२५॥
translation: Flow onward, Soma, rich in meath, and holy, enrobed in waters, on the fleecy summit! Settle in vessels that are full of fatness, as cheering and most gladdening drink for Indra!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अस्य प्रेषा हेमना पूयमानो देवो देवेभिः समपृक्त रसम् । सुतः पवित्रं पर्येति रेभन्मितेव सद्म पशुमन्ति होता ॥५२६॥
translation: In forefront of the cars forth goes the hero, the leader, seeking spoil: his host rejoices. Soma endues his robe of lasting colours, and blesses, for his friends, their calls on Indra.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सोमः पवते जनिता मतीनां जनिता दिवो जनिता पृथिव्याः । जनिताग्नेर्जनिता सूर्यस्य जनितेन्द्रस्य जनितोत विष्णोः ॥५२७॥
translation: Thy streams have been poured forth with all their sweetness, when, cleansed thou passest through the woollen filter. The race of kine thou cleansest, Pavamana! Thou didst beget: and speed the Sun with splendours.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभि त्रिपृष्ठं वृषणं वयोधामङ्गोषिणमवावशन्त वाणीः । वना वसानो वरुणो न सिन्धुर्वि रत्नधा दयते वार्याणि ॥५२८॥
translation: Let us sing praises to the Gods: sing loudly, send ye the Soma forth for mighty riches! Let him flow, sweetly-flavoured, through the filter: let the God Indu settle in the beaker!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अक्रान्त्समुद्रः प्रथमे विधर्मन् जनयन्प्रजा भुवनस्य गोपाः । वृषा पवित्रे अधि सानो अव्ये बृहत्सोमो वावृधे स्वानो अद्रिः ॥५२९॥
translation: Urged on, the father of the earth and heaven hath gone forth like a car to gather booty. Going to Indra, sharpening his weapons, and in his hands containing every treasure.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: कनिक्रन्ति हरिरा सृज्यमानः सीदन्वनस्य जठरे पुनानः । नृभिर्यतः कृणुते निर्णिजं गामतो मतिं जनयत स्वधाभिः ॥५३०॥
translation: When, by the law of the Most High, in presence of heaven and earth, the fond mind’s utterance formed him. Then, loudly lowing, came the cows to Indu, the chosen, wellloved master in the beaker.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एष स्य ते मधुमाꣳ इन्द्र सोमो वृषा वृष्णः परि पवित्रे अक्षाः । सहस्रदाः शतदा भूरिदावा शश्वत्तमं बर्हिरा वाज्यस्थात् ॥५३१॥
translation: Ten sisters, pouring out the rain together, the sage’s quickly-moving thoughts, adorn him. Hither hath run the gold-hued child of Surya, and reached the vat like a fleet vigorous courser.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवस्व सोम मधुमाꣳ ऋतावापो वसानो अधि सानो अव्ये । अव द्रोणानि घृतवन्ति रोह मदिन्तमो मत्सर इन्द्रपानः ॥५३२॥
translation: When beauties strive for him as for a charger, then strive the songs as people for the sunlight. A mighty Sage, he flows enrobed in waters and hymns as ‘twree a stall that kine may prosper.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र सेनानीः शूरो अग्रे रथानां गव्यन्नेति हर्षते अस्य सेना । भद्रान्कृण्वन्निन्द्रहवान्त्सखिभ्य आ सोमो वस्त्रा रभसानि दत्ते ॥५३३॥
translation: Strong Indu, bathed in milk, flows on for Indra, Soma exciting, strength, for his carousal. He quells malignity and slays the demons, King of the homestead, he who gives us comfort.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र ते धारा मधुमतीरसृग्रन्वारं यत्पूतो अत्येष्यव्यम् । पवमान पवसे धाम गोनां जनयन्त्सूर्यमपिन्वो अर्कैः ॥५३४॥
translation: Pour forth this wealth with this purification: flow onward to the yellow lake, O Indu! Here, too, the bright one, wind-swift, full of wisdom, shall give a son to him who cometh quickly.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र गायताभ्यर्चाम देवान्त्सोमꣳ हिनोत महते धनाय । स्वादुः पवतामति वारमव्यमा सीदतु कलशं देव इन्दुः ॥५३५॥
translation: Soma, the mighty, when, the waters’ offspring, he chose the Gods, performed that great achievement. He, Pavamana, granted strength to Indra: he, Indu, generated light in Surya.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र हिन्वानो जनिता रोदस्यो रथो न वाजꣳ सनिषन्नयासीत् । इन्द्रं गच्छन्नायुधा सꣳशिशानो विश्वा वसु हस्तयोरादधानः ॥५३६॥
translation: As for a chariot-race, the skilful speaker, first hymn, inventor, hath with song been started. The sisters ten upon the fleecy summit adorn the car-horse in the resting-places.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तक्षद्यदी मनसो वेनतो वाग्ज्येष्ठस्य धर्मं द्युक्षोरनीके । आदीमायन्वरमा वावशाना जुष्टं पतिं कलशे गाव इन्दुम् ॥५३७॥
translation: Hastening onward like the waves of waters our holy hymns are coming forth to Soma. To him they go with lowly adoration, and, longing, enter him who longs to meet them.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: साकमुक्षो मर्जयन्त स्वसारो दश धीरस्य धीतयो धनुत्रीः । हरिः पर्यद्रवज्जाः सूर्यस्य द्रोणं ननक्षे अत्यो न वाजी ॥५३८॥
translation: For first possession of your juice. for the exhilarating drink, Drive ye away the dog, my friends, drive ye the long-tongued dog away!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अधि यदस्मिन्वाजिनीव शुभः स्पर्धन्ते धियः सूरे न विशः । अपो वृणानः पवते कवीयान्व्रजं न पशुवर्धनाय मन्म ॥५३९॥
translation: As Pushan. Fortune, Bhaga, comes this Soma while they make him pure. 32 He, Lord of all the multitude, hath looked upon the earth and heaven.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्दुर्वाजी पवते गोन्योघा इन्द्रे सोमः सह इन्वन्मदाय । हन्ति रक्षो बाधते पर्यरातिं वरिवस्कृण्वन्वृजनस्य राजा ॥५४०॥
translation: The Somas, very rich in sweets, for which the sieve is destined,. flow Effused, the source of Indra’s joy: may your strong juices reach the Gods!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अया पवा पवस्वैना वसूनि माꣳश्चत्व इन्दो सरसि प्र धन्व । ब्रध्नश्चिद्यस्य वातो न जूतिं पुरुमेधाश्चित्तकवे नरं धात् ॥५४१॥
translation: For us the Soma juices flow, the drops best furtherers of weal, Effused as friends, without a spot, benevolent, finders of the. light.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: महत्तत्सोमो महिषश्चकारापां यद्गर्भोऽवृणीत देवान् । अदधादिन्द्रे पवमान ओजोऽजनयत्सूर्ये ज्योतिरिन्दुः ॥५४२॥
translation: Stream on us riches that are craved by hundreds, best at winning spoil, Riches, O Indu, thousandfold, most splendid, that surpass the light!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: असर्जि वक्वा रथ्ये यथाजौ धिया मनोता प्रथमा मनीषा । दश स्वसारो अधि सानो अव्ये मृजन्ति वह्निꣳ सदनेष्वच्छ ॥५४३॥
translation: The guileless ones are singing praise to Indra’s well-beloved friend, As, in the morning of its life, the mothers lick the new-born calf.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अपामिवेदूर्मयस्तर्त्तुराणाः प्र मनीषा ईरते सोममच्छ । नमस्यन्तीरुप च यन्ति सं चाच विशन्त्युशतीरुशन्तम् ॥५४४॥
translation: They for the bold and lovely one ply manly vigour like a bow; Bright, glad, in front of songs they spread to form a vesture for the Lord.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पुरोजिती वो अन्धसः सुताय मादयित्नवे । अप श्वानꣳश्नथिष्टन सखायो दीर्घजिह्व्यम् ॥५४५॥
translation: Him with ths fleece they purify, brown, golden-hued, beloved of all, Who with exhilarating juice goes forth to all the deities.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अयं पूषा रयिर्भगः सोमः पुनानो अर्षति । पतिर्विश्वस्य भूमनो व्यख्यद्रोदसी उभे ॥५४६॥
translation: Let him, as mortal, crave this speech, for him who presses, of the juice, As Bhrigu’s sons chased Makha, so drive ye the niggard hound away!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सुतासो मधुमत्तमाः सोमा इन्द्राय मन्दिनः । पवित्रवन्तो अक्षरन्देवान्गच्छन्तु वो मदाः ॥५४७॥
translation: Graciously-minded he is flowing on his way to win dear names o’er which the youthful one grows great. The mighty and far-seeing one hath mounted now the mighty Surya’s car which moves to every side.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सोमाः पवन्त इन्दवोऽस्मभ्यं गातुवित्तमाः । मित्राः स्वाना अरेपसः स्वाध्यः स्वर्विदः ॥५४८॥
translation: Spontaneous let our drops of Soma juice flow on, pressed out and tawny-coloured, mightily, to the Gods! Still let our enemies, the godless, be in want, though filled with food; and let our prayers obtain success!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभी नो वाजसातमꣳ रयिमर्ष शतस्पृहम् । इन्दो सहस्रभर्णसं तुविद्युम्नं विभासहम् ॥५४९॥
translation: Most beauteous of the beauteous, Indra’s thunderbolt, this Soma, rich in sweets, hath clamoured in the vat. Dropping with oil, abundant, streams of sacrifice flow unto him, and milch-kine, lowing, with their milk.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभी नवन्ते अद्रुहः प्रियमिन्द्रस्य काम्यम् । वत्सं न पूर्व आयुनि जातꣳ रिहन्ति मातरः ॥५५०॥
translation: Indu hath started forth for Indra’s settled place, and slights not, as a friend, the promise of his friend. Soma comes onward like a youth with youthful maids, and gains the beaker by a course of hundred paths.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ हर्यताय धृष्णवे धनुष्टन्वन्ति पौꣳस्यम् । शुक्रा वि यन्त्यसुराय निर्णिजे विपामग्रे महीयुवः ॥५५१॥
translation: On flows the potent juice, sustainer of the heavens; the strength of Gods, whom men must hail with shouts of joy. Thou, gold-hued, started like a courser by brave men, art lightly showing forth thy splendour in the streams.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: परि त्यꣳ हर्यतꣳ हरिं बभ्रुं पुनन्ति वारेण । यो देवान्विश्वाꣳ इत्परि मदेन सह गच्छति ॥५५२॥
translation: Far-seeing Soma flows, the Steer, the Lord of hymns, the furtherer of days, of mornings, and of heaven. Breath of the rivers, he hath roared into the jars, and with the help of sages entered Indra’s heart.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र सुन्वानायास्यान्धसो मर्तो न वष्ट तद्वचः । अप श्वानमराधसꣳ हता मखं न भृगवः ॥५५३॥
translation: The three-times seven milch-kine in the loftiest heaven have for this Soma poured the genuine milky draught. Four other beauteous creatures hath he made for his adornment when he waxed in strength through holy rites.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभि प्रियाणि पवते चनोहितो नामानि यह्वो अधि येषु वर्धते । आ सूर्यस्य बृहतो बृहन्नधि रथं विष्वञ्चमरुहद्विचक्षणः ॥५५४॥
translation: Flow on to indra, Soma, carefully effused: let sickness stay afar together with the fiend! Let not the double-tongued delight them with thy juice: here be thy flowing drops laden with opulence!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अचोदसो नो धन्वन्त्विन्दवः प्र स्वानासो बृहद्देवेषु हरयः । वि चिदश्नाना इषयो अरातयोऽर्यो नः सन्तु सनिषन्तु नो धियः ॥५५५॥
translation: Even as a King hath Soma, red and tawny Bull, been pressed: the wondrous one hath bellowed to the kine. 33 While purified thou passest through the filtering fleece to seat thee hawk-like on the place that drops with oil.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एष प्र कोशे मधुमाꣳ अचिक्रददिन्द्रस्य वज्रो वपुषो वपुष्टमः । अभ्यॄ३तस्य सुदुघा घृतश्चुतो वाश्रा अर्षन्ति पयसा च धेनवः ॥५५६॥
translation: The drops of Soma juice, like cows who yield their milk, have flowed forth, rich in meath, unto the diety, And, seated on the grass, raising their voice, assumed the milk, the covering robe wherewith the address stream.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्रो अयासीदिन्दुरिन्द्रस्य निष्कृतꣳ सखा सख्युर्न प्र मिनाति सङ्गिरम् । मर्य इव युवतिभिः समर्षति सोमः कलशे शतयामना पथा ॥५५७॥
translation: They balm him, balm him over, balm him thoroughly, caress the mighty strength and balm it with the meath. They seize the flying Steer at the stream’s breathing-place: cleansing with gold they grasp the animal herein.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: धर्ता दिवः पवते कृत्व्यो रसो दक्षो देवानामनुमाद्यो नृभिः । हरिः सृजानो अत्यो न सत्वभिर्वृथा पाजाꣳसि कृणुषे नदीष्वा ॥५५८॥
translation: Spread is thy cleansing filter, Brahmanaspati: as prince thou enterest its limbs from every side. The raw, whose mass hath not been heated, gains not this: they only which are dressed, which bear, attain to it.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वृषा मतीनां पवते विचक्षणः सोमो अह्नां प्रतरीतोषसाꣳ दिवः । प्राणा सिन्धूनाꣳ कलशाꣳ अचिक्रददिन्द्रस्य हार्द्याविशन्मनीषिभिः ॥५५९॥
translation: To Indra, to the mighty one, let these gold-coloured juices go, Drops born as Law prescribes, that find the light of heavenj
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्रिरस्मै सप्त धेनवो दुदुह्रिरे सत्यामाशिरं परमे व्योमनि । चत्वार्यन्या भुवनानि निर्णिजे चारूणि चक्रे यदृतैरवर्धत ॥५६०॥
translation: Flow vigilant for Indra, thou Soma, yea, Indu, run thou forth; Bring hither splendid strength that finds the light of heaven!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्राय सोम सुषुतः परि स्रवापामीवा भवतु रक्षसा सह । मा ते रसस्य मत्सत द्वयाविनो द्रविणस्वन्त इह सन्त्विन्दवः ॥५६१॥
translation: Sit down, O friends, and sing aloud to him who purifies himself. Deck him for glory, like a child, with holy rites!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: असावि सोमो अरुषो वृषा हरी राजेव दस्मो अभि गा अचिक्रदत् । पुनानो वारमत्येष्यव्ययꣳ श्येनो न योनिं घृतवन्तमासदत् ॥५६२॥
translation: Friends, hymn your Lord who makes him pure for rapturous carouse: let them Sweeten him, as a child, with lauds and sacred gifts!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र देवमच्छा मधुमन्त इन्दवोऽसिष्यदन्त गाव आ न धेनवः । बर्हिषदो वचनावन्त ऊधभिः परिस्रुतमुस्रिया निर्णिजं धिरे ॥५६३॥
translation: Breath of the mighty Dames, the Child, speeding the plan of’ sacrifice, Surpasses all things that are dear, yea, from of old!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अञ्जते व्यञ्जते समञ्जते क्रतुꣳ रिहन्ति मध्वाभ्यञ्जते । सिन्धोरुऽच्छ्वासे पतयन्तमुक्षणꣳ हिरण्यपावाः पशुमप्सु गृभ्णते ॥५६४॥
translation: In might, O Indu, with thy streams flow for the banquet of the Gods: Rich in meath, Soma, in our beaker take thy seat!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवित्रं ते विततं ब्रह्मणस्पते प्रभुर्गात्राणि पर्येषि विश्वतः । अतप्ततनूर्न तदामो अश्नुते शृतास इद्वहन्तः सं तदाशत ॥५६५॥
translation: Soma, while filtered, with his wave flows through the long wool of the sheep, Roaring, while purified, before the voice of song.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रमच्छ सुता इमे वृषणं यन्तु हरयः । श्रुष्टे जातास इन्दवः स्वर्विदः ॥५६६॥
translation: The speech is uttered for the Sage, for Soma being purified: Bring meed as ‘twere to one who makes thee glad with hymns!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र धन्वा सोम जागृविरिन्द्रायेन्दो परि स्रव । द्युमन्तꣳ शुष्ममा भर स्वर्विदम् ॥५६७॥
translation: Flow to us, Indu, very strong, effused, with wealth of kine and, steeds, And do thou lay above the milk thy radiant hue!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सखाय आ नि षीदत पुनानाय प्र गायत । शिशुं न यज्ञैः परि भूषत श्रिये ॥५६८॥
translation: Voices have sung aloud to thee as finder-out of wealth for us: We clothe the hue thou wearest with a robe of milk.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तं वः सखायो मदाय पुनानमभि गायत । शिशुं न हव्यैः स्वदयन्त गूर्तिभिः ॥५६९॥
translation: Gold-hued and lovely in his course through tangles of the wooli he flows: Stream forth heroic fame upon the worshippers!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्राणा शिशुर्महीनाꣳ हिन्वन्नृतस्य दीधितिम् । विश्वा परि प्रिया भुवदध द्विता ॥५७०॥
translation: On through the long wool of the sheep to the meath-dropping vat he flows: The Rishis’ sevenfold quire hath sung aloud to him. I. For Indra flow, thou Soma, on, as most inspiring drink, exceeding rich in sweets. Great, most celestial, gladdening drink!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवस्व देववीतय इन्दो धाराभिरोजसा । आ कलशं मधुमान्त्सोम नः सदः ॥५७१॥
translation: Make high and splendid glory shine hitherward, Lord of food, God, on the friend of Gods: Unclose the cask of middle air!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सोमः पुनान ऊर्मिणाव्यं वारं वि धावति । अग्रे वाचः पवमानः कनिक्रदत् ॥५७२॥
translation: Press ye and pour him, like a steed, laud-worthy, speeding through the region and the flood, Who swims in water, dwells in wood! 34
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र पुनानाय वेधसे सोमाय वच उच्यते । भृतिं न भरा मतिभिर्जुजोषते ॥५७३॥
translation: Him, even this Steer who milks the heavens, him with a thousand streams, distilling rapturous joy, Him who brings all things excellent.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: गोमन्न इन्दो अश्ववत्सुतः सुदक्ष धनिव । शुचिं च वर्णमधि गोषु धारय ॥५७४॥
translation: Effused is he who brings good things, who brings us store of’ wealth and sweet refreshing food, Soma who brings us quiet homes.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अस्मभ्यं त्वा वसुविदमभि वाणीरनूषत । गोभिष्टे वर्णमभि वासयामसि ॥५७५॥
translation: For, verily, Pavamana, thou, divine! endued with brightest splendour calling all Creatures to immortality.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवते हर्यतो हरिरति ह्वराꣳसि रꣳह्या । अभ्यर्ष स्तोतृभ्यो वीरवद्यशः ॥५७६॥
translation: Effused, he floweth in a stream, best rapture-giver, in the longwool of the sheep, Sporting, as ‘twere the waters’ wave.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: परि कोशं मधुश्चुतꣳ सोमः पुनानो अर्षति । अभि वाणीरृषीणाꣳ सप्ता नूषत ॥५७७॥
translation: He who from out the rocky cavern with his might took forth the red-refulgent cows-- Thou drewest to thyself the stall of kine and steeds: burst it, brave Lord, like one in mail; yea, burst it, O brave Lord, like one in mail! 35
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उपास्मै गायता नरः पवमानायेन्दवे । अभि देवाꣳ इयक्षते ॥६५१॥
translation: Sing forth to Indu, O ye men, to him who now is purified, Fain to pay worship to the Gods!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभि ते मधुना पयोऽथर्वाणो अशिश्रयुः । देवं देवाय देवयु ॥६५२॥
translation: Together with thy pleasant juice the Atharvans have commingled. milk. Divine, God-loving, for the God.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स नः पवस्व शं गवे शं जनाय शमर्वते । शꣳ राजन्नोषधीभ्यः ॥६५३॥
translation: Bring health to cattle with thy flow, health to the people, health, to steeds, Health, O thou King, to growing plants!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: दविद्युतत्या रुचा परिष्टोभन्त्या कृपा । सोमाः शुक्रा गवाशिरः ॥६५४॥
translation: Bright are these Somas blent with milk, with light that flashes brilliantly, And form that shouteth all around.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: हिन्वानो हेतृभिर्हित आ वाजं वाज्यक्रमीत् । सीदन्तो वनुषो यथा ॥६५५॥
translation: Roused by his drivers and sent forth, the strong Steed hath come: nigh for spoil, As warriors when they stand arrayed.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ऋधक्सोम स्वस्तये संजग्मानो दिवा कवे । पवस्व सूर्यो दृशे ॥६५६॥
translation: Specially, Soma, Sage, by day, coming together for our weal, Like Surya, flow for us to see!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवमानस्य ते कवे वाजिन्त्सर्गा असृक्षत । अर्वन्तो न श्रवस्यवः ॥६५७॥
translation: The streams of Pavamana, thine, Sage, mighty one, have poured them forth, Like coursers eager for renown.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अच्छा कोशं मधुश्चुतमसृग्रं वारे अव्यये । अवावशन्त धीतयः ॥६५८॥
translation: They have been poured upon the Reece towards the meath-distilling vat: The holy songs have rung aloud.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अच्छा समुद्रमिन्दवोऽस्तं गावो न धेनवः । अग्मन्नृतस्य योनिमा ॥६५९॥
