translation: Like milch-kine coming home, the drops of Soma juice have reached the lake, Have reached the shrine of sacrifice
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्न आ याहि वीतये गृणानो हव्यदातये । नि होता सत्सि बर्हिषि ॥६६०॥
translation: Come, Agni, praised with song to feast and sacrificial offerings: sit As Hotar on the holy grass!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तं त्वा समिद्भिरङ्गिरो घृतेन वर्धयामसि । बृहच्छोचा यविष्ठ्य ॥६६१॥
translation: So, Angiras, we make thee strong with fuel and with holy oil. Blaze high, thou youngest of the Gods!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स नः पृथु श्रवाय्यमच्छा देव विवाससि । बृहदग्ने सुवीर्यम् ॥६६२॥
translation: For us thou winnest, Agni, God, heroic strength exceeding great, Far-spreading and of high renown.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ नो मित्रावरुणा घृतैर्गव्यूतिमुक्षतम् । मध्वा रजाꣳसि सुक्रतू ॥६६३॥
translation: Varuna, Mitra, sapient pair, pour fatness on our pastures, pour Meath on the regions of the air!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उरुशꣳसा नमोवृधा मह्ना दक्षस्य राजथः । द्राघिष्ठाभिः शुचिव्रता ॥६६४॥
translation: Gladdened by homage, ruling far, ye reign by majesty of might, Pure in your ways, for evermore.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: गृणाना जमदग्निना योनावृतस्य सीदतम् । पातꣳ सोममृतावृधा ॥६६५॥
translation: Lauded by Jamadagni’s song, sit in the shrine of sacrifice: Drink Soma, ye who strengthen Law!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ याहि सुषुमा हि त इन्द्र सोमं पिबा इमम् । एदं बर्हिः सदो मम ॥६६६॥
translation: Come, we have pressed theJuice for thee; O Indra, drink this Soma here: Sit thou on this my sacred grass! 37
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ त्वा ब्रह्मयुजा हरी वहतामिन्द्र केशिना । उप ब्रह्माणि नः शृणु ॥६६७॥
translation: O Indra, let thy long-maned bays, yoked by prayer, bring thee hitherward! Give ear and listen to our prayers!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ब्रह्माणस्त्वा युजा वयꣳ सोमपामिन्द्र सोमिनः । सुतावन्तो हवामहे ॥६६८॥
translation: We Soma-bearing Brahmans call thee Soma-drinker with thy friend, We, Indra, bringing Soma juice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्राग्नी आ गतꣳ सुतं गीर्भिर्नभो वरेण्यम् । अस्य पातं धियेषिता ॥६६९॥
translation: Indra and Agni, moved by songs, come to the juice, the precious dew: Drink ye thereof, impelled by prayer!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्राग्नी जरितुः सचा यज्ञो जिगाति चेतनः । अया पातमिमꣳ सुतम् ॥६७०॥
translation: Indra and Agni, with the man who lauds comes visible sacrifice: So drink ye both this flowing juice!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रमग्निं कविच्छदा यज्ञस्य जूत्या वृणे । ता सोमस्येह तृम्पताम् ॥६७१॥
translation: With force of sacrifice I seek Indra, Agni who love the wise: With Soma let them sate them here!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उच्चा ते जातमन्धसो दिवि सद्भूम्या ददे । उग्रꣳ शर्म महि श्रवः ॥६७२॥
translation: High is thy juice’s birth: though set in heaven, on earth it hath obtained Dread sheltering power and great renown.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स न इन्द्राय यज्यवे वरुणाय मरुद्भ्यः । वरिवोवित्परि स्रव ॥६७३॥
translation: Finder of room and freedom, flow for Indra whom we must adore, For Varuna and the Marut host!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एना विश्वान्यर्य आ द्युम्नानि मानुषाणाम् । सिषासन्तो वनामहे ॥६७४॥
translation: Striving to win, with him we gain all riches from the enemy, Yea, all the glories of mankind,
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पुनानः सोम धारयापो वसानो अर्षसि । आ रत्नधा योनिमृतस्य सीदस्युत्सो देवो हिरण्ययः ॥६७५॥
translation: Cleansing thee, Soma, in thy stream, thou flowest in watery robe. Giver of wealth, thou sittest in the place of Law, O God, a fountain made of gold.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: दुहान ऊधर्दिव्यं मधु प्रियं प्रत्नꣳ सधस्थमासदत् । आपृच्छ्यं धरुणं वाज्यर्षसि नृभिर्धौतो विचक्षणः ॥६७६॥
translation: He, milking for dear meath the heavenly udder, hath sat in the ancient gathering-place. Washed by the men, far-sighted, strong, thou streamest to ther honourable reservoir.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र तु द्रव परि कोशं नि षीद नृभिः पुनानो अभि वाजमर्ष । अश्वं न त्वा वाजिनं मर्जयन्तोऽच्छा बर्ही रशनाभिर्नयन्ति ॥६७७॥
translation: Run onward to the reservoir and seat thee: cleansed by the men speed forward to the battle. Making thee glossy like an able courser, forth to the sacred grass with reins they lead thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स्वायुधः पवते देव इन्दुरशस्तिहा वृजना रक्षमाणः । पिता देवानां जनिता सुदक्षो विष्टम्भो दिवो धरुणः पृथिव्याः ॥६७८॥
translation: Indu, the well-armed God is flowing onward, he who averts the curse and guards the homesteads. Father, begetter of the Gods, most skilful, the buttress of the heavens and earth’s supporter.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ऋषिर्विप्रः पुरएता जनानामृभुर्धीर उशना काव्येन । स चिद्विवेद निहितं यदासामपीच्या३ꣳ गुह्यं नाम गोनाम् ॥६७९॥
translation: Like kine unmilked we call aloud, hero, to thee, and sing thy praise, Looker on heavenly light, Lord of this moving world, Lord, Indra! of what moveth not.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभि त्वा शूर नोनुमोऽदुग्धा इव धेनवः । ईशानमस्य जगतः स्वर्दृशमीशानमिन्द्र तस्थुषः ॥६८०॥
translation: None other like to thee, of earth or of the heavens, hath been or ever will be born. Desiring horses, Indra Maghavan! and kine, as men of might we call on thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: न त्वावाꣳ अन्यो दिव्यो न पार्थिवो न जातो न जनिष्यते । अश्वायन्तो मघवन्निन्द्र वाजिनो गव्यन्तस्त्वा हवामहे ॥६८१॥
translation: With what help will he come to us, wonderful, everwaxing friend? With what most mighty company?
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: कया नश्चित्र आ भुवदूती सदावृधः सखा । कया शचिष्ठया वृता ॥६८२॥
translation: What genuine and most liberal draught will spirit thee with juice to burst Open e’en strongly-guarded wealth?
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: कस्त्वा सत्यो मदानां मꣳहिष्ठो मत्सदन्धसः । दृढा चिदारुजे वसु ॥६८३॥
translation: Do thou who art protector of us thy friends who praise thee With hundred aids approach us! XIII Indra 38
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभी षु णः सखीनामविता जरितॄणाम् । शतं भवास्यूतये ॥६८४॥
translation: As cows low to their calves in stalls, so with our songs we glorify This Indra, even your wondrous God who checks attack, who takes delight in precious juice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तं वो दस्ममृतीषहं वसोर्मन्दानमन्धसः । अभि वत्सं न स्वसरेषु धेनव इन्द्रं गीर्भिर्नवामहे ॥६८५॥
translation: Celestial, bounteous giver, girt about with might, rich, mountain-like, in pleasant things,-- Him swift we seek for foodful booty rich in kine, brought hundredfold and thousandfold.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: द्युक्षꣳ सुदानुं तविषीभिरावृतं गिरिं न पुरुभोजसम् । क्षुमन्तं वाजꣳ शतिनꣳ सहस्रिणं मक्षू गोमन्तमीमहे ॥६८६॥
translation: Loud-singing at tbe sacred rite where Soma flows, we priests invoke. With haste, that he may help, as the bard’s cherisher. Indra who findeth wealth for you.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तरोभिर्वो विदद्वसुमिन्द्रꣳ सबाध ऊतये । बृहद्गायन्तः सुतसोमे अध्वरे हुवे भरं न कारिणम् ॥६८७॥
translation: Whom, fair of cheek, in rapture of the juice, the firm resistless slayers hinder not: Giver of glorious wealth to him who sings his praise, honouring him who toils and pours.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: न यं दुध्रा वरन्ते न स्थिरा मुरो मदेषु शिप्रमन्धसः । य आदृत्या शशमानाय सुन्वते दाता जरित्र उक्थ्यम् ॥६८८॥
translation: In sweetest and most gladdening stream flow pure, O Soma, on thy way, Pressed out for Indra, for his drink!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स्वादिष्ठया मदिष्ठया पवस्व सोम धारया । इन्द्राय पातवे सुतः ॥६८९॥
translation: Fiend-queller, friend of all men, he hath reached his shrine, his dwelling-place. Within the iron-hammered vat.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: रक्षोहा विश्वचर्षणिरभि योनिमयोहते । द्रोणे सधस्थमासदत् ॥६९०॥
translation: Be thou best Vritra-slaver, best granter of room, most liberal: Promote our wealthy princes’ gifts!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वरिवोधातमो भुवो मꣳहिष्ठो वृत्रहन्तमः । पर्षि राधो मघोनाम् ॥६९१॥
translation: For Indra flow, thou Soma, on, as most inspiring drink, most rich in sweets, Great, most Celestial, gladdening drink!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवस्व मधुमत्तम इन्द्राय सोम क्रतुवित्तमो मदः । महि द्युक्षतमो मदः ॥६९२॥
translation: Thou of whom having drunk the Steer acts like a steer: having drunk this that finds the light, He, excellently wise, hath come anear to food and booty, even as Etasa.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यस्य ते पीत्वा वृषभो वृषायतेऽस्य पीत्वा स्वर्विदः । स सुप्रकेतो अभ्यक्रमीदिषोऽच्छा वाजं नैतशः ॥६९३॥
translation: To Indra, to the mighty let these golden-coloured juices go, Drops born as Law prescribes, that find the light of heaven!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रमच्छ सुता इमे वृषणं यन्तु हरयः । श्रुष्टे जातास इन्दवः स्वर्विदः ॥६९४॥
translation: This juice that gathers spoil flows, pressed, for Indra, for his maintenance. Soma bethinks him of the conqueror, as he knows.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अयं भराय सानसिरिन्द्राय पवते सुतः । सोमो जैत्रस्य चेतति यथा विदे ॥६९५॥
translation: Yea, Indra in the joys of this obtains the grasp that gathers spoil, And, winning waters, wields the mighty thunderbolt. XVIII Soma Pavamana.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अस्येदिन्द्रो मदेष्वा ग्राभं गृभ्णाति सानसिम् । वज्रं च वृषणं भरत्समप्सुजित् ॥६९६॥
translation: For first possession of your juice, for the exhilarating drink, Drive ye away the dog, my friends, drive ye the long-tongued dog away!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पुरोजिती वो अन्धसः सुताय मादयित्नवे । अप श्वानꣳ श्नथिष्टन सखायो दीर्घजिह्व्यम् ॥६९७॥
translation: He who with purifying stream, effused, comes flowing hitherward, Indu, is like an able steed.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यो धारया पावकया परिप्रस्यन्दते सुतः । इन्दुरश्वो न कृत्व्यः ॥६९८॥
translation: With prayer all-reaching let the men tend unassailable Soma: be- The stones prepared for sacrifice!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तं दुरोषमभी नरः सोमं विश्वाच्या धिया । यज्ञाय सन्त्वद्रयः ॥६९९॥
translation: Graciously- minded he is flowing on his way to win dear names o’er which the youthful one grows great. The mighty and far-seeing one hath mounted now the mighty Surya’s car which moves to every side.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभि प्रियाणि पवते चनोहितो नामानि यह्वो अधि येषु वर्धते । आ सूर्यस्य बृहतो बृहन्नधि रथं विष्वञ्चमरुहद्विचक्षणः ॥७००॥
translation: The speaker, unassailable master of this prayer, the tongue of sacrifice, pours forth the pleasant meath. As son be sets the name of mother and of sire in the far distance, in the third bright realm of heaven. 39
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ऋतस्य जिह्वा पवते मधु प्रियं वक्ता पतिर्धियो अस्या अदाभ्यः । दधाति पुत्रः पित्रोरपीच्यां३ नाम तृतीयमधि रोचनं दिवः ॥७०१
translation: Sending forth flashes he hath bellowed to the jars, led by the men into the golden reservoir. The milkers of the sacrifice have sung to him: Lord of three heights, thou shinest brightly o’er the Dawns.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अव द्युतानः कलशाꣳ अचिक्रदन्नृभिर्येमाणः कोश आ हिरण्यये । अभी ऋतस्य दोहना अनूषताधि त्रिपृष्ठ उषसो वि राजसि ॥७०२॥
translation: Sing to your Agni with each song, at every sacrifice for strength! Come, let us praise the wise and everlasting God, even as a well-beloved friend:
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यज्ञायज्ञा वो अग्नये गिरागिरा च दक्षसे । प्रप्र वयममृतं जातवेदसं प्रियं मित्रं न शꣳसिषम् ॥७०३॥
translation: The Son of Strength; for is be not our gracious Lord? Let us serve him who bears our gifts! In battles may he be our help and strengthener, yea, be the saviour of our lives!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ऊर्जो नपातꣳ स हिनायमस्मयुर्दाशेम हव्यदातये । भुवद्वाजेष्वविता भुवद्वृध उत त्राता तनूनाम् ॥७०४॥
translation: O Agni, come; far other songs of praise will I sing forth to thee. Wax mighty with these Soma drops!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एह्यू षु ब्रवाणि तेऽग्न इत्थेतरा गिरः । एभिर्वर्धास इन्दुभिः ॥७०५॥
translation: Where’er thy mind applies itself, vigour preeminent hast thou: There wilt thou gain a dwelling-place.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यत्र क्व च ते मनो दक्षं दधस उत्तरम् । तत्र योनिं कृणवसे ॥७०६॥
translation: Not for a moment only lasts thy bounty, Lord of many men: Our service therefore shalt thou gain.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: न हि ते पूर्तमक्षिपद्भुवन्नेमानां पते । अथा दुवो वनवसे ॥७०७॥
translation: We call on thee, O matchless one. We, seeking help, possessing nothing firm ourselves. Call on thee, wondrous, thunder-armed:
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वयमु त्वामपूर्व्य स्थूरं न कच्चिद्भरन्तोऽवस्यवः । वज्रिञ्चित्रꣳ हवामहे ॥७०८॥
translation: On thee for aid in sacrifice, This youth of ours, the bold, the terrible, bath gone forth. We therefore, we thy friends, Indra, have chosen thee, spoil winner, as our succourer.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उप त्वा कर्मन्नूतये स नो युवोग्रश्चक्राम यो धृषत् । त्वामिध्यवितारं ववृमहे सखाय इन्द्र सानसिम् ॥७०९॥
translation: So, Indra, friend of song, do we draw near to thee with longing; we have streamed to thee Coming like floods that follow floods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अधा हीन्द्र गिर्वण उप त्वा काम ईमहे ससृग्महे । उदेव ग्मन्त उदभिः ॥७१०॥
translation: As rivers swell the ocean, so, hero, our prayers increase thy might, Though of thyself, O Thunderer, waxing day by day.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वार्ण त्वा यव्याभिर्वर्धन्ति शूर ब्रह्माणि । वावृध्वाꣳसं चिदद्रिवो दिवेदिवे ॥७११॥
translation: With holy song they bind to the broad wide-yoked car the bay steeds of the quickening God, Bearers of Indra, yoked by word. I Indra I. Invite ye Indra with a song to drink your draught of Soma juicel All-conquering Satakratu, most munificent of all who live!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: युञ्जन्ति हरी इषिरस्य गाथयोरौ रथ उरुयुगे वचोयुजा । इन्द्रवाहा स्वर्विदा ॥७१२॥
translation: Lauded by many, much-invoked, leader of song renowned of old: His name is Indra, tell it forth!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पान्तमा वो अन्धस इन्द्रमभि प्र गायत । विश्वासाहꣳ शतक्रतुं मꣳहिष्ठं चर्षणीनाम् ॥७१३॥
translation: Indra, the dancer, be to us the giver of abundant wealth: The mighty bring it us knee-deep!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पुरुहूतं पुरुष्टुतं गाथान्या३ꣳसनश्रुतम् । इन्द्र इति ब्रवीतन ॥७१४॥
translation: Sing ye a song, to make him glad, to Indra, Lord of tawny steeds, The Soma-drinker, O my friends!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्र इन्नो महोनां दाता वाजानां नृतुः । महाꣳ अभिज्ञ्वा यमत् ॥७१५॥
translation: To him, the bounteous, say the laud, and let us glorify, as men May do, the giver of true gifts!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र व इन्द्राय मादनꣳ हर्यश्वाय गायत । सखायः सोमपाव्ने ॥७१६॥
translation: O Indra, Lord of boundless might, for us thou seekest spoil and kine, Thou seekest gold for us, good Lord! III Indra 40
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: शꣳसेदुक्थꣳ सुदानव उत द्युक्षं यथा नरः । चकृमा सत्यराधसे ॥७१७॥
translation: This, even this, O Indra, we implore: as thy devoted friends, The Kanvas praise thee with their hymns.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वं न इन्द्र वाजयुस्त्वं गव्युः शतक्रतो । त्वꣳ हिरण्ययुर्वसो ॥७१८॥
translation: Naught else, O Thunderer, have I praised in the skilled singer’s eulogy; On thy laud only have I thought.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वयमु त्वा तदिदर्था इन्द्र त्वायन्तः सखायः । कण्वा उक्थेभिर्जरन्ते ॥७१९॥
translation: The Gods seek him who presses out the Soma; they desire not sleep: They punish sloth unweariedly
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: न घेमन्यदा पपन वज्रिन्नपसो नविष्टौ । तवेदु स्तोमैश्चिकेत ॥७२०॥
translation: For Indra, lover of carouse, loud be our songs about the juice: Let poets sing the song of praise
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इच्छन्ति देवाः सुन्वन्तं न स्वप्नाय स्पृहयन्ति । यन्ति प्रमादमतन्द्राः ॥७२१॥
translation: We summon Indra to the draught, in whom all glories rest, in whom The seven communities rejoice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्राय मद्वने सुतं परि ष्टोभन्तु नो गिरः । अर्कमर्च्चन्तु कारवः ॥७२२॥
translation: At the Trikadrukas the Gods span sacrifice that stirs the mind: Let our songs aid and prosper it!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यस्मिन्विश्वा अधि श्रियो रणन्ति सप्त सꣳसदः । इन्द्रꣳ सुते हवामहे ॥७२३॥
translation: Here, Indra, is thy Soma draught, made pure upon the sacred grass: Run hither, come and drink thereof!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्रिकद्रुकेषु चेतनं देवासो यज्ञमत्नत । तमिद्वर्धन्तु नो गिरः ॥७२४॥
translation: Strong-rayed! adored with earnest hymns! this juice is shed for thy delight: Thou art invoked, Akhandala!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अयं त इन्द्र सोमो निपूतो अधि बर्हिषि । एहीमस्य द्रवा पिब ॥७२५॥
translation: To Kundapayya, grandson’s son, grandson of Sringavrish! to thee, To him have I addressed my thought.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: शाचिगो शाचिपूजनायꣳ रणाय ते सुतः । आखण्डल प्र हूयसे ॥७२६॥
translation: Indra, as one with mighty arm, gather for us with thy right hand, Manifold and nutritious spoil!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यस्ते शृङ्गवृषो णपात्प्रणपात्कुण्डपाय्यः । न्यस्मिन् दध्र आ मनः ॥७२७॥
translation: We know thee mighty in thy deeds, of mighty bounty, mighty wealth. Mighty in measure, prompt to aid.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ तू न इन्द्र क्षुमन्तं चित्रं ग्राभꣳ सं गृभाय । महाहस्ती दक्षिणेन ॥७२८॥
translation: Hero when thou wouldst give thy gifts, neither the Gods nor mortal men Restrain thee like a fearful bull.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विद्मा हि त्वा तुविकूर्मिं तुविदेष्णं तुवीमघम् । तुविमात्रमवोभिः ॥७२९॥
translation: Hero, the Soma being shed, I pour the juice for thee to drink: Sate thee and finish thy carouse!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: न हि त्वा शूर देवा न मर्तासो दित्सन्तम् । भीमं न गां वारयन्ते ॥७३०॥
translation: Let not the fools, or those who mock, beguile thee when they seek thine aid: Love not the enemy of prayer!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभि त्वा वृषभा सुते सुतꣳ सृजामि पीतये । तृम्पा व्यश्नुही मदम् ॥७३१॥
translation: Here let them cheer thee well supplied with milk to great munificence: Drink as the wild bull drinks the lake! VIII lndra I. Here is the Soma juice expressed: O Vasu, drink till thou art full! Undaunted God, we give it thee!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मा त्वा मूरा अविष्यवो मोपहस्वान आ दभन् । मा कीं ब्रह्मद्विषं वनः ॥७३२॥
translation: Washed by the men, pressed out with stones, strained through the filter made of wool, ‘Tis like a courser bathed in streams.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इह त्वा गोपरीणसं महे मन्दन्तु राधसे । सरो गौरो यथा पिब ॥७३३॥
translation: This juice have we made sweet for thee like barley, blending it with milk. Indra, I call thee to our feast.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इदम् वसो सुतमन्धः पिबा सुपूर्णमुदरम् । अनाभयिन्ररिमा ते ॥७३४॥
translation: So, Lord of affluent gifts, this juice hath been expressed for thee with strength: Drink of it, thou who lovest song!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नृभिर्धौतः सुतो अश्नैरव्या वारैः परिपूतः । अश्वो न निक्तो नदीषु ॥७३५॥
translation: Incline thy body to the juice which suits thy godlike nature well: 41 Thee, Soma-lover! let it cheer!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तं ते यवं यथा गोभिः स्वादुमकर्म श्रीणन्तः । इन्द्र त्वास्मिंत्सधमादे ॥७३६॥
translation: O Indra, let it enter both thy flanks, enter thy head with prayer, With bounty, hero! both thine arms!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इदꣳ ह्यन्वोजसा सुतꣳ राधानां पते । पिबा त्वा३स्य गिर्वणः ॥७३७॥
translation: O Come ye hither, sit ye down; to Indra sing ye forth your song, Companions, bringing hymns of praise,
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यस्ते अनु स्वधामसत्सुते नि यच्छ तन्वम् । स त्वा ममत्तु सोम्य ॥७३८॥
translation: Laud Indra, richest of the rich, who ruleth over noblest wealth, Beside the flowing Soma juice!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र ते अश्नोतु कुक्ष्योः प्रेन्द्र ब्रह्मणा शिरः । प्र बाहू शूर राधसा ॥७३९॥
translation: May he stand near us in our need with all abundance, for our wealth: With strength may he come nigh to us!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ त्वेता नि षीदतेन्द्रमभि प्र गायत । सखाय स्तोमवाहसः ॥७४०॥
translation: In every need, in every fray we call, as friends to succour us, Indra, the mightiest of all.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पुरूतमं पुरूणामीशानं वार्याणाम् । इन्द्रꣳ सोमे सचा सुते ॥७४१॥
translation: I call him, mighty to resist, the hero of our ancient home, Thee whom my sire invoked of old.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स घा नो योग आ भुवत्स राये स पुरन्ध्या । गमद्वाजेभिरा स नः ॥७४२॥
translation: If he will hear us, let him come with succour of a thousand kinds, With strength and riches, to our call!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: योगेयोगे तवस्तरं वाजेवाजे हवामहे । सखाय इन्द्रमूतये ॥७४३॥
translation: When Somas flow thou makest pure, Indra, thy mind that merits laud, For gain of strength that ever grows: for great is he.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अनु प्रत्नस्यौकसो हुवे तुविप्रतिं नरम् । यं ते पूर्वं पिता हुवे ॥७४४॥
translation: In heaven’s first region, in the seat of Gods, is he who brings success, Most glorious, prompt to save, who wins the waterfloods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ घा गमद्यदि श्रवत्सहस्रिणीभिरूतिभिः । वाजेभिरुप नो हवम् ॥७४५॥
translation: Him I invoke, to win the spoil, even mighty Indra for the fray. Be thou most near to us for bliss, a friend to aid!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्र सुतेषु सोमेषु क्रतुं पुनीष उक्थ्यम् । विदे वृधस्य दक्षस्य महाꣳ हि षः ॥७४६॥
translation: With this mine homage I invoke Agni for you, the Son of Strength. Dear, wisest envoy, skilled in noble sacrifice, immortal, messanger of all.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स प्रथमे व्योमनि देवानाꣳ सदने वृधः । सुपारः सुश्रवस्तमः समप्सुजित् ॥७४७॥
translation: His two red horses, all-supporting, let him yoke: let him, well-worshipped, urge them fast! Then hath the sacrifice good prayers and happy end, the heavenly gift of wealth to men.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तमु हुवे वाजसातय इन्द्रं भराय शुष्मिणम् । भवा नः सुम्ने अन्तमः सखा वृधे ॥७४८॥
translation: Advancing, sending forth her rays, the daughter of the Sky is seen. The mighty one lays bare the darkness with her eye, the friendly Lady makes the light.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एना वो अग्निं नमसोर्जो नपातमा हुवे । प्रियं चेतिष्ठमरतिꣳ स्वध्वरं विश्वस्य दूतममृतम् ॥७४९॥
translation: The Sun ascending, the refulgent star, pours down his beams. together with the Dawn. O Dawn, at thine arising, and, the Sun’s, may we attain the share allotted us!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स योजते अरुषा विश्वभोजसा स दुद्रवत्स्वाहुतः । सुब्रह्मा यज्ञः सुशमी वसूनां देवꣳ राधो जनानाम् ॥७५०॥
translation: These morning sacrifices call you, Asvins, at the break of day. For help have I invoked you rich in power and might: for, house by house, ye visit all.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्रत्यु अदर्श्यायत्यू३च्छन्ती दुहिता दिवः । अपो मही वृणुते चक्षुषा तमो ज्योतिष्कृणोति सूनरी ॥७५१॥
translation: Ye, heroes, have bestowed wonderful nourishment: send it to him whose songs are sweet. One-minded, both of you, drive your car down to us: drink yethe savoury Soma juice! XVI Soma Pavamana.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उदुस्रियाः सृजते सूर्यः सचा उद्यन्नक्षत्रमर्चिवत् । तवेदुषो व्युषि सूर्यस्य च सं भक्तेन गमेमहि ॥७५२॥
translation: After his ancient splendour, they, the bold, have drawn the bright milk from The Sage who wins a thousand spoils.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इमा उ वां दिविष्टय उस्रा हवन्ते अश्विना । अयं वामह्वेऽवसे शचीवसू विशंविशꣳ हि गच्छथः ॥७५३॥
translation: In aspect he is like the Sun: he runneth forward to the lakes: Seven currents flowing to the 42 sky.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: युवं चित्रं ददथुर्भोजनं नरा चोदेथाꣳ सूनृतावते । अर्वाग्रथꣳ समनसा नि यच्छतं पिबतꣳ सोम्यं मधु ॥७५४॥
translation: He, while they purify him, stands high over all things that exist Soma, a God as Surya is.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अस्य प्रत्नामनु द्युतꣳ शुक्रं दुदुह्रे अह्रयः । पयः सहस्रसामृषिम् ॥७५५॥
translation: By generation long ago this God, engendered for the Gods, Flows tawny to the straining cloth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अयꣳ सूर्य इवोपदृगयꣳ सराꣳसि धावति । सप्त प्रवत आ दिवम् ॥७५६॥
translation: According to primeval plan this poet hath been strengthened by, The sage as God for all the Gods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अयं विश्वानि तिष्ठति पुनानो भुवनोपरि । सोमो देवो न सूर्यः ॥७५७॥
translation: Shedding the ancient fiuid thou art poured into the cleansing sieve: Roaring, thou hast produced the Gods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एष प्रत्नेन जन्मना देवो देवेभ्यः सुतः । हरि पवित्रे अर्षति ॥७५८॥
translation: Bring near us those who stand aloof: strike fear into our enemy: O Pavamana, find us wealth!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एष प्रत्नेन मन्मना देवो देवेभ्यस्परि । कविर्विप्रेण वावृधे ॥७५९॥
translation: To him the active, nobly born.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: दुहानः प्रत्नमित्पयः पवित्रे परि षिच्यसे । क्रन्दं देवाꣳ अजीजनः ॥७६०॥
translation: Sing ye your songs to him, O men!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उप शिक्षापतस्थुषो भियसमा धेहि शत्रवे । पवमान विदा रयिम् ॥७६१॥
translation: The Somas skilled in song, the waves have led the water forward, like Buffaloes speeding to the woods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उपो षु जातमप्तुरं गोभिर्भङ्गं परिष्कृतम् । इन्दुं देवा अयासिषुः ॥७६२॥
translation: With stream of sacrifice the brown bright drops have flowed with strength in store Of kine into the wooden vats.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उपास्मै गायता नरः पवमानायेन्दवे । अभि देवाꣳ इयक्षते ॥७६३॥
translation: To Indra, Vayu. Varuna to Vishnu and the Maruts let The Soma juices flow expressed.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र सोमासो विपश्चितोऽपो नयन्त ऊर्मयः । वनानि महिषा इव ॥७६४॥
translation: O Soma, for the feast of Gods, river-like he hath swelled with surge, Sweet with the liquor of the stalk, as one who wakes, into the vat that drops with meath.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभि द्रोणानि बभ्रवः शुक्रा ऋतस्य धारया । वाजं गोमन्तमक्षरन् ॥७६५॥
translation: Like a dear son how must be decked, the bright and shining one hath clad him in his robe. Men skilful at their work drive him forth, like a car, into the rivers from their hands.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सुता इन्द्राय वायवे वरुणाय मरुद्भ्यः । सोमा अर्षन्तु विष्णवे ॥७६६॥
translation: The rapture-shedding Somas have flowed forth in our assembly, pressed. To glorify our liberal lords.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र सोम देववीतये सिन्धुर्न पिप्ये अर्णसा । अꣳशोः पयसा मदिरो न जागृविरच्छा कोशं मधुश्चुतम् ॥७६७॥
translation: Now like a swan hemaketh all the company sing each his hymm He like steed is bathed in milk.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ हर्यतो अर्जुनो अत्के अव्यत प्रियः सूनुर्न मर्ज्यः । तमीꣳ हिन्वन्त्यपसो यथा रथं नदीष्वा गभस्त्योः ॥७६८॥
translation: And Trita’s maidens onward urge the tawny-coloured with the stones, Indu for Indra, for his drink. XXII Soma Pavamana.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र सोमासो मदच्युतः श्रवसे नो मघोनाम् । सुता विदथे अक्रमुः ॥७६९॥
translation: Herewith flow on, thou friend of Gods! Singing, thou runnest round the sieve oni every side. The streams of meath have been effused.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आदीꣳ हꣳसो यथा गणं विश्वस्यावीवशन्मतिम् । अत्यो न गोभिरज्यते ॥७७०॥
translation: Lovely, gold-coloured, on he flows.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आदीं त्रितस्य योषणो हरिꣳ हिन्वन्त्यद्रिभिः । इन्दुमिन्द्राय पीतये ॥७७१॥
translation: For him who presses, of the juice. 43
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अया पवस्व देवयू रेभन्पवित्रं पर्येषि विश्वतः । मधोर्धारा असृक्षत ॥७७२॥
translation: Soma, as leader of the song, flow onward with thy wondrous aid. For holy lore of every sort!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवते हर्यतो हरिरति ह्वराꣳसि रꣳह्या । अभ्यर्ष स्तोतृभ्यो वीरवद्यशः ॥७७३॥
translation: Do thou as leader of the song, stirring the waters of the sea, Flow onward, known to all mankind! 1 O Soma, O thou Sage, these worlds stand ready to enhance thy might: The milch-kine run for thy behoof.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र सुन्वानायान्धसो मर्तो न वष्ट तद्वचः । अप श्वानमराधसं हता मखं न भृगवः ॥७७४॥
translation: Indu, flow on, a mighty juice; glorify us among the folk: Drive all our enernies away!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवस्व वाचो अग्रियः सोम चित्राभिरूतिभिः । अभि विश्वानि काव्या ॥७७५॥
translation: And in thy friendship, Indu, most sublime and glorious, may we Subdue all those who war with us!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वꣳ समुद्रिया अपोऽग्रियो वाच ईरयन् । पवस्व विश्वचर्षणे ॥७७६॥
translation: Those awful weapons which thou hast, sharpened at point to strike men down-- Guard us therewith from every foe!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तुभ्येमा भुवना कवे महिम्ने सोम तस्थिरे । तुभ्यं धावन्ति धेनवः ॥७७७॥
translation: O Soma, thou art strong and bright, potent, O God, with potent sway,
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवस्वेन्दो वृषा सुतः कृधी नो यशसो जने । विश्वा अप द्विषो जहि ॥७७८॥
translation: Steer-strong thy might is like a steer’s, steer-strong the wood, steer-strong the juice: A steer indeed, O Steer, art thou.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यस्य ते सख्ये वयꣳ सासह्याम पृतन्यतः । तवेन्दो द्युम्न उत्तमे ॥७७९॥
translation: Thou, Indu, as a vigorous horse, hast neighed together steeds and kine: Unbar for us the doors to wealth!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: या ते भीमान्यायुधा तिग्मानि सन्ति धूर्वणे । रक्षा समस्य नो निदः ॥७८०॥
translation: For thou art strong by splendour: we, O Pavamana call on thee, The brilliant looker on the light.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वृषा सोम द्युमाꣳ असि वृषा देव वृषव्रतः । वृषा धर्माणि दध्रिषे ॥७८१॥
translation: When thou art sprinkled with the streams, thou reachest, purified by men, Thy dwelling in the wooden vat.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वृष्णस्ते वृष्ण्यꣳ शवो वृषा वनं वृषा सुतः । स त्वं वृषन्वृषेदसि ॥७८२॥
translation: Do thou, rejoicing, nobly-armed! pour upon us heroic strength. O Indu, come thou hitherward!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अश्वो न चक्रदो वृषा सं गा इन्दो समर्वतः । वि नो राये दुरो वृधि ॥७८३॥
translation: We seek to win thy friendly love, even Pavamana’s flowing o’er The limit of the cleansing sieve.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वृषा ह्यसि भानुना द्युमन्तं त्वा हवामहे । पवमान स्वर्दृशम् ॥७८४॥
translation: With those same waves which in their stream o’erflow the purifying sieve, Soma, be gracious unto us!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यदद्भिः परिषिच्यसे मर्मृज्यमान आयुभिः । द्रोणे सधस्थमश्नुषे ॥७८५॥
translation: O Soma, being purified, bring us from all sides-for thou canst- Riches and food with hero sons!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ पवस्व सुवीर्यं मन्दमानः स्वायुध । इहो ष्विन्दवा गहि ॥७८६॥
translation: Agni we choose as envoy, skilled performer of this holy rite, Hotar, possessor of all wealth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवमानस्य ते वयं पवित्रमभ्युन्दतः । सखित्वमा वृणीमहे ॥७८७॥
translation: With constant calls they invocate Agni, Agni, Lord of the house, Oblation-bearer, much-beloved 44
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ये ते पवित्रमूर्मयोऽभिक्षरन्ति धारया । तेभिर्नः सोम मृडय ॥७८८॥
translation: Bring the Gods hither, Agni, born for him who trims the Sacred grass: Thou art our Hotar, meet for praise!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स नः पुनान आ भर रयिं वीरवतीमिषम् । ईशानः सोम विश्वतः ॥७८९॥
translation: Mitra and Varuna we call to drink the draught of Soma juice, Those born endowed with holy strength.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्निं दूतं वृणीमहे होतारं विश्ववेदसम् । अस्य यज्ञस्य सुक्रतुम् ॥७९०॥
translation: Those who by Law uphold the Law, Lords of the shining light of Law, Mitra I call, and Varuna.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्निमग्निꣳ हवीमभिः सदा हवन्त विश्पतिम् । हव्यवाहं पुरुप्रियम् ॥७९१॥
translation: Let Varuna be our chief defence, let Mitra guard us with all aids, Both make us rich exceedingly!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्ने देवाꣳ इहा वह जज्ञानो वृक्तबर्हिषे । असि होता न ईड्यः ॥७९२॥
translation: Indra the singers with high praise, Indra reciters with their lauds, Indra the choirs have glorified.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मित्रं वयꣳ हवामहे वरुणꣳ सोमपीतये । या जाता पूतदक्षसा ॥७९३॥
translation: Indra is close to his two bays, with chariot ready at his word, Indra the golden, thunder-armed.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ऋतेन यावृतावृधावृतस्य ज्योतिषस्पती । ता मित्रावरुणा हुवे ॥७९४॥
translation: Help us in battles Indra, in battles where thousand spoils are gained, With awful aids, O awful one!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वरुणः प्राविता भुवन्मित्रो विश्वाभिरूतिभिः । करतां नः सुराधसः ॥७९५॥
translation: Indra raised up the son aloft in heaven, that he may see afar: He burst the mountain for the kine. IX Indra-Agni
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रमिद्गाथिनो बृहदिन्द्रमर्केभिरर्किणः । इन्द्रं वाणीरनूषत ॥७९६॥
translation: To Indra and to Agni we bring reverence high and holy hymn, And, craving help, soft words with prayer.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्र इद्धर्योः सचा सम्मिश्ल आ वचोयुजा । इन्द्रो वज्री हिरण्ययः ॥७९७॥
translation: For all these holy singers thus implore these twain to succour them, And priests that they may win them strength.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्र वाजेषु नोऽव सहस्रप्रधनेषु च । उग्र उग्राभिरूतिभिः ॥७९८॥
translation: Eager to laud you, we with songs invoke you, bearing sacred food, Fain for success in sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रो दीर्घाय चक्षस आ सूर्यꣳ रोहयद्दिवि । वि गोभिरद्रिमैरयत् ॥७९९॥
translation: Flow onward, mighty with thy stream, inspiriting the Marut’s Lord, Winning all riches with thy power!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रे अग्ना नमो बृहत्सुवृक्तिमेरयामहे । धिया धेना अवस्यवः ॥८००॥
translation: I send thee forth to battle from the press, O Pavamana, strong, Sustainer, looker on the light!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ता हि शश्वन्त ईडत इत्था विप्रास ऊतये । सबाधो वाजसातये ॥८०१॥
translation: Acknowledged by this song of mine, flow, tawnycoloured, with thy stream: Incite to battle thine ally!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ता वां गीर्भिर्विपन्युवः प्रयस्वन्तो हवामहे । मेधसाता सनिष्यवः ॥८०२॥
translation: A Red Bull bellowing to the kine, thou goest, causing the heavens and earth to roar and thunder. A shout is heard like Indra’s in the battle: thou flowest on, sending this voice before thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वृषा पवस्व धारया मरुत्वते च मत्सरः । विश्वा दधान ओजसा ॥८०३॥
translation: Swelling with milk, abounding in sweet juices, urging the meathrich plant thou goest onward. Making loud clamour, Soma Pavamana, thou flowest when thou art effused for Indra.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तं त्वा धर्त्तारमोण्यो३: पवमान स्वर्दृशम् । हिन्वे वाजेषु वाजिनम् ॥८०४॥
translation: So flow thou on inspiriting, for rapture, turning the weapon of the water’s holder! Flow to us wearing thy resplendent colour, effused and eager for the kine. O Soma!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अया चित्तो विपानया हरिः पवस्व धारया । युजं वाजेषु चोदय ॥८०५॥
translation: That we may win us wealth and power we poets verily, call on thee: In war men call on thee, Indra, the hero’s Lord, in the steed’s race-course call on thee 45
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वृषा शोणो अभिकनिक्रदद्गा नदयन्नेषि पृथिवीमुत द्याम् । इन्द्रस्येव वग्नुरा शृण्व आजौ प्रचोदयन्नर्षसि वाचमेमाम् ॥८०६॥
translation: As such, O wonderful, whose hand holds thunder, praised as mighty, Caster of the Stone! Pour on us boldly, Indra, kine and chariot-steeds, ever to be the conqueror’s strength!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: रसाय्यः पयसा पिन्वमान ईरयन्नेषि मधुमन्तमꣳशुम् । पवमान सन्तनिमेषि कृण्वन्निन्द्राय सोम परिषिच्यमानः ॥८०७॥
translation: To you will I sing Indra’s praise who gives good gifts, as we I we know; The praise of Maghavan who, rich in treasure, aids his singers with wealth thousandfold.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एवा पवस्व मदिरो मदायोदग्राभस्य नमयन्वधस्नुम् । परि वर्णं भरमाणो रुशन्तं गव्युर्नो अर्ष परि सोम सिक्तः ॥८०८॥
translation: As with a hundred hosts, he rushes boldly on, and for the offerer slays his foes. As from a mountain fiow the water-brooks, thus flow his gifts who feedeth many a one.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वामिद्धि हवामहे सातौ वाजस्य कारवः । त्वां वृत्रेष्विन्द्र सत्पतिं नरस्त्वां काष्ठास्वर्वतः ॥८०९॥
translation: O Thunderer, zealous worshippers gave thee drink this time yesterday: So, Indra, listen here to him who offers lauds: come near unto our dwelling-place!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स त्वं नश्चित्र वज्रहस्त धृष्णुया मह स्तवानो अद्रिवः । गामश्वꣳ रथ्यमिन्द्र सं किर सत्रा वाजं न जिग्युषे ॥८१०॥
translation: Lord of bay steeds, fair-helmed, rejoice thee: thee we seek. Here the disposers wait on thee. Thy glories, meet for praise! are highest by the juice, O Indra, lover of the song.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभि प्र वः सुराधसमिन्द्रमर्च यथा विदे । यो जरितृभ्यो मघवा पुरूवसुः सहस्रेणेव शिक्षति ॥८११॥
translation: Flow onward with that juice of thine most excellent, that brings delight, Slaying the wicked, dear to Gods!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: शतानीकेव प्र जिगाति धृष्णुया हन्ति वृत्राणि दाशुषे । गिरेरिव प्र रसा अस्य पिन्विरे दत्राणि पुरुभोजसः ॥८१२॥
translation: Killing the foeman and his hate, and daily winning spoil and strength, Gainer art thou of steeds and kine.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वामिदा ह्यो नरोऽपीप्यन्वज्रिन्भूर्णयः । स इन्द्र स्तोमवाहस इह श्रुध्युप स्वसरमा गहि ॥८१३॥
translation: Red-hued, be blended with the milk that seems to yield its lovely breast, Falcon-like resting in thine home!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मत्स्वा सुशिप्रिन्हरिवस्तमीमहे त्वया भूषन्ति वेधसः । तव श्रवाꣳस्युपमान्युक्थ्य सुतेष्विन्द्र गिर्वणः ॥८१४॥
translation: As Pashan, Fortune, Bhaga, comes this Soma while they make him pure. He, Lord of all the multitude, hath looked upon the earth and heaven.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यस्ते मदो वरेण्यस्तेना पवस्वान्धसा । देवावीरघशꣳसहा ॥८१५॥
translation: The dear cows sang in joyful mood together to the gladdening drink. The drops as they are purified, the Soma juices, make the paths.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: जघ्निर्वृत्रममित्रियꣳ सस्निर्वाजं दिवेदिवे । गोषातिरश्वसा असि ॥८१६॥
translation: O Pavamana, bring the juice, the mightiest, worthy to be famed, Which the Five Tribes have over them, whereby we may win opulence!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सम्मिश्लो अरुषो भुवः सूपस्थाभिर्न धेनुभिः । सीदञ्छ्येनो न योनिमा ॥८१७॥
translation: Far-seeing Soma flows, the Steer, the Lord of hymns, the furtherer of days, of mornings, and of heaven. Breath of the rivers, he hath roared into the jars, and with the help of sages entered Indra’s heart.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अयं पूषा रयिर्भगः सोमः पुनानो अर्षति । पतिर्विश्वस्य भूमनो व्यख्यद्रोदसी उभे ॥८१८॥
translation: On, with the sages, flows the poet on his way, and guided by the men, hath streamed into the vats. He, showing Trita’s name, hath caused the meath to flow, increasing Vayu’s strength to make him Indra’s friend.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: समु प्रिया अनूषत गावो मदाय घृष्वयः । सोमासः कृण्वते पथः पवमानास इन्दवः ॥८१९॥
translation: He, being purified, hath made the mornings shine, and it is he who gave the rivers room to flow. Making the three-times seven pour out the milky stream, Soma, the cheerer, yields whate’er the heart finds sweet.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: य ओजिष्ठस्तमा भर पवमान श्रवाय्यम् । यः पञ्च चर्षणीरभि रयिं येन वनामहे ॥८२०॥
translation: For so thou art the brave man’s friend; a hero, too, art thou, and strong: So may thy heart be won us!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वृषा मतीनां पवते विचक्षणः सोमो अह्नां प्रतरीतोषसां दिवः । प्राणा सिन्धूनां कलशाꣳ अचिक्रददिन्द्रस्य हार्द्याविशन्मनीषिभिः ॥८२१॥
translation: So hath the offering. wealthiest Lord, been paid by all the worshippers. So dwell thou, Indra, even with us! 46
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मनीषिभिः पवते पूर्व्यः कविर्नृभिर्यतः परि कोशाꣳ असिष्यदत् । त्रितस्य नाम जनयन्मधु क्षरन्निन्द्रस्य वायुꣳ सख्याय वर्धयन् ॥८२२॥
translation: Be not thou like a slothful priest, O Lord of spoil and strength: rejoice In the pressed Soma blent with milk!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अयं पुनान उषसो अरोचयदयꣳ सिन्धुभ्यो अभवदु लोककृत् । अयं त्रिः सप्त दुदुहान आशिरꣳ सोमो हृदे पवते चारु मत्सरः ॥८२३॥
translation: All sacred songs have magnified Indra expansive as the sea. Best of all warriors borne on cars, the Lord of heroes, Lord of strength.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एवा ह्यसि वीरयुरेवा शूर उत स्थिरः । एवा ते राध्यं मनः ॥८२४॥
translation: Lord of might, Indra, may we ne’er, strong in thy friendship, be afraid! We glorify with praises thee, the never conquered conqueror.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एवा रातिस्तुविमघ विश्वेभिर्धायि धातृभिः । अधा चिदिन्द्र नः सचा ॥८२५॥
translation: The gifts of Indra from of old, his saving succours never fail, When to his worshippers he gives the boon of booty rich in kine.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मो षु ब्रह्मेव तदिन्द्रयुर्भुवो वाजानां पते । मत्स्वा सुतस्य गोमतः ॥८२६॥
translation: These rapid Soma-drops have been poured through the purifying sieve. To bring us all felicities.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रं विश्वा अवीवृधन्त्समुद्रव्यचसं गिरः । रथीतमꣳ रथीनां वाजानाꣳ सत्पतिं पतिम् ॥८२७॥
translation: Dispelling manifold mishap, giving the courser’s progeny, Yea, and the warrior steed’s, success.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सख्ये त इन्द्र वाजिनो मा भेम शवसस्पते । त्वामभि प्र नोनुमो जेतारमपराजितम् ॥८२८॥
translation: Bringing prosperity to kine, they pour perpetual strengthening food On us for noble eulogy. II Soma Pavamana.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पूर्वीरिन्द्रस्य रातयो न वि दस्यन्त्यूतयः । यदा वाजस्य गोमत स्तोतृभ्यो मꣳहते मघम् ॥८२९॥
translation: King Pavamana is implored with holy songs, on man’s behalf, To travel through, the realm of air.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एत असृग्रमिन्दवस्तिरः पवित्रमाशवः । विश्वान्यभि सौभगा ॥८३०॥
translation: Pressed for the banquet of the Gods, O Soma, bring us might,and speed, Like beauty for a’brilliant show!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विघ्नन्तो दुरिता पुरु सुगा तोकाय वाजिनः । त्मना कृण्वन्तो अर्वतः ॥८३१॥
translation: Bring us, O Indu, hundredfold increase of kine, and noble steeds. The gift of fortune for our help!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: कृण्वन्तो वरिवो गवेऽभ्यर्षन्ति सुष्टुतिम् । इडामस्मभ्यꣳ संयतम् ॥८३२॥
translation: With sacrifice we seek to thee fair cherisher of manly might In mansons of the lofty heavens.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: राजा मेधाभिरीयते पवमानो मनावधि । अन्तरिक्षेण यातवे ॥८३३॥
translation: Drink gladdening, crusher of the bold, praiseworthy, with most mighty sway, Destroyer of a hundred forts.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ नः सोम सहो जुवो रूपं न वर्चसे भर । सुष्वाणो देववीतये ॥८३४॥
translation: Hence riches came to thee, the King, O sapient one: the strong-winged bird, Unwearied, brought thee from the sky.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ न इन्दो शातग्विनं गवां पोषꣳ स्वश्व्यम् । वहा भगत्तिमूतये ॥८३५॥
translation: And now, sent forth, he hath attained to mighty power and majesty, Active and ready to assist.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तं त्वा नृम्णानि बिभ्रतꣳ सधस्थेषु महो दिवः । चारुꣳ सुकृत्ययेमहे ॥८३६॥
translation: That each may see the light, the bird brought us the guard of Law, the friend O fall, the speeder through the air.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: संवृक्तधृष्णुमुक्थ्यं महामहिव्रतं मदम् । शतं पुरो रुरुक्षणिम् ॥८३७॥
translation: For food, flow onward with thy stream, cleansed and made bright by sapient men: Indu, with sheen approach the milk!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अतस्त्वा रयिरभ्ययद्राजानꣳ सुक्रतो दिवः । सुपर्णो अव्यथी भरत् ॥८३८॥
translation: While thou art cleansed, song-lover. bring comfort and vigourto the folk, Poured, tawny one! on milk and curds!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अधा हिन्वान इन्द्रियं ज्यायो महित्वमानशे । अभिष्टिकृद्विचर्षणिः ॥८३९॥
translation: Purified for feast of Gods, go thou to Indra’s resting-place, Resplendent, furthered by the strong! V Agni. 47
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विश्वस्मा इत्स्वर्दृशे साधारणꣳ रजस्तुरम् । गोपामृतस्य विर्भरत् ॥८४०॥
translation: By Agni Agni is inflamed, Lord of the house, wise, young,. who bears Our gifts: the ladle is his mouth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इषे पवस्व धारया मृज्यमानो मनीषिभिः । इन्दो रुचाभि गा इहि ॥८४१॥
translation: God, Agni, be his sure defence who, lord of sacrificial gifts. Worshippeth thee the messenger.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पुनानो वरिवस्कृध्यूर्जं जनाय गिर्वणः । हरे सृजान आशिरम् ॥८४२॥
translation: Be gracious, brilliant Godl to him who, rich in sacred gifts,would fain Call Agni to the feast of Gods!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पुनानो देववीतय इन्द्रस्य याहि निष्कृतम् । द्युतानो वाजिभिर्हितः ॥८४३॥
translation: Mitra of holy strength I call, and foe-destroying Varuna, Who perfect prayer with offered oil.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्निनाग्निः समिध्यते कविर्गृहपतिर्युवा । हव्यवाड्जुह्वास्यः ॥८४४॥
translation: By Law, O Mitra, Varuna, Law-strengtheners who cleave to Law, Have ye obtained your lofty power.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यस्त्वामग्ने हविष्पतिर्दूतं देव सपर्यति । तस्य स्म प्राविता भव ॥८४५॥
translation: The Sages, Mitra, Varuna, of wide dominion, mighty ones, Bestow on us effectual strength.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यो अग्निं देववीतये हविष्माꣳ आविवासति । तस्मै पावक मृडय ॥८४६॥
translation: So mayst thou verily be seen coming with fearless Indra: both Of equal splendour, bringing bliss!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मित्रꣳ हुवे पूतदक्षं वरुणं च रिशादसम् । धियं घृताचीꣳ साधन्ता ॥८४७॥
translation: Thereafter they, as is their wont, resumed the state of new-born babes, Taking their sacrificial name.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ऋतेन मित्रावरुणावृतावृधावृतस्पृशा । क्रतुं बृहन्तमाशाथे ॥८४८॥
translation: Thou, Indra, with the rapid Gods who shatter even what is firm, Even in the cave didst find the cows. VIII Indra-Agni
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: कवी नो मित्रावरुणा तुविजाता उरुक्षया । दक्षं दधाते अपसम् ॥८४९॥
translation: I call the twain whose deed wrought here hath all been famed in ancient time: Indra and Agni harm us not!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रेण सꣳ हि दृक्षसे संजग्मानो अबिभ्युषा । मन्दू समानवर्च्चसा ॥८५०॥
translation: The strong, the scatterers of the foe, Indra and Agni we invoke: May they be kind to one like me:
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आदह स्वधामनु पुनर्गर्भत्वमेरिरे । दधाना नाम यज्ञियम् ॥८५१॥
translation: Ye slay our Arya foes, O Lords of heroes, slay our Dasa foes: Ye drive all enemies away. IX Soma Pavamana.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वीडु चिदारुजत्नुभिर्गुहा चिदिन्द्र वह्निभिः । अविन्द उस्रिया अनु ॥८५२॥
translation: The living drops of Soma juice pour, as they flow the gladdening drink, Intelligent drops above the station of the sea, exhilarating, dropping meath.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ता हुवे ययोरिदं पप्ने विश्वं पुरा कृतम् । इन्द्राग्नी न मर्धतः ॥८५३॥
translation: May Pavamana, King and God, speed with his wave over the sea the lofty rite! Do thou by Mitra’s and by Varuna’s decree flow furthering the lofty rite:
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उग्रा विघनिना मृध इन्द्राग्नी हवामहे । ता नो मृडात ईदृशे ॥८५४॥
translation: Far-seeing, lovely, guided by the men, the God whose habitation is the sea!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: हथो वृत्राण्यार्या हथो दासानि सत्पती । हथो विश्वा अप द्विषः ॥८५५॥
translation: Three are the voices that the car-steed utters: he speaks the lore of prayer, the thought of Order. To the cows’ master come the cows inquiring: the hymns with eager longing come to Soma.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभि सोमास आयवः पवन्ते मद्यं मदम् । समुद्रस्याधि विष्टपे मनीषिणो मत्सरासो मदच्युतः ॥८५६॥
translation: To Soma come the cows, the milch-kine longing, to Soma sages with their hymns inquiring. Soma, effused, is purified and lauded: our hymns and Trishtup songs unite in Soma.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तरत्समुद्रं पवमान ऊर्मिणा राजा देव ऋतं बृहत् । अर्षा मित्रस्य वरुणस्य धर्मणा प्र हिन्वान ऋतं बृहत् ॥८५७॥
translation: Thus, Soma, as we pour thee into vessels, while thou art purified, flow for our welfare! Pass into Indra. with great joy and rapture: make the voice swell, and generate abundance!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नृभिर्येमाणो हर्यतो विचक्षणो राजा देवः समुद्र्यः ॥८५८॥
translation: O Indra, if a hundred heavens and if a hundred earths were thine,-- No, not a hundred suns could match thee at thy birth, not both the worlds, O Thunderer. 48
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तिस्रो वाच ईरयति प्र वह्निरृतस्य धीतिं ब्रह्मणो मनीषाम् । गावो यन्ति गोपतिं पृच्छमानाः सोमं यन्ति मतयो वावशानाः ॥८५९॥
translation: Thou, hero, hast performed thy hero deeds with might, yea, all with strength, O strongest one. Maghavan, help us to a stable full of kine, O Thunderer, with wondrous aids!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सोमं गावो धेनवो वावशानाः सोमं विप्रा मतिभिः पृच्छमानाः । सोमः सुत ऋच्यते पूयमानः सोमे अर्कास्त्रिष्टुभः सं नवन्ते ॥८६०॥
translation: We compass thee like water, we whose grass is trimmed and Soma pressed. Here where the filter pours its stream, thy worshippers round thee, O Vritra-slayer, sit.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एवा नः सोम परिषिच्यमान आ पवस्व पूयमानः स्वस्ति । इन्द्रमा विश बृहता मदेन वर्धया वाचं जनया पुरन्धिम् ॥८६१॥
translation: Men, Vasu! by the Soma with lauds call thee to the foremost place. When cometh he athirst unto the juice as home, O Indra, like a bellowing bull?
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यद् द्याव इन्द्र ते शतꣳशतं भूमीरुत स्युः । न त्वा वज्रिन्त्सहस्रꣳ सूर्या अनु न जातमष्ट रोदसी ॥८६२॥
translation: O valiant hero, boldly win thousandfold spoil with Kanva’s sons! O active Maghavan, with eager prayer we crave the yellowhued with store of kine.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ पप्राथ महिना वृष्ण्या वृषन्विश्वा शविष्ठ शवसा । अस्माꣳ अव मघवन्गोमति व्रजे वज्रिञ्चित्राभिरूतिभिः ॥८६३॥
translation: With Plenty for his true ally the active man will gain the spoil. Your Indra, much-invoked, I bend with song, as bends a wright his wheel of solid wood.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वयं घ त्वा सुतावन्त आपो न वृक्तबर्हिषः । पवित्रस्य प्रस्रवणेषु वृत्रहन्परि स्तोतार आसते ॥८६४॥
translation: They who bestow great riches love not paltry praise: wealth comes not to the niggard churl. Light is the task to give, O Maghavan, to one like me on the decisive day.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स्वरन्ति त्वा सुते नरो वसो निरेक उक्थिनः । कदा सुतं तृषाण ओक आ गम इन्द्र स्वब्दीव वꣳसगः ॥८६५॥
translation: Three several words are uttered: kine are lowing cows. who give the milk: The tawny-hued goes bellowing on.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: कण्वेभिर्धृष्णवा धृषद्वाजं दर्षि सहस्रिणम् । पिशङ्गरूपं मघवन्विचर्षणे मक्षू गोमन्तमीमहे ॥८६६॥
translation: The young and sacred mothers of the holy rite have uttered praise, Embellishing the Child of Heaven.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तरणिरित्सिषासति वाजं पुरन्ध्या युजा । आ व इन्द्रं पुरुहूतं नमे गिरा नेमिं तष्टेव सुद्रुवम् ॥८६७॥
translation: From every side, O Soma, for our profit, pour thou forth four seas. Filled full of riches thousandfold!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: न दुष्टुतिर्द्रविणोदेषु शस्यते न स्रेधन्तꣳ रयिर्नशत् । सुशक्तिरिन्मघवन् तुभ्यं मावते देष्णं यत्पार्ये दिवि ॥८६८॥
translation: The Somas, very rich in sweets, for which the sieve is distined, flow Effused, the source of Indra’s joy: may you strong juices reach the Gods!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तिस्रो वाच उदीरते गावो मिमन्ति धेनवः । हरिरेति कनिक्रदत् ॥८६९॥
translation: Indu flows on for Indra’s sake,-thus have the deities declared. The Lord of Speech exerts himself, controller of all power and might.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभि ब्रह्मीरनूषत यह्वीरृतस्य मातरः । मर्जयन्तीर्दिवः शिशुम् ॥८७०॥
translation: Inciter of the voice of song, with thousand streams the ocean flows. Even Soma, Lord of opulence, the friend of Indra, day by day.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: रायः समुद्राꣳश्चतुरोऽस्मभ्यꣳ सोम विश्वतः । आ पवस्व सहस्रिणः ॥८७१॥
translation: SPREAD is thy cleansing filter, Brahmanaspati: as prince thou enterest its limbs from every side. The raw; whose mass bath not been heated. gains not this: they only which are dressed, which bear, attain to it.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सुतासो मधुमत्तमाः सोमा इन्द्राय मन्दिनः । पवित्रवन्तो अक्षरं देवान्गच्छन्तु वो मदाः ॥८७२॥
translation: High in the seat of heaven is placed the scorcher’s sieve: its, threads are standing separate, glittering with light. The swift ones favour him who purifieth this: with brilliancy they mount up to the height of heaven.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्दुरिन्द्राय पवत इति देवासो अब्रुवन् । वाचस्पतिर्मखस्यते विश्वस्येशान ओजसः ॥८७३॥
translation: The foremost spotted Steer bath made the Mornings shine: he bellows, fain for war, among created things. By his high wisdom have the mighty Sages wrought: the Fathers who behold mankind laid down the germ.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सहस्रधारः पवते समुद्रो वाचमीङ्खयः । सोमस्पती रयीणाꣳ सखेन्द्रस्य दिवेदिवे ॥८७४॥
translation: Sing forth to him, the holy, most munificent, sublime with his refulgent glow, To Agni, ye Upastutas 49
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवित्रं ते विततं ब्रह्मणस्पते प्रभुर्गात्राणि पर्येषि विश्वतः । अतप्ततनूर्न तदामो अश्नुते शृतास इद्वहन्तः सं तदाशत ॥८७५॥
translation: Worshipped with gifts, enkindled, splendid, Maghavan shall win himself heroic fame: And will not his more plentiful benevolence come to us with abundant strength?
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तपोष्पवित्रं विततं दिवस्पदेऽर्चन्तो अस्य तन्तवो व्यस्थिरन् । अवन्त्यस्य पवितारमाशवो दिवः पृष्ठमधि रोहन्ति तेजसा ॥८७६॥
translation: We sing this strong and wild delight of thine which conquers in the fray, Which, Caster of the Stone! gives room and shines like gold.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अरूरुचदुषसः पृश्निरग्रिय उक्षा मिमेति भुवनेषु वाजयुः । मायाविनो ममिरे अस्य मायया नृचक्षसः पितरो गर्भमा दधुः ॥८७७॥
translation: Wherewith thou foundest shining lights for Ayu and for Manu’s sake: Now joying in this sacred grass thou bearnest forth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र मꣳहिष्ठाय गायत ऋताव्ने बृहते शुक्रशोचिषे । उपस्तुतासो अग्नये ॥८७८॥
translation: This day too singers of the hymn praise, as of old, this might of thine: Win thou the waters every day, thralls of the strong!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ वꣳसते मघवा वीरवद्यशः समिद्धो द्युम्न्याहुतः । कुविन्नो अस्य सुमतिर्भवीयस्यच्छा वाजेभिरागमत् ॥८७९॥
translation: O Indra, hear Tirschi’s call, the call of him who serveth thee. Satisfy him with wealth of kine and valient offspring! Great art thou.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तं ते मदं गृणीमसि वृषणं पृक्षु सासहिम् । उ लोककृत्नुमद्रिवो हरिश्रियम् ॥८८०॥
translation: For he, O Indra, hath produced for thee the newest gladdening song, A hymn that springs from careful drop thought, ancient and full of sacred truth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: येन ज्योतीꣳष्यायवे मनवे च विवेदिथ । मन्दानो अस्य बर्हिषो वि राजसि ॥८८१॥
translation: That Indra will we laud whom songs and hymns of praise have magnified. Striving to win, we celebrate his many deeds of hero might. 50
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तदद्या चित्त उक्थिनोऽनु ष्टुवन्ति पूर्वथा । वृषपत्नीरपो जया दिवेदिवे ॥८८२॥
translation: Fleet as swift steeds thy cows celestial have been poured, O Pavamana, with the milk into the vat. Sages who make thee bright, O friend whom Rishis love, have shed continuous streams from out the realm of air.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: श्रुधी हवं तिरश्च्या इन्द्र यस्त्वा सपर्यति । सुवीर्यस्य गोमतो रायस्पूर्धि महाꣳ असि ॥८८३॥
translation: The beams of Pavamana, sent from earth and heaven his ensigns who is ever stedfast, travel round. When on the sieve the golden-hued is cleansed he rests within the jars as one who seats him in his place.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यस्त इन्द्र नवीयसीं गिरं मन्द्रामजीजनत् । चिकित्विन्मनसं धियं प्रत्नामृतस्य पिप्युषीम् ॥८८४॥
translation: O thou who seest all things, sovran as thou art and passing strong, thy rays encompass every form. Pervading with thy natural powers thou flowest on, and as the whole world’s Lord, O Soma, thou art King.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तमु ष्टवाम यं गिर इन्द्रमुक्थानि वावृधुः । पुरूण्यस्य पौꣳस्या सिषासन्तो वनामहे ॥८८५॥
translation: From heaven hath Pavamana, made, as ‘twere, the marvellous thunder, and The lofty light of all mankind.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र त आश्विनीः पवमान धेनवो दिव्या असृग्रन्पयसा धरीमणि । प्रान्तरिक्षात्स्थाविरीस्ते असृक्षत ये त्वा मृजन्त्यृषिषाण वेधसः ॥८८६॥
translation: The gladdening and auspicious juice of thee, O Pavamana, King! Flows o’cr the woollen straining-cloth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उभयतः पवमानस्य रश्मयो ध्रुवस्य सतः परि यन्ति केतवः । यदी पवित्रे अधि मृज्यते हरिः सत्ता नि योनौ कलशेषु सीदति ॥८८७॥
translation: Thy juice, O Pavamana, sends its rays abroad fixe splendid skill, Like lustre, all heaven’s light, to see.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विश्वा धामानि विश्वचक्ष ऋभ्वसः प्रभोष्टे सतः परि यन्ति केतवः । व्यानशी पवसे सोम धर्मणा पतिर्विश्वस्य भुवनस्य राजसि ॥८८८॥
translation: Impetuous, bright, have they come forth, unwearied in their speed, like bulls, Driving the black skin far away.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवमानो अजीजनद्दिवश्चित्रं न तन्यतुम् । ज्योतिर्वैश्वानरं बृहत् ॥८८९॥
translation: May we attain the bridge of bliss, leaving the bridge of woe behind: The riteless Dasa may we quell!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवमान रसस्तव मदो राजन्नदुच्छुनः । वि वारमव्यमर्षति ॥८९०॥
translation: The mighty Pavamana’s roar is heard as ‘twere the rush of rain The lightning-Rashes move in heaven.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवमानस्य ते रसो दक्षो वि राजति द्युमान् । ज्योतिर्विश्वꣳ स्वर्दृशे ॥८९१॥
translation: Indu, pour out abundant food with store of cattle and of gold, Of heroes, Soma! and of steeds!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र यद्गावो न भूर्णयस्त्वेषा अयासो अक्रमुः । घ्नन्तः कृष्णामप त्वचम् ॥८९२॥
translation: Flow onward, dear to all mankind fi full the mighty heaven and earth, As Dawn, as Surya with his beams
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सुवितस्य वनामहेऽति सेतुं दुराय्यम् । साह्याम दस्युमव्रतम् ॥८९३॥
translation: On every side, O Soma, flow round us with thy protecting stream, As Rasa flows around the world!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: शृण्वे वृष्टेरिव स्वनः पवमानस्य शुष्मिणः । चरन्ति विद्युतो दिवि ॥८९४॥
translation: Flow on, O thou of lofty thought, flow swift in thy beloved form, Saying, I go where dwell the Gods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ पवस्व महीमिषं गोमदिन्दो हिरण्यवत् । अश्ववत्सोम वीरवत् ॥८९५॥
translation: Preparing what is unprepared, and bringing store of food to man, Make thou the rain descend from heaven
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवस्व विश्वचर्षण आ मही रोदसी पृण । उषाः सूर्यो न रश्मिभिः ॥८९६॥
translation: Even here is he who, swift of course, hath with the river’s wave Rowed down. From heaven upon the straining cloth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: परि णः शर्मयन्त्या धारया सोम विश्वतः । सरा रसेव विष्टपम् ॥८९७॥
translation: With might. producing glare, the juice enters the purifying sieve, Far-seeing, sending forth its light. 51
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आशुरर्ष बृहन्मते परि प्रियेण धाम्ना । यत्र देवा इति ब्रुवन् ॥८९८॥
translation: Inviting him from far away, and even from near at hand, the juice For Indra is poured forth as meath.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: परिष्कृण्वन्ननिष्कृतं जनाय यातयन्निषः । वृष्टिं दिवः परि स्रव ॥८९९॥
translation: In union they have sung the hymn: with stones they urge the golden-hued, Indu for Indra, for his drink.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अयꣳ स यो दिवस्परि रघुयामा पवित्र आ । सिन्धोरूर्मा व्यक्षरत् ॥९००॥
translation: The glittering maids send Sdra forth, the glorious sisters, closeallied, Send Indu forth, their mighty Lord.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सुत एति पवित्र आ त्विषिं दधान ओजसा । विचक्षाणो विरोचयन् ॥९०१॥
translation: Pervade, O Pavamana, all our treasures with repeated light, Pressed out, O God thyself, for Gods!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आविवासन्परावतो अथो अर्वावतः सुतः । इन्द्राय सिच्यते मधु ॥९०२॥
translation: Pour on us, Pavamana! rain, as service and fair praise for Gods: Pour forth unceasingly for food!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: समीचीना अनूषत हरिꣳ हिन्वन्त्यद्रिभिः । इन्दुमिन्द्राय पीतये ॥९०३॥
translation: The watchful guardian of the people hath been born, Agni, the very strong, for fresh prosperity. With oil upon his face. with high heaven-touching flame, he shineth splendidly, pure, for the Bharatas.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: हिन्वन्ति सूरमुस्रयः स्वसारो जामयस्पतिम् । महामिन्दुं महीयुवः ॥९०४॥
translation: O Agni, the Angirasas discovered thee what time thou layest hidden, fleeing back from wood to wood. Thou by attrition art produced as conquering might, and men, O Angiras, call thee the Son of Strength.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवमान रुचारुचा देव देवेभ्यः सुतः । विश्वा वसून्या विश ॥९०५॥
translation: The men enkindle Agni in his threefold seat, ensign of sacrifice, the earliest bousehold- priest. With Indra and the Gods together on the grass let the wise priest sit to complete the sacrifice! VII Mitra-Varuna
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ पवमान सुष्टुतिं वृष्टिं देवेभ्यो दुवः । इषे पवस्व संयतम् ॥९०६॥
translation: This Soma hath been pressed for you, Low-strengtheners, Mitra, Varuna! List, list ye here to this may call!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: जनस्य गोपा अजनिष्ट जागृविरग्निः सुदक्षः सुविताय नव्यसे । घृतप्रतीको बृहता दिविस्पृशा द्युमद्वि भाति भरतेभ्यः शुचिः ॥९०७॥
translation: Both Kings who never injure aught have come to their sublimest home, The thousand-pillared, firmly based.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वामग्ने अङ्गिरसो गुहा हितमन्वविन्दञ्छिश्रियाणं वनेवने । स जायसे मथ्यमानः सहो महत्त्वामाहुः सहसस्पुत्रमङ्गिरः ॥९०८॥
translation: Worshipped with fat libation. Lords of gifts, Adityas, sovran Kings, They wait on him whose life is true.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यज्ञस्य केतुं प्रथमं पुरोहितमग्निं नरस्त्रिषधस्थे समिन्धते । इन्द्रेण देवैः सरथꣳस बर्हिषि सीदन्नि होता यजथाय सुक्रतुः ॥९०९॥
translation: Armed with the bones of dead Dadhyach, Indra with unresisted. might The nine-and-ninety Vritras slew.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अयं वां मित्रावरुणा सुतः सोम ऋतावृधा । ममेदिह श्रुतꣳ हवम् ॥९१०॥
translation: He, searching for the horse’s head that in the mountains lay concealed, Found it in Saryandvdn lake.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: राजानावनभिद्रुहा ध्रुवे सदस्युत्तमे । सहस्रस्थूण आशाते ॥९११॥
translation: Then straight they recognized the mystic name of the creative Steer. There in the mansion of the Moon. IX Indra Agni I. As rain from out the cloud, for you, Indra and Agni, from my thought This noblest praise hath been produced.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ता सम्राजा घृतासुती आदित्या दानुनस्पती । सचेते अनवह्वरम् ॥९१२॥
translation: Indra and Agni, listen to the singer’s call: accept his songs. Fulfil, ye mighty Lords, his prayers!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रो दधीचो अस्थभिर्वृत्राण्यप्रतिष्कुतः । जघान नवतीर्नव ॥९१३॥
translation: Give us not up to indigence, ye heroes, Indra, Agni, nor To Slander and reproach of men! X Soma Pavamana 52
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इच्छन्नश्वस्य यच्छिरः पर्वतेष्वपश्रितम् । तद्विदच्छर्यणावति ॥९१४॥
translation: Gold-Hued! as one who giveth strength flow on for Gods to drink, a draught For Vayu and the Marut host!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अत्राह गोरमन्वत नाम त्वष्टुरपीच्यम् । इत्था चन्द्रमसो गृहे ॥९१५॥
translation: The Steer shines brightly with the Gods, dear Sage in his appointed home. Even Pavamana unbeguiled.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इयं वामस्य मन्मन इन्द्राग्नी पूर्व्यस्तुतिः । अभ्राद्वृष्टिरिवाजनि ॥९१६॥
translation: O Pavamana, sent by prayer, roaring about thy dwelling-place, Ascend to Vayu as Law bids!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: शृणुतं जरितुर्हवमिन्द्राग्नी वनतं गिरः । ईशाना पिप्यतं धियः ॥९१७॥
translation: O Soma, Indu, every day thy friendship hath been my delight. Many fiends follow me; help me, thou tawny-hued: pass on beyond these barriers!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मा पापत्वाय नो नरेन्द्राग्नी माभिशस्तये । मा नो रीरधतं निदे ॥९१८॥
translation: Close to thy bosom am I. Soma, day and night draining the milk, O golden hued. Surya himself refulgent with his glow have we, as birds, o’ertaken in his course.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवस्व दक्षसाधनो देवेभ्यः पीतये हरे । मरुद्भ्यो वायवे मदः ॥९१९॥
translation: Active, while being purified, he hath assailed all enemies: They deck the Sage with holy hymns.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सं देवैः शोभते वृषा कविर्योनावधि प्रियः । पवमानो अदाभ्यः ॥९२०॥
translation: The Red hath mounted to his shrine; strong Indra hath approached the juice: In his firm dwelling let him rest!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवमान धिया हितो३ऽभि योनिं कनिक्रदत् । धर्मणा वायुमारुहः ॥९२१॥
translation: O Indu, Soma, send us now great opulence from every side: Pour on us treasures thousandfold!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तवाहꣳ सोम रारण सख्य इन्दो दिवेदिवे । पुरूणि बभ्रो नि चरन्ति मामव परिधीꣳरति ताꣳइहि ॥९२२॥
translation: Drink Soma, Indra Lord of bays! and let it cheer thee: the stone, like a well-guided courser, Directed by the presser’s arms bath pressed it.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तवाहं नक्तमुत सोम ते दिवा दुहानो बभ्र ऊधनि । घृणा तपन्तमति सूर्यं परः शकुना इव पप्तिम ॥९२३॥
translation: So let the draught of joy, thy dear companion, by which, O Lord of bays, thou slayest Vritras, Delight thee, Indra, Lord of princely treasuresl
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पुनानो अक्रमीदभि विश्वा मृधो विचर्षणिः । शुम्भन्ति विप्रं धीतिभिः ॥९२४॥
translation: Mark closely, Maghavan, the word I utter, this eulogy recited by Vasislitha: Accept the prayers I offer at thy banquet!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ योनिमरुणो रुहद्गमदिन्द्रो वृषा सुतम् । ध्रुवे सदसि सीदतु ॥९२५॥
translation: Heroes of one accord brought forth and formed for kingship Indra who wins the victory in all encounters, For power, in firmness, in the field, the great destroyer, fierce and exceeding strong, stalwart and full of vigour.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नू नो रयिं महामिन्दोऽस्मभ्यꣳ सोम विश्वतः । आ पवस्व सहस्रिणम् ॥९२६॥
translation: The holy sages form a ring, to view and sing unto the Ram. Inciters, very brilliant, from all deceit, are with your chariters nigh to hear.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पिबा सोममिन्द्र मदतु त्वा यं ते सुषाव हर्यश्वाद्रिः । सोतुर्बाहुभ्याꣳ सुयतो नार्वा ॥९२७॥
translation: Bards joined in song to Indra so that he might drink the Soma juice. The Lord of light, that he whose laws stand fast might aid with power and with the help he gives.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यस्ते मदो युज्यश्चारुरस्ति येन वृत्राणि हर्यश्व हꣳसि । स त्वामिन्द्र प्रभूवसो ममत्तु ॥९२८॥
translation: He who as sovran Lord of men moves with his chariots unrestrained, The Vritra-slayer, conqueror of all fighting hosts, preeminents, is praised in song.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: बोधा सु मे मघवन्वाचमेमां यां ते वसिष्ठो अर्चति प्रशस्तिम् । इमा ब्रह्म सधमादे जुषस्व ॥९२९॥
translation: Honour that Indra, Puruhanman! for his aid, him in whose hand of old the fair Sustaining bolt of thunder, mighty like the God, like Surya, was deposited!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विश्वाः पृतना अभिभूतरं नरः सजूस्ततक्षुरिन्द्रं जजनुश्च राजसे । क्रत्वे वरे स्थेमन्यामुरीमुतोग्रमोजिष्ठं तरसं तरस्विनम् ॥९३०॥
translation: The Sage of heaven whose heart is wise, when laid between both hands, with roars, Gives us delightful powers of life.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नेमिं नमन्ति चक्षसा मेषं विप्रा अभिस्वरे । सुदीतयो वो अद्रुहोऽपि कर्णे तरस्विनः समृक्वभिः ॥९३१॥
translation: He, the bright son, when born, illumed his parents who had sprung to life, 53 Great Son, great strengtheners of Law.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: समु रेभासो अस्वरन्निन्द्रꣳ सोमस्य पीतये । स्वः पतिर्यदी वृधे धृतव्रतो ह्योजसा समूतिभिः ॥९३२॥
translation: On, onward to a glorious home, free from all guile and dear to. men, Flow with enjoyment to our praise!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यो राजा चर्षणीनां याता रथेभिरध्रिगुः । विश्वासां तरुता पृतनानां ज्येष्ठं यो वृत्रहा गृणे ॥९३३॥
translation: For, verily, Pavamana, thou, divine! endued with brightest splendour, calling all Creatures to immortality.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रं तꣳ शुम्भ पुरुहन्मन्नवसे यस्य द्विता विधर्त्तरि । हस्तेन वज्रः प्रति धायि दर्शतो महान् देवो न सूर्यः ॥९३४॥
translation: With whom Dadhyach Navagva opened fastened doors, by whom the sages gained their wish, By whom they won the fame of lovely Amrita in the felicity of Gods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: परि प्रिया दिवः कविर्वयाꣳसि नप्त्योर्हितः । स्वानैर्याति कविक्रतुः ॥९३५॥
translation: Soma, while filtered, with his wave flows through the long wool of the sheep, Roaring, while purified, before the voice of song.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स सूनुर्मातरा शुचिर्जातो जाते अरोचयत् । महान्मही ऋतावृधा ॥९३६॥
translation: With prayers they cleanse the mighty steed, sporting in wood, above the fleece: Our hymns, intoned, have praised him of the triple height.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्रप्र क्षयाय पन्यसे जनाय जुष्टो अद्रुहः । वीत्यर्ष पनिष्टये ॥९३७॥
translation: He hath been hastened to the jars, bountiful, like an eager horse, And, lifting up his voice, while filtered, glided on.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वꣳ ह्या३ङ्ग दैव्य पवमान जनिमानि द्युमत्तमः । अमृतत्वाय घोषयन् ॥९३८॥
translation: Father of holy hymns, Soma flows onward, the father of the earth, father of heaven. Father of Agni, Surya’s generator, the father who begat Indra and Vishnu.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: येना नवग्वा दध्यङ्ङपोर्णुते येन विप्रास आपिरे । देवानाꣳ सुम्ने अमृतस्य चारुणो येन श्रवाꣳस्याशत ॥९३९॥
translation: Brahman of Gods, the leader of the poets, Rishi of sages, chief of savage creatures, Falcon amid the vultures, axe of forests, over the cleansing sieve goes Soma singing.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सोमः पुनान ऊर्मिणाव्यं वारं वि धावति । अग्रे वाचः पवमानः कनिक्रदत् ॥९४०॥
translation: He, Soma Pavamana, like a river, hath stirred the wave of voice, our songs and praises Beholding these inferior powers, the hero, well knowing, takes his stand among the cattle. XX Agni I. Hither, for powerful kinship, I call Agni, him who prospers you, Most frequent at our solemn rites.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: धीभिर्मृजन्ति वाजिनं वने क्रीडन्तमत्यविम् । अभि त्रिपृष्ठं मतयः समस्वरन् ॥९४१॥
translation: That through this famed one’s power he may stand by us, even as Tvasbtar comes Unto the forms that must be shaped.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: असर्जि कलशाꣳ अभि मीढ्वान्त्सप्तिर्न वाजयुः । पुनानो वाचं जनयन्नसिष्यदत् ॥९४२॥
translation: This Agni is the Lord supreme above all glories’ mid the Gods: May he come nigh to us with strength.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सोमः पवते जनिता मतीनां जनिता दिवो जनिता पृथिव्याः । जनिताग्नेर्जनिता सूर्यस्य जनितेन्द्रस्य जनितोत विष्णोः ॥९४३॥
translation: This poured libation, Indra drink, immortal, gladdening, excellent! Streams of the bright have flowed to thee here at the seat of holy Law.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ब्रह्मा देवानां पदवीः कवीनां ऋषिर्विप्राणां महिषो मृगाणाम् । श्येनो गृध्राणाꣳ स्वधितिर्वनानाꣳ सोमः पवित्रमत्येति रेभन् ॥९४४॥
translation: When, Indra, thou dost guide thy bays, there is no better charioteer: None hath surpassed thee in thy might, none with good steeds o’ertaken thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्रावीविपद्वाच ऊर्मिं न सिन्धुर्गिर स्तोमान्पवमानो मनीषाः । अन्तः पश्यन्वृजनेमावराण्या तिष्ठति वृषभो गोषु जानन् ॥९४५॥
translation: Sing glory now to Indra, say to him your solemn eulogies! The drops poured forth have made him glad: pay reverence to his noblest might!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्निं वो वृधन्तमध्वराणां पुरूतमम् । अच्छा नप्त्रे सहस्वते ॥९४६॥
translation: Indra, be pleased: drive forward, hero, striker of thy bays! Fair, like a sage, delighting in the meath, drink of the juice for rapturous joy.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अयं यथा न आभुवत्त्वष्टा रूपेव तक्ष्या । अस्य क्रत्वा यशस्वतः ॥९४७॥
translation: O Indra, fill thy belly anew with meath that seems to flow from heaven. The sweet-voiced raptures of this juice have come, as ‘twere to heaven. to thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अयं विश्वा अभि श्रियोऽग्निर्देवेषु पत्यते । आ वाजैरुप नो गमत् ॥९४८॥
translation: Indra, victorious, Mitra-like, smote, like a Yati, Vritra dead. As Bhrigu quelled his foes, he cleft Vala in Soma’s rapturous joy. 54
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इममिन्द्र सुतं पिब ज्येष्ठममर्त्यं मदम् । शुक्रस्य त्वाभ्यक्षरन्धारा ऋतस्य सादने ॥९४९॥
translation: Winner of gold and gear and cattle flow thou on, set as impregner, Indu! ‘mid the worlds of life! Rich in brave men art thou, Soma, who winnest all: these holy singers wait upon thee with song.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: न किष्ट्वद्रथीतरो हरी यदिन्द्र यच्छसे । न किष्ट्वानु मज्मना न किः स्वश्व आनशे ॥९५०॥
translation: O Soma, thou beholdest men from every side: O Pavamana, Steer, thou wanderest through these. Pour out upon us wealth in treasure and in gold: may we have strength to live among the things that be!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्राय नूनमर्चतोक्थानि च ब्रवीतन । सुता अमत्सुरिन्दवो ज्येष्ठं नमस्यता सहः ॥९५१॥
translation: Thou passest to these worlds as sovran Lord thereof, O Indu, harnessing thy tawny well- winged mares. May they pour forth for thee milk and oil rich in sweets: O Soma, let the folk abide in thy decree!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्र जुषस्व प्र वहा याहि शूर हरिह । पिबा सुतस्य मतिर्न मधोश्चकानश्चारुर्मदाय ॥९५२॥
translation: The streams of Pavamana, thine, finder of all I have been ettused, Even as Surya’s rays of light.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्र जठरं नव्यं न पृणस्व मधोर्दिवो न । अस्य सुतस्य स्वा३र्नोप त्वा मदाः सुवाचो अस्थुः ॥९५३॥
translation: Making the light that shines from heaven thou flowest on to every form, Soma, thou swellest like a sea.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रस्तुराषाण्मित्रो न जघान वृत्रं यतिर्न । बिभेद बलं भृगुर्न ससाहे शत्रून्मदे सोमस्य ॥९५४॥
translation: Shown forth thou sendest out thy voice, O Pavamana, with a roar. Like Surya, God, as Law commands.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: गोवित्पवस्व वसुविद्धिरण्यविद्रेतोधा इन्दो भुवनेष्वर्पितः । त्वꣳ सुवीरो असि सोम विश्ववित्तं त्वा नर उप गिरेम आसते ॥९५५॥
translation: Hitherward have the Somas streamed, the drops while they are purified: When blent, in waters they are raised.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वं नृचक्षा असि सोम विश्वतः पवमान वृषभ ता वि धावसि । स नः पवस्व वसुमद्धिरण्यवद्वयꣳ स्याम भुवनेषु जीवसे ॥९५६॥
translation: The milk hath run to meet them like floods rushing down a precipice: They come to Indra, being cleansed.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ईशान इमा भुवनानि ईयसे युजान इन्दो हरितः सुपर्ण्यः । तास्ते क्षरन्तु मधुमद्घृतं पयस्तव व्रते सोम तिष्ठन्तु कृष्टयः ॥९५७॥
translation: O Soma Pavamana, thou flowest as Indra’s gladdener: The men have seized and lead thee forth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवमानस्य विश्ववित्प्र ते सर्गा असृक्षत । सूर्यस्येव न रश्मयः ॥९५८॥
translation: Thou, Indu, when, expressed by stones, thou runnest to the filter, art Ready for Indra’s high decree.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: केतुं कृण्वन् दिवस्परि विश्वा रूपाभ्यर्षसि । समुद्रः सोम पिन्वसे ॥९५९॥
translation: Victorious, to be hailed with joy, O Soma, flow delighting men, As the supporter of mankind!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: जज्ञानो वाचमिष्यसि पवमान विधर्मणि । क्रन्दन् देवो न सूर्यः ॥९६०॥
translation: Flow on, best Vritra-slayer; flow meet to be hailed with joyful lauds, pure, purifying, wonderful
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र सोमासो अधन्विषुः पवमानास इन्दवः । श्रीणाना अप्सु वृञ्जते ॥९६१॥
translation: Pure, purifying, is he called, Soma effused and full of sweets, Slayer of sinners, dear to Gods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभि गावो अधन्विषुरापो न प्रवता यतीः । पुनाना इन्द्रमाशत ॥९६२॥
translation: The Sage hath robed him in the sheep’s wool for the banquet of the Gods, Subduing all our enemies.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र पवमान धन्वसि सोमेन्द्राय मादनः । नृभिर्यतो वि नीयसे ॥९६३॥
translation: For he, as Pavamana, sends thousandfold riches in the shape Of cattle to the worshippers.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्दो यदद्रिभिः सुतः पवित्रं परिदीयसे । अरमिन्द्रस्य धाम्ने ॥९६४॥
translation: Thou graspest all things with thy mind, and purifiest thee with thoughts: As such, O Soma, find us fame!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वꣳ सोम नृमादनः पवस्व चर्षणीधृतिः । सस्निर्यो अनुमाद्यः ॥९६५॥
translation: Pour on us lofty glory, send sure riches to our liberal lords: Bring food to those who sing thy praise!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवस्व वृत्रहन्तम उक्थेभिरनुमाद्यः । शुचिः पावको अद्भुतः ॥९६६॥
translation: As thou art cleansed, O wondrous steed, O Soma, thou hast entered, like A pious king, into the songs, 55
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: शुचिः पावक उच्यते सोमः सुतः स मधुमान् । देवावीरघशꣳसहा ॥९६७॥
translation: He, Soma, like a courser in the floods invincible, made bright With hands, is resting in the press.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र कविर्देववीतयेऽव्या वारेभिरव्यत । साह्वान्विश्वा अभि स्पृधः ॥९६८॥
translation: Disporting, like a liberal chief, thou goest. Soma to the sieve, Lending the laud heroic strength.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स हि ष्मा जरितृभ्य आ वाजं गोमन्तमिन्वति । पवमानः सहस्रिणम् ॥९६९॥
translation: Pour on us with thy juice all kinds of corn, each sort of nourishment! And, Soma, all felicities!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: परि विश्वानि चेतसा मृज्यसे पवसे मती । स नः सोम श्रवो विदः ॥९७०॥
translation: As thine, O Indu, is the praise, and thine what springeth from, the juice, Seat thee on the dear sacred grass!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभ्यर्ष बृहद्यशो मघवद्भ्यो ध्रुवꣳ रयिम् । इषꣳ स्तोतृभ्य आ भर ॥९७१॥
translation: And, finding for us steeds and kine, O Soma, with thy juice flow on Through days that fly most rapidly!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वꣳ राजेव सुव्रतो गिरः सोमाविवेशिथ । पुनानो वह्ने अद्भुत ॥९७२॥
translation: As one who conquers, ne’er subdued, attacks and slays the enemy, Thus, vanquisher of thousands! flow!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स वह्निरप्सु दुष्टरो मृज्यमानो गभस्त्योः । सोमश्चमूषु सीदति ॥९७३॥
translation: Thou, Indu, with thy streams that drop sweet juices, which were poured for help, Hast settled in the cleansing sieve.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: क्रीडुर्मखो न मꣳहयुः पवित्रꣳ सोम गच्छसि । दधत्स्तोत्रे सुवीर्यम् ॥९७४॥
translation: So flow thou onward through the fleece, for Indra flow to be his drink, Seating thee in the shrine of Law!
