author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यवंयवं नो अन्धसा पुष्टंपुष्टं परि स्रव । विश्वा च सोम सौभगा ॥९७५॥
translation: As giving room and freedom, as most sweet, pour butter forth and milk, O Soma, for the Angirasas!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्दो यथा तव स्तवो यथा ते जातमन्धसः । नि बर्हिषि प्रिये सदः ॥९७६॥
translation: Thy glories are, like lightnings from the rainy cloud, visible, Agni, like the comings of the Dawns, When, loosed to wander over plants and forest trees, thou crammest by thyself thy food into thy mouth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उत नो गोविदश्ववित्पवस्व सोमान्धसा । मक्षूतमेभिरहभिः ॥९७७॥
translation: When, sped and urged by wind, thou spreadest thee abroad, soon piercing through thy food according to thy will, The hosts, who ne’er decayest, eager to consume, like men on chariots, Agni! strive on every side.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यो जिनाति न जीयते हन्ति शत्रुमभीत्य । स पवस्व सहस्रजित् ॥९७८॥
translation: Agni, the Hotar-priest who fills the assembly full, waker of wisdom, chief controller of the thought- Thee, yea, none other than thyself, doth man elect priest of the holy offering, great and small, alike. VIII Mitra-Varuna
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यास्ते धारा मधुश्चुतोऽसृग्रमिन्द ऊतये । ताभिः पवित्रमासदः ॥९७९॥
translation: Even far and wide, O Varuna and Mitra, doth your help extend: May I obtain your kind good-will!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सो अर्षेन्द्राय पीतये तिरो वाराण्यव्यया । सीदन्नृतस्य योनिमा ॥९८०॥
translation: True Gods, may we completely gain food and a dwelling place from you: Ye Mitras, may we be your own!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वꣳ सोम परि स्रव स्वादिष्ठो अङ्गिरोभ्यः । वरिवोविद्घृतं पयः ॥९८१॥
translation: Guard us, ye Mitras, with your guards, save us, ye skilled to save: may we Subdue the Dasyus by ourselves! IX Indra I. Arising in thy might, thy jaws thou shookest Indra, having drunk The Soma which the press had shed.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तव श्रियो वर्ष्यस्येव विद्युतोग्नेश्चिकित्र उषसामिवेतयः । यदोषधीरभिसृष्टो वनानि च परि स्वयं चिनुषे अन्नमासनि ॥९८२॥
translation: Indra, both world gave place to thee as thou wast fighting, when thou wast The slayer of the Dasyu hosts. 56
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वातोपजूत इषितो वशाꣳ अनु तृषु यदन्ना वेविषद्वितिष्ठसे । आ ते यतन्ते रथ्यो३यथा पृथक्शर्धाꣳस्यग्ने अजरस्य धक्षतः ॥९८३॥
translation: From Indra, have I measured out a song eight-footed with nine parts, Delicate, strengthening the Law. X Indra-Agni
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मेधाकारं विदथस्य प्रसाधनमग्निꣳ होतारं परिभूतरं मतिम् । त्वामर्भस्य हविषः समानमित् त्वां महो वृणते नान्यं त्वत् ॥९८४॥
translation: Indra and Agni, these our songs of praise have sounded forth to you: Ye who bring blessings! drink the juice
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पुरूरुणा चिद्ध्यस्त्यवो नूनं वां वरुण । मित्र वꣳसि वाꣳ सुमतिम् ॥९८५॥
translation: Come, Indra, Agni, with those teams, desired of many, which ye have, O heroes, for the worshipper
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ता वाꣳ सम्यगद्रुह्वाणेषमश्याम धाम च । वयं वां मित्रा स्याम ॥९८६॥
translation: With those to his libation poured, ye heroes, Indra, Agni, come: Come ye to drink the Soma-juice!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पातं नो मित्रा पायुभिरुत त्रायेथाꣳ सुत्रात्रा । साह्याम दस्यून् तनूभिः ॥९८७॥
translation: Soma, flow on exceeding bright with loud roar to the reservoirs, Resting in wooden vats thy home!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उत्तिष्ठन्नोजसा सह पीत्वा शिप्रे अवेपयः । सोममिन्द्र चमू सुतम् ॥९८८॥
translation: Let water winning Somas flow to Indra, Vayu, Varuna, To Vishnu and Marut host!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अनु त्वा रोदसी उभे स्पर्धमानमददेताम् । इन्द्र यद्दस्युहाभवः ॥९८९॥
translation: Soma, bestowing food upon our progeny, from every side Pour on us riches thousandfold.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वाचमष्टापदीमहं नवस्रक्तिमृतावृधम् । इन्द्रात्परितन्वं ममे ॥९९०॥
translation: Pressed out by pressers Soma goes over the fleecy backs of sheep, Goes even as with a mare in tawny-coloured stream, goes in a sweetly-sounding stream.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्राग्नी युवामिमे३ऽभि स्तोमा अनूषत । पिबतꣳ शम्भुवा सुतम् ॥९९१॥
translation: Down to the water Soma, rich in kine, bath flowed with cows, with cows that have been milked. They have approached the mixing-vessels as a sea: the cheerer streams for the carouse.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: या वाꣳ सन्ति पुरुस्पृहो नियुतो दाशुषे नरा । इन्द्राग्नी ताभिरा गतम् ॥९९२॥
translation: O Purifying Soma, bring to us the wondrous treasure, meet. For lauds, that is in earth and heaven!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ताभिरा गच्छतं नरोपेदꣳ सवनꣳ सुतम् । इन्द्राग्नी सोमपीतये ॥९९३॥
translation: Cleansing the lives of men, thou, Steer, bellowing on the sacred grass, Gold-hued, hast settled in thy home.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अर्षा सोम द्युमत्तमोऽभि द्रोणानि रोरुवत् । सीदन्योनौ वनेष्वा ॥९९४॥
translation: For ye twain, Indra, Soma, are Lords of heaven’s light, Lords of the kine: Prosper, as mighty ones, our prayers
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अप्सा इन्द्राय वायवे वरुणाय मरुद्भ्यः । सोमा अर्षन्तु विष्णवे ॥९९५॥
translation: By men hath Indra been advanced, the Vritra-sIayer, to joy and strength. Him only we invoke for help in battles whether great or small be he our aid in deeds or might!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इषं तोकाय नो दधदस्मभ्यꣳ सोम विश्वतः । आ पवस्व सहस्रिणम् ॥९९६॥
translation: For, hero, thou art like a host, art giver of abundant spoil. Strengthening e’en the feeble, thou aidest the sacrificer, thou givest great wealth to him who pours.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सोम उ ष्वाणः सोतृभिरधि ष्णुभिरवीनाम् । अश्वयेव हरिता याति धारया मन्द्रया याति धारया ॥९९७॥
translation: When war and battles are on foot, booty is offered to the bold. Yoke thou thy wildly-rushing bays! Whom wilt thou slay, and whom enrich? Do thou, O Indra, make us rich! XV Indra I. The juice of Soma thus diffused, sweet to the taste, the bright cows drink, Who travelling in splendour close to mighty Indra’s side rejoice, good in their own supremacy.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अनूपे गोमान्गोभिरक्षाः सोमो दुग्धाभिरक्षाः । समुद्रं न संवरणान्यग्मन्मन्दी मदाय तोशते ॥९९८॥
translation: Craving his touch the dappled kine mingle the Soma with their milk. The milch-kine dear to Indra send forth his death dealing thunder-bolt, good in their own 57 supremacy.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यत्सोम चित्रमुक्थ्यं दिव्यं पार्थिवं वसु । तन्नः पुनान आ भर ॥९९९॥
translation: With veneration, passing wise, they honour his victorious might. They follow close his many laws to win them due preeminence, good in their own supremacy.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वृषा पुनान आयूꣳषि स्तनयन्नधि बर्हिषि । हरिः सन्योनिमासदः ॥१०००॥
translation: Strong, mountain-born, the stalk hath been pressed in the streams for rapturous joy. Hawk-like he settles in his home.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: युवꣳ हि स्थः स्वःपती इन्द्रश्च सोम गोपती । ईशाना पिप्यतं धियः ॥१००१॥
translation: Fair is the juice beloved of Gods, washed in the waters, pressed by men: The milch kine sweeten it with milk
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रो मदाय वावृधे शवसे वृत्रहा नृभिः । तमिन्महत्स्वाजिषूतिमर्भे हवामहे स वाजेषु प्र नोऽविषत् ॥१००२॥
translation: Then, like a steed, have they adorned the inciter for eternal life, The meath’s juice at the festival.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: असि हि वीर सेन्योऽसि भूरि पराददिः । असि दभ्रस्य चिद्वृधो यजमानाय शिक्षसि सुन्वते भूरि ते वसु ॥१००३॥
translation: Make high and splendid glory shine hitherward, Lord of food, God, on the friend of Gods Unclose the cask of middle air
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यदुदीरत आजयो धृष्णवे धीयते धनम् । युङ्क्ष्वा मदच्युता हरी कं हनः कं वसौ दधोऽस्माँ इन्द्र वसौ दधः ॥१००४॥
translation: Roll onward from the press, O mighty one, effused, as kings, supporter of the tribes Pour on us rain from heaven, send us the water’s flow, urging our thoughts to win the spoil!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स्वादोरित्था विषूवतो मधोः पिबन्ति गौर्यः । या इन्द्रेण सयावरीर्वृष्णा मदन्ति शोभथा वस्वीरनु स्वराज्यम् ॥१००५॥
translation: Breath of the mighty Dames, the Child, speeding the plan of sacrifice, Surpasses all things that are dear, yea, from of old.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ता अस्य पृशनायुवः सोमꣳ श्रीणन्ति पृश्नयः । प्रिया इन्द्रस्य धेनवो वज्रꣳ हिन्वन्ति सायकं वस्वीरनु स्वराज्यम् ॥१००६॥
translation: The place that is concealed hath gained a share of Trita’s pressing-stones, By the seven laws of sacrifice, even that dear place.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ता अस्य नमसा सहः सपर्यन्ति प्रचेतसः । व्रतान्यस्य सश्चिरे पुरूणि पूर्वचित्तये वस्वीरनु स्वराज्यम् ॥१००७॥
translation: He hath sent forth unto the heights the three, in stream, as Trita’s wealth: He who is passing wise measures his pathways out.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: असाव्यꣳशुर्मदायाप्सु दक्षो गिरिष्ठाः । श्येनो न योनिमासदत् ॥१००८॥
translation: Flow to the filter with thy stream, effused, to win us spoil and wealth, Soma exceeding rich in meath for Indra, Vishnu, and the Gods
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: शुभ्रमन्धो देववातमप्सु धौतं नृभिः सुतम् । स्वदन्ति गावः पयोभिः ॥१००९॥
translation: The hymns that know not guile, caress thee, golden-coloured, in the sieve. As mothers, Pavamana, lick the new-born calf, as Law commands.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आदीमश्वं न हेतारमशूशुभन्नमृताय । मधो रसꣳ सधमादे ॥१०१०॥
translation: Lord of great sway, thou liftest thee above the heavens, above the earth. Thou, of Pavamana, hast assumed thy coat of mail with majesty.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभि द्युम्नं बृहद्यश इषस्पते दीदिहि देव देवयुम् । वि कोशं मध्यमं युव ॥१०११॥
translation: Strong Indu, bathed in milk, flows on for Indra, Soma exciting strength, for his carousal. He quells malignity and slays the demons, King of the homestead, he who gives us comfort.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ वच्यस्व सुदक्ष चम्वोः सुतो विशां वह्निर्न विश्पतिः । वृष्टिं दिवः पवस्व रीतिमपो जिन्वन्गविष्टये धियः ॥१०१२॥
translation: Then in a stream he flows, milked out with press-stones, mingled with sweetness, through the fleecy filter-- Indu rejoicing in the love of Indra, the God who gladdens for the God’s enjoyment.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्राणा शिशुर्महीनाꣳ हिन्वन्नृतस्य दीधितिम् । विश्वा परि प्रिया भुवदध द्विता ॥१०१३॥
translation: He flows, as he is cleansed, to sacred duties, a God bedewing Gods with his own juices. Indu hath, clothed in powers that suit the season, on the raised fleece engaged the ten swift fingers.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उप त्रितस्य पाष्यो३रभक्त यद्गुहा पदम् । यज्ञस्य सप्त धामभिरध प्रियम् ॥१०१४॥
translation: O Agni, God, we kindle thee, refulgent, wasting not away, That this more glorious fuel may send forth for thee its shine to heaven. Bring food to those who sing thy praise!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्रीणि त्रितस्य धारया पृष्ठेष्वैरयद्रयिम् । मिमीते अस्य योजना वि सुक्रतुः ॥१०१५॥
translation: To thee the splendid, Lord of light! bright! wondrous! prince of men! is brought. Oblation with the holy verse, O Agni, bearer of our gifts! Bring food to those who sing thy 58 praise!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवस्व वाजसातये पवित्रे धारया सुतः । इन्द्राय सोम विष्णवे देवेभ्यो मधुमत्तरः ॥१०१६॥
translation: Thou heatest both the ladles in thy mouth, O brilliant prince of men! So fill us also in our hymns abundantly, thou Lord of Strength. Bring food to those who sing thy praise!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वाꣳ रिहन्ति धीतयो हरिं पवित्रे अद्रुहः । वत्सं जातं न मातरः पवमान विधर्मणि ॥१०१७॥
translation: Sing ye a psalm to Indra; sing a great song to the lofty Sage, To him who maketh prayer, inspired, who loveth laud.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वं द्यां च महिव्रत पृथिवीं चाति जभ्रिषे । प्रति द्रापिममुञ्चथाः पवमान महित्वना ॥१०१८॥
translation: Thou, Indra, art the conqueror: thou gavest splendour to the Sun. Maker of all things, thou art mighty and All-God.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्दुर्वाजी पवते गोन्योघा इन्द्रे सोमः सह इन्वन्मदाय । हन्ति रक्षो बाधते पर्यरातिं वरिवस्कृण्वन्वृजनस्य राजा ॥१०१९॥
translation: Radiant with light thou wentest to the sky, the luminous realm of -heaven. The Gods, O Indra, strove to win thy friendly love.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अध धारया मध्वा पृचानस्तिरो रोम पवते अद्रिदुग्धः । इन्दुरिन्द्रस्य सख्यं जुषाणो देवो देवस्य मत्सरो मदाय ॥१०२०॥
translation: This Soma hath been pressed for thee, O Indra, bold one, mightiest, come! May Indra vigour fill thee full, as Surya fills mid-air with rays
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभि व्रतानि पवते पुनानो देवो देवान्त्स्वेन रसेन पृञ्चन् । इन्दुर्धर्माण्यृतुथा वसानो दश क्षिपो अव्यत सानौ अव्ये ॥१०२१॥
translation: Slayer of Vritra, mount thy car! The bay steeds have been yoked by prayer. May, with its voice, the pressing-stone draw thine attention hitherward!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ ते अग्न इधीमहि द्युमन्तं देवाजरम् । युद्ध स्या ते पनीयसी समिद्दीदयति द्यवीषꣳ स्तोतृभ्य आ भर ॥१०२२॥
translation: His pair of tawny coursers bring Indra, resistless in his might. Hither to Rishis’ songs of praise and sacrifice performed by men. 59
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ ते अग्न ऋचा हविः शुक्रस्य ज्योतिषस्पते । सुश्चन्द्र दस्म विश्पते हव्यवाट्तुभ्यꣳ हूयत इषꣳ स्तोतृभ्य आ भर ॥१०२३॥
translation: Light of the sacrifice, be pours delicious meathp most wealthy, father and begetter of the Gods. He, gladdening, best of cheerers, juice that Indra loves, enriches with mysterious treasure earth and heaven.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ओभे सुश्चन्द्र विश्पते दर्वी श्रीणीष आसनि । उतो न उत्पुपूर्या उक्थेषु शवसस्पत इषꣳ स्तोतृभ्य आ भर ॥१०२४॥
translation: The Lord of heaven, the vigorous and far-seeing one, flowsshouting to the beaker with his thousand streams. Coloured like gold he rests in seats where Mitra dwells, the Steer made beautiful by rivers and by sheep.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्राय साम गायत विप्राय बृहते बृहत् । ब्रह्मकृते विपश्चिते पनस्यवे ॥१०२५॥
translation: As Pavamana thou flowest before the streams: thou goest on, before the hymn, before the kine. Thou sharest mighty booty in the van of war Soma, well-armed, thou art pressed out by men who press.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वमिन्द्राभिभूरसि त्वꣳ सूर्यमरोचयः । विश्वकर्मा विश्वदेवो महाꣳ असि ॥१०२६॥
translation: Through our desire of heroes, kine, and horses, vigorous Somadrops, Brilliant and swift, have been effused.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विभ्राजन् ज्योतिषा स्व३रगच्छो रोचनं दिवः । देवास्त इन्द्र सख्याय येमिरे ॥१०२७॥
translation: They, beautified by holy men and purified in both the hands, Are flowing through the fleecy cloth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: असावि सोम इन्द्र ते शविष्ठ धृष्णवा गहि । आ त्वा पृणक्त्विन्द्रियꣳ रजः सूर्यो न रश्मिभिः ॥१०२८॥
translation: These Soma juices shall pour forth all treasures for the worshipper, From heaven and earth and firmament.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ तिष्ठ वृत्रहन्रथं युक्ता ते ब्रह्मणा हरी । अर्वाचीनꣳ सु ते मनो ग्रावा कृणोतु वग्नुना ॥१०२९॥
translation: Flow, Soma, Indu, dear to Gods, swift through the purifying sieve, And enter fndra in thy strength
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रमिद्धरी वहतोऽप्रतिधृष्टशवसम् । ऋषीणाꣳ सुष्टुतीरुप यज्ञं च मानुषाणाम् ॥१०३०॥
translation: As mighty food speed hitherward, Indu, as a most splendid steer: Sit in thy place as one with power
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ज्योतिर्यज्ञस्य पवते मधु प्रियं पिता देवानां जनिता विभूवसुः । दधाति रत्नꣳ स्वधयोरपीच्यं मदिन्तमो मत्सर इन्द्रियो रसः ॥१०३१॥
translation: The well-loved meath was made to flow, the stream of the creative juice: The Sage drew waters to himself.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभिक्रन्दन्कलशं वाज्यर्षति पतिर्दिवः शतधारो विचक्षणः । हरिर्मित्रस्य सदनेषु सीदति मर्मृजानोऽविभिः सिन्धुभिर्वृषा ॥१०३२॥
translation: The mighty waters, yea, the floods accompany thee mighty one, When thou wilt clothe thee with the milk.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्रे सिन्धूनां पवमानो अर्षत्यग्रे वाचो अग्रियो गोषु गच्छसि । अग्रे वाजस्य भजसे महद्धनꣳ स्वायुधः सोतृभिः सोम सूयसे ॥१०३३॥
translation: The lake is brightened in the floods. Soma, our friend, heaven’s prop and stay, Falls on the purifying cloth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: असृक्षत प्र वाजिनो गव्या सोमासो अश्वया । शुक्रासो वीरयाशवः ॥१०३४॥
translation: The tawny Bull hath bellowed. fair as mighty Mitra to behold He gleams and flashes with the Sun.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: शुम्भमाना ऋतायुभिर्मृज्यमाना गभस्त्योः । पवन्ते वारे अव्यये ॥१०३५॥
translation: Songs, Indra, active in their might, are beautified for thee, wherewith Thou deckest thee for rapturous joy.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ते विश्वा दाशुषे वसु सोमा दिव्यानि पार्थिवा । पवन्तामान्तरिक्ष्या ॥१०३६॥
translation: To thee who givest ample room we pray, to win the wild delight, That Thou mayst have exalted praise,
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवस्व देववीरति पवित्रꣳ सोम रꣳह्या । इन्द्रमिन्दो वृषा विश ॥१०३७॥
translation: Winner of kine Indu, art thou, winner of heroes, steeds, and spoil: Primeval soul of sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ वच्यस्व महि प्सरो वृषेन्दो द्युम्नवत्तमः । आ योनिं धर्णसिः सदः ॥१०३८॥
translation: Pour on us, Indu! Indra-strength with a full stream of sweetness, like Parianya, sender of the rain! IV Soma Pavamana 60
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अधुक्षत प्रियं मधु धारा सुतस्य वेधसः । अपो वसिष्ट सुक्रतुः ॥१०३९॥
translation: O Soma Pavamana, be victorious, win us high renown; And make us better than we are!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: महान्तं त्वा महीरन्वापो अर्षन्ति सिन्धवः । यद्गोभिर्वासयिष्यसे ॥१०४०॥
translation: Win thou the light, win heavenly light, and, Soma, all felicities; And make us better than we are!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: समुद्रो अप्सु मामृजे विष्टम्भो धरुणो दिवः । सोमः पवित्रे अस्मयुः ॥१०४१॥
translation: Win skilful strength and mental power! O Soma, drive away our foes; And make us better than we are!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अचिक्रदद्वृषा हरिर्महान्मित्रो न दर्शतः । सꣳ सूर्येण दिद्युते ॥१०४२॥
translation: Ye purifiers, purify Soma for Indra, for his drink; Make thou us better than we are!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: गिरस्त इन्द ओजसा मर्मृज्यन्ते अपस्युवः । याभिर्मदाय शुम्भसे ॥१०४३॥
translation: Give us our portion in the Sun through thine own mental power and aids; And make us better than we are!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तं त्वा मदाय घृष्वय उ लोककृत्नुमीमहे । तव प्रशस्तये महे ॥१०४४॥
translation: Through thine own mental power and aids long may we look upon the Sun: Make thou us better than we are!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: गोषा इन्दो नृषा अस्यश्वसा वाजसा उत । आत्मा यज्ञस्य पूर्व्यः ॥१०४५॥
translation: Well-weaponed Soma, pour to us a stream of riches doubly great; And make us better than we are!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अस्मभ्यमिन्दविन्द्रियं मधोः पवस्व धारया । पर्जन्यो वृष्टिमाꣳ इव ॥१०४६॥
translation: As one victorious unsubdued in battle, pour forth wealth to us: And make us better than we are!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सना च सोम जेषि च पवमान महि श्रवः । अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि ॥१०४७॥
translation: With offerings, Pavamana! men have strengthened thee as Law commands: Make thou us better than we are!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सना ज्योतिः सना स्वा३र्विश्वा च सोम सौभगा । अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि ॥१०४८॥
translation: O Indu, bring us wealth in steeds brilliant and quickening all life; And make us better than we are!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सना दक्षमुत क्रतुमप सोम मृधो जहि । अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि ॥१०४९॥
translation: Swift runs this giver of delight, even the stream of flowing juice: Swift runs this giver of delight.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवीतारः पुनीतन सोममिन्द्राय पातवे । अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि ॥१०५०॥
translation: The Morning knows all precious things, the Goddess knows her grace to man: Swift runs this giver of delight.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वꣳ सूर्ये न आ भज तव क्रत्वा तवोतिभिः । अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि ॥१०५१॥
translation: We have accepted thousands from Dhvasra’s and Purusbanti’s hands: Swift runs this giver of delight.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तव क्रत्वा तवोतिभिर्ज्योक्पश्येम सूर्यम् । अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि ॥१०५२॥
translation: From whom we have accepted thus thousands and three-times ten besides: Swift runs this giver of delight.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभ्यर्ष स्वायुध सोम द्विबर्हसꣳ रयिम् । अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि ॥१०५३॥
translation: Forth with his stream who gladdens best these Soma juices have been poured, Lauded with songs for mighty strength.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभ्य३र्षानपच्युतो वाजिन्त्समत्सु सासहिः । अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि ॥१०५४॥
translation: Thou flowest to enjoy the milk, and bringest valour, being, cleansed: Winning the spoil flow hitherward
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वां यज्ञैरवीवृधन्पवमान विधर्मणि । अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि ॥१०५५॥
translation: And, hymned by Jamadagni, let all nourishment that kine supply, And general praises, flow to us!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: रयिं नश्चित्रमश्विनमिन्दो विश्वायुमा भर । अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि ॥१०५६॥
translation: For Jatavedas, worthy of our praise, will we frame with our mind this eulogy as ‘twere a car. For good, in his assembly, is this care of ours. Let us not, in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तरत्स मन्दी धावति धारा सुतस्यान्धसः । तरत्स मन्दी धावति ॥१०५७॥
translation: We will bring fuel and prepare our sacred gifts, reminding thee at each successive holy time. Fulfil our thoughts that we may lengthen out our lives Let us not, in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उस्रा वेद वसूनां मर्तस्य देव्यवसः । तरत्स मन्दी धावति ॥१०५८॥
translation: May we have power to kindle thee! Fulfil our prayers in thee the Gods eat the presented sacrifice. 61 Bring hither the Adityas, for we long for them! Let us not, in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm! VIII Mitra, Varuna, Aryaman
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ध्वस्रयोः पुरुषन्त्योरा सहस्राणि दद्महे । तरत्स मन्दी धावति ॥१०५९॥
translation: Soon as the Sun hath risen I sing to you, to Mitra, Varuna, And Aryaman who slays the foe.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ ययोस्त्रिꣳशतं तना सहस्राणि च दद्महे । तरत्स मन्दी धावति ॥१०६०॥
translation: With wealth of gold may this my song bring unmolested might; may this, Sages! obtain the sacrifice!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एते सोमा असृक्षत गृणानाः शवसे महे । मदिन्तमस्य धारया ॥१०६१॥
translation: May we be thine, God Varuna, and with our princes, Mitra, thine: May we gain food and heavenly light!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभि गव्यानि वीतये नृम्णा पुनानो अर्षसि । सनद्वाजः परि स्रव ॥१०६२॥
translation: Drive all our enemies away, smite down the foes who press around, And bring the wealth for which we long:
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उत नो गोमतीरिषो विश्वा अर्ष परिष्टुभः । गृणानो जमदग्निना ॥१०६३॥
translation: Of which the world shall know forthwith as given by thee abundantly: Bring us the wealth for which we long:
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इमꣳ स्तोममर्हते जातवेदसे रथमिव सं महेमा मनीषया । भद्रा हि नः प्रमतिरस्य सꣳसद्यग्ने सख्ये मा रिषामा वयं तव ॥१०६४॥
translation: O Indra, that which is concealed in strong firm place precipito us: Bring us the wealth for which we long! X Indra-Agni
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: भरामेध्मं कृणवामा हवीꣳषि ते चितयन्तः पर्वणापर्वणा वयम् । जीवातवे प्रतराꣳ साधया धियोऽग्ने सख्ये म रिषामा वयं तव ॥१०६५॥
translation: Yea, ye are priests of sacrifice, winners in war and holy works Indra and Agni, mark this well!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: शकेम त्वा समिधꣳ साधया धियस्त्वे देवा हविरदन्त्याहुतम् । त्वमादित्याꣳआ वह तान्ह्यु३श्मस्यग्ने सख्ये मा रिषामा वयं तव ॥१०६६॥
translation: Bountiful, riders on the car, slayers of Vritra unsubdued, Indra and Agni, mark this well!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्रति वाꣳसूर उदिते मित्रं गृणीषे वरुणम् । अर्यमणꣳ रिशादसम् ॥१०६७॥
translation: The men with pressing-stones have pressed this meath of yours which gives delight: Indra and Agni, mark this well!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: राया हिरण्यया मतिरियमवृकाय शवसे । इयं विप्रा मेधसातये ॥१०६८॥
translation: For Indra girt by Maruts, flow, thou Indu, very rich in meath, To seat thee in the place of song!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ते स्याम देव वरुण ते मित्र सूरिभिः सह । इषꣳ स्वश्च धीमहि ॥१०६९॥
translation: Sage: who know the lore of speech deck thee, the strong sustainer, well: Men make thee bright and beautiful.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: भिन्धि विश्वा अप द्विषः परि बाधो जही मृधः । वसु स्पार्हं तदा भर ॥१०७०॥
translation: Let Mitra, Varuna, Aryaman drink Pavamana’s juice, yea, thine. Sage! let the Maruts drink thereof.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यस्य ते विश्वमानुषग्भूरेर्दत्तस्य वेदति । वसु स्पार्हं तदा भर ॥१०७१॥
translation: Deft-handed! thou when purified liftest thy voice amid the sea. Thou, Pavamana makest riches flow to us, yellow, abundant, much-desired.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यद्वीडाविन्द्र यत्स्थिरे यत्पर्शाने पराभृतम् । वसु स्पार्हं तदा भर ॥१०७२॥
translation: Made pure, as Pavamana, in the sheep’s long wool, the Steer bath bellowed in the vat. Thou flowest, Soma Pavamana! balmed with ‘milk unto the meeting-place of Gods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यज्ञस्य हि स्थ ऋत्विजा सस्नी वाजेषु कर्मसु । इन्द्राग्नी तस्य बोधतम् ॥१०७३॥
translation: Him here, the offspring of the sea, the ten swift fingers beautify: With the Adityas is he seen.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तोशासा रथयावाना वृत्रहणापराजिता । इन्द्राग्नी तस्य बोधतम् ॥१०७४॥
translation: With Indra and with Vayu he, effused, flows onward with the beams Of Surya to the cleansing sieve.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इदं वां मदिरं मध्वधुक्षन्नद्रिभिर्नरः । इन्द्राग्नी तस्य बोधतम् ॥१०७५॥
translation: Flow rich in sweets and lovely for our Bhaga, Vayu, Pushan, fair For Mitra and for Varuna!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रायेन्दो मरुत्वते पवस्व मधुमत्तमः । अर्कस्य योनिमासदम् ॥१०७६॥
translation: With Indra splendid feasts be ours, rich in all strengthening things, wherewith, Wealthy in food, we may rejoice! 62
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तं त्वा विप्रा वचोविदः परिष्कृण्वन्ति धर्णसिम् । सं त्वा मृजन्त्यायवः ॥१०७७॥
translation: Like thee, thyself, for singers yoked, thou movest, as it were besought, Bold one, the axle of the car,
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: रसं ते मित्रो अर्यमा पिबन्तु वरुणः कवे । पवमानस्य मरुतः ॥१०७८॥
translation: That, Satakratu, thou, to serve and please thy praisers, as it were, Stirrest the axle with thy strength.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मृज्यमानः सुहस्त्या समुद्रे वाचमिन्वसि । रयिं पिशङ्गं बहुलं पुरुस्पृहं पवमानाभ्यर्षसि ॥१०७९॥
translation: As a good cow to him who milks, we call the doer of good deeds, To our assistance day by day.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पुनानो वारे पवमानो अव्यये वृषो अचिक्रदद्वने । देवानाꣳ सोम पवमान निष्कृतं गोभिरञ्जानो अर्षसि ॥१०८०
translation: Come thou to our libations, drink of Soma, Soma-drinker! yea, The rich one’s rapture giveth kine.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एतमु त्यं दश क्षिपो मृजन्ति सिन्धुमातरम् । समादित्येभिरख्यत ॥१०८१॥
translation: So may we be acquainted with thine innermost benevolence: Neglect us not; come hitherward!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: समिन्द्रेणोत वायुना सुत एति पवित्र आ । सꣳ सूर्यस्य रश्मिभिः ॥१०८२॥
translation: As, like the Morning, thou has filled, O Indra, both the earth and heaven, So as the mighty one, great King of all the mighty race of men, the Goddess mother brought thee forth, the blessed mother gave thee life.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स नो भगाय वायवे पूष्णे पवस्व मधुमान् । चारुर्मित्रे वरुणे च ॥१०८३॥
translation: Thou bearest in thine hand a lance like a long hook, great counsellor. As with his foremost foot a goat, draw down the branch O Maghavan. The Goddess mother brought thee forth, the blessed mother gave thee life.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: रेवतीर्नः सधमाद इन्द्रे सन्तु तुविवाजाः । क्षुमन्तो याभिर्मदेम ॥१०८४॥
translation: Relax that mortal’s stubborn strength whose heart is bent on wickedness. Trample him down beneath thy feet who watches for and aims at us. The Goddess mother brought thee forth, the blessed mother gave thee life.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ घ त्वावान् त्मना युक्तः स्तोतृभ्यो धृष्णवीयानः । ऋणोरक्षं न चक्र्योः ॥१०८५॥
translation: Soma, the dweller on the hills, effused, hath flowed into the sieve. All-bounteous art thou in carouse.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ यद्दुवः शतक्रतवा कामं जरितॄणाम् । ऋणोरक्षं न शचीभिः ॥१०८६॥
translation: Thou art a holy bard, a Sage; the meath offspring of thy sap: All bounteous art thou in carouse.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सुरूपकृत्नुमूतये सुदुघामिव गोदुहे । जुहूमसि द्यविद्यवि ॥१०८७॥
translation: All-d6ties of one accorcl have come that they may drink of thee: All-bounteous art thou in carouse.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उप नः सवना गहि सोमस्य सोमपाः पिब । गोदा इद्रेवतो मदः ॥१०८८॥
translation: Effused is he who brings good things, who brings us store of wealth, and sweet refreshing food, Soma who brings us quiet homes:
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अथा ते अन्तमानां विद्याम सुमतीनाम् । मा नो अति ख्य आ गहि ॥१०८९॥
translation: He whom our Indra and the Marut host shall drink, Bhaga shall drink with Aryaman, By whom we bring to us Mitra and Varuna, and Indra for our great defence.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उभे यदिन्द्र रोदसी आपप्राथोषा इव । महान्तं त्वा महीनाꣳ सम्राजं चर्षणीनाम् । देवी जनित्र्यजीजनद्भद्रा जनित्र्यजीजनत् ॥१०९०॥
translation: Friends, hymn your Lord who makes him pure for rapturous carouse: let them Sweeten him, as a child, with lauds and sacred gifts
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: दीर्घꣳ ह्यङ्कुशं यथा शक्तिं बिभर्षि मन्तुमः । पूर्वेण मघवन्पदा वयामजो यथा यमः । देवी जनित्र्यजीजनद्भद्रा जनित्र्यजीजनत् ॥१०९१॥
translation: Like as a calf with mother cows, so Indu is urged forth and sent, Glorified by our hymns;, the god-delighting juice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अव स्म दुर्हृणायतो मर्त्तस्य तनुहि स्थिरम् । अधस्पदं तमीं कृधि यो अस्माꣳ अभिदासति । देवी जनित्र्यजीजनद्भद्रा जनित्र्यजीजनत् ॥१०९२॥
translation: Effectual help to power is he. he is a banquet for the troop, He who hath been effused, more rich in meath, for Gods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: परि स्वानो गिरिष्ठाः पवित्रे सोमो अक्षरत् । मदेषु सर्वधा असि ॥१०९३॥
translation: For us the Soma juices flow, the drops best furtherers of weal, Effused as friends, without a spot, benevolent, finders of the light.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वं विप्रस्त्वं कविर्मधु प्र जातमन्धसः । मदेषु सर्वधा असि ॥१०९४॥
translation: These Soma juices, skill.ed in song, purified, blent with milk and curd, 63 Hastening on and firmly set in oil resemble beauteous suns.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वे विश्वे सजोषसो देवासः पीतिमाशत । मदेषु सर्वधा असि ॥१०९५॥
translation: Effused by means of pressing- stones, upon the oxhide visible, They, treasure-finders, have announced food unto us from every side.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स सुन्वे यो वसूनां यो रायामानेता य इडानाम् । सोमो यः सुक्षितीनाम् ॥१०९६॥
translation: Pour forth this wealth with this purification: flow onward to the yellow lake, O Indu! Here, too, the bright one, wind-swift, full of wisdom, shall give a son to him who cometh quickly.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यस्य त इन्द्रः पिबाद्यस्य मरुतो यस्य वार्यमणा भगः । आ येन मित्रावरुणा करामह एन्द्रमवसे महे ॥१०९७॥
translation: Flow on for us with this purification to the famed ford of thee whose due is glory! May the foe-queller shake us down, for triumph, like a tree’s ripe fruit, sixty thousand treasures!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तं वः सखायो मदाय पुनानमभि गायत । शिशुं न हव्यैः स्वदयन्त गूर्तिभिः ॥१०९८॥
translation: Eagerly do we pray for those two exploits, at the blue lake and Prisana, wrought in battle. He sent our enemies to sleep and slew them, and turned away the foolish and unfriendly.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सं वत्स इव मातृभिरिन्दुर्हिन्वानो अज्यते । देवावीर्मदो मतिभिः परिष्कृतः ॥१०९९॥
translation: O Agni, be our nearest friend, yea, our protector and our kind deliverer!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अयं दक्षाय साधनोऽयꣳ शर्धाय वीतये । अयं देवेभ्यो मधुमत्तरः सुतः ॥११००॥
translation: As gracious Agni, famed for treasures, come, and, most resplendent, give us store of wealth!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सोमाः पवन्त इन्दवोऽस्मभ्यं गातुवित्तमाः । मित्राः स्वाना अरेपसः स्वाध्यः स्वर्विदः ॥११०१॥
translation: To thee then, O most bright, O radiant God, we come with prayer for happiness for our friends.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ते पूतासो विपश्चितः सोमासो दध्याशिरः । सूरासो न दर्शतासो जिगत्नवो ध्रुवा घृते ॥११०२॥
translation: May we, with Indra and the Gods to aid us, bring these existing worlds to full completion!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सुष्वाणासो व्यद्रिभिश्चिताना गोरधि त्वचि । इषमस्मभ्यमभितः समस्वरन्वसुविदः ॥११०३॥
translation: Our sacrifice, our bodies, and our offspring, let Indra with the Adityas-form and finish!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अया पवा पवस्वैना वसूनि माꣳश्चत्व इन्दो सरसि प्र धन्व । ब्रध्नश्चिद्यस्य वातो न जूतिं पुरुमेधाश्चित्तकवे नरं धात् ॥११०४॥
translation: With the Adityas, with the band of Maruts, let Indra send us medicines to heal us!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उत न एना पवया पवस्वाधि श्रुते श्रवाय्यस्य तीर्थे । षष्टिꣳ सहस्रा नैगुतो वसूनि वृक्षं न पक्वं धूनवद्रणाय ॥११०५॥
translation: Sing to your Indra, mightiest Vritra-slayer, sing to the Sage the song that he accepteth!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: महीमे अस्य वृष नाम शूषे माꣳश्चत्वे वा पृशने वा वधत्रे । अस्वापयन्निगुतः स्नेहयच्चापामित्राꣳ अपाचितो अचेतः ॥११०६॥
translation: The God declares the deities’ generations, like Usana, proclaiming lofty wisdom. With brilliant kin far-ruling, sanctifying, the wild boar, singing with his foot, advances.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्ने त्वं नो अन्तम उत त्राता शिवो भुवो वरूथ्यः ॥११०७॥
translation: The swans, the Vrishagnas from anear us, restless, have brought their clamour to our dwelling-- Friends come to Pavamana, meet for praises-and sound in concert their resistless music.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वसुरग्निर्वसुश्रवा अच्छा नक्षि द्युमत्तमो रयिं दाः ॥११०८॥
translation: He takes the swiftness of the great Far strider: cows low as, ‘twere to him who sports at pleasure. He with the sharpened horns brings forth abundance: the silvery shines by night, by day the golden.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तं त्वा शोचिष्ठ दीदिवः सुम्नाय नूनमीमहे सखिभ्यः ॥११०९॥
translation: Like cars that thunder on their way, like coursers eager for renown, Have Soma drops flowed forth for wealth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इमा नु कं भुवना सीषधेमेन्द्रश्च विश्वे च देवाः ॥१११०
translation: Forth have they rushed from holding hands, like chariots that are urged to speed, Like joyful songs of singing-men.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यज्ञं च नस्तन्वं च प्रजां चादित्यैरिन्द्रः सह सीषधातु ॥११११॥
translation: The Somas deck themselves with milk as kings are graced with eulogies, And, with seven priests, the sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आदित्यैरिन्द्रः सगणो मरुद्भिरस्मभ्यं भेषजा करत् ॥१११२॥
translation: Pressed for the gladdening draught the drops flow forth abundantly with song, Flow with the stream of savoury juice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र व इन्द्राय वृत्रहन्तमाय विप्राय गाथं गायत यं जुजोषते ॥१११३॥
translation: Winning Vivasvan’s glory and speeding the light of Dawn, the suns, Pass through the openings of the cloth. 64
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अर्चन्त्यर्कं मरुतः स्वर्का आ स्तोभति श्रुतो युवा स इन्द्रः ॥१११४॥
translation: The singing-men of ancient time open the doors of sacred songs-- The men who bring the mighty One.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उप प्रक्षे मधुमति क्षियन्तः पुष्येम रयिं धीमहे त इन्द्र ॥१११५॥
translation: In close society have come the priests, the sevenfold brotherhood, Filling the station of the One.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र काव्यमुशनेव ब्रुवाणो देवो देवानां जनिमा विवक्ति । महिव्रतः शुचिबन्धुः पावकः पदा वराहो अभ्येति रेभन् ॥१११६॥
translation: He makes us kin with Gods, he joins the Sun, for seeing, with mine eye; I milk the Sage’s offspring forth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र हꣳसासस्तृपला वग्नुमच्छामादस्तं वृषगणा अयासुः । अङ्गोषिणं पवमानꣳ सखायो दुर्मर्षं वाणं प्र वदन्ति साकम् ॥१११७॥
translation: The Sun beholdeth with his eye the heaven’s dear quarter which the priests Have set within the sacred cell.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स योजत उरुगायस्य जूतिं वृथा क्रीडन्तं मिमते न गावः । परीणसं कृणुते तिग्मशृङ्गो दिवा हरिर्ददृशे नक्तमृज्रः ॥१११८॥
translation: Forth on their way the glorious drops have flowed for maintenance of Law, Knowing what suits this worshipper.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र स्वानासो रथा इवार्वन्तो न श्रवस्यवः । सोमासो राये अक्रमुः ॥१११९॥
translation: Down in the mighty waters sinks the stream of Meath, most excellent, Oblation best of all in worth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: हिन्वानासो रथा इव दधन्विरे गभस्त्योः । भरासः कारिणामिव ॥११२०॥
translation: About the holy place the Steer, true, guileless, noblest, hath sent forth, Continuous voices in the wood.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: राजानो न प्रशस्तिभिः सोमासो गोभिरञ्जते । यज्ञो न सप्त धातृभिः ॥११२१॥
translation: When the Sage, purging manly deeds and lofty wisdom flows, around,
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: परि स्वानास इन्दवो मदाय बर्हणा गिरा । मधो अर्षन्ति धारया ॥११२२॥
translation: When purified, he sits enthroned as King over the warring clans. What time the sages speed him on.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आपानासो विवस्वतो जिन्वन्त उषसो भगम् । सूरा अण्वं वि तन्वते ॥११२३॥
translation: Most dear, gold-coloured, in the fleece he sinks, and settles in the wood: The singer is besieged with song.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अप द्वारा मतीनां प्रत्ना ऋण्वन्ति कारवः । वृष्णो हरस आयवः ॥११२४॥
translation: He goes to Indra, Vayu, and the Asvins with the rapturous joy, To whomsoe’er his power delights.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: समीचीनास आशत होतारः सप्तजानयः । पदमेकस्य पिप्रतः ॥११२५॥
translation: The waves of pleasant Soma flow to Bhaga, Mitra, Varuna, Well knowing, through his mighty powers.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नाभा नाभिं न आ ददे चक्षुषा सूर्यं दृशे । कवेरपत्यमा दुहे ॥११२६॥
translation: Gain for us, O ye Heaven and Earth, riches of Meath to win us strength: Gain for us treasures and renown.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभि प्रियं दिवस्पदमध्वर्युभिर्गुहा हितम् । सूरः पश्यति चक्षसा ॥११२७॥
translation: We choose to-day that chariot-steed of thine, the strong, that brings us bliss, The guardian, the desire of all;
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: असृग्रमिन्दवः पथा धर्मन्नृतस्य सुश्रियः । विदाना अस्य योजना ॥११२८॥
translation: The excellent, the gladdener, the Sage with heart that understands. The guardian, the desire of all;
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र धारा मधो अग्रियो महीरपो वि गाहते । हविर्हविःषु वन्द्यः ॥११२९॥
translation: Who for ourselves, O thou most wise, is wealth and fair intelligence, The guardian, the desire of all.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र युजा वाचो अग्रियो वृषो अचिक्रदद्वने । सद्माभि सत्यो अध्वरः ॥११३०॥
translation: Agni Vaisvanara, born in course of Order, the messenger of earth, the head of heaven, The Sage, the Sovran, guest of men, our vessel fit for their mouth, the Gods have generated.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: परि यत्काव्या कविर्नृम्णा पुनानो अर्षति । स्वर्वाजी सिषासति ॥११३१॥
translation: To thee, immortal! when to life thou springest all the Gods sing for joy as to their infant. They by thy mental powers were made immortal, Vaisvdnara when thou shonest from thy parents.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवमानो अभि स्पृधो विशो राजेव सीदति । यदीमृण्वन्ति वेधसः ॥११३२॥
translation: Him have they praised, mid-point of sacrifices, great cistern of libations, seat of riches. Vaisvanara, conveyer of oblations, ensign of worship, have the Gods engendered. IV Mitra-Varuna
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अव्या वारे परि प्रियो हरिर्वनेषु सीदति । रेभो वनुष्यते मती ॥११३३॥
translation: Sing forth unto your Varuna and Mitra with a song inspired: They, mighty Lords, are lofty law.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स वायुमिन्द्रमश्विना साकं मदेन गच्छति । रणा यो अस्य धर्मणा ॥११३४॥
translation: Full springs of fatness, sovran Kings, Mitra and Varuna, the twain, Gods glorified among the Gods,
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ मित्रे वरुणे भगे मधोः पवन्त ऊर्मयः । विदाना अस्य शक्मभिः ॥११३५॥
translation: So help ye us to riches, great celestial and terrestrial wealth! Vast is your sway among the Gods. 65
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अस्मभ्यꣳ रोदसी रयिं मध्वो वाजस्य सातये । श्रवो वसूनि सञ्जितम् ॥११३६॥
translation: O Indra marvellously bright, come, these libations long for thee, Thus by firie fingers purified!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ ते दक्षं मयोभुवं वह्निमद्या वृणीमहे । पान्तमा पुरुस्पृहम् ॥११३७॥
translation: Urged by the holy singer, sped by song, come nigb, O Indra, to The sacrificing suppliant’s pravers!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ मन्द्रमा वरेण्यमा विप्रमा मनीषिणम् । पान्तमा पुरुस्पृहम् ॥११३८॥
translation: Approach, O Indra, basting thee, Lord of bay horses, to our prayers: In our libation t ake delight! VI Indra-Agni
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ रयिमा सुचेतुनमा सुक्रतो तनूष्वा । पान्तमा पुरुस्पृहम् ॥११३९॥
translation: Glorify him who compasses all forests with his glowing Dame, And leaves them blackened by his tongue.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मूर्धानं दिवो अरतिं पृथिव्या वैश्वानरमृत आ जातमग्निम् । कविꣳ सम्राजमतिथिं जनानामासन्नः पात्रं जनयन्त देवाः ॥११४०॥
translation: He who gains Indra’s grace by fire enkindled, finds as easy way Over the floods to splendid wealth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वां विश्वे अमृत जायमानꣳ शिशुं न देवा अभि सं नवन्ते । तव क्रतुभिरमृतत्वमायन्वैश्वानर यत्पित्रोरदीदेः ॥११४१॥
translation: Give us, ye twain, swift steeds to bring Indra and Agni, and bestow Abundant food with wealth on us. VII Soma Pavamana.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नाभिं यज्ञानाꣳ सदनꣳ रयीणां महामाहावमभि सं नवन्त । वैश्वानरꣳ रथ्यमध्वराणां यज्ञस्य केतुं जनयन्त देवाः ॥११४२॥
translation: Indu hath started forth for Indra’s settled place, and slights not,. as a friend, the promise of his friend. Soma comes onward like a youth with youthful maids, and gains the beaker by a course of hundred paths.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र वो मित्राय गायत वरुणाय विपा गिरा । महिक्षत्रावृतं बृहत् ॥११४३॥
translation: Your hymns of pleasant sound, praiseworthy, fond of lauds, have come into the hall enclosed for sacrifice. Singers have hymned the golden-coloured as he sports, and milchkine have come near to meet him with their milk,
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सम्राजा या घृतयोनी मित्रश्चोभा वरुणश्च । देवा देवेषु प्रशस्ता ॥११४४॥
translation: O Soma, Indu, while they cleanse thee, with thy wave pour orb us plentiful accumulated food, Which, ceaseless, thrice a day shall yield us hero power enriched. with store of nourishment, and strength, and meath. VIII Indra.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ता नः शक्तं पार्थिवस्य महो रायो दिव्यस्य । महि वां क्षत्रं देवेषु ॥११४५॥
translation: No one by deed attains to him who works and strengthensevermore: No, not by sacrifice, to Indra praised of all, resistless, daring, bold in might;
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रा याहि चित्रभानो सुता इमे त्वायवः । अण्वीभिस्तना पूतासः ॥११४६॥
translation: The powerful conqueror, invincible in war, him at whose birth the mighty ones, The kine who spread afar, sent their loud voices out, heavens, earths sent their loud voices out.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रा याहि धियेषितो विप्रजूतः सुतावतः । उप ब्रह्माणि वाघतः ॥११४७॥
translation: Sit down, O friends, and sing aloud to him who purifies himself: Deck him for glory, like a child, with holy rites
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रा याहि तूतुजान उप ब्रह्माणि हरिवः । सुते दधिष्व नश्चनः ॥११४८॥
translation: Loose him who bringeth household wealth, even as a calf with. mother kine, Him who bath double strength, strong, god-delighting juice!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तमीडिष्व यो अर्चिषा वना विश्वा परिष्वजत् । कृष्णा कृणोति जिह्वया ॥११४९॥
translation: Purify him who gives us power, most blissful one, that he may be A banquet for the troop, Mitra, and Varuna!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: य इद्ध आविवासति सुम्नमिन्द्रस्य मर्त्यः । द्युम्नाय सुतरा अपः ॥११५०॥
translation: The Strong hath flowed forth in a thousand streams, flowed through the filter and the sheep’s long wool.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ता नो वाजवतीरिष आशून्पिपृतमर्वतः । एन्द्रमग्निं च वोढवे ॥११५१॥
translation: With ceaseless genial flow the Strong hath run, purified by the waters, blent with milk.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्रो अयासीदिन्दुरिन्द्रस्य निष्कृतꣳ सखा सख्युर्न प्र मिनाति सङ्गिरम् । मर्य इव युवतिभिः समर्षति सोमः कलशे शतयाम्ना पथा ॥११५२॥
translation: Pressed out with stones, directed by the men, go forth, O Soma, into Indra’s throat! 66
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र वो धियो मन्द्रयुवो विपन्युवः पनस्युवः संवरणेष्वक्रमुः । हरिं क्रीडन्तमभ्यनूषत स्तुभोऽभि धेनवः पयसेदशिश्रयुः ॥११५३॥
translation: The Soma juices which have been expressed afar or near at hand, Or there on Saryanavan’s bank,
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ नः सोम संयतं पिप्युषीमिषमिन्दो पवस्व पवमान ऊर्मिणा । या नो दोहते त्रिरहन्नसश्चुषी क्षुमद्वाजवन्मधुमत्सुवीर्यम् ॥११५४॥
translation: Those pressed among Arjikas, pressed among the active, in, men’s homes, Or pressed among the Fivefold Tribes--
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: न किष्टं कर्मणा नशद्यश्चकार सदावृधम् । इन्द्रं न यज्ञैर्विश्वगूर्तमृभ्वसमधृष्टं धृष्णुमोजसा ॥११५५॥
translation: May these celestial drops, expressed, pour forth upon us, as they flow, Rain from the heavens and hero strength!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अषाढमुग्रं पृतनासु सासहिं यस्मिन्महीरुरुज्रयः । सं धेनवो जायमाने अनोनवुर्द्यावः क्षामीरनोनवुः ॥११५६॥
translation: May Vatsa draw thy mind away even from thy loftiest dwelling-place! Agni, I yearn for thee with song.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सखाय आ नि षीदत पुनानाय प्रगायत । शिशुं न यज्ञैः परि भूषत श्रिये ॥११५७॥
translation: Thou art alike in many a place: through all the regions thou art Lord. In fray and fight we call on thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: समी वत्सं न मातृभिः सृजता गयसाधनम् । देवाव्यां३मदमभि द्विशवसम् ॥११५८॥
translation: When we are seeking spoil we call Agni to help us in the strife, Giver of wordrous gifts in war.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पुनाता दक्षसाधनं यथा शर्धाय वीतये । यथा मित्राय वरुणाय शन्तमम् ॥११५९॥
translation: O Indra, bring great strength to us, bring valour, 5atakratu, thou most active, bring A hero conquering in war!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र वाज्यक्षाः सहस्रधारस्तिरः पवित्रं वि वारमव्यम् ॥११६०॥
translation: For, gracious Satakratu, thou hast ever been a mother and a sire to us, So now for bliss we pray to thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स वाज्यक्षाः सहस्ररेता अद्भिर्मृजानो गोभिः श्रीणानः ॥११६१॥
translation: To thee, strong! much-invoked! who showest forth thy strength, made very mighty! do I speak: So grant thou us heroic power!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र सोम याहीन्द्रस्य कुक्षा नृभिर्येमानो अद्रिभिः सुतः ॥११६२॥
translation: Stone-Darting Indra, wonderous God, what wealth thou hast not given me here, That bounty, treasure-finder! bring, filling full both thy hands, to us!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ये सोमासः परावति ये अर्वावति सुन्विरे । ये वादः शर्यणावति ॥११६३॥
translation: Bring what thou deemest worth the wish, O Indra that which is in heavem! So may we know thee as thou art a giver boundless in thy gifts!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: य आर्जीकेषु कृत्वसु ये मध्ये पस्त्यानाम् । ये वा जनेषु पञ्चसु ॥११६४॥
translation: Thy lofty spirit famed in all the regions as appeasable,-- With this thou rendest even things firm, Stone-darter! so to win thee strength. 67
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ते नो वृष्टिं दिवस्परि पवन्तामा सुवीर्यम् । स्वाना देवास इन्दवः ॥११६५॥
translation: The Maruts with their troop adorn and brighten, even at his birth, the Sage, the lovely infant. By songs a poet, and a Sage by wisdom, Soma goes singing through the cleansing filter.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ ते वत्सो मनो यमत्परमाच्चित्सधस्थात् । अग्ने त्वां कामये गिरा ॥११६६॥
translation: Light-winner, Rishi-minded, Rishi-maker, hymned in a thousand hymns, leader of sages, Eager to gain his third form, mighty, Soma is, like Viraj, resplendent as a singer.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पुरुत्रा हि सदृङ्ङसि दिशो विश्वा अनु प्रभुः । समत्सु त्वा हवामहे ॥११६७॥
translation: Hawk seated in the press, bird wide-extended, the banner seeking kine and wielding weapons, Uniting with the sea, the wave of waters, the mighty tells his fourth form and declares it.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: समत्स्वग्निमवसे वाजयन्तो हवामहे । वाजेषु चित्रराधसम् ॥११६८॥
translation: Obeying Indra’s dear desire these Soma juices have flowed forth Increasing his heroic might.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वं न इन्द्रा भर ओजो नृम्णꣳ शतक्रतो विचर्षणे । आ वीरं पृतनासहम् ॥११६९॥
translation: Laid in the press and flowing pure to Vayu and the Asvins, may These give us great heroic strength.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वꣳ हि नः पिता वसो त्वं माता शतक्रतो बभूविथ । अथा ते सुम्नमीमहे ॥११७०॥
translation: Soma, as thou art purified, incite to bounty Indra’s heart, To seat him in the shrine of Gods!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वाꣳ शुष्मिन्पुरुहूत वाजयन्तमुप ब्रुवे सहस्कृत । स नो रास्व सुवीर्यम् ॥११७१॥
translation: The ten swift fingers deck thee forth seven ministers impel thee on, The sages have rejoiced in thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यदिन्द्र चित्र म इह नास्ति त्वादातमद्रिवः । राधस्तन्नो विदद्वस उभयाहस्त्या भर ॥११७२॥
translation: When through the filter thou art poured we clothe thee with a robe of milk, To be a rapturous feast for Gods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यन्मन्यसे वरेण्यमिन्द्र द्युक्षं तदा भर । विद्याम तस्य ते वयमकूपारस्य दावनः ॥११७३॥
translation: When purified within the jars, Soma bright-red and golden-hued, Hath veiled him in a milky dress.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यत्ते दिक्षु प्रराध्यं मनो अस्ति श्रुतं बृहत् । तेन दृढा चिदद्रिव आ वाजं दर्षि सातये ॥११७४॥
translation: Flow onward to our wealthy lords. Drive all our enemies away: O lndu, pass into thy friend!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: शिशुं जज्ञानꣳ हर्यतं मृजन्ति शुम्भन्ति विप्रं मरुतो गणेन । कविर्गीर्भिः काव्येना कविः सन्त्सोमः पवित्रमत्येति रेभन् ॥११७५॥
translation: May we obtain thee, Indra’s drink, who viewest men and findest light, Gain thee and progeny and food!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ऋषिमना य ऋषिकृत्स्वर्षाः सहस्रनीथः पदवीः कवीनाम् । तृतीयं धाम महिषः सिषासन्त्सोमो विराजमनु राजति ष्टुप् ॥११७६॥
translation: Send down the rain from heaven and make splendour upon the earth! Give us, O Soma, victory in war!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: चमूषच्छ्येनः शकुनो विभृत्वा गोविन्दुर्द्रप्स आयुधानि बिभ्रत् । अपामूर्मिꣳ सचमानः समुद्रं तुरीयं धाम महिषो विवक्ति ॥११७७॥
translation: Poured through the fleece in thousand streams purified Soma floweth to, Indra’s and Vayu’s meeting-place.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एते सोमा अभि प्रियमिन्द्रस्य काममक्षरन् । वर्धन्तो अस्य वीर्यम् ॥११७८॥
translation: Sing forth, ye men who long for help, to Pavamana, to the Sage, Effused to entertain the Gods!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पुनानासश्चमूषदो गच्छन्तो वायुमश्विना । ते नो धत्त सुवीर्यम् ॥११७९॥
translation: The Soma drops with thousand powers are purified to win us strength, Hymned to become the feast of Gods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रस्य सोम राधसे पुनानो हार्दि चोदय । देवानां योनिमासदम् ॥११८०॥
translation: Yea, as thou flowest bring great store of food that we may win us strength: Indu, bring splendid manly might
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मृजन्ति त्वा दश क्षिपो हिन्वन्ति सप्त धीतयः । अनु विप्रा अमादिषुः ॥११८१॥
translation: Like coursers by their drivers urged, they were poured forth, to win us strength, Swift through the woollen straining-cloth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: देवेभ्यस्त्वा मदाय कꣳ सृजानमति मेष्यः । सं गोभिर्वासयामसि ॥११८२॥
translation: May they in flowing give us wealth in thousands, and heroic power,-- These godlike Soma drops effused!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पुनानः कलशेष्वा वस्त्राण्यरुषो हरिः । परि गव्यान्यव्यत ॥११८३॥
translation: The roaring Soma drops flow on, like milch-kine lowing to, their calves: 68 They have run forth from both the hands.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मघोन आ पवस्व नो जहि विश्वा अप द्विषः । इन्दो सखायमा विश ॥११८४॥
translation: Beloved by Indra, bringing joy, roaring as thou art purified, Drive all our enemies away.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नृचक्षसं त्वा वयमिन्द्रपीतꣳ स्वर्विदम् । भक्षीमहि प्रजामिषम् ॥११८५॥
translation: As Pavamanas, driving off the godless, looking on the light, Sit in the place of sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वृष्टिं दिवः परि स्रव द्युम्नं पृथिव्या अधि । सहो नः सोम पृत्सु धाः ॥११८६॥
translation: The Soma drops, exceeding rich in sweets, to Indra have been poured, Shed with the stream of sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सोमः पुनानो अर्षति सहस्रधारो अत्यविः । वायोरिन्द्रस्य निष्कृतम् ॥११८७॥
translation: Sages have called to Indra, like cows, milch-kine, lowing to their calves, Called him to drink the Soma juice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवमानमवस्यवो विप्रमभि प्र गायत । सुष्वाणं देववीतये ॥११८८॥
translation: In the stream’s wave wise Soma dwells, distilling rapture, in his. seat, Resting upon a wild cow’s hide.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवन्ते वाजसातये सोमाः सहस्रपाजसः । गृणाना देववीतये ॥११८९॥
translation: Far-sighted Soma, Sage and bard, is worshipped in the central point, Of heaven, the straining-cloth of wool.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उत नो वाजसातये पवस्व बृहतीरिषः । द्युमदिन्दो सुवीर्यम् ॥११९०॥
translation: In close embracement Indu holds Soma when poured within the: jars. And on the purifying sieve.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अत्या हियाना न हेतृभिरसृग्रं वाजसातये । वि वारमव्यमाशवः ॥११९१॥
translation: Indu sends forth a voice on high, up in the region of the sea. Stirring the cask that drops with meath.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ते नः सहस्रिणꣳ रयिं पवन्तामा सुवीर्यम् । स्वाना देवास इन्दवः ॥११९२॥
translation: The tree whose praises never fail dwells in the stream of holy milk, Urged onward by its human friend.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वाश्रा अर्षन्तीन्दवोऽभि वत्सं न मातरः । दधन्विरे गभस्त्योः ॥११९३॥
translation: O Pavamana bring us wealth bright with a thousand splendours; yea, O Indu, give us ready help!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: जुष्ट इन्द्राय मत्सरः पवमानः कनिक्रदत् । विश्वा अप द्विषो जहि ॥११९४॥
translation: Sage, poet, poured with all his stream, Soma is driven, far away, To the dear places of the sky.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अपघ्नन्तो अराव्णः पवमानाः स्वर्दृशः । योनावृतस्य सीदत ॥११९५॥
translation: Loud as a river’s roaring wave thy powers have lifted up themselves: Urge on thine arrow’s sharpened point!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सोमा असृग्रमिन्दवः सुता ऋतस्य धारया । इन्द्राय मधुमत्तमाः ॥११९६॥
translation: At thine effusion upward rise three voices fresh and strong, when thou. Flowest upon the fleecy ridge.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभि विप्रा अनूषत गावो वत्सं न धेनवः । इन्द्रꣳ सोमस्य पीतये ॥११९७॥
translation: On to the fleece they urge with stones the dear, the goldencoloured one, Even Pavamana dropping meath.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मदच्युत्क्षेति सादने सिन्धोरूर्मा विपश्चित् । सोमो गौरी अधि श्रितः ॥११९८॥
translation: Flow with thy current to the sieve, O Sage, best giver of delight, To seat these in the shrine of song!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: दिवो नाभा विचक्षणोऽव्या वारे महीयते । सोमो यः सुक्रतुः कविः ॥११९९॥
translation: Best giver of delight, flow on anointed with the milk for balm, And enter into Indra’s throat!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यः सोमः कलशेष्वा अन्तः पवित्र आहितः । तमिन्दुः परि षस्वजे ॥१२००॥
translation: Flow onward, Indu, with this food for him who in thy wild delights, Battered the nine-and-ninety down.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र वाचमिन्दुरिष्यति समुद्रस्याधि विष्टपि । जिन्वन्कोशं मधुश्चुतम् ॥१२०१॥
translation: Smote swiftly forts, and Sambara, then Yadu and that Turvasa, For pious Divodasa’s sake!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नित्यस्तोत्रो वनस्पतिर्धेनामन्तः सबर्दुघाम् । हिन्वानो मानुषा युजा ॥१२०२॥
translation: Finder of horses, pour on us horses and wealth in kine and gold, And Indu, food in boundless store!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ पवमान धारया रयिꣳ सहस्रवर्चसम् । अस्मे इन्दो स्वाभुवम् ॥१२०३॥
translation: Chasing our foemen, driving off the godless, Soma floweth on, Going to Indra’s settled place.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभि प्रिया दिवः कविर्विप्रः स धारया सुतः । सोमो हिन्वे परावति ॥१२०४॥
translation: O Pavamana, hither bring great riches, and destroy our foes: O Indu, grant heroic fame! 69
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उत्ते शुष्मास ईरते सिन्धोरूर्मेरिव स्वनः । वाणस्य चोदया पविम् ॥१२०५॥
translation: A hundred obstacles have ne’er checked thee when rain to give thy boons, When, being cleansed, thou combatest.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्रसवे त उदीरते तिस्रो वाचो मखस्युवः । यदव्य एषि सानवि ॥१२०६॥
translation: Flow onward with that stream wherewith thou gavest splendour to the sun, Speeding the waters kind to man!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अव्या वारैः परि प्रियꣳ हरिꣳ हिन्वन्त्यद्रिभिः । पवमानं मधुश्चुतम् ॥१२०७॥
translation: He, Pavamana, high o’er man, yoked the Sun’s courser Etasa, To travel through the realm of air.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ पवस्व मदिन्तम पवित्रं धारया कवे । अर्कस्य योनिमासदम् ॥१२०८॥
translation: Yea, those bay steeds he harnessed to the chariot that the Sun might come: Indu, he said, is Indra’s self.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स पवस्व मदिन्तम गोभिरञ्जानो अक्तुभिः । एन्द्रस्य जठरं विश ॥१२०९॥
translation: Associate with fires, make your God Agni envoy at sacrifice, best skilled in worship, Established firm among mankind, the holy flame-crowned and fed with oil, the purifier!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अया वीती परि स्रव यस्त इन्दो मदेष्वा । अवाहन्नवतीर्नव ॥१२१०॥
translation: Like a steed neighing eager for the pasture, when he hath stepped forth from the great enclosure: Then the wind following blows upon his splendour, and, straight, the path is black which thou hast travelled.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पुरः सद्य इत्थाधिये दिवोदासाय शम्बरम् । अध त्यं तुर्वशं यदुम् ॥१२११॥
translation: From thee, a bull but newly born, O Agni, the kindled everlasting flames rise upward. Aloft to heaven as ruddy smoke thou mountest: Agni, thou speedest to the Gods as envoy.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: परि णो अश्वमश्वविद्गोमदिन्दो हिरण्यवत् । क्षरा सहस्रिणीरिषः ॥१२१२॥
translation: We make this Indra very strong to strike the mighty Vritra dead: A vigorous hero shall he be.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अपघ्नन्पवते मृधोऽप सोमो अराव्णः । गच्छन्निन्द्रस्य निष्कृतम् ॥१२१३॥
translation: This Indra, made for giving gifts, is stablished, mightiest, in strength, Bright, meet for Soma, famed in song.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: महो नो राय आ भर पवमान जही मृधः । रास्वेन्दो वीरवद्यशः ॥१२१४॥
translation: By song, as ‘twere’ the powerful bolt which none may parry, was prepared: Strong and invincible he grew. XI Soma Pavamana I. Adhvaryu, to the filter lead the Soma-juice expressed with stones: Make thou it pure for Indra’s drink!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: न त्वा शतं च न ह्रुतो राधो दित्सन्तमा मिनन् । यत्पुनानो मखस्यसे ॥१२१५॥
translation: These Gods and all the Marut host, Indu! enjoy this juice of thine, This Pavamana’s flowing meath.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अया पवस्व धारया यया सूर्यमरोचयः । हिन्वानो मानुषीरपः ॥१२१६॥
translation: Pour out for Indra, Thunder-armed, the milk of heaven, the Soma’s juice, Most excellent, most rich in sweets!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अयुक्त सूर एतशं पवमानो मनावधि । अन्तरिक्षेण यातवे ॥१२१७॥
translation: On flows the potent juice, sustainer of the heavens, the strength of Gods, whom men must hail with shouts of joy, Thou, gold-hued, started like a courser by brave men, art lightly showing forth thy splendour in the streams.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उत त्या हरितो रथे सूरो अयुक्त यातवे । इन्दुरिन्द्र इति ब्रुवन् ॥१२१८॥
translation: He takes his weapons, like a hero, in his hands, fain to win light, car-borne, in forays for the kine. Indu, while stimulating Indra’s might, is urged forward and balmed by sages skilful in their task.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्निं वो देवमग्निभिः सजोषा यजिष्ठं दूतमध्वरे कृणुध्वम् । यो मर्त्येषु निध्रुविरृतावा तपुर्मूर्धा घृतान्नः पावकः ॥१२१९॥
translation: Soma, as thou art purified with flowing wave, exhibiting thy strength enter thou Indra’s throat. Make both worlds stream for us, as lightning doth the clouds: mete out exhaustless powers for us through this our prayer! 70
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्रोथदश्वो न यवसेऽविष्यन्यदा महः संवरणाद्व्यस्थात् । आदस्य वातो अनु वाति शोचिरध स्म ते व्रजनं कृष्णमस्ति ॥१२२०॥
translation: Though, Indra, thou art called by men eastward and westward, north and south, Thou chiefly art with Anava and Turvasa, brave champion! urged by men to come.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उद्यस्य ते नवजातस्य वृष्णोऽग्ने चरन्त्यजरा इधानाः । अच्छा द्यामरुषो धूम एषि सं दूतो अग्न ईयसे हि देवान् ॥१२२१॥
translation: Or, Indra, when with Ruma, Rusama, Syavaka, and Kripa thou rejoicest thee, Still do the Kanvas, bringing prayer, with hymns of praise O Indra, draw thee hither: come!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तमिन्द्रं वाजयामसि महे वृत्राय हन्तवे । स वृषा वृषभो भुवत् ॥१२२२॥
translation: Both boons,-may, Indra, hitherward turned, listen to this prayer of ours. And mightiest Maghavan with thought inclined to us come near to drink to Soma juice!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रः स दामने कृत ओजिष्ठः स बले हितः । द्युम्नी श्लोकी स सोम्यः ॥१२२३॥
translation: For him, strong, independent ruler, Heaven and Earth have fashioned forth with power and might. Thou seatest thee as first among thy peers in place, for thy soul longs for Soma juice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: गिरा वज्रो न सम्भृतः सबलो अनपच्युतः । ववक्ष उग्रो अस्तृतः ॥१२२४॥
translation: God, working with mankind flow on; to Indra go thy gladdening juice: To Vayu mount as Law commands!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अध्वर्यो अद्रिभिः सुतꣳ सोमं पवित्र आ नय । पुनाहीन्द्राय पातवे ॥१२२५॥
translation: O Soma Pavamana, thou pourest out wealth that may be famed: O Indu, pass into the lake!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तव त्य इन्दो अन्धसो देवा मधोर्व्याशत । पवमानस्य मरुतः ॥१२२६॥
translation: Soma, thou flowest chasing foes, finder of wisdom and delight: Drive thou the godless folk afar!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: दिवः पीयूषमुत्तमꣳ सोममिन्द्राय वज्रिणे । सुनोता मधुमत्तमम् ॥१२२७॥
translation: Stream on us riches that are craved by hundreds, best at winning spoil, Riches, O Indu, thousandfold, most splendid, that surpass the light!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: धर्ता दिवः पवते कृत्व्यो रसो दक्षो देवानामनुमाद्यो नृभिः । हरिः सृजानो अत्यो न सत्वभिर्वृथा पाजाꣳसि कृणुषे नदीष्वा ॥१२२८॥
translation: May we, O Vasu, be most near to this thy bounty, food, and wealth! Desired by many men, and in thy favour, O resistless one!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: शूरो न धत्त आयुधा गभस्त्योः स्वाः३ सिषासन्रथिरो गविष्टिषु । इन्द्रस्य शुष्ममीरयन्नपस्युभिरिन्दुर्हिन्वानो अज्यते मनीषिभिः ॥१२२९॥
translation: Effused, this Indu hath flowed on, distilling rapture, to the fleece. He streams erect to sacrifice, as ‘twere with splendour, seeking kine.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रस्य सोम पवमान ऊर्मिणा तविष्यमाणो जठरेष्वा विश । प्र नः पिन्व विद्युदभ्रेव रोदसी धिया नो वाजाꣳ उप माहि शश्वतः ॥१२३०॥
translation: Flow onward, Soma, as a mighty sea, as Father of the Gods, to every form!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यदिन्द्र प्रागपागुदङ्न्यग्वा हूयसे नृभिः । सिमा पुरू नृषूतो अस्यानवेऽसि प्रशर्ध तुर्वशे ॥१२३१॥
translation: Flow on, O Soma, radiant for the Gods, blissful to heaven and earth and living things!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यद्वा रुमे रुशमे श्यावके कृप इन्द्र मादयसे सचा । कण्वासस्त्वा स्तोमेभिर्ब्रह्मवाहस इन्द्रा यच्छन्त्या गहि ॥१२३२॥
translation: Thou art, bright juice, sustainer of the sky: flow, mighty, in accordance with true law! XVIII Agni I. I laud your most beloved guest, like a dear friend, O Agni, him! Who, like a chariot, wins us wealth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उभयꣳ शृणवच्च न इन्द्रो अर्वागिदं वचः । सत्राच्या मघवान्त्सोमपीतये धिया शविष्ठ आ गमत् ॥१२३३॥
translation: Whom as a Sage who merits praise the Gods have, from the olden time, Established among mortal men.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तꣳ हि स्वराजं वृषभं तमोजसा धिषणे निष्टतक्षतुः । उतोपमानां प्रथमो नि षीदसि सोमकामꣳ हि ते मनः ॥१२३४॥
translation: Do thou, most youthful God, protect the men who offer, hear their songs, And of thyself preserve their seed!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवस्व देव आयुषगिन्द्रं गच्छतु ते मदः । वायुमा रोह धर्मणा ॥१२३५॥
translation: Come unto us, O Indra, dear, still conquering, unconcealable Wide as a mountain spread on all sides, Lord of heaven.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवमान नि तोशसे रयिꣳ सोम श्रवाय्यम् । इन्दो समुद्रमा विश ॥१२३६॥
translation: O truthful Soma-drinker, thou art mightier than both the worlds. Thou strengthenest him who pours’libation, Lord of heaven.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अपघ्नन्पवसे मृधः क्रतुवित्सोम मत्सरः । नुदस्वादेवयुं जनम् ॥१२३७॥
translation: For thou art he, O Indra, who upholdeth all our fortresses, The Dasyu’s slayer, man’s sustainer, Lord of heaven. 71
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभी नो वाजसातमं रयिमर्ष शतस्पृहम् । इन्दो सहस्रभर्णसं तुविद्युम्नं विभासहम् ॥१२३८॥
translation: Render of forts, the young, the wise, of strength unmeasured, was he born, Sustainer of each sacred rite, Indra, the Thunderer, much extolled,
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वयं ते अस्य राधसो वसोर्वसो पुरुस्पृहः । नि नेदिष्ठतमा इषः स्याम सुम्ने ते अध्रिगो ॥१२३९॥
translation: Thou wielder of the stone, didst burst the cave of Vala rich in kine. The Gods came pressing to thy side, and free from terror aided thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: परि स्य स्वानो अक्षरदिन्दुरव्ये मदच्युतः । धारा य ऊर्ध्वो अध्वरे भ्राजा न याति गव्ययुः ॥१२४०॥
translation: They glorified with hymns of praise Indra who reigneth by his might, Whose bounteous gifts in thousands come, yea, even more abundantly.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवस्व सोम महान्त्समुद्रः पिता देवानां विश्वाभि धाम ॥१२४१॥
translation: Guard of all being, generating creatures, loud roared the sea as highest law commanded. Strong in the filter, on the fleecy summit, pressed from the stone, Soma hath waxen mighty.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: शुक्रः पवस्व देवेभ्यः सोम दिवे पृथिव्यै शं च प्रजाभ्यः ॥१२४२॥
translation: Make Vayu glad, for furtherance and bounty: cheer Varuna and Mitra, as they cleanse thee! Gladden the Gods, gladden the host of Maruts: make Heaven and Earth rejoice, O God, O Soma!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: दिवो धर्त्तासि शुक्रः पीयूषः सत्ये विधर्मन्वाजी पवस्व ॥१२४३॥
translation: Soma, the mighty, when, the water’s offspring, he chose the Gods, performed that great achievement. He, Pavamana, granted strength to Indra: he, Indu, generated strength in Surya.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्रेष्ठं वो अतिथिꣳ स्तुषे मित्रमिव प्रियम् । अग्ने रथं न वेद्यम् ॥१२४४॥
translation: Here present this immortal God flies, like a bird upon her wings, To settle in the vats of wood.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: कविमिव प्रशꣳस्यं यं देवास इति द्विता । नि मर्त्येष्वादधुः ॥१२४५॥
translation: Praised by the sacred bards, this God dives into waters, and bestows Rich gifts upon the worshipper.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वं यविष्ठ दाशुषो नॄꣳपाहि शृणुही गिरः । रक्षा तोकमुत त्मना ॥१२४६॥
translation: He. like a warrior going forth with heroes, as he flows along. Is fain to win all precious boons.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एन्द्र नो गधि प्रिय सत्राजिदगोह्य । गिरिर्न विश्वतः पृथुः पतिर्दिवः ॥१२४७॥
translation: This God as he is flowirig on speeds like a car and gives his aid: He lets his voice be heard of all.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभि हि सत्य सोमपा उभे बभूथ रोदसी । इन्द्रासि सुन्वतो वृधः पतिर्दिवः ॥१२४८॥
translation: This God, while flowing, is adorned, gold-coloured, for the spoil, by men Devout and skilled in holy songs.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वꣳ हि शश्वतीनामिन्द्र धर्त्ता पुरामसि । हन्ता दस्योर्मनोर्वृधः पतिर्दिवः ॥१२४९॥
translation: This God, made ready with the hymn runs swiftly through the winding ways, Inviolable as he flows.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पुरां भिन्दुर्युवा कविरमितौजा अजायत । इन्द्रो विश्वस्य कर्मणो धर्त्ता वज्री पुरुष्टुतः ॥१२५०॥
translation: A way he rushes with his stream, across the regions, into heaven, And roars as he is flowing on.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वं वलस्य गोमतोऽपावरद्रिवो बिलम् । त्वां देवा अबिभ्युषस्तुज्यमानास आविषुः ॥१२५१॥
translation: While flowing, meet for sacrifice, he hath gone up to heaven, across The regions, never overthrown.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रमीशानमोजसाभि स्तोमैरनूषत । सहस्रं यस्य रातय उत वा सन्ति भूयसीः ॥१२५२॥
translation: By generation long ago, this God, engendered for the Gods, Flows tawny to the straining-cloth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अक्रान्त्समुद्रः प्रथमे विधर्मन् जनयन्प्रजा भुवनस्य गोपाः । वृषा पवित्रे अधि सानो अव्ये बृहत्सोमो वावृधे स्वानो अद्रिः ॥१२५३॥
translation: This Lord of many holy laws, even at his birth engendering strength, Effused, flows onward in a stream.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मत्सि वायुमिष्टये राधसे नो मत्सि मित्रावरुणा पूयमानः । मत्सि शर्धो मारुतं मत्सि देवान्मत्सि द्यावापृथिवी देव सोम ॥१२५४॥
translation: Through the fine fingers, with the song, this hero comes with rapid cars, Going to Indra’s settled place.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: महत्तत्सोमो महिषश्चकारापां यद्गर्भोऽवृणीत देवान् । अदधादिन्द्रे पवमान ओजोऽजनयत्सूर्ये ज्योतिरिन्दुः ॥१२५५॥
translation: In holy thought he ponders much for the great service of theGods, Where the immortals have their seat.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एष देवो अमर्त्यः पर्णवीरिव दीयते । अभि द्रोणान्यासदम् ॥१२५६॥
translation: Men beautify him in the vats, him worthy to be beautified, Him who brings forth abundant food.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एष विप्रैरभिष्टुतोऽपो देवो वि गाहते । दधद्रत्नानि दाशुषे ॥१२५७॥
translation: He is deposited and led along the consecrated path 72 When zealous men are urging him,
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एष विश्वानि वार्या शूरो यन्निव सत्वभिः । पवमानः सिषासति ॥१२५८॥
translation: He moves, a vigorous steed, adorned with beauteous rays of shining gold, He who is Sovran of the streams.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एष देवो रथर्यति पवमानो दिशस्यति । आविष्कृणोति वग्वनुम् ॥१२५९॥
translation: He brandishes his horns on high, and whets them, bull who leads the herd, Doing with might heroic deeds.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एष देवो विपन्युभिः पवमान ऋतायुभिः । हरिर्वाजाय मृज्यते ॥१२६०॥
translation: He, over places rough to pass bringing rich treasures, closely pressed. Descends into the reservoirs.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एष देवो विपा कृतोऽति ह्वराꣳसि धावति । पवमानो अदाभ्यः ॥१२६१॥
translation: Him, even him the golden-hued, well armed, best giver of delight, Ten fingers urge to run his course.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एष दिवं वि धावति तिरो रजाꣳसि धारया । पवमानः कनिक्रदत् ॥१२६२॥
translation: This Bull, this chariot robes him in the sheep’s long wool as heproceeds. To war that wins a thousand spoils.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एष दिवं व्यासरत्तिरो रजाꣳस्यस्तृतः । पवमानः स्वध्वरः ॥१२६३॥
translation: The dames of Trita with the stones urge forth this goldencoloured one, Indu to Indra for his drink.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एष प्रत्नेन जन्मना देवो देवेभ्यः सुतः । हरिः पवित्रे अर्षति ॥१२६४॥
translation: He like a falcon settles down amid the families of men, Like lover speeding to his love.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एष उ स्य पुरुव्रतो जज्ञानो जनयन्निषः । धारया पवते सुतः ॥१२६५॥
translation: This young exhilarating juice looks downward from its place in heaven, This Soma drop that pierced the sieve.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एष धिया यात्यण्व्या शूरो रथेभिराशुभिः । गच्छन्निन्द्रस्य निष्कृतम् ॥१२६६॥
translation: Pressed for the draught, this tawny juice flows forth intelligent, calling out, Unto the well-beloved place.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एष पुरु धियायते बृहते देवतातये । यत्रामृतास आशत ॥१२६७॥
translation: Him, here, the gold-decked skilful ten cleanse carefully, who make him bright. And beauteous for the gladdening draught.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एतं मृजन्ति मर्ज्यमुप द्रोणेष्वायवः । प्रचक्राणं महीरिषः ॥१२६८॥
translation: Urged by the men, this vigorous steed, Lord of the mind omniscient, Flies to the long wool of the sheep.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एष हितो वि नीयतेऽन्तः शुन्ध्यावता पथा । यदी तुञ्जन्ति भूर्णयः ॥१२६९॥
translation: Within the filter hath he flowed, this Soma for the Gods effused. Entering all their essences.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एष रुक्मिभिरीयते वाजी शुभ्रेभिरꣳशुभिः । पतिः सिन्धूनां भवन् ॥१२७०॥
translation: He shines in beauty there, this God, immortal, in his dwellingplace, Foe-slayer, dearest to the Gods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एष शृङ्गाणि दोधुवच्छिशीते यूथ्यो३वृषा । नृम्णा दधान ओजसा ॥१२७१॥
translation: Directed by the sisters ten, bellowing on his way this Steer Runs onward to the wooden vats.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एष वसूनि पिब्दनः परुषा ययिवाꣳ अति । अव शादेषु गच्छति ॥१२७२॥
translation: This Pavamana, gladdening drink within the purifying sieve, Gave splendour to the Sun in heaven.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एतमु त्यं दश क्षिपो हरिꣳ हिन्वन्ति यातवे । स्वायुधं मदिन्तमम् ॥१२७३॥
translation: Unconquerable Lord of speech, dwelling beside Viavasvan, he Mounts up together with the Sun.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एष उ स्य वृषा रथोऽव्या वारेभिरव्यत । गच्छन्वाजꣳ सहस्रिणम् ॥१२७४॥
translation: This Sage, exalted by our lands, flows to the purifying sieve, Scattering foes as he is cleansed.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एतं त्रितस्य योषणो हरिꣳ हिन्वन्त्यद्रिभिः । इन्दुमिन्द्राय पीतये ॥१२७५॥
translation: Giver of strength, winner of light, for Indra and for Vayu he Is poured upon the filtering-cloth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एष स्य मानुषीष्वा श्येनो न विक्षु सीदति । गच्छञ्जारो न योषितम् ॥१२७६॥
translation: The men conduct him, Soma, Steer, omniscient the head of heaven. Effused into the vats of wood.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एष स्य मद्यो रसोऽव चष्टे दिवः शिशुः । य इन्दुर्वारमाविशत् ॥१२७७॥
translation: Longing for kine, longing for gold hath Indu Pavamana roared, Still conqueror, never overcome.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एष स्य पीतये सुतो हरिरर्षति धर्णसिः । क्रन्दन्योनिमभि प्रियम् ॥१२७८॥
translation: To Indra in the firmament this mighty tawny Steer hath flowed This Indu, being purified.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एतं त्यꣳ हरितो दश मर्मृज्यन्ते अपस्युवः । याभिर्मदाय शुम्भते ॥१२७९॥
translation: This Soma being purified flows mighty and invincible, Slayer of sinners, dear to Gods. 73
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एष वाजी हितो नृभिर्विश्वविन्मनसस्पतिः । अव्यं वारं वि धावति ॥१२८०॥
translation: This Soma, strong effused for draught, flows to the purifying sieve, Slaying the fiends, loving the Gods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एष पवित्रे अक्षरत्सोमो देवेभ्यः सुतः । विश्वा धामान्याविशन् ॥१२८१॥
translation: Far sighted, tawny-coloured, he flows to the sieve intelligent, Bellowing to his place of rest.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एष देवः शुभायतेऽधि योनावमर्त्यः । वृत्रहा देववीतमः ॥१२८२॥
translation: This vigorous Pavamana runs forth to the luminous realm of heaven, Fiend-slayer, through the sheep’s long wool.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एष वृषा कनिक्रदद्दशभिर्जामिभिर्यतः । अभि द्रोणानि धावति ॥१२८३॥
translation: This Pavamana, up above on Trita’s ridge, hath made the Sun, Together with the Sisters, shine.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एष सूर्यमरोचयत्पवमानो अधि द्यवि । पवित्रे मत्सरो मदः ॥१२८४
translation: Effused, this Soma, Steer, who slays Vritra, room-giver, unbeguiled, Hath gone as ‘twere to win the spoil.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एष सूर्येण हासते संवसानो विवस्वता । पतिर्वाचो अदाभ्यः ॥१२८५
translation: Urged by the sage upon his way, this God speeds forward to the: vats, Indu to Indra, giving boons.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एष कविरभिष्टुतः पवित्रे अधि तोशते । पुनानो घ्नन्नप द्विषः ॥१२८६॥
translation: The man who reads the essence stored by saints, the Pavamana hymns, Tastes food completely purified, made sweet by Matarisvan’s touch.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एष इन्द्राय वायवे स्वर्जित्परि षिच्यते । पवित्रे दक्षसाधनः ॥१२८७॥
translation: Whoever reads the essence stored by saints, the Pavamana hymns, For him Sarasvat! pours forth water and butter, milk and meath.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एष नृभिर्वि नीयते दिवो मूर्धा वृषा सुतः । सोमो वनेषु विश्ववित् ॥१२८८॥
translation: Yea, for the Pavamanas flow richly, drop fatness, bring us weal,-- Amrit deposited among the Brahmans, essence stored by saints.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एष गव्युरचिक्रदत्पवमानो हिरण्ययुः । इन्दुः सत्राजिदस्तृतः ॥१२८९॥
translation: So may the Pavamana hymns bestow on us this world and that, And gratify our hearts’ desires’-the Goddesses combined with Gods!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एष शुष्म्यसिष्यददन्तरिक्षे वृषा हरिः । पुनान इन्दुरिन्द्रमा ॥१२९०॥
translation: The purifying flood wherewith Gods ever purify themselves,-- With that, in thousand currents, may the Pavamanas make us clean!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एष शुष्म्यदाभ्यः सोमः पुनानो अर्षति । देवावीरघशꣳसहा ॥१२९१॥
translation: The Pavamana hymns bring weal: by these man goes to Paradise, And, eating pure and holy food, attains to immortality.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स सुतः पीतये वृषा सोमः पवित्रे अर्षति । विघ्नन्रक्षाꣳसि देवयुः ॥१२९२॥
translation: We with great reverence have approached the Youngest, who hath shone forth well kindled in his dwelling, Wondrously bright between wide earth and heaven, well worshipped, looking forth in all directions.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स पवित्रे विचक्षणो हरिरर्षति धर्णसिः । अभि योनिं कनिक्रदत् ॥१२९३॥
