translation: Through his great might o’ercoming all misfortunes, praised in the house is Agni Jatavedas. May he preserve us from disgrace and trouble, both us who laud him and our wealthy princes!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स वाजी रोचनं दिवः पवमानो वि धावति । रक्षोहा वारमव्ययम् ॥१२९४॥
translation: O Agni, thou art Varuna and Mitra: Vasishthas! with their holy hymns exalt thee. With thee be most abundant gain of treasure! Do ye preserve us evermore with blessing!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स त्रितस्याधि सानवि पवमानो अरोचयत् । जामिभिः सूर्यꣳ सह ॥१२९५॥
translation: Indra, great in his power and might, and like Parjanya rich in rain. Hath been increased by Vatsa’s lauds.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स वृत्रहा वृषा सुतो वरिवोविददाभ्यः । सोमो वाजमिवासरत् ॥१२९६॥
translation: Since Kanvas have with lauds made him completer of the sacrifice, Words are their own appropriate arms.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स देवः कविनेषितो३ऽभि द्रोणानि धावति । इन्दुरिन्द्राय मꣳहयन् ॥१२९७॥
translation: When priests who magnify the Son of holy law present their gifts, Sages with Order’s hymn of praise. XI Soma Pavamana 74
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यः पावमानीरध्येत्यृषिभिः सम्भृतꣳ रसम् । सर्वꣳ स पूतमश्नाति स्वदितं मातरिश्वना ॥१२९८॥
translation: Of gold-hued Pavamana, great destroyer, radiant streams have flowed, Swift streams of him whose gleams are swift.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पावमानीर्यो अध्येत्यृषिभिः सम्भृतꣳ रसम् । तस्मै सरस्वती दुहे क्षीरꣳ सर्पिर्मधूदकम् ॥१२९९॥
translation: Best rider of the chariot, praised with fairest praise ‘mid beauteous ones, Gold gleaming with the Marut host,
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पावमानीः स्वस्त्ययनीः सुदुघा हि घृतश्चुतः । ऋषिभिः संभृतो रसो ब्राह्मणेष्वमृतꣳ हितम् ॥१३००
translation: Penetrate, Pavamana, best at winning booty, with thy rays, Giving the Singer hero strength!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पावमानीर्दधन्तु न इमं लोकमथो अमुम् । कामान्त्समर्धयन्तु नो देवीर्देवैः समाहृताः ॥१३०१
translation: Hence sprinkle forth the juice effused, Soma, the best of sacred gifts, Who, friend of man, hath run among the water-streams He hath pressed Soma out with stones.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: येन देवाः पवित्रेणात्मानं पुनते सदा । तेन सहस्रधारेण पावमानीः पुनन्तु नः ॥१३०२
translation: Now, being purified, flow hither through the fleece, invincible and more odorous! We joy in thee in waters when thou art effused, blending thee still with juice and milk.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पावमानीः स्वस्त्ययनीस्ताभिर्गच्छति नान्दनम् । पुण्याꣳश्च भक्षान्भक्षयत्यमृतत्वं च गच्छति ॥१३०३
translation: Pressed out for all to see, delighting Gods, Indu, far-seeing one, is mental power.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अगन्म महा नमसा यविष्ठं यो दीदाय समिद्धः स्वे दुरोणे । चित्रभानुꣳ रोदसी अन्तरुर्वी स्वाहुतं विश्वतः प्रत्यञ्चम् ॥१३०४॥
translation: Even as a King hath Soma, red and tawny Bull, been pressed the wondrous one hath bellowed to the kine. While purified thou passest through the filtering fleece to seat thee hawk-like in the place that drops with oil.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स मह्ना विश्वा दुरितानि साह्वानग्नि ष्टवे दम आ जातवेदाः । स नो रक्षिषद्दुरितादवद्यादस्मान्गृणत उत नो मघोनः ॥१३०५॥
translation: Parjanya is the sire of the leaf-bearing Bull: on mountains, in earth’s centre hath he made his home. The waters have flowed forth, the Sisters, to the kine: he meets the pressing-stones at the beloved rite.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वं वरुण उत मित्रो अग्ने त्वां वर्धन्ति मतिभिर्वसिष्ठाः । त्वे वसु सुषणनानि सन्तु यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥१३०६॥
translation: To glory goest thou, a Sage with ordering skill, like a groomed steed thou rushest forward to the prize. Be gracious to us, Soma, driving off distress! Thou goest, clothed in butter, to a robe of state.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: महाꣳ इन्द्रो य ओजसा पर्जन्यो वृष्टिमाꣳ इव । स्तोमैर्वत्सस्य वावृधे ॥१३०७॥
translation: Turning as ‘twere to meet the Sun, enjoy from Indra all good things! When he who will be born is born with power we look to treasures as our heritage.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: कण्वा इन्द्रं यदक्रत स्तोमैर्यज्ञस्य साधनम् । जामि ब्रुवत आयुधा ॥१३०८॥
translation: Praise him who sends us wealth, prompt with his liberal boons Good 4re the gifts that Indra gives. He is not wroth with one who satisfies his wish: he instigates, his mind to give.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्रजामृतस्य पिप्रतः प्र यद्भरन्त वह्नयः । विप्रा ऋतस्य वाहसा ॥१३०९॥
translation: Indra, give us security from that whereof we are afraid Help us, O Maghavan, let thy favour aid us thus drive away foes and enemies!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवमानस्य जिघ्नतो हरेश्चन्द्रा असृक्षत । जीरा अजिरशोचिषः ॥१३१०॥
translation: For thou, O liberal Lord of ample bounty, art the ruler of our house and home. So, Indra Maghavan, thou lover of the song, we with pressed Soma call on thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवमानो रथीतमः शुभ्रेभिः शुभ्रशस्तमः । हरिश्चन्द्रो मरुद्गणः ॥१३११॥
translation: Thou, Soma, hast a running stream, sweet-toned most strong at sacrifice: Flow bounteously bestowing wealth
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवमान व्यश्नुहि रश्मिभिर्वाजसातमः । दधत्स्तोत्रे सुवीर्यम् ॥१३१२
translation: Thou most delightful, when effused, running, the best of gladdeners, art Indu, still conquering, ne’er subdued.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: परीतो षिञ्चता सुतꣳ सोमो य उत्तमꣳ हविः । दधन्वाꣳ यो नर्यो अप्स्वा३न्तरा सुषाव सोममद्रिभिः ॥१३१३
translation: Do thou, poured forth by pressing- stones, flow hither uttering a roar, And bring us brightly-glorious strength! XVII Soma Pavamana 75
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नूनं पुनानोऽविभिः परि स्रवादब्धः सुरभिन्तरः । सुते चित्वाप्सु मदामो अन्धसा श्रीणन्तो गोभिरुत्तरम् ॥१३१४॥
translation: In might, O Indu, with thy streams flow for the banquet of the Gods: Rich in meath, Soma, in our beaker take thy seat!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: परि स्वानश्चक्षसे देवमादनः क्रतुरिन्दुर्विचक्षणः ॥१३१५
translation: Thy drops that swim in water have exalted Indra to delight The Gods have drunk thee up for immortality.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: असावि सोमो अरुषो वृषा हरी राजेव दस्मो अभि गा अचिक्रदत् । पुनानो वारमत्येष्यव्ययꣳ श्येनो न योनिं घृतवन्तमासदत् ॥१३१६॥
translation: Stream opulence to us, ye drops of Soma, pressed and purified Pouring down rain from heaven in floods, and finding light!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पर्जन्यः पिता महिषस्य पर्णिनो नाभा पृथिव्या गिरिषु क्षयं दधे । स्वसार आपो अभि गा उदासरन्त्सं ग्रावभिर्वसते वीते अध्वरे ॥१३१७॥
translation: Him with the fleece they purify, brown, golden-hued beloved of all, Who with exhilarating juice goes forth to all the deities
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: कविर्वेधस्या पर्येषि माहिनमत्यो न मृष्टो अभि वाजमर्षसि । अपसेधन्दुरिता सोम नो मृड घृता वसानः परि यासि निर्णिजम् ॥१३१८॥
translation: Whom, bright with native splendour, crushed between the preesing-stones, a friend. Whom Indra dearly loves, the waves and ten companions dip and bathe
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: श्रायन्त इव सूर्यं विश्वेदिन्द्रस्य भक्षत । वसूनि जातो जनिमान्योजसा प्रति भागं न दीधिमः ॥१३१९॥
translation: For Vritra-slaying Indra, thou, Soma, art poured that he may drink, And for the guerdon-giving man, the hero sitting in his seat.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अलर्षिरातिं वसुदामुप स्तुहि भद्रा इन्द्रस्य रातयः । यो अस्य कामं विधतो न रोषति मनो दानाय चोदयन् ॥१३२०॥
translation: Flow onward Soma, flow for mighty strength, as a strong courser, bathed, to win the prize.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यत इन्द्र भयामहे ततो नो अभयं कृधि । मघवञ्छग्धि तव तन्न ऊतये वि द्विषो वि मृधो जहि ॥१३२१॥
translation: The pressers clarify this juice of thine, the Soma for delight and lofty fame.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वꣳ हि राधसस्पते राधसो महः क्षयस्यासि विधर्त्ता । तं त्वा वयं मघवन्निन्द्र गिर्वणः सुतावन्तो हवामहे ॥१३२२॥
translation: They deck the gold-hued infant, newly-born, even Soma, Indu, in the sieve, for Gods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वꣳ सोमासि धारयुर्मन्द्र ओजिष्ठो अध्वरे । पवस्व मꣳहयद्रयिः ॥१३२३॥
translation: The Gods have come to Indu well-descended, beautified with milk, The active crusher of the foe.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वꣳ सुतो मदिन्तमो दधन्वान्मत्सरिन्तमः । इन्दुः सत्राजिदस्तृतः ॥१३२४॥
translation: Even as mother cows their calf, so let our praise-songs strengthen him, Yea, him who winneth Indra’s heart!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वꣳ सुष्वाणो अद्रिभिरभ्यर्ष कनिक्रदत् । द्युमन्तꣳ शुष्ममा भर ॥१३२५॥
translation: Soma, pour blessings on our kine, pour forth the food that streams with milk: Increase the sea, praiseworthy one!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवस्व देववीतय इन्दो धाराभिरोजसा । आ कलशं मधुमान्त्सोम नः सदः ॥१३२६॥
translation: Hitherward! they who light the flame and straightway trim the sacred grass, Whose friend is Indra ever young.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तव द्रप्सा उदप्रुत इन्द्रं मदाय वावृधुः । त्वां देवासो अमृताय कं पपुः ॥१३२७॥
translation: Large is their fuel, much their laud, wide is their splinter from the stake, Whose friend is Indra ever young.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ नः सुतास इन्दवः पुनाना धावता रयिम् । वृष्टिद्यावो रीत्यापः स्वर्विदः ॥१३२८॥
translation: Unquelled in fight the hero leads his army with the warrior chiefs, Whose friend is Indra ever young.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: परि त्यꣳ हर्यतꣳ हरिं बभ्रुं पुनन्ति वारेण । यो देवान्विश्वाꣳ इत्परि मदेन सह गच्छति ॥१३२९॥
translation: He who alone bestoweth wealth on mortal man who offereth gifts, Is Indra only, potent Lord whom none resist.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: द्विर्यं पञ्च स्वयशसꣳ सखायो अद्रिसꣳहतम् । प्रियमिन्द्रस्य काम्यं प्रस्नापयन्त ऊर्मयः ॥१३३०॥
translation: Whoever with the Soma pressed draws thee away from many men,- Verily Indra gains thereby tremendous power.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्राय सोम पातवे वृत्रघ्ने परि षिच्यसे । नरे च दक्षिणावते वीराय सदनासदे ॥१३३१॥
translation: When willhe trample, like a weed, the man who hath no gift for him? When, verily, will Indra hear our songs of praise?
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवस्व सोम महे दक्षायाश्वो न निक्तो वाजी धनाय ॥१३३२॥
translation: The singers hymn thee, they who chant the psalm of praise are lauding thee. The Brahmans have exalted thee, O Satakratu, like a pole.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र ते सोतारो रसं मदाय पुनन्ति सोमं महे द्युम्नाय ॥१३३३॥
translation: When thou wast climbing ridge from ridge, he looked upon the toilsome task: Indra takes notice of that wish, and the Ram hastens with his troop.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: शिशुं जज्ञानꣳ हरिं मृजन्ति पवित्रे सोमं देवेभ्य इन्दुम् ॥१३३४॥
translation: Harness thy pair of strong bay steeds, long-maned, whose bodies fill the girths. And, Indra, Soma drinker, come to listen to our songs Of praise! 76
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उपो षु जातमप्तुरं गोभिर्भङ्गं परिष्कृतम् । इन्दुं देवा अयासिषुः ॥१३३५॥
translation: Agni,well kindled bring the Gods for him who offers holy gifts; And worship them, pure Hotar-priest!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तमिद्वर्धन्तु नो गिरो वत्सꣳ सꣳशिश्वरीरिव । य इन्द्रस्य हृदꣳसनिः ॥१३३६॥
translation: O Sage, Tanunapat, present our sacrifice to Gods to-day, Sweet to the taste, that they may help!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अर्षा नः सोम शं गवे धुक्षस्व पिप्युषीमिषम् । वर्धा समुद्रमुक्थ्य ॥१३३७॥
translation: Dear Narasansa, sweet of tongue, presenter of oblations, I Invoke to this our sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ घा ये अग्निमिन्धते स्तृणन्ति बर्हिरानुषक् । येषामिन्द्रो युवा सखा ॥१३३८॥
translation: Agni, on thy most easy car, entreated, hither bring the Gods! Manus-appointed Priest art thou.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: बृहन्निदिध्म एषां भूरि शस्त्रं पृथुः स्वरुः । येषामिन्द्रो युवा सखा ॥१३३९॥
translation: So when the Sun hath risen to-day may sinless Mitra, Aryaman, Bhaga, and Savitar send us forth!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अयुद्ध इद्युधा वृतꣳ शूर आजति सत्वभिः । येषामिन्द्रो युवा सखा ॥१३४०॥
translation: May this our home be guarded well: forward, ye bounteous, on the way, Who bear us safely o’er distress!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: य एक इद्विदयते वसु मर्ताय दाशुषे । ईशानो अप्रतिष्कुत इन्द्रो अङ्ग ॥१३४१॥
translation: Yea, Aditi, and those great Kings whose statute is inviolate, Are sovrans of a vast domain.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यश्चिद्धि त्वा बहुभ्य आ सुतावाꣳ आविवासति । उग्रं तत्पत्यते शव इन्द्रो अङ्ग ॥१३४२॥
translation: Let Soma juices make thee glad! Display thy bounty, Thunderer: Drive off the enemies of prayer!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: कदा मर्तमराधसं पदा क्षुम्पमिव स्फुरत् । कदा नः शुश्रवद्गिर इन्द्रो अङ्ग ॥१३४३॥
translation: Crush with thy foot the niggard churls who bring no gifts! mighty art thou: There is not one to equal thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: गायन्ति त्वा गायत्रिणोऽर्चन्त्यर्कमर्किणः । ब्रह्माणस्त्वा शतक्रत उद्वꣳशमिव येमिरे ॥१३४४॥
translation: Thou art the Lord of Somas pressed, Somas unpressed are also thine: Thou art the Sovran of the folk.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यत्सानोः सान्वारुहो भूर्यस्पष्ट कर्त्वम् । तदिन्द्रो अर्थं चेतति यूथेन वृष्णिरेजति ॥१३४५॥
translation: True object of our hymns, Sage, watchful Soma hath settled in the press as they refine him. Him the Adhvaryus, paired and eager, follow, leaders of sacrifice and skilful-handed.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: युङ्क्ष्वा हि केशिना हरी वृषणा कक्ष्यप्रा । अथा न इन्द्र सोमपा गिरामुपश्रुतिं चर ॥१३४६॥
translation: He, purified and bringing gifts to Surya, hath filled full heaven and earth, and hath disclosed them. He by whose dear help heroes gain their wishes will yield the precious meed as to a victor.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सुषमिद्धो न आ वह देवाꣳ अग्ने हविष्मते । होतः पावक यक्षि च ॥१३४७॥
translation: He, being cleansed, the strengthener and increaser, bountiful Soma helped us his lustre, Wherein our sires of old who knew the footsteps found light and sought the kine within the mountain.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मधुमन्तं तनूनपाद्यज्ञं देवेषु नः कवे । अद्या कृणुह्यूतये ॥१३४८॥
translation: Glorify naught besides, O friends, so shall no sorrow trouble you! Praise only mighty Indra, when the juice is shed, and say your lauds repeatedly!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नराशꣳसमिह प्रियमस्मिन्यज्ञ उप ह्वये । मधुजिह्वꣳ हविष्कृतम् ॥१३४९॥
translation: Even him, the swift one, like a bull who rushes down men’s conqueror, bounteous like a cow; Him who is cause of both, of enmity and peace, to both sides most munificent.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्ने सुखतमे रथे देवाꣳ ईडित आ वह । असि होता मनुर्हितः ॥१३५०॥
translation: These songs of our exceeding sweet, these hymns of praise ascend to thee, Like ever-conquering chariots that display their strength, gain wealth and give unfailing help. 77
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यदद्य सूर उदितेऽनागा मित्रो अर्यमा । सुवाति सविता भगः ॥१३५१॥
translation: The Bhrigus are like suns, like Kanvas, and have gained each thing whereon their thought was bent. The living men of Priyamedha’s race have sun g exalting Indra with their lauds.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सुप्रावीरस्तु स क्षयः प्र नु यामन्त्सुदानवः । ये नो अꣳहोऽतिपिप्रति ॥१३५२॥
translation: Run forth to battle conquering the Vritras! thou Speedest to quell the foe like one exacting debts.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उत स्वराजो अदितिरदब्धस्य व्रतस्य ये । महो राजान ईशते ॥१३५३॥
translation: Thou Pavamana, didst beget the Sun with might, and rain in the supporting sky, Hasting to us with plenty vivified with milk.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उ त्वा मन्दन्तु सोमाः कृणुष्व राधो अद्रिवः । अव ब्रह्मद्विषो जहि ॥१३५४॥
translation: For, Soma, we rejoice ourselves in thee effused for great supremacy in fight; Thou, Pavamana, enterest into mighty deeds.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पदा पणीनराधसो नि बाधस्व महाꣳ असि । न हि त्वा कश्च न प्रति ॥१३५५॥
translation: Flow forth, O Soma, flow thou onward, sweet to Indra’s, Mitra’s, Pushan’s, Bhaga’s taste!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वमीशिषे सुतानामिन्द्र त्वमसुतानाम् । त्वꣳ राजा जनानाम् ॥१३५६॥
translation: So flow thou on as bright celestial juice, flow to the vast immortal dwelling-place!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ जागृविर्विप्र ऋतं मतीनाꣳ सोमः पुनानो असदच्चमूषु । सपन्ति यं मिथुनासो निकामा अध्वर्यवो रथिरासः सुहस्ताः ॥१३५७॥
translation: Let Indra drink, O Soma, of thy juice for wisdom, and all deities for strength!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स पुनान उप सूरे दधान ओभे अप्रा रोदसी वी ष आवः । प्रिया चिद्यस्य प्रियसास ऊती सतो धनं कारिणे न प्र यꣳसत् ॥१३५८॥
translation: Even as the beams of Surya, urging men to speed, they issue forth together, gladdening as they flow, These swift outpourings in long course of holy rites: no form save only Indra shows itself so pure.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स वर्धिता वर्धनः पूयमानः सोमो मीढ्वाꣳ अभि नो ज्योतिषावीत् । यत्र नः पूर्वे पितरः पदज्ञाः स्वर्विदो अभि गा अद्रिमिष्णन् ॥१३५९॥
translation: The thought is deeply fixed, the savoury juice is shed; the tongue with joyous sound is stirring in the mouth: And Pavamana, like the shout of those who press, the drop, rich in sweet juice, is flowing through the fleece.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मा चिदन्यद्वि शꣳसत सखायो मा रिषण्यत । इन्द्रमित्स्तोता वृषणꣳ सचा सुते मुहुरुक्था च शꣳसत ॥१३६०॥
translation: The bull is bellowing; the cows are coming nigh: the Goddesses approach the God’s own resting-place. Onward hath Soma pressed through the sheep’s fair bright fleece, and hath, as ‘twere, endued a garment newly washed.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अवक्रक्षिणं वृषभं यथा जुवं गां न चर्षणीसहम् । विद्वेषणꣳ संवननमुभयङ्करं मꣳहिष्ठमुभयाविनम् ॥१३६१॥
translation: From the two fire-sticks have the men engendered, with thought, urged by the hand, the glorious Agni, Far-seen, with pointed flame, Lord of the Homestead.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उदु त्ये मधुमत्तमा गिरः स्तोमास ईरते । सत्राजितो धनसा अक्षितोतयो वाजयन्तो रथा इव ॥१३६२॥
translation: The Vasus set that Agni in the dwelling, fair to behold, for help, from every quarter: Who, in the house for ever, must be honoured.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: कण्वा इव भृगवः सूर्या इव विश्वमिद्धीतमाशत । इन्द्रꣳ स्तोमेभिर्महयन्त आयवः प्रियमेधासो अस्वरन् ॥१३६३॥
translation: Shine thou before us, Agni, well-enkindled, with flame, most youthful God, that never fadeth! To thee come goods and treasures all together.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पर्यू षु प्र धन्व वाजसातये परि वृत्राणि सक्षणिः । द्विषस्तरध्या ऋणया न ईरसे ॥१३६४॥
translation: This spotted Bull hath come and sat before the mother in the east, Advancing to his father heaven.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अजीजनो हि पवमान सूर्यं विधारे शक्मना पयः । गोजीरया रꣳहमाणः पुरन्ध्या ॥१३६५
translation: As expiration from his breath, his radiance penetrates within The Bull shines out through all the sky.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अनु हि त्वा सुतꣳ सोम मदामसि महे समर्यराज्ये । वाजाँ अभि पवमान प्र गाहसे ॥१३६६॥
translation: Song is bestowed upon the Bird: it reigns supreme through thirty realms. Throughout the days at break of morn. 78
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: परि प्र धन्वेन्द्राय सोम स्वादुर्मित्राय पूष्णे भगाय ॥१३६७॥
translation: Chant we a hymn to Agni while we go to sacrifice, to him Who hears us even from afar!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एवामृताय महे क्षयाय स शुक्रो अर्ष दिव्यः पीयूषः ॥१३६८॥
translation: Who from of old, in carnage, when the folk were gathered, hath preserved. His household for the worshipper.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रस्ते सोम सुतस्य पेयात्क्रत्वे दक्षाय विश्वे च देवाः ॥१३६९॥
translation: May that most blissful Agni guard our wealth and all ourfamily. And keep us safe from pain and grief
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सूर्यस्येव रश्मयो द्रावयित्नवो मत्सरासः प्रसुतः साकमीरते । तन्तुं ततं परि सर्गास आशवो नेन्द्रादृते पवते धाम किं चन ॥१३७०॥
translation: Yea, let men say, Agni is born, even he who slayeth Vritra, he, Who winneth wealth in every fight!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उपो मतिः पृच्यते सिच्यते मधु मन्द्राजनी चोदते अन्तरासनि । पवमानः सन्तनिः सुन्वतामिव मधुमान्द्रप्सः परि वारमर्षति ॥१३७१॥
translation: Harness, O Agni, O thou God, thy steeds which are most excellent! The fleet ones bring the rapidly.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उक्षा मिमेति प्रति यन्ति धेनवो देवस्य देवीरुप यन्ति निष्कृतम् । अत्यक्रमीदर्जुनं वारमव्ययमत्कं न निक्तं परि सोमो अव्यत ॥१३७२॥
translation: Come hither, bring the Gods to us to taste the sacrificial feast, To drink the draught of Soma juice!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्निं नरो दीधितिभिररण्योर्हस्तच्युतं जनयत प्रशस्तम् । दूरेदृशं गृहपतिमथव्युम् ॥१३७३॥
translation: O Agni of the Bharatas, flame splendid with unfading might Shine forth and gleam, eternal one!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तमग्निमस्ते वसवो न्यृण्वन्त्सुप्रतिचक्षमवसे कुतश्चित् । दक्षाय्यो यो दम आस नित्यः ॥१३७४॥
translation: Let him, as mortal, crave this speech for him who presses of the juice! As Bhrigu’s sons chased Makha, so drive ye the niggard hound away.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्रेद्धो अग्ने दीदिहि पुरो नोऽजस्रया सूर्म्या यविष्ठ । त्वाꣳ शश्वन्त उप यन्ति वाजाः ॥१३७५॥
translation: The kinsman hath endued his robe even as a son is clasped in arms. He went, as lover to a dame, to take his station suitor-like.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आयं गौः पृश्निरक्रमीदसदन्मातरं पुरः । पितरं च प्रयन्त्स्वः ॥१३७६॥
translation: That hero who produces strength, he who hath propped both worlds apart, Gold-hued, hath wrapped him in the sieve to settle, priest-like, in his place.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अन्तश्चरति रोचनास्य प्राणादपानती । व्यख्यन्महिषो दिवम् ॥१३७७
translation: Still, Indra, from all ancient time rivalless ever and companionless art thou: Thou seekest friendship but in war.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्रिꣳशद्धाम वि राजति वाक्पतङ्गाय धीयते । प्रति वस्तोरह द्युभिः ॥१३७८॥
translation: Thou findest not the wealthy man to be thy friend: those scorn thee who are flown with wine. What time thou thunderest and gatherest, then thou, even as a father, art invoked.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उपप्रयन्तो अध्वरं मन्त्रं वोचेमाग्नये । आरे अस्मे च शृण्वते ॥१३७९॥
translation: A thousand and a hundred steeds are harnessed to thy golden car: Yoked by devotion, Indra, let the long-maned bays bring thee to drink the Soma juice!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यः स्नीहितीषु पूर्व्यः संजग्मानासु कृष्टिषु । अरक्षद्दाशुषे गयम् ॥१३८०॥
translation: Yoked to thy chariot wrought of gold, may thy two bays with, peacock tails. Convey thee hither, steeds with their white backs, to quaff sweet juice that makes us eloquent!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स नो वेदो अमात्यमग्नी रक्षतु शन्तमः । उतास्मान्पात्वꣳहसः ॥१३८१॥
translation: So drink, thou lover of the song, as the first drinker, of this juice. This the outpouring of the savoury sap prepared is good and meet to gladden thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उत ब्रुवन्तु जन्तव उदग्निर्वृत्रहाजनि । धनञ्जयो रणेरणे ॥१३८२॥
translation: Press ye and pour him, like a steed, laud-worthy, speeding through the region and the flood, Who swims in water, dwells in wood
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्ने युङ्क्ष्वा हि ये तवाश्वासो देव साधवः । अरं वहन्त्याशवः ॥१३८३॥
translation: The Steer with thousand streams who poureth out the rain, dear to the race of deities; Who, born in Law, hath waxen mighty by the Law, King, God, and lofty ordinance. VII Agni 79
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अच्छा नो याह्या वहाभि प्रयाꣳसि वीतये । आ देवान्त्सोमपीतये ॥१३८४॥
translation: Served with oblation, kindled, bright, through love of song, may Agni, bent On riches, smite the Vritras dead
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उदग्ने भारत द्युमदजस्रेण दविद्युतत् । शोचा वि भाह्यजर ॥१३८५॥
translation: His father’s father, shining in his mother’s ever-lasting side, Set on the seat of sacrifice!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र सुन्वानायान्धसो मर्तो न वष्ट तद्वचः । अप श्वानमराधसꣳ हता मखं न भृगवः ॥१३८६॥
translation: O active Jatavedas, bring devotion that wins progeny, Agni, that it may shine to heaven!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ जामिरत्के अव्यत भुजे न पुत्र ओण्योः । सरज्जारो न योषणां वरो न योनिमासदम् ॥१३८७॥
translation: Made pure by this man’s urgent zeal and impulse, the God hath with his juice the Gods pervaded. Pressed, singing, to the sieve he goes, as passes the Hotar to enclosures hoiding cattle.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स वीरो दक्षसाधनो वि यस्तस्तम्भ रोदसी । हरिः पवित्रे अव्यत वेधा न योनिमासदम् ॥१३८८॥
translation: Robed in fair raiment meet to wear in combat, a mighty Sage pronouncing invocations, Roll onward to the press-boards as they cleanse thee, far-seeing at the feast of Gods and watchful!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभ्रातृव्यो अना त्वमनापिरिन्द्र जनुषा सनादसि । युधेदापित्वमिच्छसे ॥१३८९॥
translation: Dear, he is brightened on the fleecy summit, a prince among us, nobler than the noble. Roar out as thou art purified, run forward! Do ye preserve us evermore with blessings!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: न की रेवन्तꣳ सख्याय विन्दसे पीयन्ति ते सुराश्वः । यदा कृणोषि नदनुꣳ समूहस्यादित्पितेव हूयसे ॥१३९०॥
translation: Come now and let us glorify pure Indra with pure Sama hymn! Let milk-blent juice delight him made stronger with pure, pure songs of praise!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ त्वा सहस्रमा शतं युक्ता रथे हिरण्यये । ब्रह्मयुजो हरय इन्द्र केशिनो वहन्तु सोमपीतये ॥१३९१॥
translation: O Indra, come thou pure to us, with pure assistance pure thyself! Pure, send thou riches down to us, and, meet for Soma! pure, rejoice!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ त्वा रथे हिरण्यये हरी मयूरशेप्या । शितिपृष्ठा वहतां मध्वो अन्धसो विवक्षणस्य पीतये ॥१३९२॥
translation: O Indra, pure, vouchsafe us wealth, and, pure enrich the worshipper! Pure, thou dost strike the Vritras dead, and strivest pure, to win the spoil.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पिबा त्व३स्य गिर्वणः सुतस्य पूर्वपा इव । परिष्कृतस्य रसिन इयमासुतिश्चारुर्मदाय पत्यते ॥१३९३॥
translation: Eager for wealth we meditate Agni’s effectual laud to-day, Laud of the God who touches heaven.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ सोता परि षिञ्चताश्वं न स्तोममप्तुरꣳ रजस्तुरम् । वनप्रक्षमुदप्रुतम् ॥१३९४॥
translation: May Agni who is Hotar-priest among mankind accept our songs, And worship the celestial folk!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सहस्रधारं वृषभं पयोदुहं प्रियं देवाय जन्मने । ऋतेन य ऋतजातो विवावृधे राजा देव ऋतं बृहत् ॥१३९५॥
translation: Thou, Agni, art spread widely forth, Priest dear and excellent through thee Men make the sacrifice complete.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्निर्वृत्राणि जङ्घनद्द्रविणस्युर्विपन्यया । समिद्धः शुक्र आहुतः ॥१३९६॥
translation: To him, praiseworthy, sacred tones have sounded, Steer of the triple height, the life- bestower. Dwelling in wood, like Varuna, a river, lavishing treasure, he distributes blessings.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: गर्भे मातुः पितुष्पिता विदिद्युतानो अक्षरे । सीदन्नृतस्य योनिमा ॥१३९७॥
translation: Great conqueror, warrior girt, Lord of all heroes, flow on thy way as he who winneth riches: With sharpened arms, with swift bow, never vanquished in battle, vanquishing in fight the foemen!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ब्रह्म प्रजावदा भर जातवेदो विचर्षणे । अग्ने यद्दीदयद्दिवि ॥१३९८॥
translation: Giving security, Lord of wide dominion, send us both heaven and earth with all their fulness! Striving to win the Dawns, the light, the waters, and cattle, call to us abundant booty!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अस्य प्रेषा हेमना पूयमानो देवो देवेभिः समपृक्त रसम् । सुतः पवित्रं पर्येति रेभन्मितेव सद्म पशुमन्ति होता ॥१३९९॥
translation: O Indra, thou art far-renowned, impetuous Lord of power and might. Alone, the never-conquered guardian of mankind, thou smitest down resistless foes.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: भद्रा वस्त्रा समन्या३वसानो महान्कविर्निवचनानि शꣳसन् । आ वच्यस्व चम्वोः पूयमानो विचक्षणो जागृविर्देववीतौ ॥१४००॥
translation: As such we seek thee now, O Asura, the most wise, craving thy bounty as our share Thy sheltering defence is like an ample cloak. So may thy favours reach to us. XIII Agni 80
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: समु प्रियो मृज्यते सानौ अव्ये यशस्तरो यशसां क्षैतो अस्मे । अभि स्वर धन्वा पूयमानो यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥१४०१॥
translation: Thee have we chosen, skilfullest in sacrifice, immortal, Priest, among the Gods, Best finisher of this holy rite:
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एतो न्विन्द्रꣳ स्तवाम शुद्धꣳ शुद्धेन साम्ना । शुद्धैरुक्थैर्वावृध्वाꣳसꣳ शुद्धैराशीर्वान्ममत्तु ॥१४०२॥
translation: The Waters’ Child, the blessed brightly-shining one, Agni whose, light is excellent. May he by sacrifice win us in heaven the grace of Mitra, Varuna, and the Floods!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्र शुद्धो न आ गहि शुद्धः शुद्धाभिरूतिभिः । शुद्धो रयिं नि धारय शुद्धो ममद्धि सोम्य ॥१४०३॥
translation: Lord of all food is he, the man whom thou protectest in the fight, Agni, and urgest to the fray.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्र शुद्धो हि नो रयिꣳ शुद्धो रत्नानि दाशुषे । शुद्धो वृत्राणि जिघ्नसे शुद्धो वाजꣳ सिषाससि ॥१४०४॥
translation: Him, whosoever he may be, no one may vanquish, mighty one! Nay, very glorious wealth is his.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्ने स्तोमं मनामहे सिध्रमद्य दिविस्पृशः । देवस्य द्रविणस्यवः ॥१४०५॥
translation: May he who dwells with all mankind conquer in fight with steeds of war, With sages may he win the spoil.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्निर्जुषत नो गिरो होता यो मानुषेष्वा । स यक्षद्दैव्यं जनम् ॥१४०६॥
translation: Ten sisters, pouring out the rain together, the sage’s quickly moving thoughts, adorn him. Hither hath run the gold-hued Child of Surya, and reached the vat like a fleet vigorous courser.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वमग्ने सप्रथा असि जुष्टो होता वरेण्यः । त्वया यज्ञं वि तन्वते ॥१४०७॥
translation: Even as a youngling shouting with his mothers, the bounteous Steer hath flowed along with waters. As youth to damsel, so with milk he hastens on to the settled meeting-place, the beaker.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभि त्रिपृष्ठं वृषणं वयोधामङ्गोषिणमवावशन्त वाणीः । वना वसानो वरुणो न सिन्धुर्वि रत्नधा दयते वार्याणि ॥१४०८॥
translation: Yea, swollen is the udder of the milch-cow; thither in streams. comes very sapient Indu. The kine make ready, as with new-washed treasures, the head and chief with milk within the vessels.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: शूरग्रामः सर्ववीरः सहावाञ्जेता पवस्व सनिता धनानि । तिग्मायुधः क्षिप्रधन्वा समत्स्वषाढः साह्वान्पृतनासु शत्रून् ॥१४०९॥
translation: Drink, Indra, of the savoury juice, and cheer thee, with our milky draught! Be, for our weal, our friend and sharer of the feast, and let thy wisdom guard us well!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उरुगव्यूतिरभयानि कृण्वन्त्समीचीने आ पवस्वा पुरन्धी । अपः सिषासन्नुषसः स्वऽ३र्गाः सं चिक्रदो महो अस्मभ्यं वाजान् ॥१४१०॥
translation: In thy kind grace and favour may we still be strong: cast us not down before the foe! With manifold assistance guard and succour us, and stablish us in thy good-will!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वमिन्द्र यशा अस्यृजीषी शवसस्पतिः । त्वं वृत्राणि हꣳस्यप्रतीन्येक इत्पुर्वनुत्तश्चर्षणीधृतिः ॥१४११॥
translation: The three-times seven milch-kine in the loftiest heaven have for this Soma poured the genuine milky draught. Four other beauteous creatures hath he made for his adornment when he waxed in strength through holy rites.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तमु त्वा नूनमसुर प्रचेतसꣳ राधो भागमिवेमहे । महीव कृत्तिः शरणा त इन्द्र प्र ते सुम्ना नो अश्नवन् ॥१४१२॥
translation: Enjoying lovely Amrit by his wisdom he divided, each apart from other, earth and heaven. He gladly wrapped himself in the most lucid floods, when through their glory they-found the God’s resting-place.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यजिष्ठं त्वा ववृमहे देवं देवत्रा होतारममर्त्यम् । अस्य यज्ञस्य सुक्रतुम् ॥१४१३॥
translation: May those his brilliant rays be ever free from death, inviolate for both classes of created things-- Rays wherewith powers of men and Gods are purified! Yea, even for this have sages welcomed him as King.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अपां नपातꣳ सुभगꣳ सुदीदितिमग्निमु श्रेष्ठशोचिषम् । स नो मित्रस्य वरुणस्य सो अपामा सुम्नं यक्षते दिवि ॥१४१४॥
translation: Lauded with song, to feast him, flow to Vayu, flow purified to Varuna and Mitra! Flow to the song inspiring car-borne hero, to mighty Indra, him who wields the thunder!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यमग्ने पृत्सु मर्त्यमवा वाजेषु यं जुनाः । स यन्ता शश्वतीरिषः ॥१४१५॥
translation: Pour on us garments that shall clothe us meetly, send, purified, milch-kine, abundant yielders! God Soma, send us cbariot-drawing horses that they may bring us treasures bright and golden! 81
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: न किरस्य सहन्त्य पर्येता कयस्य चित् । वाजो अस्ति श्रवाय्यः ॥१४१६॥
translation: Send to us in a stream celestial riches, send us when thou art cleansed, what earth containeth, So that thereby we may acquire possessions and Rishihood in Jamadagni’s manner!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स वाजं विश्वचर्षणिरर्वद्भिरस्तु तरुता । विप्रेभिरस्तु सनिता ॥१४१७॥
translation: When thou, unequalled Maghavan, wast born to smite the Vritras dead, Thou spreadest out the spacious earth and didst support and prop the heavens.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: साकमुक्षो मर्जयन्त स्वसारो दश धीरस्य धीतयो धनुत्रीः । हरिः पर्यद्रवज्जाः सूर्यस्य द्रोणं ननक्षे अत्यो न वाजी ॥१४१८॥
translation: Then was the sacrifice produced for thee, the laud, and song of joy. In might thou art above this All, all that now is and yet shall be.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सं मातृभिर्न शिशुर्वावशानो वृषा दधन्वे पुरुवारो अद्भिः । मर्यो न योषामभि निष्कृतं यन्त्सं गच्छते कलश उस्रियाभिः ॥१४१९॥
translation: Raw kine thou filledst with ripe milk. Thou madest Surya rise to heaven. Heat him as milk is heated with pure Sdma hymns, great joy to him who loves the song!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उत प्र पिप्य ऊधरघ्न्याया इन्दुर्धाराभिः सचते सुमेधाः । मूर्धानं गावः पयसा चमूष्वभि श्रीणन्ति वसुभिर्न निक्तैः ॥१४२०॥
translation: Rejoice: thy glory hath been quaffed, Lord of bay steeds! as ‘twere the bowl’s enlivening mead. Thine, Steer, is Indu, Steer, the Strong, best winner of a thousand spoils.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पिबा सुतस्य रसिनो मत्स्वा न इन्द्र गोमतः । आपिर्नो बोधि सधमाद्ये वृधे३ऽस्माꣳ अवन्तु ते धियः ॥१४२१॥
translation: Let our strong drink, most excellent, exhilarating, come to thee, Victorious, Indra! bringing gain, immortal conquering in fight!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: भूयाम ते सुमतौ वाजिनो वयं मा न स्तरभिमातये । अस्मान् चित्राभिरवतादभिष्टिभिरा नः सुम्नेषु यामय ॥१४२२॥
translation: Thou, hero, winner of the spoil, urgest to speed the car of man. Burn, like a vessel with the flame, the riteless Dasyu, conqueror!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्रिरस्मै सप्त धेनवो दुदुह्रिरे सत्यामाशिरं परमे व्योमनि । चत्वार्यन्या भुवनानि निर्णिजे चारूणि चक्रे यदृतैरवर्धत ॥१४२३॥
translation: Pour down the rain upon us, pour a wave of waters from the sky. And plenteous store of wholesome foood!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स भक्षमाणो अमृतस्य चारुण उभे द्यावा काव्येना वि शश्रथे । तेजिष्ठा अपो मꣳहना परि व्यत यदी देवस्य श्रवसा सदो विदुः ॥१४२४॥
translation: Flow onward with that stream of thine, whereby the cows have come to us. The kine of strangers to our home.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ते अस्य सन्तु केतवोऽमृत्यवोऽदाभ्यासो जनुषी उभे अनु । येभिर्नृम्णा च देव्या च पुनत आदिद्राजानं मनना अगृभ्णत ॥१४२५॥
translation: Dearest to Gods in sacred rites, pour on us fatness with thy stream, Pour down on us a flood of rain!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभि वायुं वीत्यर्षा गृणानो३ऽभि मित्रावरुणा पूयमानः । अभि नरं धीजवनꣳ रथेष्ठामभीन्द्रं वृषणं वज्रबाहुम् ॥१४२६॥
translation: To give as vigour, with thy stream run through the fleecy straining-cloth! For verily the Gods will hear.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभि वस्त्रा सुवसनान्यर्षाभि धेनूः सुदुघाः पूयमानः । अभि चन्द्रा भर्तवे नो हिरण्याभ्यश्वान्रथिनो देव सोम ॥१४२७॥
translation: Onward hath Pavamana flowed and beaten off the Rakshasas. Flashing out splendour as of old.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभी नो अर्ष दिव्या वसून्यभि विश्वा पार्थिवा पूयमानः । अभि येन द्रविणमश्नवामाभ्यार्षेयं जमदग्निवन्नः ॥१४२८॥
translation: Bring forth oblations to the God who knoweth all, who fain would drink. The wanderer, lagging not behind the hero, coming nigh with, speed!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यज्जायथा अपूर्व्य मघवन्वृत्रहत्याय । तत्पृथिवीमप्रथयस्तदस्तभ्ना उतो दिवम् ॥१४२९॥
translation: With Somas go ye nigh to him chief drinker of the Soma’s. juice: With beakers to the impetuous God, to Indra with the flowing, drops!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तत्ते यज्ञो अजायत तदर्क उत हस्कृतिः । तद्विश्वमभिभूरसि यज्जातं यच्च जन्त्वम् ॥१४३०॥
translation: What time with Somas, with the drops effused,, ye come beforethe God, Full wise, he knows the hope of each, and, bold one strikes this. foe and that.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आमासु पक्वमैरय आ सूर्यꣳ रोहयो दिवि । घर्मं न सामं तपता सुवृक्तिभिर्जुष्टं गिर्वणसे बृहत् ॥१४३१॥
translation: To him, Adhvaryu! yea, to him give offerings of the juiceexpressed! Will he not keep us safely from the spiteful curse of each, presumptuous high-born foe?
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मत्स्यपायि ते महः पात्रस्येव हरिवो मत्सरो मदः । वृषा ते वृष्ण इन्दुर्वाजी सहस्रसातमः ॥१४३२॥
translation: Sing ye a song to Soma brown of hue, of independent might, The Red, who reaches up to heaven!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ नस्ते गन्तु मत्सरो वृषा मदो वरेण्यः । सहावाꣳ इन्द्र सानसिः पृतनाषाडमर्त्यः ॥१४३३॥
translation: Purify Soma when effused with stones which hands move rapidly, And pour the sweet milk in the meath.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वꣳ हि शूरः सनिता चोदयो मनुषो रथम् । सहावान्दस्युमव्रतमोषः पात्रं न शोचिषा ॥१४३४॥
translation: With humble homage draw ye nigh; blend the libation with the curds: 82 To Indra offer Indu up
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवस्व वृष्टिमा सु नोऽपामूर्मिं दिवस्परि । अयक्ष्मा बृहतीरिषः ॥१४३५॥
translation: Soma, foe-queller, strong and swift, doing the will of Gods, pour forth, Prosperity upon our kine
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तया पवस्व धारया यया गाव इहागमन् । जन्यास उप नो गृहम् ॥१४३६॥
translation: Heart-knower, Sovran of the heart, thou art effused, O Soma, Tthat, Indra. may drink thee and rejoice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: घृतं पवस्व धारया यज्ञेषु देववीतमः । अस्मभ्यं वृष्टिमा पव ॥१४३७॥
translation: O Soma Pavamana, give us riches and heroic strength, Indu, with Indra. our ally! IV Indra I. Surya, thou mountest up to meet the hero famous for his wealth, Who hurls the bolt and works for men;
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स न ऊर्जे व्य३व्ययं पवित्रं धाव धारया । देवासः शृणवन्हि कम् ॥१४३८॥
translation: Him who with might of both his arms broke nine-and-ninety castles down, Slew Vritra and smote Ahi dead.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवमानो असिष्यदद्रक्षाꣳस्यपजङ्घनत् । प्रत्नवद्रोचयन्रुचः ॥१४३९॥
translation: This Indra is our gracious friend. He sends, like a full-streaming cow, Riches in horses, kine, and corn.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्रत्यस्मै पिपीषते विश्वानि विदुषे भर । अरङ्गमाय जग्मयेऽपश्चादध्वने नरः ॥१४४०॥
translation: May the bright God drink glorious Soma-mingled meath, giving the sacrifices lord unbroken life He who, wind-urged, in person guards our offspring well, nourishes them with food and shines o’er many a land.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एमेनं प्रत्येतन सोमेभिः सोमपातमम् । अमत्रेभिरृजीषिणमिन्द्रꣳ सुतेभिरिन्दुभिः ॥१४४१॥
translation: Radiant, as high Truth, cherished, best at winning strength, Truth based upon the statute that supports the heavens, He rose, a light that kills Vritras and enemies, best slayer of the Dasyus, Asuras, and foes.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यदी सुतेभिरिन्दुभिः सोमेभिः प्रतिभूषथ । वेदा विश्वस्य मेधिरो धृषत्तन्तमिदेषते ॥१४४२॥
translation: This light, the best of lights, supreme, all conquering, winner of riches, is exalted with high laud. All-lighting, radiant, mighty as the Sun to see, he spreadeth wide unshaken victory and strength.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अस्माअस्मा इदन्धसोऽध्वर्यो प्र भरा सुतम् । कुवित्समस्य जेन्यस्य शर्धतोऽभिशस्तेरवस्वरत् ॥१४४३॥
translation: O Indra, give us wisdom as a sire gives wisdom to his sons, Guide us, O much-invoked, in this our way: may we still livc and look upon the light!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: बभ्रवे नु स्वतवसेऽरुणाय दिविस्पृशे । सोमाय गाथमर्चत ॥१४४४॥
translation: Grant that no mighty foes, unknown, malevolent unhallowed, tread us to the ground! With thine assistance, hero, may we pass through all the waters that are rushing down!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: हस्तच्युतेभिरद्रिभिः सुतꣳ सोमं पुनीतन । मधावा धावता मधु ॥१४४५॥
translation: Protect us, Indra, each to-day, each to morrow, and each following day! Through all the days shalt thou, Lord of the brave, preserve our singers both by day and night!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नमसेदुप सीदत दध्नेदभि श्रीणीतन । इन्दुमिन्द्रे दधातन ॥१४४६॥
translation: A crushing warrior, passing rich, is Maghavan, endowed with all heroic strength. Thine arms, O Satakratu, are exceeding strong, those arms, which grasp the thunderbolt.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अमित्रहा विचर्षणिः पवस्व सोम शं गवे । देवेभ्यो अनुकामकृत् ॥१४४७॥
translation: We call upon Sarasvan as unmarried men who long for wives, As bounteous men who yearn for sons.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्राय सोम पातवे मदाय परि षिच्यसे । मनश्चिन्मनसस्पतिः ॥१४४८॥
translation: Yea, she most dear amid dear streams-seven-sistered, loved with foundest love. Sarasvati, hath earned our praise. X Svitar. Brahmapaspati. Agni 83
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवमान सुवीर्यꣳ रयिꣳ सोम रिरीहि णः । इन्दविन्द्रेण नो युजा ॥१४४९॥
translation: May we attain that excellent glory of Savitar the God: So may he stimulate our prayers!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उद्घेदभि श्रुतामघं वृषभं नर्यापसम् । अस्तारमेषि सूर्य ॥१४५०॥
translation: O Brahmanaspati, make thou Kakshivan Ausija a loud Chanter of flowing Soma juice!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नव यो नवतिं पुरो बिभेद बाह्वोजसा । अहिं च वृत्रहावधीत् ॥१४५१॥
translation: Agni, thou pourest life: send down upon us food and vigorous strength; Drive thou misfortune far away! XI Mitra-Varuva
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स न इन्द्रः शिवः सखाश्वावद्गोमद्यवमत् । उरुधारेव दोहते ॥१४५२॥
translation: So help ye us to riches, great celestial and terrestrial wealth Vast is your sway among the Gods!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विभ्राड् बृहत्पिबतु सोम्यं मध्वायुर्दधद्यज्ञपतावविह्रुतम् । वातजूतो यो अभिरक्षति त्मना प्रजाः पिपर्ति बहुधा वि राजति ॥१४५३॥
translation: Carefully tending Law with law they have attained their vigorous might: Both Gods, devoid of guile, wax strong.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विभ्राड् बृहत्सुभृतं वाजसातमं धर्मं दिवो धरुणे सत्यमर्पितम् । अमित्रहा वृत्रहा दस्युहन्तमं ज्योतिर्जज्ञे असुरहा सपत्नहा ॥१४५४॥
translation: With rainy skies and streaming floods, Lords of the food that falls in dew, A lofty seat have they attained. XII Indra I. They who stand round him as he moves harness the bright, the ruddy steed: The lights shining in the sky.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इदꣳ श्रेष्ठं ज्योतिषां ज्योतिरुत्तमं विश्वजिद्धनजिदुच्यते बृहत् । विश्वभ्राड् भ्राजो महि सूर्यो दृश उरु पप्रथे सह ओजो अच्युतम् ॥१४५५
translation: On both sides to the car they yoke the two bay coursers dear to him, Brown, bold, who bear the hero on.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्र क्रतुं न आ भर पिता पुत्रेभ्यो यथा । शिक्षा णो अस्मिन्पुरुहूत यामनि जीवा ज्योतिरशीमहि ॥१४५६॥
translation: Thou, making light where no light was, and form, O men where form was not, Wast born together with the Dawns.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मा नो अज्ञाता वृजना दुराध्यो३माशिवासोऽव क्रमुः । त्वया वयं प्रवतः शश्वतीरपोऽति शूर तरामसि ॥१४५७॥
translation: For thee this Soma is effused. O Indra: drink of this j uice; for thee the stream is flowing-- Soma, which thou thyself hast made and chosen, even Indu for thy special drink to cheer thee!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अद्याद्या श्वःश्व इन्द्र त्रास्व परे च नः । विश्वा च नो जरितॄन्त्सत्पते अहा दिवा नक्तं च रक्षिषः ॥१४५८॥
translation: Like a capacious car hath it been harnessed, the mighty, to acquire abundant treasures. Then in the sacrifice they shouted lauding all triumphs won by Nahus in the battle.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्रभङ्गी शूरो मघवा तुवीमघः सम्मिश्लो वीर्याय कम् । उभा ते बाहू वृषणा शतक्रतो नि या वज्रं मिमिक्षतुः ॥१४५९॥
translation: Flow onward like the potent band of Maruts, like that celestial host which none revileth! Quickly be gracious unto us like waters, like sacrifice victorious, thousand-fashioned!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: जनीयन्तो न्वग्रवः पुत्रीयन्तः सुदानवः । सरस्वन्तꣳ हवामहे ॥१४६०॥
translation: O Agni, thou hast been ordained Hotar of every sacrifice, By Gods, among the race of men. So with sweet-sounding tongues for us sacrifice nobly in this rite: Bring thou the Gods and worship them
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उत नः प्रिया प्रियासु सप्तस्वसा सुजुष्टा । सरस्वती स्तोम्या भूत् ॥१४६१॥
translation: For, as disposer, Agni, God, most wise in sacrifices, thou Knowest straightway the roads and paths.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तत्सवितुर्वरेण्यं भर्गो देवस्य धीमहि । धियो यो नः प्रचोदयात् ॥१४६२॥
translation: Immortal, Hotar-priest, and God, with wondrous power heleads the way, Urging the congregations on.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सोमानाꣳ स्वरणं कृणुहि ब्रह्मणस्पते । कक्षीवन्तं य औशिजः ॥१४६३॥
translation: Strong, he is set on deeds of strength. He is led forth in holy rites, Sage who completes the sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्न आयूꣳषि पवस आ सुवोर्जमिषं च नः । आरे बाधस्व दुच्छुनाम् ॥१४६४॥
translation: Excellent, he was made by thought. The germ of beings have gained. Yea, and the Sire of active power.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ता नः शक्तं पार्थिवस्य महो रायो दिव्यस्य । महि वां क्षत्रं देवेषु ॥१४६५॥
translation: Pour on the juice the heated milk which hasteneth to heaven and. earth; Bestow the liquid on the Bull!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ऋतमृतेन सपन्तेषिरं दक्षमाशाते । अद्रुहा देवौ वर्धेते ॥१४६६॥
translation: These know their own abiding-place: like calves beside themother cows, They come together with their kin. 84
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वृष्टिद्यावा रीत्यापेषस्पती दानुमत्याः । बृहन्तं गर्तमाशाते ॥१४६७॥
translation: Devouring in their greedy jaws, they make sustaining food irb heaven, For Indra, Agni, homage, light.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: युञ्जन्ति ब्रध्नमरुषं चरन्तं परि तस्थुषः । रोचन्ते रोचना दिवि ॥१४६८॥
translation: In all the worlds That was the best and highest whence sprang the mighty one, of splendid valour, As soon as he is born he smites his foemen, he in whom all who lend him aid are joyful foe
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: युञ्जन्त्यस्य काम्या हरी विपक्षसा रथे । शोणा धृष्णू नृवाहसा ॥१४६९॥
translation: Grown mighty in his strength, of ample vigour, he as a strikes fear into the Dasa, Eager to win the breathing and the breathless. All sang thy praise at banquet and oblation.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: केतुं कृण्वन्नकेतवे पेशो मर्या अपेशसे । समुषद्भिरजायथाः ॥१४७०॥
translation: All concentrate on thee their mental vigour, what time these, once or twice, are thine assistants. Blend what is sweeter than the sweet with sweetness: win quickly with our meath that meath in battle.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अयꣳ सोम इन्द्र तुभ्यꣳ सुन्वे तुभ्यं पवते त्वमस्य पाहि । त्वꣳ ह यं चकृषे त्वं ववृष इन्दुं मदाय युज्याय सोमम् ॥१४७१॥
translation: At the Trikadrukas the great and strong enjoyed the barley-brew. With Vishnu did he drink the pressed-out Soma juice, even as he would. That hath so heightened him the great, the wide, to do his mighty work. So may the God attend the God, true Indu Indra who is true!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स ईꣳ रथो न भुरिषाडयोजि महः पुरूणि सातये वसूनि । आदीं विश्वा नहुष्याणि जाता स्वर्षाता वन ऊर्ध्वा नवन्त ॥१४७२॥
translation: Brought forth together with wisdom and potent strength thou grewest great: with hero deeds subduing the malevolent, most swift in act; Giving prosperity and lovely wealth to him who praiseth thee. So may the God attend the God, true Indu Indra who is true!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: शुष्मी शर्धो न मारुतं पवस्वानभिशस्ता दिव्या यथा विट् । आपो न मक्षू सुमतिर्भवा नः सहस्राप्साः पृतनाषाण् न यज्ञः ॥१४७३॥
translation: So he resplendent in the battle overcame Krivi by might. He with his majesty bath filled the earth and heaven, and waxen strong. One share of the libation bath he swallowed down: one share he left. Enlighten us! So may the God attend the God, true Indu Indra who is true! 85
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वमग्ने यज्ञानाꣳ होता विश्वेषाꣳ हितः । देवेभिर्मानुषे जने ॥१४७४॥
translation: Praise, even as he is known, with song Indra the guardian of the kine, The Son of Truth, Lord of the brave,
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स नो मन्द्राभिरध्वरे जिह्वाभिर्यजा महः । आ देवान्वक्षि यक्षि च ॥१४७५॥
translation: Hither have his bay steeds been sent, red steeds are on the sacred grass Where we in concert sing our songs.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वेत्था हि वेधो अध्वनः पथश्च देवाञ्जसा । अग्ने यज्ञेषु सुक्रतो ॥१४७६॥
translation: For Indra, thunder-armed, the kine have yielded mingled milk and meath, What time he found them in the vault.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: होता देवो अमर्त्यः पुरस्तादेति मायया । विदथानि प्रचोदयन् ॥१४७७॥
translation: Draw near unto our Indra who must be invoked in every fight! Come, thou most mighty Vritra-slayer, meet for praise come to libations and to hymns.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वाजी वाजेषु धीयतेऽध्वरेषु प्र णीयते । विप्रो यज्ञस्य साधनः ॥१४७८॥
translation: Thou art the best of all in sending bounteous gyifts, true art thou,, lordly in thine act. We claim alliance with the very glorious one, yea, with the mighty Son of Strength. III Soma Pavamana I. They have drained forth from out the great depth of the sky the old divine primeval milk that claims the laud: They lifted up their voice to Indra at his birth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: धिया चक्रे वरेण्यो भूतानां गर्भमा दधे । दक्षस्य पितरं तना ॥१४७९॥
translation: Then, beautifully radiant, certain heavenly ones proclaimed their kinship with him as they looked thereon: Savitar opens, as it were, the fold of heaven.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ सुते सिञ्चत श्रियꣳ रोदस्योरभिश्रियम् । रसा दधीत वृषभम् ॥१४८०॥
translation: And now that thou, O Pavamana, art above this earth and heaven and all existence in thy might, Thou shinest like a bull supreme among the herd.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ते जानत स्वमोक्यं३सं वत्सासो न मातृभिः । मिथो नसन्त जामिभिः ॥१४८१॥
translation: O Agni, graciously announce this our good fortune to the Gods, And this our newest hymn of praise!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उप स्रक्वेषु बप्सतः कृण्वते धरुणं दिवि । इन्द्रे अग्ना नमः स्वः ॥१४८२॥
translation: Thou dealest gifts, resplendent one! nigh, as with wave of Sindhu, thou Swift strearnest to the worshipper.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तदिदास भुवनेषु ज्येष्ठं यतो जज्ञ उग्रस्त्वेषनृम्णः । सद्यो जज्ञानो नि रिणाति शत्रूननु यं विश्वे मदन्त्यूमाः ॥१४८३॥
translation: Give us a share of wealth most high, a share of wealth most near to us, A share of wealth that is between.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वावृधानः शवसा भूर्योजाः शत्रुर्दासाय भियसं दधाति । अव्यनच्च व्यनच्च सस्नि सं ते नवन्त प्रभृता मदेषु ॥१४८४॥
translation: I from my Father have obtained deep knowledge of eternal Law; I was born like unto the Sun.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वे क्रतुमपि वृञ्जन्ति विश्वे द्विर्यदेते त्रिर्भवन्त्यूमाः । स्वादोः स्वादीयः स्वादुना सृजा समदः सु मधु मधुनाभि योधीः ॥१४८५॥
translation: After the ancient manner I, like Kanva, beautify my songs, And Indra’s self gains power thereby.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्रिकद्रुकेषु महिषो यवाशिरं तुविशुष्मस्तृम्पत्सोममपिबद्विष्णुना सुतं यथावशम् । स ईं ममाद महि कर्म कर्तवे महामुरुꣳ सैनꣳ सश्चद्देवो देवꣳ सत्य इन्दुः सत्यमिन्द्रम् ॥१४८६॥
translation: Whatever gishis have not praised thee, Indra, or have praised thee, wax Mighty indeed when praised by me! VI Agni 86
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: साकं जातः क्रतुना साकमोजसा ववक्षिथ साकं वृद्धो वीर्यैः सासहिर्मृधो विचर्षणिः । दाता राध स्तुवते काम्यं वसु प्रचेतन सैनꣳ सश्चद्देवो देवꣳ सत्य इन्दुः सत्यमिन्द्रम् ॥१४८७॥
translation: Agni, produced by strength, do thou with all thy fires accept our prayer: With those that are with Gods, with those that are with men exalt our songs!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अध त्विषीमाꣳ अभ्योजसा कृविं युधाभवदा रोदसी अपृणदस्य मज्मना प्र वावृधे । अधत्तान्यं जठरे प्रेमरिच्यत प्र चेतय सैनꣳ सश्चद्देवो देवꣳ सत्य इन्दुः सत्यमिन्द्रम् ॥१४८८॥
translation: Forth come to us with all his fires that Agni, whose the mighty are, Come, fully girt about with wealth for us and for our kith and kin!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभि प्र गोपतिं गिरेन्द्रमर्च यथा विदे । सूनुꣳ सत्यस्य सत्पतिम् ॥१४८९॥
translation: Do thou, O Agni, with thy fires strengthen our prayer and sacrifices: Incite them to bestow their wealth to aid our service of the Gods!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ हरयः ससृज्रिरेऽरुषीरधि बर्हिषि । यत्राभि संनवामहे ॥१४९०॥
translation: Some, the men of old whose grass was trimmed addressed the hymn to thee for mighty strength and for renown: So, hero, urge us onward to heroic power’
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्राय गाव आशिरं दुदुह्रे वज्रिणे मधु । यत्सीमुपह्वरे विदत् ॥१४९१॥
translation: All round about hast thou with glory pierced for us as ‘twere a never-failing well for men to drink, Borne on thy way as ‘twere in fragments from both arms.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ नो विश्वासु हव्यमिन्द्रꣳ समत्सु भूषत । उप ब्रह्माणि सवनानि वृत्रहन्परमज्या ऋचीषम ॥१४९२॥
translation: Thou didst produce him, deathless one! for mortal man, for maintenance of Law and lovely Amrita: Thou evermore hast moved making wealth flow to us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वं दाता प्रथमो राधसामस्यसि सत्य ईशानकृत् । तुविद्युम्नस्य युज्या वृणीमहे पुत्रस्य शवसो महः ॥१४९३॥
translation: Pour out the drops f or Indra; let him drink the meath of Soma Juice! He through his majesty sends forth his bounteous gifts.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्रत्नं पीयूषं पूर्व्यं यदुक्थ्यं महो गाहाद्दिव आ निरधुक्षत । इन्द्रमभि जायमानꣳ समस्वरन् ॥१४९४॥
translation: I spake to the bay coursers’ Lord, to him who grants the boon. of wealth: Now hear the son of Asva as he praises thee?
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आदीं के चित्पश्यमानास आप्यं वसुरुचो दिव्या अभ्यनूषत । दिवो न वारꣳ सविता व्यूर्णुते ॥१४९५॥
translation: Never was any hero born before thee mightier than thou: None certainly like thee in riches and in praise.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अध यदिमे पवमान रोदसी इमा च विश्वा भुवनाभि मज्मना । यूथे न निष्ठा वृषभो वि राजसि ॥१४९६॥
translation: Thou wishest for thy kine a bull, lord of thy cows whom none may kill, For those who long for his approach, for those who turn away from him.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इममू षु त्वमस्माकꣳ सनिं गायत्रं नव्याꣳसम् । अग्ने देवेषु प्र वोचः ॥१४९७॥
translation: The God who giveth wealth accept the full libation poured to him! Pour ye it out, then fill the vessel full again, for so the God regardeth you!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विभक्तासि चित्रभानो सिन्धोरूर्मा उपाक आ । सद्यो दाशुषे क्षरसि ॥१४९८॥
translation: The Gods made him the Hotar-priest of sacrifice, oblationbearer, passing wise. Agni gives wealth and valour to the worshipper, to man who offers up his gifts.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ नो भज परमेष्वा वाजेषु मध्यमेषु । शिक्षा वस्वो अन्तमस्य ॥१४९९॥
translation: He hath appeared, best prosperer, in whom men lay their holy acts: So may our songs of praise come nigh to Agni who was born to give the Arya strength.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अहमिद्धि पितुष्परि मेधामृतस्य जग्रह । अहꣳ सूर्य इवाजनि ॥१५००॥
translation: Him before whom the people shrink when he performs his glorious deeds, Him who wins thousands at the sacrifice, himself, that Agni, reverence with songs!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अहं प्रत्नेन जन्मना गिरः शुम्भामि कण्ववत् । येनेन्द्रः शुष्ममिद्दधे ॥१५०१॥
translation: Agni of Divoddsa, God, comes forth like Indra in his might. Rapidly hath he moved along his mother earth; he stands in high heaven’s dwelling-place.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ये त्वामिन्द्र न तुष्टुवुरृषयो ये च तुष्टुवुः । ममेद्वर्धस्व सुष्टुतः ॥१५०२॥
translation: Agni, thou pourest life: send down upon us food and vigorous strength: Drive thou misfortune far away!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्ने विश्वेभिरग्निभिर्जोषि ब्रह्म सहस्कृत । ये देवत्रा य आयुषु तेभिर्नो महया गिरः ॥१५०३
translation: Agni is Pavamana, Sage, Chief Priest of all the fivefold tribes; To him whose wealth is great we pray.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र स विश्वेभिरग्निभिरग्निः स यस्य वाजिनः । तनये तोके अस्मदा सम्यङ्वाजैः परीवृतः ॥१५०४
translation: Skilled in thy task, O Agni, pour splendour with hero strength on us, Granting me wealth that nourishes! 87
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वं नो अग्ने अग्निभिर्ब्रह्म यज्ञं च वर्धय । त्वं नो देवतातये रायो दानाय चोदय ॥१५०५॥
translation: O Agni, holy and divine with splendour and thy pleasant tongue. Bring thou the Gods and worship them!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वे सोम प्रथमा वृक्तबर्हिषो महे वाजाय श्रवसे धियं दधुः । स त्वं नो वीर वीर्याय चोदय ॥१५०६॥
translation: We pray thee bathed in butter, O bright-rayed! who lookest on the sun, Bring the Gods hither to the feast!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभ्यभि हि श्रवसा ततर्दिथोत्सं न कं चिज्जनपानमक्षितम् । शर्याभिर्न भरमाणो गभस्त्योः ॥१५०७॥
translation: Sage, we have kindled thee, the bright, the feaster on oblation, thee, O Agni, great in sacrifice! XIV Agni I. Adorable in all our prayers, favour us, Agni, with thine aid. What time the psalm is chanted forth!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अजीजनो अमृत मर्त्याय कमृतस्य धर्मन्नमृतस्य चारुणः । सदासरो वाजमच्छा सनिष्यदत् ॥१५०८॥
translation: Bring to us ever-conquering wealth, wealth, Agni, worthy of our choice, Invincible in all our frays!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एन्दुमिन्द्राय सिञ्चत पिबाति सोम्यं मधु । प्र राधाꣳसि चोदयते महित्वना ॥१५०९॥
translation: Grant us, O Agni, through thy grace wealth to support us evermore, Thy favour so that we may live!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उपो हरीणां पतिꣳ राधः पृञ्चन्तमब्रवम् । नूनꣳ श्रुधि स्तुवतो अश्व्यस्य ॥१५१०॥
translation: Let songs of ours speed Agni forth like a fleet courser in the race, And we will win each prize through him
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: न ह्याꣳ३ग पुरा च न जज्ञे वीरतरस्त्वत् । न की राया नैवथा न भन्दना ॥१५११॥
translation: Agni! the host whereby we gain kine for ourselves with help from thee,- That send us for the gain of wealth!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नदं व ओदतीनां नदं योयुवतीनाम् । पतिं वो अघ्न्यानां धेनूनामिषुध्यसि ॥१५१२॥
translation: O Agni, bring us wealth secure, vast wealth in horses and in kine: Oil thou the socket, turn the wheel!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: देवो वो द्रविणोदाः पूर्णां विवष्ट्वासिचम् । उद्वा सिञ्चध्वमुप वा पृणध्वमादिद्वो देव ओहते ॥१५१३॥
translation: O Agni, thou hast made the Sun, the eternal star, to mount the sky, Giving the boon of light to men.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तꣳ होतारमध्वरस्य प्रचेतसं वह्निं देवा अकृण्वत । दधाति रत्नं विधते सुवीर्यमग्निर्जनाय दाशुषे ॥१५१४॥
translation: Thou, Agni, art the people’s light, best, dearest, seated in thy shrine Watch for the singer, give him life!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अदर्शि गातुवित्तमो यस्मिन्व्रतान्यादधुः । उपोषु जातमार्यस्य वर्धनमग्निं नक्षन्तु नो गिरः ॥१५१५॥
translation: Agni is head and height of heaven, the master of the earth is he: He quickeneth the waters’ seed.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यस्माद्रेजन्त कृष्टयश्चर्कृत्यानि कृण्वतः । सहस्रसां मेधसाताविव त्मनाग्निं धीभिर्नमस्यत ॥१५१६॥
translation: Yea, Agni, thou as Lord of light rulest o’er choicest gifts may I, Thy singer, find defence in thee
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र दैवोदासो अग्निर्देव इन्द्रो न मज्मना । अनु मातरं पृथिवीं वि वावृते तस्थौ नाकस्य शर्मणि ॥१५१७॥
translation: Upward, O Agni, rise thy flames, pure and resplendent, blazing high, Thy lustres, fair effulgences.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्न आयूꣳषि पवस आसुवोर्जमिषं च नः । आरे बाधस्व दुच्छुनाम् ॥१५१८॥
translation: Who, Agni, is thy kin, of men? who honours thee with sacrifice? On whom dependent? who art thou?
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्निरृषिः पवमानः पाञ्चजन्यः पुरोहितः । तमीमहे महागयम् ॥१५१९॥
translation: The kinsman, Agni! of mankind, their well-beiaved friend art thou, A friend whom friends may supplicate.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्ने पवस्व स्वपा अस्मे वर्चः सुवीर्यम् । दधद्रयिं मयि पोषम् ॥१५२०॥
translation: Bring Mitra, Varukia, bring the Gods hither to. our great sacrifice: Bring them, O Agni, to thine home
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्ने पावक रोचिषा मन्द्रया देव जिह्वया । आ देवान्वक्षि यक्षि च ॥१५२१॥
translation: Meet to be worshipped and implored, showing in beauty through the gloom, Agni, the strong, is kindled well.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तं त्वा घृतस्नवीमहे चित्रभानो स्वर्दृशम् । देवाꣳ आ वीतये वह ॥१५२२॥
translation: Strong Agni is enkindled well, even as the horse that brings the Gods: 88 Men with oblations pray to him.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वीतिहोत्रं त्वा कवे द्युमन्तꣳ समिधीमहि । अग्ने बृहन्तमध्वरे ॥१५२३॥
translation: We will enkindle thee, the strong, we, hero! who axe strong ourselves,
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अवा नो अग्न ऊतिभिर्गायत्रस्य प्रभर्मणि । विश्वासु धीषु वन्द्य ॥१५२४॥
translation: Thy mighty flames, O Agni, when thou art enkindled, rise on high, Thy bright flames, thou refulgent one
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ नो अग्ने रयिं भर सत्रासाहं वरेण्यम् । विश्वासु पृत्सु दुष्टरम् ॥१५२५॥
translation: Beloved! let my ladies full of sacred oil come nigh to thee. Agni, accept our offerings!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ नो अग्ने सुचेतुना रयिं विश्वायुपोषसम् । मार्डीकं धेहि जीवसे ॥१५२६॥
translation: I pray to Agni--may he hear!--the Hotar with sweet tones, the Priest, Wondrously splendid, rich in light,
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्निꣳ हिन्वन्तु नो धियः सप्तिमाशुमिवाजिषु । तेन जेष्म धनंधनम् ॥१५२७॥
translation: O King, the potent and terrific envoy, kindled for strength, is manifest in beauty. He shines, observant, with his lofty splendour; chasing black night he comes with white- rayed morning.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यया गा आकरामहै सेनयाग्ने तवोत्या । तां नो हिन्व मघत्तये ॥१५२८॥
translation: Having o’ercome the glimmering Black with beauty, and bringing forth the Dame, the great Sire’s daughter, Holding aloft the radiant lights of Surya, as messenger of heaven he shines with treasures.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आग्ने स्थूरꣳ रयिं भर पृथुं गोमन्तमश्विनम् । अङ्धि खं वर्तया पविम् ॥१५२९॥
translation: Attendant on the blessed Dame the blessed hath come: the lover followeth his sister. Agni, far-spreading with conspicuous lustre, hath covered night with whitely-shining garments.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्ने नक्षत्रमजरमा सूर्यꣳ रोहयो दिवि । दधज्ज्योतिर्जनेभ्यः ॥१५३०॥
translation: What is the praise wherewith, O God, Angiras, Agni, Son of Strength, We, after thine own wish and thought,
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्ने केतुर्विशामसि प्रेष्ठः श्रेष्ठ उपस्थसत् । बोधा स्तोत्रे वयो दधत् ॥१५३१॥
translation: May serve thee, O thou Child of Power, and with what sacrifice’s plan? What reverent word shall I speak here?
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्निर्मूर्धा दिवः ककुत्पतिः पृथिव्या अयम् । अपाꣳ रेताꣳसि जिन्वति ॥१५३२॥
translation: Agni, come hither with thy fires; we choose thee as our Hotar; let The proffered ladle filled with offerings balm thee, best of priests, to sit on sacred grass!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ईशिषे वार्यस्य हि दात्रस्याग्ने स्वःपतिः । स्तोता स्यां तव शर्मणि ॥१५३३॥
translation: For unto thee, O Angiras, O Son of Strength, move ladles in the sacrifice. We pray to Agni, Child of Force, whose locks drop oil, foremost in sacrificial rites.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उदग्ने शुचयस्तव शुक्रा भ्राजन्त ईरते । तव ज्योतीꣳष्यर्चयः ॥१५३४॥
translation: Let our songs come anear to him beauteous and bright with piercing flame, Our sacrifices with our homage unto him much-lauded, very rich, for help:
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: कस्ते जामिर्जनानामग्ने को दाश्वध्वरः । को ह कस्मिन्नसि श्रितः ॥१५३५॥
translation: To Agni Jatavedas, to the Son of Strength, that he may give us precious gifts,
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वं जामिर्जनानामग्ने मित्रो असि प्रियः । सखा सखिभ्य ईड्यः ॥१५३६॥
translation: Immortal, from of old Priest among mortal men, whose tones are sweetest in the house!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यजा नो मित्रावरुणा यजा देवाꣳ ऋतं बृहत् । अग्ने यक्षि स्वं दमम् ॥१५३७॥
translation: Invincible is Agni, he who goes before the tribes of men, A chariot swift and ever new.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ईडेन्यो नमस्यस्तिरस्तमाꣳसि दर्शतः । समग्निरिध्यते वृषा ॥१५३८॥
translation: By bringing offerings unto him the mortal worshipper obtains A home from him whose light is pure.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वृषो अग्निः समिध्यतेऽश्वो न देववाहनः । तꣳ हविष्मन्त ईडते ॥१५३९॥
translation: Inviolable power of Gods, subduing all his enemies, Agni is mightiest in fame.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वृषणं त्वा वयं वृषन्वृषणः समिधीमहि । अग्ने दीद्यतं बृहत् ॥१५४०॥
translation: May Agni, worshipped, bring us bliss: may the gift, blessed one! and sacrifice bring bliss, Yea, may our eulogies bring bliss 89
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उत्ते बृहन्तो अर्चयः समिधानस्य दीदिवः । अग्ने शुक्रास ईरते ॥१५४१॥
translation: Show forth the mind that brings success in war with fiends, wherewith thou conquerest in fight! Bring down the many firm hopes of our enemies, and for thy victory let us win!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उप त्वा जुह्वो३मम घृताचीर्यन्तु हर्यत । अग्ने हव्या जुषस्व नः ॥१५४२॥
translation: O Agni thou who art the Lord of wealth in kine, thou Son of Strength, Bestow on us, O Jatavedas, high renown
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मन्द्रꣳ होतारमृत्विजं चित्रभानुं विभावसुम् । अग्निमीडे स उ श्रवत् ॥१५४३॥
translation: He, Agni, kindled, good and wise, must be entreated with a. song; Shine, thou of many forms, shine thou with wealth on us
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पाहि नो अग्न एकया पाह्यू३त द्वितीयया । पाहि गीर्भिस्तिसृभिरूर्जां पते पाहि चतसृभिर्वसो ॥१५४४॥
translation: And, Agni, shining of thyself by night and when the morning breaks, Burn, thou whose teeth are sharp, against the Rakshasas
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पाहि विश्वस्माद्रक्षसो अराव्णः प्र स्म वाजेषु नोऽव । त्वामिद्धि नेदिष्ठं देवतातय आपिं नक्षामहे वृधे ॥१५४५॥
translation: Exerting all our strength with thoughts of power we glorify in speech, Agni, your dear familiar friend, the darling guest of every house:
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इनो राजन्नरतिः समिद्धो रौद्रो दक्षाय सुषुमाꣳ अदर्शि । चिकिद्वि भाति भासा बृहतासिक्नीमेति रुशतीमपाजन् ॥१५४६॥
translation: Whom, served with sacrificial oil, like Mitra, men presenting gifts, Glorify with their songs of praise
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: कृष्णां यदेनीमभि वर्पसाभूज्जनयन्योषां बृहतः पितुर्जाम् । ऊर्ध्वं भानुꣳ सूर्यस्य स्तभायन्दिवो वसुभिररतिर्वि भाति ॥१५४७
translation: Much-lauded Jatavedas, him who sends oblations up to heaven, Prepared in service of the Gods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: भद्रो भद्रया सचमान आगात्स्वसारं जारो अभ्येति पश्चात् । सुप्रकेतैर्द्युभिरग्निर्वितिष्ठन्रुशद्भिर्वर्णैरभि राममस्थात् ॥१५४८॥
translation: Agni, inflamed with fuel, in my song I sing, pure bright, and stedfast set in front at sacrifice. Wise Jatavedas we implore with prayers for grace, the Sage, the Hotar-priest, bounteous, and void of guile.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: कया ते अग्ने अङ्गिर ऊर्जो नपादुपस्तुतिम् । वराय देव मन्यवे ॥१५४९॥
translation: Men, Agni, in each age, have made thee, deathless one, their envoy, offering-bearer, guard adorable. With reverence Gods and mortals have established thee as everwatchful and almighty household Lord.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: दाशेम कस्य मनसा यज्ञस्य सहसो यहो । कदु वोच इदं नमः ॥१५५०॥
translation: Though, Agni ordering the works and ways of both, as envoy of the Gods traversest both the realms. When we lay claim to thy regard and gracious care, be thou to us a th rice- protecting friendly guard?
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अधा त्वं हि नस्करो विश्वा अस्मभ्यꣳ सुक्षितीः । वाजद्रविणसो गिरः ॥१५५१॥
translation: Still turning to their aim in thee the sacrificer’s sister hymns Have come to thee before the wind.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्न आ याह्यग्निभिर्होतारं त्वा वृणीमहे । आ त्वामनक्तु प्रयता हविष्मती यजिष्ठं बर्हिरासदे ॥१५५२॥
translation: Even the waters find their place in him whose three fold sacred grass Is spread unbound, unlimited.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अच्छा हि त्वा सहसः सूनो अङ्गिरः स्रुचश्चरन्त्यध्वरे । ऊर्जो नपातं घृतकेशमीमहेऽग्निं यज्ञेषु पूर्व्यम् ॥१५५३॥
translation: The station of the bounteous God, by his unconquerable aid, Hath a fair aspect like the Sun.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अच्छा नः शीरशोचिषं गिरो यन्तु दर्शतम् । अच्छा यज्ञासो नमसा पुरूवसुं पुरुप्रशस्तमूतये ॥१५५४॥
translation: Men with their lauds are urging thee, Indra, to drink the Soma first. The Ribhus in accord have lifted up their voice, and Rudras sung thee as the first.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्निꣳ सूनुꣳ सहसो जातवेदसं दानाय वार्याणाम् । द्विता यो भूदमृतो मर्त्येष्वा होता मन्द्रतमो विशि ॥१५५५॥
translation: Indra, at sacrifice, increased his manly strength, in the wild rapture of this juice: And living men to-day, even as of old, sing forth their praises to his majesty. II Indra-Agni 90
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अदाभ्यः पुरएता विशामग्निर्मानुषीणाम् । तूर्णी रथः सदा नवः ॥१५५६॥
translation: Indra and Agni! singers skilled in melody, with lauds, hymn you: I choose you both to bring me food.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभि प्रयाꣳसि वाहसा दाश्वाꣳ अश्नोति मर्त्यः । क्षयं पावकशोचिषः ॥१५५७॥
translation: Indra and Agni! ye shook down, together, with one mightyr deed, The ninety forts which Dasas held.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: साह्वान्विश्वा अभियुजः क्रतुर्देवानाममृक्तः । अग्निस्तुविश्रवस्तमः ॥१५५८॥
translation: To Indra and to Agni prayers go forward from the holy task, Along the path of sacred Law.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: भद्रो नो अग्निराहुतो भद्रा रातिः सुभग भद्रो अध्वरः । भद्रा उत प्रशस्तयः ॥१५५९॥
translation: Indra and Agni, powers are yours, yours are oblations ano abodes: Good is your zealous energy.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: भद्रं मनः कृणुष्व वृत्रतूर्ये येना समत्सु सासहिः । अव स्थिरा तनुहि भूरि शर्धतां वनेमा ते अभिष्टये ॥१५६०॥
translation: Indra, with all thy saving helps assist us, Lord of power and might! For after thee we follow even as glorious bliss, thee, hero, finder-out of wealth!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्ने वाजस्य गोमत ईशानः सहसो यहो । अस्मे देहि जातवेदो महि श्रवः ॥१५६१॥
translation: Increaser of our steeds and multiplying kine, a golden well, G God, art thou, For no one may impair the gift laid up in thee. Bring me whatever thing I ask!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स इधानो वसुष्कविरग्निरीडेन्यो गिरा । रेवदस्मभ्यं पुर्वणीक दीदिहि ॥१५६२॥
translation: For thou--come to the worshipper!--wilt find great wealth to make us rich. Fill thyself full, O Maghavan, for gain of kine, full, Indra, forthe gain of steeds!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: क्षपो राजन्नुत त्मनाग्ने वस्तोरुतोषसः । स तिग्मजम्भ रक्षसो दह प्रति ॥१५६३॥
translation: Thou as thy gift bestowest many hundred herds, yea, many thou-sands dost thou give. With singers’ hymns have we brought the fortrender near, singing to Indra for his grace.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विशोविशो वो अतिथिं वाजयन्तः पुरुप्रियम् । अग्निं वो दुर्यं वच स्तुषे शूषस्य मन्मभिः ॥१५६४॥
translation: To him who dealeth out all wealth, the sweet-toned Hotar-priest of men, To him, like the first vessels filled with savoury juice, to Agni let the lauds go forth!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यं जनासो हविष्मन्तो मित्रं न सर्पिरासुतिम् । प्रशꣳसन्ति प्रशस्तिभिः ॥१५६५॥
translation: Votaries, bounteous givers, deck him with their songs, even as the steed who draws the car. To both, strong Lord of men! to kith and kin convey the bounties of our wealthy lords!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पन्याꣳसं जातवेदसं यो देवतात्युद्यता । हव्यान्यैरयद्दिवि ॥१५६६॥
translation: Hear this my call, O Varuna, and show thy gracious love today: Desiring help I long for thee!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: समिद्धमग्निं समिधा गिरा गृणे शुचिं पावकं पुरो अध्वरे ध्रुवम् । विप्रꣳ होतारं पुरुवारमद्रुहं कविꣳ सुम्नैरीमहे जातवेदसम् ॥१५६७॥
translation: O Hero, with what aid dost thou delight us, with what succour bring, Riches to those who worship thee?
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वां दूतमग्ने अमृतं युगेयुगे हव्यवाहं दधिरे पायुमीड्यम् । देवासश्च मर्तासश्च जागृविं विभुं विश्पतिं नमसा नि षेदिरे ॥१५६८॥
translation: Indra, for service of the Gods, Indra while sacrifice proceeds, Indra, as worshippers, in battle-shock we call, Indra that we may win the spoil.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विभूषन्नग्न उभयाꣳ अनु व्रता दूतो देवानाꣳ रजसी समीयसे । यत्ते धीतिꣳ सुमतिमावृणीमहेऽध स्म नस्त्रिवरूथः शिवो भव ॥१५६९॥
translation: With might hath Indra spread out heaven and earth, with power hath indra lighten up the Sun. In Indra are all creatures closely held; in him meet the distilling Soma-drops.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उप त्वा जामयो गिरो देदिशतीर्हविष्कृतः । वायोरनीके अस्थिरन् ॥१५७०॥
translation: Bring, Visvakarman strengthened by oblation, thyself, thy body-’tis thine own-for worship Let other men around us live in folly here let us have’, a rich and liberal patron!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यस्य त्रिधात्ववृतं बर्हिस्तस्थावसन्दिनम् । आपश्चिन्नि दधा पदम् ॥१५७१॥
translation: With this his golden splendour purifying him, he with his own allies subdues all enemies. as Sura with his own allies. Cleansing himself with stream of juice he shines forth yellow-hued and red, when with his praisers he encompasses all forms, with praisers having seven mouths.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पदं देवस्य मीढुषोऽनाधृष्टाभिरूतिभिः । भद्रा सूर्य इवोपदृक् ॥१५७२॥
translation: He moves intelligent directed to the east. The every beauteous car rivals the beams of light, the beautiful celestial car. 91 Hymns, lauding manly valour, came inciting Indra to success, that ye may be unconquered, both thy bolt and thou, both be unconquered in the war.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभि त्वा पूर्वपीतय इन्द्र स्तोमेभिरायवः । समीचीनास ऋभवः समस्वरन्रुद्रा गृणन्त पूर्व्यम् ॥१५७३॥
translation: That treasure of the Panis thou discoveredst. Thou with the Mothers deckest thee in thine abode, with, songs of worship in thine home. As ‘twere from far away is heard the psalm where hymns resound in joy. He, with the triple Dames red-hued, hath won life-power, he, gleaming, hath won vital strength.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अस्येदिन्द्रो वावृधे वृष्ण्यꣳशवो मदे सुतस्य विष्णवि । अद्या तमस्य महिमानमायवोऽनु ष्टुवन्ति पूर्वथा ॥१५७४॥
translation: Yea, cause our hymn to gain for us cattle and steeds and store of wealth, That it may help us manfully!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र वामर्चन्त्युक्थिनो नीथाविदो जरितारः । इन्द्राग्नी इष आ वृणे ॥१५७५॥
translation: Heroes of real strength, ye mark either the sweat of him who toils, Or his desire who supplicates.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्राग्नी नवतिं पुरो दासपत्नीरधूनुतम् । साकमेकेन कर्मणा ॥१५७६॥
translation: The Sons of immortality shall listen to our songs of praise, And be exceeding kind to us. XIV Heaven and Earth
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्राग्नी अपसस्पर्युप प्र यन्ति धीतयः । ऋतस्य पथ्या३ अनु ॥१५७७॥
translation: To both of you, O Heaven and Earth, we bring our lofty song of praise, Pure pair! to glorify you both.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्राग्नी तविषाणि वाꣳ सधस्थानि प्रयाꣳसि च । युवोरप्तूर्यꣳ हितम् ॥१५७८॥
translation: Ye sanctify each other’s form by your own proper strength ye rule: Further the sacrifice evermore!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: शग्ध्यू३षु शचीपत इन्द्र विश्वाभिरूतिभिः । भगं न हि त्वा यशसं वसुविदमनु शूर चरामसि ॥१५७९॥
translation: Promoting and fulfilling, ye, mighty ones, perfect Mitra’s law: Ye sit around our sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पौरो अश्वस्य पुरुकृद्गवामस्युत्सो देव हिरण्ययः । न किर्हि दानं परिमर्धिषत् त्वे यद्यद्यामि तदा भर ॥१५८०॥
translation: This is thine own. Thou drawest near, as turns a pigeon to his mate: Thou carest, too, for this our prayer.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वꣳ ह्येहि चेरवे विदा भगं वसुत्तये । उद्वावृषस्व मघवन् गविष्टय उदिन्द्राश्वमिष्टये ॥१५८१॥
translation: O hero, Lord of bounties, praised in hymns, may glorious fame and might Be his who sings the laud to thee
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वं पुरू सहस्राणि शतानि च यूथा दानाय मꣳहसे । आ पुरन्दरं चकृम विप्रवचस इन्द्रं गायन्तोऽवसे ॥१५८२॥
translation: Lord of a Hundred Powers, rise up to be our succour in this fight: In other fights let us agree
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यो विश्वा दयते वसु होता मन्द्रो जनानाम् । मधोर्न पात्रा प्रथमान्यस्मै प्र स्तोमा यन्त्वग्नये ॥१५८३॥
translation: Ye cows, protect the fount: the two mighty ones bless the sacrifice. The handles twain are wrought of gold.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अश्व न गीर्भी रथ्यꣳ सुदानवो मर्मृज्यन्ते देवयवः । उभे तोके तनये दस्म विश्पते पर्षि राधो मघोनाम् ॥१५८४॥
translation: The pressing-stones are set at work: the meath is poured into the tank At the out-shedding of the fount.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इमं मे वरुण श्रुधी हवमद्या च मृडय । त्वामवस्युरा चके ॥१५८५॥
translation: With reverence they drain the fount that circles with its wheel above. Exhaustless, with the mouth below.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: कया त्वं न ऊत्याभि प्र मन्दसे वृषन् । कया स्तोतृभ्य आ भर ॥१५८६॥
translation: Let us not tire or be afraid with thee, the mighty, for our friend! May we see Turvasa and Yadu! thy great deed, O hero, must be glorified.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रमिद्देवतातय इन्द्रं प्रयत्यध्वरे । इन्द्रꣳ समीके वनिनो हवामह इन्द्रं धनस्य सातये ॥१५८७॥
translation: On his left hip the hero hath reclined himself: the proffered feast offends him not. The milk is blended with the honey of the bee: quickly come hither, haste, and drink! XVIII Indra 92
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रो मह्ना रोदसी पप्रथच्छव इन्द्रः सूर्यमरोचयत् । इन्द्रे ह विश्वा भुवनानि येमिर इन्द्रे स्वानास इन्दवः ॥१५८८॥
