translation: May these my songs of praise exalt thee, Lord, who hast abundant wealth! Men skilled in holy hymns, pure, with the hues of fire, have sung them with their lauds to thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विश्वकर्मन्हविषा वावृधानः स्वयं यजस्व तन्व३ꣳ स्वा हि ते । मुह्यन्त्वन्ये अभितो जनास इहास्माकं मघवा सूरिरस्तु ॥१५८९॥
translation: He, when a thousand Rishis have enhanced his might, hath like an ocean spread himself. His majesty is praised as true at solemn rites, his power where holy singers rule.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अया रुचा हरिण्या पुनानो विश्वा द्वेषाꣳसि तरति सयुग्वभिः सूरो न सयुग्वभिः । धारा पृष्ठस्य रोचते पुनानो अरुषो हरिः । विश्वा यद्रूपा परियास्यृक्वभिः सप्तास्येभिरृक्वभिः ॥१५९०॥
translation: Good Lord of wealth is he to whom all Aryas, Dasas here belong. Directly unto thee, the pious Rusama Paviru, is that wealth brought nigh.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्राचीमनु प्रदिशं याति चेकितत्सꣳ रश्मिभिर्यतते दर्शतो रथो दैव्यो दर्शतो रथः । अग्मन्नुक्थानि पौꣳस्येन्द्रं जैत्राय हर्षयन् । वज्रश्च यद्भवथो अनपच्युता समत्स्वनपच्युता ॥१५९१॥
translation: In zealous haste the singers have sung forth a song distilling fatness, rich in sweets. Riches have spread among us and heroic strength, with us are flowing Soma-drops.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वꣳ ह त्यत्पणीनां विदो वसु सं मातृभिर्मर्जयसि स्व आ दम ऋतस्य धीतिभिर्दमे । परावतो न साम तद्यत्रा रणन्ति धीतयः । त्रिधातुभिररुषीभिर्वयो दधे रोचमानो वयो दधे ॥१५९२॥
translation: Flow to us, Indu, very strong, effused, with wealth of kine and steeds, And do thou lay above the milk thy radiant hue
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उत नो गोषणिं धियमश्वसां वाजसामुत । नृवत्कृणुह्यूतये ॥१५९३॥
translation: Lord of the tawny, Indu, thou who art the Gods’ most special food, As friend to friend, for splendour be thou good to men!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: शशमानस्य वा नरः स्वेदस्य सत्यशवसः । विदा कामस्य वेनतः ॥१५९४॥
translation: Drive utterly, far away from us each godless, each voracious; foe; O Indu, overcome and drive the false afar! XXI Soma Pavamana.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उप नः सूनवो गिरः शृण्वन्त्वमृतस्य ये । सुमृडीका भवन्तु नः ॥१५९५॥
translation: They balm him, balm him over, balm him thoroughly, caress. the mighty strength and balm it with the meath. They seize the flying Steer at the stream’s breathing place cleansing with gold they grasp the animal herein.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र वां महि द्यवी अभ्युपस्तुतिं भरामहे । शुची उप प्रशस्तये ॥१५९६॥
translation: Sing forth to Pavamana skilled in holy song! the juice is flowing onward like a mighty stream. He glideth like a serpent from his ancient skin, and like a. playful horse the tawny Steer hath run.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पुनाने तन्वा मिथः स्वेन दक्षेण राजथः । ऊह्याथे सनादृतम् ॥१५९७॥
translation: Dweller in floods, King, foremost, he displays his might, set among living things as measure of days. Distilling oil he flows, fair, billowy, golden-hued, borne on car of light, sharing on home with wealth. 93
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मही मित्रस्य साधथस्तरन्ती पिप्रती ऋतम् । परि यज्ञं नि षेदथुः ॥१५९८॥
translation: With all thy fires, O Agni, find pleasure in this our sacrifice, And this our speech, O son of Strength!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अयमु ते समतसि कपोत इव गर्भधिम् । वचस्तच्चिन्न ओहसे ॥१५९९॥
translation: Whate’er, in this perpetual course, we sacrifice to God and God, That gift is offered but in thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स्तोत्रꣳ राधानां पते गिर्वाहो वीर यस्य ते । विभूतिरस्तु सूनृता ॥१६००॥
translation: May he be our beloved King and excellent sweet-toned Hotar may We with bright fires be dear to him
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ऊर्ध्वस्तिष्ठा न ऊतयेऽस्मिन्वाजे शतक्रतो । समन्येषु ब्रवावहै ॥१६०१॥
translation: For you from every side we call Indra away from other men Ours, and none others, may he be!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: गाव उप वदावटे मही यज्ञस्य रप्सुदा । उभा कर्णा हिरण्यया ॥१६०२॥
translation: Unclose, our manly hero! thou for ever bounteous, yonder cloud For us, thou irresistible
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभ्यारमिदद्रयो निषिक्तं पुष्करे मधु । अवटस्य विसर्जने ॥१६०३॥
translation: As the strong bull leads on the herds, he stirs the people with his might, The ruler irresistible.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सिञ्चन्ति नमसावटमुच्चाचक्रं परिज्मानम् । नीचीनवारमक्षितम् ॥१६०४॥
translation: Wonderful, with thy saving help, send us thy bounties, gracious Lord! Thou art the charioteer, Agni, of earthly wealth: find rest and safety for our seed!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मा भेम मा श्रमिष्मोग्रस्य सख्ये तव । महत्ते वृष्णो अभिचक्ष्यं कृतं पश्येम तुर्वशं यदुम् ॥१६०५॥
translation: Prosper our kith and kin with thy protecting powers inviolate, never negligent! Keep far from us, O Agni, all celestial wrath. and wickedness of godless men!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सव्यामनु स्फिग्यं वावसे वृषा न दानो अस्य रोषति । मध्वा संपृक्ताः सारघेण धेनवस्तूयमेहि द्रवा पिब ॥१६०६॥
translation: What, Vishnu, is the name that thou proclaimest when thou declaredst, I am Sipivishta? Hide not this form from us, nor keep it secret, since thou didst wear another shape in battle.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इमा उ त्वा पुरूवसो गिरो वर्धन्तु या मम । पावकवर्णाः शुचयो विपश्चितोऽभि स्तोमैरनूषत ॥१६०७॥
translation: This offering to-day, O Sipivishta, I, skilled in rules, extol, to thee the noble. Yea, I, the poor and weak, praise thee, the mighty, who dwellest in the realm beyond this region.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अयꣳ सहस्रमृषिभिः सहस्कृतः समुद्र इव पप्रथे । सत्यः सो अस्य महिमा गृणे शवो यज्ञेषु विप्रराज्ये ॥१६०८॥
translation: O Vishnu, unto thee my lips cry Vashat! Let this mine offering, Sipivishta, please thee! May these my songs of eulogy exalt thee! Do ye preserve us evermore with blessings! V Vayu, Indra and Vayu I. Vayu, the bright is offered thee, best of the meath, at morning rites. Come thou to drink the Soma juice, God, longed for on thy team-drawn car!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यस्यायं विश्व आर्यो दासः शेवधिपा अरिः । तिरश्चिदर्ये रुशमे पवीरवि तुभ्येत्सो अज्यते रयिः ॥१६०९॥
translation: O Vayu, thou and Indra are meet drinkers of these Soma draughts, For unto you the drops proceed like waters gathering to the vale.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तुरण्यवो मधुमन्तं घृतश्चुतं विप्रासो अर्कमानृचुः । अस्मे रयिः पप्रथे वृष्ण्यꣳ शवोऽस्मे स्वानास इन्दवः ॥१६१०॥
translation: Vayu and Indra, mighty twain, borne on one chariot, Lords of strength, Come to ouf succour with your steeds, that ye may drink the Soma juice!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: गोमन्न इन्दो अश्ववत्सुतः सुदक्ष धनिव । शुचिं च वर्णमधि गोषु धारय ॥१६११॥
translation: Then thou, made beautiful by night, enterest into mighty deeds, When prayers impel the golden-hued to hasten from Vivasvan’s place.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स नो हरीणां पत इन्दो देवप्सरस्तमः । सखेव सख्ये नर्यो रुचे भव ॥१६१२॥
translation: We cleanse this gladdening drink of his, the juice which Indra chiefly drinks, That which kine took into their mouths, oF old, and princes take it now. 94
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सनेमि त्वमस्मदा अदेवं कं चिदत्रिणम् । साह्वाꣳ इन्दो परि बाधो अप द्वयुम् ॥१६१३॥
translation: Thy with the ancient psalm have sung to him as he is purified, And sacred songs which bear the Dames of Gods have supplicated him.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अञ्जते व्यञ्जते समञ्जते क्रतुꣳ रिहन्ति मध्वाभ्यञ्जते । सिन्धोरुऽच्छ्वासे पतयन्तमुक्षणꣳ हिरण्यपावाः पशुमप्सु गृभ्णते ॥१६१४॥
translation: With homage will I reverence thee, Agni, like a long-tailed steed, Imperial Lord of holy rites.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विपश्चिते पवमानाय गायत मही न धारात्यन्धो अर्षति । अहिर्न जूर्णामति सर्पति त्वचमत्यो न क्रीडन्नसरद्वृषा हरिः ॥१६१५॥
translation: May the far-striding Son of Strength, our friend who brings felicity, Who pours his gifts like rain, be ours
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्रेगो राजाप्यस्तविष्यते विमानो अह्नां भुवनेष्वर्पितः । हरिर्घृतस्नुः सुदृशीको अर्णवो ज्योतीरथः पवते राय ओक्यः ॥१६१६॥
translation: From near and far away do thou, the everlasting, evermore Protect us from the sinful man!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विश्वेभिरग्ने अग्निभिरिमं यज्ञमिदं वचः । चनो धाः सहसो यहो ॥१६१७॥
translation: Thou in thy battles, Indra, art subduer of all hostile bands. Father art thou, all-conquering, cancelling the curse, thou victor of the vanquisher!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यच्चिद्धि शश्वता तना देवंदेवं यजामहे । त्वे इद्धूयते हविः ॥१६१८॥
translation: The earth and heaven cling close to thy victorious might, as sire and mother to their child. When thou attackest Vritra, all the hostile bands shrink and faint, Indra, at thy wrath.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्रियो नो अस्तु विश्पतिर्होता मन्द्रो वरेण्यः । प्रियाः स्वग्नयो वयम् ॥१६१९॥
translation: The sacrifice made Indra great when he unrolled the earth, and made Himself a diadem in heaven.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रं वो विश्वतस्परि हवामहे जनेभ्यः । अस्माकमस्तु केवलः ॥१६२०॥
translation: In Soma’s ecstasy Indra spread the firmament and realms of light, When he cleft Vala limb from limb.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स नो वृषन्नमुं चरुꣳ सत्रादावन्नपा वृधि । अस्मभ्यमप्रतिष्कुतः ॥१६२१॥
translation: Showing the hidden, he drave forth the cows for the Angirasas, And Vala he cast headlong down.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वृषा यूथेव वꣳसगः कृष्टीरियर्त्योजसा । ईशानो अप्रतिष्कुतः ॥१६२२॥
translation: Thou speedest down to succour us this-ever-conquering God of yours, Him who is drawn to all our songs;
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वं नश्चित्र ऊत्या वसो राधाꣳसि चोदय । अस्य रायस्त्वमग्ने रथीरसि विदा गाधं तुचे तु नः ॥१६२३॥
translation: The warrior whom none may wound, the Soma-drinker ne’er o’erthrown, The chieftain of resistless might.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पर्षि तोकं तनयं पर्तृभिष्ट्वमदब्धैरप्रयुत्वभिः । अग्ने हेडाꣳसि दैव्या युयोधि नोऽदेवानि ह्वराꣳसि च ॥१६२४॥
translation: O Indra, send us riches, thou omniscient, worthy of our hymns: Help us in the decisive fray!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: किमित्ते विष्णो परिचक्षि नाम प्र यद्ववक्षे शिपिविष्टो अस्मि । मा वर्पो अस्मदप गूह एतद्यदन्यरूपः समिथे बभूथ ॥१६२५॥
translation: That lofty power and might of thine, thy strength and thine intelligence, And thy surpassing thunderbolt, the wish makes keen.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र तत्ते अद्य शिपिविष्ट हव्यमर्यः शꣳसामि वयुनानि विद्वान् । तं त्वा गृणामि तवसमतव्यान्क्षयन्तमस्य रजसः पराके ॥१६२६॥
translation: O Indra, heaven and earth augment thy manly force and thy renown: The waters and the mountains stir and urge thee on:
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वषट् ते विष्णवास आ कृणोमि तन्मे जुषस्व शिपिविष्ट हव्यम् । वर्धन्तु त्वा सुष्टुतयो गिरो मे यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥१६२७॥
translation: Vishnu in the lofty ruling power, Varuna, Mitra sing thy praise: In thee the Maruts’ company have great delight.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वायो शुक्रो अयामि ते मध्वो अग्रं दिविष्टिषु । आ याहि सोमपीतये स्पार्हो देव नियुत्वता ॥१६२८॥
translation: O Agni, God, the people sing reverent praise to thee for strength: With terrors trouble thou the foe
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रश्च वायवेषाꣳ सोमानां पीतिमर्हथः । युवाꣳ हि यन्तीन्दवो निम्नमापो न सध्र्यक् ॥१६२९॥
translation: Wilt thou not, Agni, lend us aid to win the cattle, win the wealth? Maker of room, make room for us
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वायविन्द्रश्च शुष्मिणा सरथꣳ शवसस्पती । नियुत्वन्ता न ऊतय आ यातं सोमपीतये ॥१६३०॥
translation: In the great fight cast us not off, Agni, as one who bears a load: Snatch up the wealth and win it all! XIII Indra 95
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अध क्षपा परिष्कृतो वाजाꣳ अभि प्र गाहसे । यदी विवस्वतो धियो हरिꣳ हिन्वन्ति यातवे ॥१६३१॥
translation: Before his hot displeasure all the peoples, all the men bow down, As rivers bow them to the sea.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तमस्य मर्जयामसि मदो य इन्द्रपातमः । यं गाव आसभिर्दधुः पुरा नूनं च सूरयः ॥१६३२॥
translation: Even fiercely-moving Vritra’s head he served with his thunderbolt, His mighty hundred-knotted bolt.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तं गाथया पुराण्या पुनानमभ्यनूषत । उतो कृपन्त धीतयो देवानां नाम बिभ्रतीः ॥१६३३॥
translation: That might of his shone brightly forth when Indra brought together, like A skin, the worlds of heaven and earth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अश्वं न त्वा वारवन्तं वन्दध्या अग्निं नमोभिः । सम्राजन्तमध्वराणाम् ॥१६३४॥
translation: Kind-thoughted is the noble, gladdening, friendly one.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स घा नः सूनुः शवसा पृथुप्रगामा सुशेवः । मीढ्वाꣳ अस्माकं बभूयात् ॥१६३५॥
translation: Approach, O beauteous hero, this auspicious pair that draws the car! These two are coming near to us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स नो दूराच्चासाच्च नि मर्त्यादघायोः । पाहि सदमिद्विश्वायुः ॥१६३६॥
translation: Bend lowly down, as ‘twere, your beads: be stands amid the water-flood, Pointing with his ten horns the way.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वमिन्द्र प्रतूर्तिष्वभि विश्वा असि स्पृधः । अशस्तिहा जनिता वृत्रतूरसि त्वं तूर्य तरुष्यतः ॥१६३७॥
translation: Pressers, blend Soma juice for him, each draugbt most excellent, for him The brave, the: hero, for his joy!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अनु ते शुष्मं तुरयन्तमीयतुः क्षोणी शिशुं न मातरा । विश्वास्ते स्पृधः श्नथयन्त मन्यवे वृत्रं यदिन्द्र तूर्वसि ॥१६३८॥
translation: The two stroing bay steeds, voked by prayer, hither shall bring to us our friend, Indra, song-lover, through our songs.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यज्ञ इन्द्रमवर्धयद्यद्भूमिं व्यवर्तयत् । चक्राण ओपशं दिवि ॥१६३९॥
translation: The Vritra-slayer drinks the juice. May he who gives a hundred aids Approach, nor stay afar from us!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: व्या३न्तरिक्षमतिरन्मदे सोमस्य रोचना । इन्द्रो यदभिनद्वलम् ॥१६४०॥
translation: Let the drops pass within thee as the rivers flow into the sea O Indra, naught excelleth thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उद्गा आजदङ्गिरोभ्य आविष्कृण्वन्गुहा सतीः । अर्वाञ्चं नुनुदे वलम् ॥१६४१॥
translation: ‘Thou’ wakeful hero, by thy might hast taken food of Soma juice, Which, Indra, is within thee now.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्यमु वः सत्रासाहं विश्वासु गीर्ष्वायतम् । आ च्यावयस्यूतये ॥१६४२॥
translation: O Indra, Vritra-slayer, let Soma be ready for thy maw, The drops be ready for thy forms!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: युध्मꣳ सन्तमनर्वाणꣳ सोमपामनपच्युतम् । नरमवार्यक्रतुम् ॥१६४३॥
translation: Help, thou who knowest lauds, this work, a lovely hymn in Rudra’s praise, Adorable in every house
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: शिक्षा ण इन्द्र राय आ पुरु विद्वाꣳ ऋचीषम । अवा नः पार्ये धने ॥१६४४॥
translation: May this our God, great, limitless, smoke-bannered, excellently bright, Urge us to holy thought and wealth
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तव त्यदिन्द्रियं बृहत्तव दक्षमुत क्रतुम् । वज्रꣳ शिशाति धिषणा वरेण्यम् ॥१६४५॥
translation: Like soma rich lord of men, may he, Agni, the banner of the Gods, Refulgent, hear us through our lauds!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तव द्यौरिन्द्र पौꣳस्यं पृथिवी वर्धति श्रवः । त्वामापः पर्वतासश्च हिन्विरे ॥१६४६॥
translation: Sing this, beside the flowing juice, to him, your hero, much invoked, To please him as a mighty Bull!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वां विष्णुर्बृहन्क्षयो मित्रो गृणाति वरुणः । त्वाꣳ शर्धो मदत्यनु मारुतम् ॥१६४७॥
translation: He, excellent, withholdeth not his bounteous gift of wealth in kine. When lie bath listened to our songs.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नमस्ते अग्न ओजसे गृणन्ति देव कृष्टयः । अमैरमित्रमर्दय ॥१६४८॥
translation: May he with might unclose for us the cow’s stall, whosesoe’er it be, To which the Dasyu-slayer goes!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: कुवित्सु नो गविष्टयेऽग्ने संवेषिषो रयिम् । उरुकृदुरु णस्कृधि ॥१६४९॥
translation: Through all this world strode Vishnu: thrice his foot he planted, and the whole Was gathered in his footstep’s dust. 96
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मा नो अग्ने महाधने परा वर्ग्भारभृद्यथा । संवर्गꣳ सꣳ रयिं जय ॥१६५०॥
translation: Vishnu, the guardian, he whom none deceiveth, made three steps, thenceforth Establishing his high decrees.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: समस्य मन्यवे विशो विश्वा नमन्त कृष्टयः । समुद्रायेव सिन्धवः ॥१६५१॥
translation: Look ye on Vishnu’s works whereby the friend of Indra, close allied, Hath let his holy ways be seen
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वि चिद्वृत्रस्य दोधतः शिरो बिभेद वृष्णिना । वज्रेण शतपर्वणा ॥१६५२॥
translation: The princes evermore behold that loftiest place of Vishnu, like An eye extended through the heavens.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ओजस्तदस्य तित्विष उभे यत्समवर्तयत् । इन्द्रश्चर्मेव रोदसी ॥१६५३॥
translation: This, Vishou’s station most sublime, the sages, ever-vigilant, Lovers of holy song, light up.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सुमन्मा वस्वी रन्ती सूनरी ॥१६५४
translation: May the Gods help and favour us out of the place whence Vishnu strode Over the back and ridge of earth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सरूप वृषन्ना गहीमौ भद्रौ धुर्यावभि । ताविमा उप सर्पतः ॥१६५५
translation: Let none, no, not thy worshippers, delay thee far away from us! Even from far away come thou unto our feast, or listen it already here!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नीव शीर्षाणि मृढ्वं मध्य आपस्य तिष्ठति । शृङ्गेभिर्दशभिर्दिशन् ॥१६५६
translation: For here, like rites on honey, those who pray to thee sit by the juice that they have poured. Wealth-craving singers have on Indra set their hope, as men set foot upon a car.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पन्यंपन्यमित्सोतार आ धावत मद्याय । सोमं वीराय शूराय ॥१६५७॥
translation: Sung is the song of ancient time: to Indra have ye said the prayer. They have sung many a Brihati of sacrifice, poured forth the worshipper’s many thoughts.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एह हरी ब्रह्मयुजा शग्मा वक्षतः सखायम् । इन्द्रं गीर्भिर्गिर्वणसम् ॥१६५८॥
translation: Indra hath tossed together mighty stores of wealth, and both the worlds, yea, and the sun. Pure, brightly-shining, mingled with the milk, the draughts of Soma have made Indra glad.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पाता वृत्रहा सुतमा घा गमन्नारे अस्मत् । नि यमते शतमूतिः ॥१६५९॥
translation: For Vritra-slaying Indra, thou, Soma, art poured that he may drink, And for the guerdon-giving man, the hero sitting in his seat.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ त्वा विशन्त्विन्दवः समुद्रमिव सिन्धवः । न त्वामिन्द्राति रिच्यते ॥१६६०॥
translation: Friends, may the princes, ye and we, obtain this most resplendent one, Gain him who hath the smell of strength, win him whose home is very strength!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विव्यक्थ महिना वृषन्भक्षꣳ सोमस्य जागृवे । य इन्द्र जठरेषु ते ॥१६६१॥
translation: Him with the fleece they purify, brown, golden-hued, beloved of all. Who with exhilarating juice flows forth to all the deities.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अरं त इन्द्र कुक्षये सोमो भवतु वृत्रहन् । अरं धामभ्य इन्दवः ॥१६६२॥
translation: Indra whose wealth is in thyself, what mortal will attack this man? The strong will win the spoil on the decisive day through faith in thee, O Maghavan!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: जराबोध तद्विविड्ढि विशेविशे यज्ञियाय । स्तोमꣳ रुद्राय दृशीकम् ॥१६६३॥
translation: In battles with the foe urge on our mighty ones who give the treasures dear to thee And may we with our princes, Lord of tawny steeds! pass through all peril, led by thee!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स नो महाꣳ अनिमानो धूमकेतुः पुरुश्चन्द्रः । धिये वाजाय हिन्वतु ॥१६६४॥
translation: Come, priest, and of the savoury juice pour forth a yet more gladdening draught! So is the hero praised who ever prospers us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स रेवाँ इव विश्पतिर्दैव्यः केतुः शृणोतु नः । उक्थैरग्निर्बृहद्भानुः ॥१६६५॥
translation: Indra, whom tawny coursers bear, praise such as thine, preeminent, None by his power or by his goodness hath attained.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तद्वो गाय सुते सचा पुरुहूताय सत्वने । शं यद्गवे न शाकिने ॥१६६६॥
translation: We, seeking glory, have invoked this God of yours, the Lord of wealth, Who must be magnified by constant sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: न घा वसुर्नि यमते दानं वाजस्य गोमतः । यत्सीमुपश्रवद्गिरः ॥१६६७॥
translation: Sing praise to him, the Lord of light. The Gods have made the God to be their messenger, To bear oblation to the Gods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: कुवित्सस्य प्र हि व्रजं गोमन्तं दस्युहा गमत् । शचीभिरप नो वरत् ॥१६६८॥
translation: Agni, the bounteous giver, bright with varied flames, laud thou, O singer Sobhari, Him who controls this sacred food with Soma blent, who hath first claim to sacrifice! 97
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इदं विष्णुर्वि चक्रमे त्रेधा नि दधे पदम् । समूढमस्य पाꣳसुले ॥१६६९॥
translation: Expressed by stones, O Soma, and urged through the long wool of the sheep, Thou, entering the press-boards, even as men a fort, goldbued, hast settled in the vats.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्रीणि पदा वि चक्रमे विष्णुर्गोपा अदाभ्यः । अतो धर्माणि धारयन् ॥१६७०॥
translation: He beautifies himself through the sheep’s long fine wool, the bounteous, like the racing steed, Even Soma Pavamana who shall be the joy of sages and of holy bards.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विष्णोः कर्माणि पश्यत यतो व्रतानि पस्पशे । इन्द्रस्य युज्यः सखा ॥१६७१॥
translation: Here, verily, yesterday we let the Thunder-wielder drink his fill. Bring him the juice poured forth in sacrifice to-day! Now range you by the glorious one!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तद्विष्णोः परमं पदꣳ सदा पश्यन्ति सूरयः । दिवीव चक्षुराततम् ॥१६७२॥
translation: Even the wolf, the savage beast that rends the sheep, follows the path of his decrees. So graciously accepting, Indra, this our praise, with wondrous thought come forth to us! XIV Indra-Agni
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तद्विप्रासो विपन्यवो जागृवाꣳसः समिन्धते । विष्णोर्यत्परमं पदम् ॥१६७३॥
translation: Indra and Agni, in your deeds of might ye deck heaven’s lucid realms: Famed is that hero strength of yours.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अतो देवा अवन्तु नो यतो विष्णुर्विचक्रमे । पृथिव्या अधि सानवि ॥१६७४॥
translation: To Indra and to Agni prayers go forward from the holy task. Along the path of sacred Law.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मो षु त्वा वाघतश्च नारे अस्मन्नि रीरमन् । आरात्ताद्वा सधमादं न आ गहीह वा सन्नुप श्रुधि ॥१६७५॥
translation: Indra and Agni, powers are yours, yours are oblations and abodes: Good is your zealous energy.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इमे हि ते ब्रह्मकृतः सुते सचा मधौ न मक्ष आसते । इन्द्रे कामं जरितारो वसूयवो रथे न पादमा दधुः ॥१६७६॥
translation: Who knows what vital power he wins, drinking beside the flowing juice? This is the fair-cheeked God who, joying in the draught, breaks down the castles in his strength.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अस्तावि मन्म पूर्व्यं ब्रह्मेन्द्राय वोचत । पूर्वीरृतस्य बृहतीरनूषत स्तोतुर्मेधा असृक्षत ॥१६७७॥
translation: As a wild elephant rushes on, this way and that way mad with heat, None may restrain thee, yet come hither to the draught! Thou, movest mighty in thy power.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: समिन्द्रो रायो बृहतीरधूनुत सं क्षोणी समु सूर्यम् । सꣳ शुक्रासः शुचयः सं गवाशिरः सोमा इन्द्रममन्दिषुः ॥१६७८॥
translation: When he, the terrible, ne’er o’erthrown, stedfast, made ready for the fight-- When Indra Maghavan lists to his praiser’s call, he will not stand aloof, but come.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्राय सोम पातवे वृत्रघ्ने परि षिच्यसे । नरे च दक्षिणावते वीराय सदनासदे ॥१६७९॥
translation: The Pavamanas have been poured, the brilliant drops of Soma juice, For holy lore of every kind.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तꣳ सखायः पुरूरुचं वयं यूयं च सूरयः । अश्याम वाजगन्ध्यꣳ सनेम वाजपस्त्यम् ॥१६८०॥
translation: From heaven, from out the firmament hath PavamAna been effused Upon the back and ridge of earth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: परि त्यꣳ हर्यतꣳ हरिं बभ्रुं पुनन्ति वारेण । यो देवान्विश्वाँ इत्परि मदेन सह गच्छति ॥१६८१॥
translation: The Pavamanas have been shed, the beautified swift Somadrops, Driving all enemies afar. XVII Indra-Agni I. Indra and Agni I invoke, joint-victors, bounteous, unsubdued, Foe-slayers, best to win the spoil.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: कस्तमिन्द्र त्वावसवा मर्त्यो दधर्षति । श्रद्धा हि ते मघवन् पार्ये दिवि वाजी वाजं सिषासति ॥१६८२॥
translation: Indra and Agni, singers skilled in melody hymn you bringing lauds: I choose you both to bring me food.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मघोनः स्म वृत्रहत्येषु चोदय ये ददति प्रिया वसु । तव प्रणीती हर्यश्व सूरिभिर्विश्वा तरेम दुरिता ॥१६८३॥
translation: Together, with one mighty deed, Indra and Agni, ye shook down. The ninety forts which Dasas held.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एदु मधोर्मदिन्तरꣳ सिञ्चाध्वर्यो अन्धसः । एवा हि वीर स्तवते सदावृधः ॥१६८४॥
translation: O Child of Strength, to thee whose look is lovely, with oblations we, O Agni, have poured forth our songs. 98
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्र स्थातर्हरीणां न किष्टे पूर्व्यस्तुतिम् । उदानꣳश शवसा न भन्दना ॥१६८५॥
translation: To thee for shelter are we come, as to the shade from fervent heat, Agni, who glitterest like gold
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तं वो वाजानां पतिमहूमहि श्रवस्यवः । अप्रायुभिर्यज्ञेभिर्वावृधेन्यम् ॥१६८६॥
translation: Mighty as one who slays with shafts, or like a bull with sharpened horn, Agni, thou brakest down the forts.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तं गूर्धया स्वर्णरं देवासो देवमरतिं दधन्विरे । देवत्रा हव्यमूहिषे ॥१६८७॥
translation: To give eternal glow, we pray Vaisvanara the holy one, Lord of the light of sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विभूतरातिं विप्र चित्रशोचिषमग्निमीडिष्व यन्तुरम् । अस्य मेधस्य सोम्यस्य सोभरे प्रेमध्वराय पूर्व्यम् ॥१६८८॥
translation: Who, furthering the light of Law, hath spread himself to meet this work: He sends the seasons, mighty one.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ सोम स्वानो अद्रिभिस्तिरो वाराण्यव्यया । जनो न पुरि चम्वोर्विशद्धरिः सदो वनेषु दध्रिषे ॥१६८९॥
translation: Love of what is and what shall be, Agni, in his beloved forms, Shines forth alone as sovran Lord. I Agni 1.Wise Agni, in the ancient way, making his body beautiful, Hath been exalted by the sage.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स मामृजे तिरो अण्वानि मेष्यो मीढ्वान्त्सप्तिर्न वाजयुः । अनुमाद्यः पवमानो मनीषिभिः सोमो विप्रेभिरृक्वभिः ॥१६९०॥
translation: I invocate the Child of Strength, Agni whose glow is bright and pure, In this well-ordered sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वयमेनमिदा ह्योऽपीपेमेह वज्रिणम् । तस्मा उ अद्य सवने सुतं भरा नूनं भूषत श्रुते ॥१६९१॥
translation: So, Agni, rich in many friends, with fiery splendour seat thyself. With Gods upon our sacred grass!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वृकश्चिदस्य वारण उरामथिरा वयुनेषु भूषति । सेमं न स्तोमं जुजुषाण आ गहीन्द्र प्र चित्रया धिया ॥१६९२॥
translation: O thou with stones for arms, thy powers, rending the fiends, have raised themselves: Drive off the foes who compass us
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्राग्नी रोचना दिवः परि वाजेषु भूषथः । तद्वां चेति प्र वीर्यम् ॥१६९३॥
translation: Hence conquering with might when car meets car, and when the prize is staked, With fearless heart will I sing praise.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्राग्नी अपसस्पर्युप प्र यन्ति धीतयः । ऋतस्य पथ्या३ अनु ॥१६९४॥
translation: None, evil-minded, may assail this Pavamana’s holy laws Crush him who fain would fight with thee!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्राग्नी तविषाणि वां सधस्थानि प्रयाँसि च । युवोरप्तूर्यं हितम् ॥१६९५॥
translation: For Indra to the streams they urge the tawny rapture-dropping steed, Indu, the bringer of delight.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: क ईं वेद सुते सचा पिबन्तं कद्वयो दधे । अयं यः पुरो विभिनत्त्योजसा मन्दानः शिप्र्यन्धसः ॥१६९६॥
translation: Come hither, Indra, with bay steeds, joyous, with tails like peacocks’ plumes! Let no men check thy course as fowlers stay the bird: pass o’er them as o’er desert lands!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: दाना मृगो न वारणः पुरुत्रा चरथं दधे । न किष्ट्वा नि यमदा सुते गमो महाꣳश्चरस्योजसा ॥१६९७॥
translation: Vritra’s devourer, he who burst the cloud, brake forts, and drave the floods, Indra, who mounts his chariot at his bay steeds’ cry, shatters e’en things that stand most firm.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: य उग्रः सन्ननिष्टृतः स्थिरो रणाय सꣳस्कृतः । यदि स्तोतुर्मघवा शृणवद्धवं नेन्द्रो योषत्या गमत् ॥१६९८॥
translation: Like pools of water deep and full, like kine thou cherishest thy might; Like the milch-cows that go well-guarded to the mead, like water-brooks that reach the lake.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवमाना असृक्षत सोमाः शुक्रास इन्दवः । अभि विश्वानि काव्या ॥१६९९॥
translation: Even as the wild bull, when he thirsts, goes to the desert’s watery pool, Come hither quickly both at morning and at eve, and with the Kanvas drink thy fill!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवमाना दिवस्पर्यन्तरिक्षादसृक्षत । पृथिव्या अधि सानवि ॥१७००॥
translation: May the drops gladden thee, Lord Indra, and obtain bounty for him who pours the juice! Soma, shed in the press, thou stolest and didst drink, and hence hast won surpassing might. V Indra I. Thou as a God. O mightiest, verily blessest mortal man. O Maghavan, there is no comforter but thou: Indra, I speak my words to thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवमानास आशवः शुभ्रा असृग्रमिन्दवः । घ्नन्तो विश्वा अप द्विषः ॥१७०१॥
translation: Let not thy bounteous gifts, let not thy saving help all fail us good Lord, at any time! And measure out to us, thou lover of man-kind, all riches hitherward from men 99 VI Dawn I. This Lady, excellent and kind, after her sister shining forth, Daughter of Heaven, hath shown herself.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तोशा वृत्रहणा हुवे सजित्वानापराजिता । इन्द्राग्नी वाजसातमा ॥१७०२॥
translation: Red, like a mare, and beautiful, holy, the mother of the kine, The Dawn became the Asvins’ friend.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र वामर्चन्त्युक्थिनो नीथाविदो जरितारः । इन्द्राग्नी इष आ वृणे ॥१७०३
translation: Yea, and thou art the Asvins’, friend the mother of the cows art thou: O Dawn, thou rules over wealth
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्राग्नी नवतिं पुरो दासपत्नीरधूनुतम् । साकमेकेन कर्मणा ॥१७०४॥
translation: Now Morning with her earliest light shines forth, dear daughter of the Sky: High, Asvins, I extol your praise
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उप त्वा रण्वसंदृशं प्रयस्वन्तः सहस्कृत । अग्ने ससृज्महे गिरः ॥१७०५॥
translation: Children of Ocean, mighty ones, discoverers of riches, Gods, Finders of treasure through our prayer!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उप च्छायामिव घृणेरगन्म शर्म ते वयम् । अग्ने हिरण्यसन्दृशः ॥१७०६॥
translation: Your lofty coursers hasten over the everlasting realm, whea your car flies with winged steeds.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: य उग्र इव शर्यहा तिग्मशृङ्गो न वꣳसगः । अग्ने पुरो रुरोजिथ ॥१७०७॥
translation: O Dawn who hast a store of wealth, bring unto us that splendid gift Wherewith we may support children and children’s sons
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ऋतावानं वैश्वानरमृतस्य ज्योतिषस्पतिम् । अजस्रं घर्ममीमहे ॥१७०८॥
translation: Thou radiant Lady of sweet strains, with wealth of horses and of kine Shine thou on us this day, O Dawn, auspiciously
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: य इदं प्रतिपप्रथे यज्ञस्य स्वरुत्तिरन् । ऋतूनुत्सृजते वशी ॥१७०९
translation: O Dawn who hast a store of wealth, yoke red steeds to thy car to-day. Then bring us all delight and all felicities
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्निः प्रियेषु धामसु कामो भूतस्य भव्यस्य । सम्राडेको विराजति ॥१७१०॥
translation: O Asvins, wonderful in act, do ye unanimous direct Your chariot to our home wealthy in kine and gold!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्निः प्रत्नेन जन्मना शुम्भानस्तन्वा३ꣳ स्वाम् । कविर्विप्रेण वावृधे ॥१७११॥
translation: Hither may they who wake at dawn bring, to drink Soma, both the Gods, Health-givers, wonder-workers, borne on paths of gold!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ऊर्ज्जो नपातमा हुवेऽग्निं पावकशोचिषम् । अस्मिन्यज्ञे स्वध्वरे ॥१७१२॥
translation: Ye who brought down the hymn from heaven, a light that giveth light to men, Do ye, O Asvins, bring strength hither unto us!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स नो मित्रमहस्त्वमग्ने शुक्रेण शोचिषा । देवैरा सत्सि बर्हिषि ॥१७१३॥
translation: I think of Agni who is kind, whom, as their home, the milch-kine seek; Whom fleet-foot coursers seek as home, and strong enduring, steeds as home. Bring food to those who sing thy praise!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उत्ते शुष्मासो अस्थू रक्षो भिन्दन्तो अद्रिवः । नुदस्व याः परिस्पृधः ॥१७१४॥
translation: For Agni, God of all mankind, gives the strong courser to theman. Agni gives ready gear for wealth, he gives the best when he ix pleased. Bring food to those who sing thy praise!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अया निजघ्निरोजसा रथसङ्गे धने हिते । स्तवा अबिभ्युषा हृदा ॥१७१५॥
translation: The Agni who is praised as kind, to whom the milch-kine come. in herds, To whom the racers, swift of foot, to whom our wellborn princes come. Bring food to those who sing thy praise!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अस्य व्रतानि नाधृषे पवमानस्य दूढ्या । रुज यस्त्वा पृतन्यति ॥१७१६॥
translation: O heavenly Dawn, awaken us to ample opulence today, Even as thou didst waken us with Satyasravas, Vayya’s, Son, high-born! delightful with thy steeds!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तꣳ हिन्वन्ति मदच्युतꣳ हरिं नदीषु वाजिनम् । इन्दुमिन्द्राय मत्सरम् ॥१७१७॥
translation: Daughter of heaven, thou dawnedst of Sunitha, Suchadratha’s son; So dawn thou on one mightier still, on Satyasravas, Vayya’s son, high-born! delightful with thy steeds! 100
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ मन्द्रैरिन्द्र हरिभिर्याहि मयूररोमभिः । मा त्वा के चिन्नि येमुरिन्न पाशिनोऽति धन्वेव ताꣳ इहि ॥१७१८॥
translation: So bringing treasure, shine to-day on us, thou daughter, of the Sky, As on one mightier thou hast dawned, on Satyasravas, Vayya’s son, high-born! delightful with thy steeds!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वृत्रखादो वलꣳ रुजः पुरां दर्मो अपामजः । स्थाता रथस्य हर्योरभिस्वर इन्द्रो दृढा चिदारुजः ॥१७१९॥
translation: To meet your treasure-bringing car, the car that is most dear to us, Asvins the Rishi is prepared, your worshipper with, songs of praise. Lovers of sweetness, hear my call
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: गम्भीराꣳ उदधीꣳरिव क्रतुं पुष्यसि गा इव । प्र सुगोपा यवसं धेनवो यथा ह्रदं कुल्या इवाशत ॥१७२०॥
translation: Pass, Asvins, over all away. May I obtain you for myself, Wonderful, with your golden paths, most gracious, bringers of the flood! Lovers of sweetness, hear my call!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यथा गौरो अपा कृतं तृष्यन्नेत्यवेरिणम् । आपित्वे नः प्रपित्वे तूयमा गहि कण्वेषु सु सचा पिब ॥१७२१॥
translation: Come to us, O ye Asvins twain, bringing your precious treasures, come Ye Rudras, on your paths of gold, rejoicing, with your store of wealth! Lovers of sweetness, hear my call!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मन्दन्तु त्वा मघवन्निन्द्रेन्दवो राधोदेयाय सुन्वते । आमुष्या सोममपिबश्चमू सुतं ज्येष्ठं तद्दधिषे सहः ॥१७२२॥
translation: Agni is wakened by the people’s fuel to meet the Dawn who cometh like a milch-cow. Like young trees shooting up on high their branches, his flames mounting to the vault of heaven.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वमङ्ग प्र शꣳसिषो देवः शविष्ठ मर्त्यम् । न त्वदन्यो मघवन्नस्ति मर्डितेन्द्र ब्रवीमि ते वचः ॥१७२३॥
translation: For the Gods’ worship hath the priest been wakened: kind Agni hath arisen erect at morning. Kindled, his radiant might is made apparent, and the great God hath been set free from darkness.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मा ते राधाꣳसि मा त ऊतयो वसोऽस्मान्कदा चना दभन् । विश्वा च न उपमिमीहि मानुष वसूनि चर्षणिभ्य आ ॥१७२४॥
translation: When he hath roused the line of his attendants, with the bright milk bright Agni is anointed. Then is prepared the effectual oblation, which spread in front, with tongues, erect, he drinketh,
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्रति ष्या सूनरी जनी व्युच्छन्ती परि स्वसुः । दिवो अदर्शि दुहिता ॥१७२५॥
translation: This light is come, amid all lights the fairest: born is the brilliant, far-extending brightness. Night, sent away for Savitar’s uprising, hath yielded up a birthplace for the morning.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अश्वेव चित्रारुषी माता गवामृतावरी । सखा भूदश्विनोरुषाः ॥१७२६॥
translation: The fair, the bright is come with her white offspring to her the Dark one hath resigned her dwelling. Akin, immortal, following each other, changing their colours both the heavens move onward.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उत सखास्यश्विनोरुत माता गवामसि । उतोषो वस्व ईशिषे ॥१७२७॥
translation: Common, unending is the sisters’ pathway: taught by the Gods alternately they travel, Fair-formed, of different hues and yet one-minded, Night and Dawn clash not, neither do they tarry.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एषो उषा अपूर्व्या व्युच्छति प्रिया दिवः । स्तुषे वामश्विना बृहत् ॥१७२८॥
translation: Agni, the bright face of the Dawns, is shining: the singers’ pious voices have ascended. Borne on your chariot, Asvins, turn you hither, and come unto our brimming warm libation!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: या दस्रा सिन्धुमातरा मनोतरा रयीणाम् । धिया देवा वसुविदा ॥१७२९॥
translation: Most frequent guests, they scorn not what is ready: even now the lauded Asvins are beside us. With promptest aid they come at morn and evening, the worshipper’s most healthful guards from trouble.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वच्यन्ते वां ककुहासो जूर्णायामधि विष्टपि । यद्वाꣳ रथो विभिष्पतात् ॥१७३०॥
translation: Yea, come at milking-time, at early morning, at noon of day, and when the Sun is setting, By day, at night, with most auspicious favour! Not only now the draught hath drawn the Asvins. XVI Dawn 101
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उषस्तच्चित्रमा भरास्मभ्यं वाजिनीवति । येन तोकं च तनयं च धामहे ॥१७३१॥
translation: These Dawns have raised their banner: in the eastern half of middle air they spread abroad their shining light. Like heroes who prepare their weapons for the fray, the cows are coming on, the mothers, red of hue.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उषो अद्येह गोमत्यश्वावति विभावरि । रेवदस्मे व्युच्छ सूनृतावति ॥१७३२॥
translation: Rapidly have the ruddy beams of light shot up: the red cows have they harnessed, easy to be yoked. The Dawns have made their pathways as in former times: redhued, they have attained refulgent brilliancy.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: युङ्क्ष्वा हि वाजिनीवत्यश्वाꣳ अद्यारुणाꣳ उषः । अथा नो विश्वा सौभगान्या वह ॥१७३३॥
translation: They sing their song like women active in their tasks, along their common path hither from far away, Bringing refreshment to the liberal devotee, yea, all things to the worshipper who pours the juice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अश्विना वर्तिरस्मदा गोमद्दस्रा हिरण्यवत् । अर्वाग्रथꣳ समनसा नि यच्छतम् ॥१७३४॥
translation: Agni is wakened: Surya riseth from the earth. Bright Dawn hath opened out the mighty twain with light. The Asvins have equipped their chariot for the course. God Savitar hath roused the world in sundry ways.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एह देवा मयोभुवा दस्रा हिरण्यवर्त्तनी । उषर्बुधो वहन्तु सोमपीतये ॥१७३५॥
translation: When, O ye Asvins, ye equip your mighty car, with fatness and with honey balm, ye twain, our power! To our devotion give victorious strength in war: may we win riches in the heroes’ strife for spoil!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यावित्था श्लोकमा दिवो ज्योतिर्जनाय चक्रथुः । आ न ऊर्जं वहतमश्विना युवम् ॥१७३६॥
translation: Nigh to us come the Asvins’ lauded three wheeled car, the car laden with meath and drawn by fleet-foot steeds, Three-seated, opulent, bestowing all delight: may it bring weal to us, to cattle and to men!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्निं तं मन्ये यो वसुरस्तं यं यन्ति धेनवः । अस्तमर्वन्त आशवोऽस्तं नित्यासो वाजिन इषꣳ स्तोतृभ्य आ भर ॥१७३७॥
translation: Thy streams that never fail or waste flow forth like showers of rain from heaven, To bring a thousand stores of wealth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्निर्हि वाजिनं विशे ददाति विश्वचर्षणिः । अग्नी राये स्वाभुवꣳ स प्रीतो याति वार्यमिषꣳ स्तोतृभ्य आ भर ॥१७३८॥
translation: He, flows beholding on his way all well-beloved sacred lore, Green-tinted, brandishing his arms.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सो अग्निर्यो वसुर्गृणे सं यमायन्ति धेनवः । समर्वन्तो रघुद्रुवः सꣳ सुजातासः सूरय इषꣳ स्तोतृभ्य आ भर ॥१७३९॥
translation: He, when the people deck him like a docile king of elephants, Sits as a falcon in the wood.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: महे नो अद्य बोधयोषो राये दिवित्मती । यथा चिन्नो अबोधयः सत्यश्रवसि वाय्ये सुजाते अश्वसूनृते ॥१७४०॥
translation: So bring thou hitherward to us, Indu, while thou art purified. All treasures both of heaven and earth! 102
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: या सुनीथे शौचद्रथे व्यौच्छो दुहितर्दिवः । सा व्युच्छ सहीयसि सत्यश्रवसि वाय्ये सुजाते अश्वसूनृते ॥१७४१॥
translation: Forward have flowed the streams of power, of this the mighty one effused, Of him who waits upon the Gods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सा नो अद्याभरद्वसुर्व्युच्छा दुहितर्दिवः । यो व्यौच्छः सहीयसि सत्यश्रवसि वाय्ये सुजाते अश्वसूनृते ॥१७४२॥
translation: The singers praise him with their song, and learned priests adorn the steed Born as thelight that merits laud.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्रति प्रियतमꣳ रथं वृषणं वसुवाहनम् । स्तोता वामश्विनावृषि स्तोमेभिर्भूषति प्रति माध्वी मम श्रुतꣳ हवम् ॥१७४३॥
translation: These things thou winnest quickly, while men cleanse thee, Soma, nobly rich!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अत्यायातमश्विना तिरो विश्वा अहꣳ सना । दस्रा हिरण्यवर्तनी सुषुम्णा सिन्धुवाहसा माध्वी मम श्रुतꣳ हवम् ॥१७४४॥
translation: This Brahman, comer at the due time, named Indra, is renowned and praised.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ नो रत्नानि बिभ्रतावश्विना गच्छतं युवम् । रुद्रा हिरण्यवर्तनी जुषाणा वाजिनीवसू माध्वी मम श्रुतꣳ हवम् ॥१७४५॥
translation: To thee alone, O Lord of Strength, go, as it were, all songs of praise.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अबोध्यग्निः समिधा जनानां प्रति धेनुमिवायतीमुषासम् । यह्वा इव प्र वयामुज्जिहानाः प्र भानवः सस्रते नाकमच्छ ॥१७४६॥
translation: Like streams of water on their way, let bounties, Indra, flow from thee!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अबोधि होता यजथाय देवानूर्ध्वो अग्निः सुमनाः प्रातरस्थात् । समिद्धस्य रुशददर्शि पाजो महान्देवस्तमसो निरमोचि ॥१७४७॥
translation: Even as a car to give us aid, we draw thee nigh to favour us, Strong in thy deeds, quelling attack, Indra, Lord, mightiest! of the brave.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यदीं गणस्य रशनामजीगः शुचिरङ्क्ते शुचिभिर्गोभिरग्निः । आद्दक्षिणा युज्यते वाजयन्त्युत्तानामूर्ध्वो अधयज्जुहूभिः ॥१७४८॥
translation: Great in thou power and wisdom, strong, with thought that comprehendeth all! Wide hast thou spread in majesty.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इदꣳ श्रेष्ठं ज्योतिषां ज्योतिरागाच्चित्रः प्रकेतो अजनिष्ट विभ्वा । यथा प्रसूता सवितुः सवायैवा रात्र्युषसे योनिमारैक् ॥१७४९॥
translation: Thou very mighty one, whose hands by virtue of thy greatness wield The golden bolt that beaks its way!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: रुशद्वत्सा रुशती श्वेत्यागादारैगु कृष्णा सदनान्यस्याः । समानबन्धू अमृते अनूची द्यावा वर्णं चरत आमिनाने ॥१७५०॥
translation: He who hath lighted up the joyous castle, wise courser like the steed of cloudy heaven, Bright like the Sun with hundredfold existence
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: समानो अध्वा स्वस्रोरनन्तस्तमन्यान्या चरतो देवशिष्टे । न मेथेते न तस्थतुः सुमेके नक्तोषासा समनसा विरूपे ॥१७५१॥
translation: He, doubly born, hath spread in his effulgence through the three luminous realms, through all the regions, Best sacrificing Priest where waters gather.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ भात्यग्निरुषसामनीकमुद्विप्राणां देवया वाचो अस्थुः । अर्वाञ्चा नूनꣳ रथ्येह यातं पीपिवाꣳसमश्विना घर्ममच्छ ॥१७५२॥
translation: Priest doubly born, he through his love of glory hath in his keeping all things worth the choosing. The man who brings him gifts hath noble offspring.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: न सꣳस्कृतं प्र मिमीतो गमिष्ठान्ति नूनमश्विनोपस्तुतेह । दिवाभिपित्वेऽवसागमिष्ठा प्रत्यवर्त्तिं दाशुषे शम्भविष्ठा ॥१७५३॥
translation: Agni, with hymns may we now accomplish that which thou lovest, Strength, like a horse auspicious, with service!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उता यातꣳ संगवे प्रातरह्नो मध्यन्दिन उदिता सूर्यस्य । दिवा नक्तमवसा शन्तमेन नेदानीं पीतिरश्विना ततान ॥१७५४॥
translation: For, Agni, thou art now the promoter of strength auspicious, Lofty sacrifice, power effective.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एता उ त्या उषसः केतुमक्रत पूर्वे अर्धे रजसो भानुमञ्जते । निष्कृण्वाना आयुधानीव धृष्णवः प्रति गावोऽरुषीर्यन्ति मातरः ॥१७५५॥
translation: Through these our praises, come thou to meet us, bright as the sunlight, Agni, kindly with all thy faces!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उदपप्तन्नरुणा भानवो वृथा स्वायुजो अरुषीर्गा अयुक्षत । अक्रन्नुषासो वयुनानि पूर्वथा रुशन्तं भानुमरुषीरशिश्रयुः ॥१७५६॥
translation: Immortal Jatavedas, thou bright-hued refulgent gift of Dawn. Agni, this day to him who pays oblations bring the Gods who waken with the morn!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अर्चन्ति नारीरपसो न विष्टिभिः समानेन योजनेना परावतः । इषं वहन्तीः सुकृते सुदानवे विश्वेदह यजमानाय सुन्वते ॥१७५७॥
translation: For thou art offering-bearer, well-loved messenger, and charioteer of holy rites. Accordant with the Asvins and with Dawn grant us heroic strength and lofty fame! VII Indra 103
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अबोध्यग्निर्ज्म उदेति सूर्यो व्यु३षाश्चन्द्रा मह्यावो अर्चिषा । आयुक्षातामश्विना यातवे रथं प्रासावीद्देवः सविता जगत्पृथक् ॥१७५८॥
translation: The old hath waked the young Moon from his slumber who runs his circling course with many round him Behold the God’s high wisdom in its greatness: he who died yesterday to-day is living.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यद्युञ्जाथे वृषणमश्विना रथं घृतेन नो मधुना क्षत्रमुक्षतम् । अस्माकं ब्रह्म पृतनासु जिन्वतं वयं धना शूरसाता भजेमहि ॥१७५९॥
translation: Strong is the red Bird in his strength, great hero, who from of old bath had no nest to dwell in. That which he knows is truth and never idle: he wins and gives the wealth desired of many.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अर्वाङ्त्रिचक्रो मधुवाहनो रथो जीराश्वो अश्विनोर्यातु सुष्टुतः । त्रिवन्धुरो मघवा विश्वसौभगः शं न आ वक्षद्द्विपदे चतुष्पदे ॥१७६०॥
translation: Through these Thunderer gained strong manly vigour, through whom he waxed in stren gth to slaughter Vritra; These who through might of actual operation sprang forth as Gods in course of Law and Order.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र ते धारा असश्चतो दिवो न यन्ति वृष्टयः । अच्छा वाजꣳ सहस्रिणम् ॥१७६१॥
translation: Here is the Soma ready pressed: of this the Maruts, yea, of this Self-luminous, the Asvins, drink.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभि प्रियाणि काव्या विश्वा चक्षाणो अर्षति । हरिस्तुञ्जान आयुधा ॥१७६२॥
translation: Of this, moreover, purified, set in three places, procreant, Drink Varuna, Mitra, Aryaman.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स मर्मृजान आयुभिरिभो राजेव सुव्रतः । श्येनो न वꣳसु षीदति ॥१७६३॥
translation: Yea, Indra, like the Hotar-priest, will in the early morning drink, At pleasure, of the milky juice:
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स नो विश्वा दिवो वसूतो पृथिव्या अधि । पुनान इन्दवा भर ॥१७६४॥
translation: Verily, Surya, thou art great; truly, Aditya, thou art great. O most admired for greatness of thy majesty, God, by thy greatn.ess thou art great.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्रास्य धारा अक्षरन्वृष्णः सुतस्यौजसः । देवाꣳ अनु प्रभूषतः ॥१७६५॥
translation: Yea, Surya, thou art great in fame: thou evermore, O God, art great. Thou by thy greatness art the Gods’ High-Priest, divine, farspread unconquerable light.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सप्तिं मृजन्ति वेधसो गृणन्तः कारवो गिरा । ज्योतिर्जज्ञानमुक्थ्यम् ॥१७६६॥
translation: Come, Lord of rapturous joys, to our libations with thy bay steeds, come With bay steeds to our flowing juice!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सुषहा सोम तानि ते पुनानाय प्रभूवसो । वर्धा समुद्रमुक्थ्य ॥१७६७॥
translation: Known as best Vritra-slayer erst, as Indra $atakratu, come With bay steeds to our flowing juice!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एष ब्रह्मा य ऋत्विय इन्द्रो नाम श्रुतो गृणे ॥१७६८॥
translation: For, Vritra-slayer, thou art he who drinks these drops of Soma come With bay steeds to our flowing juice!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वामिच्छवसस्पते यन्ति गिरो न संयतः ॥१७६९॥
translation: Bring to the wise, the great, who waxeth mighty your offerings and make ready your devotion. Go forth to many tribes as man’s controller!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वि स्रुतयो यथा पथ इन्द्र त्वद्यन्तु रातयः ॥१७७०॥
translation: For Indra the sublime, the far-pervading, have singers generateo prayer and praises; The sages never violate his statutes.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ त्वा रथं यथोतये सुम्नाय वर्तयामसि । तुविकूर्मिमृतीषहमिन्द्रं शविष्ठ सत्पतिम् ॥१७७१॥
translation: The choirs have established Indra King for ever for victory him, whose anger is resistless: And for the bays’ Lord strengthened those he loveth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तुविशुष्म तुविक्रतो शचीवो विश्वया मते । आ पप्राथ महित्वना ॥१७७२॥
translation: If I, O Indra, were the lord of riches ample as thine own, I would support the singer, God who scatterest wealth! and, not abandon him to woe.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यस्य ते महिना महः परि ज्मायन्तमीयतुः । हस्ता वज्रꣳ हिरण्ययम् ॥१७७३॥
translation: Each day would I enrich the man who sang my praise, in whatsoever place he were. No kinship is there better, Maghavan, than thine: a father even, is no more. XIII Indra 104
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ यः पुरं नार्मिणीमदीदेदत्यः कविर्नभन्यो३ नार्वा । सूरो न रुरुक्वाञ्छतात्मा ॥१७७४॥
translation: Here thou the call of the juice-drinking press-stone: mark thou the sage’s hymn who sings and lauds thee! Take to thine inmost self these adorations!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभि द्विजन्मा त्री रोचनानि विश्वा रजाꣳसि शुशुचानो अस्थात् । होता यजिष्ठो अपाꣳ सधस्थे ॥१७७५॥
translation: I know and ne’er forget the hymns and praises of thee, theconqueror, of thy power immortal. Thy name I ever utter, self-refulgent!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अयꣳ स होता यो द्विजन्मा विश्वा दधे वार्याणि श्रवस्या । मर्तो यो अस्मै सुतुको ददाश ॥१७७६॥
translation: Among mankind many are thy libations, and many a time the pious sage invokes thee. O Maghavan, be not long distant from us!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्ने तमद्याश्वं न स्तोमैः क्रतुं न भद्रꣳ हृदिस्पृशम् । ऋध्यामा त ओहैः ॥१७७७॥
translation: Sing strength to Indra that shall. set his chariot in the foremost place! Giver of room in closest fight, slayer of foes in shock of war, be thou our great encorager! Let the weak bowstrings break upon the bows of our weak mies!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अधा ह्यग्ने क्रतोर्भद्रस्य दक्षस्य साधोः । रथीरृतस्य बृहतो बभूथ ॥१७७८॥
translation: Thou didst destroy the Dragon: thou sentest the rivers down to Earth. Foeless, O Indra, wast thou born. Thou tendest well each choicest thing. Therefore we draw us close to thee. Let the weak bowstrings break upon the bows of our weak enemies! Destroyed be all malignitics and all our enemy’s designs!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एभिर्नो अर्कैर्भवा नो अर्वाङ् स्वा३र्ण ज्योतिः । अग्ने विश्वेभिः सुमना अनीकैः ॥१७७९॥
translation: Thy bolt thou castest at the foe, O Indra, who would smite us dead: thy liberal bounty gives us wealth. Let the weak bowstrings break upon the bows of our weak enemies!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्ने विवस्वदुषसश्चित्रꣳ राधो अमर्त्य । आ दाशुषे जातवेदो वहा त्वमद्या देवाꣳ उषर्बुधः ॥१७८०॥
translation: Rich be the praiser of one rich and liberal, Lord of days! like thee: High rank be his who lauds the juice!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: जुष्टो हि दूतो असि हव्यवाहनोऽग्ने रथीरध्वराणाम् । सजूरश्विभ्यामुषसा सुवीर्यमस्मे धेहि श्रवो बृहत् ॥१७८१॥
translation: His wealth who hath no store of kine hath ne’er found out recited laud, Nor song of praises that is sung.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विधुं दद्राणꣳ समने बहूनां युवानꣳ सन्तं पलितो जगार । देवस्य पश्य काव्यं महित्वाद्या ममार स ह्यः समान ॥१७८२॥
translation: Give us not, Indra, as a prey unto the scornful or the proud: Help, mighty one, with power and might!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: शाक्मना शाको अरुणः सुपर्ण आ यो महः शूरः सनादनीडः । यच्चिकेत सत्यमित्तन्न मोघं वसु स्पार्हमुत जेतोत दाता ॥१७८३॥
translation: Come hither, Indra, with thy bays, come thou to Kanva’s eulogy! Ye by command of yonder Dyaus, God bright by day! have gone to heaven.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ऐभिर्ददे वृष्ण्या पौꣳस्यानि येभिरौक्षद्वृत्रहत्याय वज्री । ये कर्मणः क्रियमाणस्य मह्न ऋते कर्ममुदजायन्त देवाः ॥१७८४॥
translation: The stones’ rim shakes the Soma here like a wolf worrying a sheep. Ye by command of yonder Dyaus, God bright by day I have gone to heaven.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अस्ति सोमो अयꣳ सुतः पिबन्त्यस्य मरुतः । उत स्वराजो अश्विना ॥१७८५॥
translation: May the stone bring thee as it speaks, the Soma-stone with ringing voice! Ye by command of yonder Dyaus, God bright by day! have gone to heaven.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पिबन्ति मित्रो अर्यमा तना पूतस्य वरुणः । त्रिषधस्थस्य जावतः ॥१७८६॥
translation: For Indra flow most rich in sweets, O Soma, bringing him delight!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उतो न्वस्य जोषमा इन्द्रः सुतस्य गोमतः । प्रातर्होतेव मत्सति ॥१७८७॥
translation: Bright, meditating sacred song, these juices have sent Vayu forth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: बण्महाꣳ असि सूर्य बडादित्य महाꣳ असि । महस्ते सतो महिमा पनिष्टम मह्ना देव महाꣳ असि ॥१७८८॥
translation: They were sent forth to feast the Gods, like chariots speeding in the race.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: बट् सूर्य श्रवसा महाꣳ असि सत्रा देव महाꣳ असि । मह्ना देवानामसुर्यः पुरोहितो विभु ज्योतिरदाभ्यम् ॥१७८९॥
translation: Agni I deem our Hotar priest, munificent wealth-giver, Son of Strength, who knoweth all that is even as the Sage who knoweth all. Lord of fair rites, a God with form erected turning to the Gods, he when the flame hath sprung forth from the holy oil, the offered fatness, longs for it as it grows bright.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उप नो हरिभिः सुतं याहि मदानां पते । उप नो हरिभिः सुतम् ॥१७९०॥
translation: We, sacrificing, call on the best worshipper thee eldest of Angirasas, singer! with hyrnns, thee, brilliant one! with singers’ hymn; Thee, wandering round, as ‘twere the sky, thee who art Hotar-priest of men, whom, Bull with hair of flame, the people must observe, tile people that he speed them on. 105
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: द्विता यो वृत्रहन्तमो विद इन्द्रः शतक्रतुः । उप नो हरिभिः सुतम् ॥१७९१॥
translation: He with his blazing Power refulgent far and wide, he verily it iswho conquers demon foes, conquers the demons like an axe: At whose close touch things solid partg and what is stable yields he keeps his ground and flinches not,like trees. Subduing all from the skilled archer flinches not.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वꣳ हि वृत्रहन्नेषां पाता सोमानामसि । उप नो हरिभिः सुतम् ॥१७९२॥
translation: O Agni, strength and fame are thine: thy fires blaze forth on high, O thou refulgent God! Sage, passing bright, thou givest to the worshipper with power, the wealth that merits laud.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र वो महे महेवृधे भरध्वं प्रचेतसे प्र सुमतिं कृणुध्वम् । विशः पूर्वीः प्र चर चर्षणिप्राः ॥१७९३॥
translation: With brilliantg purifying sheen, with perfect sheen thou liftest up thyself in light. Thou, visiting both thy mothers, aidest them as son; thou joinest close the earth and heaven.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उरुव्यचसे महिने सुवृक्तिमिन्द्राय ब्रह्म जनयन्त विप्राः । तस्य व्रतानि न मिनन्ति धीराः ॥१७९४॥
translation: O Jatavedas, Son of Strength, rejoice thyself, gracious, in our fair hymns and songs! In thee have they heaped viands various, many formed; wealthborn, of wondrous help are they.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रं वाणीरनुत्तमन्युमेव सत्रा राजानं दधिरे सहध्यै । हर्यश्वाय बर्हया समापीन् ॥१७९५॥
translation: Agni, spread forth, as ruler, over living things: give wealth, to us, immortal God! Thou shinest out from beauty fair to look upon: thou leadest us to beauteous Power.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यदिन्द्र यावतस्त्वमेतावदहमीशीय । स्तोतारमिद्दधिषे रदावसो न पापत्वाय रꣳसिषम् ॥१७९६॥
translation: I laud the Sage, who orders sacrifice, who hath great riches under his control. Thou givest blest award of good, and plenteous food, thou givest wealth that wins success.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: शिक्षेयमिन्महयते दिवेदिवे राय आ कुहचिद्विदे । न हि त्वदन्यन्मघवन्न आप्यं वस्यो अस्ति पिता च न ॥१७९७॥
translation: The men have set before them, for his favour, Agni, strong, visible to all, the holy. Thee, Lord divine, with ears to hear, most famous, mens’ generations magnify with praise- songs.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: श्रुधी हवं विपिपानस्याद्रेर्बोधा विप्रस्यार्चतो मनीषाम् । कृष्वा दुवाꣳस्यन्तमा सचेमा ॥१७९८॥
translation: Agni, he conquers by thine aid that brings him store of valiant sons and does great deeds, Whose bond of friendship is thy choice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: न ते गिरो अपि मृष्ये तुरस्य न सुष्टुतिमसुर्यस्य विद्वान् । सदा ते नाम स्वयशो विवक्मि ॥१७९९॥
translation: Thy spark is black and crackling; kindled in due time, O bounteous, it is taken up. Thou art the dear friend of the mighty Mornings: thou shinest in glimmerings of the night.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: भूरि हि ते सवना मानुषेषु भूरि मनीषी हवते त्वामित् । मारे अस्मन्मघवञ्ज्योक्कः ॥१८००॥
translation: Him, duly coming, as their germ have plants received: this Agni have maternal Waters brought to life. So, in like manner, do the forest trees and plants bear him within them and produce him evermore.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्रो ष्वस्मै पुरोरथमिन्द्राय शूषमर्चत । अभीके चिदु लोककृत्सङ्गे समत्सु वृत्रहा । अस्माकं बोधि चोदिता नभन्तामन्यकेषां ज्याका अधि धन्वसु ॥१८०१॥
translation: Agni grows bright for Indra: he shines far resplendent in the sky: He sends forth offspring like a queen.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वꣳ सिन्धूꣳरवासृजोऽधराचो अहन्नहिम् । अशत्रुरिन्द्र जज्ञिषे विश्वं पुष्यसि वार्यम् । तं त्वा परि ष्वजामहे नभन्तामन्यकेषां ज्याका अधि धन्वसु ॥१८०२॥
translation: The sacred hymns love him who wakes and watches: to him who watches the holy verses. This Soma saith to him Who wake my dwelling in thy friendship.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वि षु विश्वा अरातयोऽर्यो नशन्त नो धियः । अस्तासि शत्रवे वधं यो न इन्द्र जिघाꣳसति । या ते रातिर्ददिर्वसु नभन्तामन्यकेषां ज्याका अधि धन्वसु ॥१८०३॥
translation: Agni is watchful, and the Richas love him: Agni is watchful, Sama hymns approach him. Agni is watchful, to him saith this Soma, I rest and have my dwelling in thy friendship.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: रेवाꣳ इद्रेवत स्तोता स्यात् त्वावतो मघोनः । प्रेदु हरिवः सुतस्य ॥१८०४॥
translation: Praise to the friends who sit in front! to those seated together,praise I use the hundred-footed speech speech. 106
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उक्थं च न शस्यमानं नागो रयिरा चिकेत । न गायत्रं गीयमानम् ॥१८०५॥
translation: I use the hundred-footed speech, I sing what hath a thousand paths, Gayatra, Trishtup, Jagat hymn.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मा न इन्द्र पीयत्नवे मा शर्धते परा दाः । शिक्षा शचीवः शचीभिः ॥१८०६॥
translation: Gayatra, Trishtup, Jagat hymn,the forms united and complete, Have the Gods made familiar friends.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एन्द्र याहि हरिभिरुप कण्वस्य सुष्टुतिम् । दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो ॥१८०७॥
translation: Agni, is light, light is Agni, Indra is light, light is Indra Surya is light, light is Surya.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अत्रा वि नेमिरेषामुरां न धूनुते वृकः । दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो ॥१८०८॥
translation: O Agni, turn again with strength, turn thou again with food and life: Save us again from grief and woe!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ त्वा ग्रावा वदन्निह सोमी घोषेण वक्षतु । दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो ॥१८०९॥
translation: O Agni, turn again with wealth sprinkle thou us from everyside. With thine own all-supporting stream!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवस्व सोम मन्दयन्निन्द्राय मधुमत्तमः ॥१८१०॥
translation: If I, O Indra, were like thee, the single ruler over wealth. My worshipper should be rich in kine.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ते सुतासो विपश्चितः शुक्रा वायुमसृक्षत ॥१८११॥
translation: I should be fain, O Lord of power, to strengthen and enrich thesage, Where I the ford of herds of kine.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: असृग्रं देववीतये वाजयन्तो रथा इव ॥१८१२॥
translation: Thy goodness, Indra, is a cow yielding in plenty kine and steeds. To worshippers who press the juice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्निꣳ होतारं मन्ये दास्वन्तं वसोः सूनुꣳ सहसो जातवेदसं विप्रं न जातवेदसम् । य ऊर्ध्वया स्वध्वरो देवो देवाच्या कृपा । घृतस्य विभ्राष्टिमनु शुक्रशोचिष आजुह्वानस्य सर्पिषः ॥१८१३॥
translation: Yea, Waters, ye bring health and bliss: so help ye us to energy. That we may look on great delight!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यजिष्ठं त्वा यजमाना हुवेम ज्येष्ठमङ्गिरसां विप्र मन्मभिर्विप्रेभिः शुक्र मन्मभिः । परिज्मानमिव द्याꣳ होतारं चर्षणीनाम् । शोचिष्केशं वृषणं यमिमा विशः प्रावन्तु जूतये विशः ॥१८१४॥
translation: Give us a portion of the dew, the most auspicious that ye have, Like mothers in their longing love!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स हि पुरू चिदोजसा विरुक्मता दीद्यानो भवति द्रुहन्तरः परशुर्न द्रुहन्तरः । वीडु चिद्यस्य समृतौ श्रुवद्वनेव यत्स्थिरम् । निष्षहमाणो यमते नायते धन्वासहा नायते ॥१८१५॥
translation: For you we gladly go to hirn to whose abode ye speed us on, And, Waters, give us procreant strength!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्ने तव श्रवो वयो महि भ्राजन्ते अर्चयो विभावसो । बृहद्भानो शवसा वाजमुक्थ्यꣳ३ दधासि दाशुषे कवे ॥१८१६॥
translation: May Vata breathe his balm on us, healthful, delightful to our heart: May he prolong our days of life!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पावकवर्चाः शुक्रवर्चा अनूनवर्चा उदियर्षि भानुना । पुत्रो मातरा विचरन्नुपावसि पृणक्षि रोदसी उभे ॥१८१७॥
translation: Thou art our father, Vata, yea, thou art our brother and our friend: So give us strength that we may live!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ऊर्जो नपाज्जातवेदः सुशस्तिभिर्मन्दस्व धीतिभिर्हितः । त्वे इषः सं दधुर्भूरिवर्पसश्चित्रोतयो वामजाताः ॥१८१८॥
translation: The store of Amrit that laid away yonder, O Vata, in thine home-- Give us strength that we may live!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इरज्यन्नग्ने प्रथयस्व जन्तुभिरस्मे रायो अमर्त्य । स दर्शतस्य वपुषो वि राजसि पृणक्षि दर्शतं क्रतुम् ॥१८१९॥
translation: The fleet steed wearing divers forms, the eagle bearing his golden raiment to his birthplace, Clothed in due season with the light of Surya, red, hath begot the sacrifice in person.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इष्कर्त्तारमध्वरस्य प्रचेतसं क्षयन्तꣳ राधसो महः । रातिं वामस्य सुभगां महीमिषं दधासि सानसिꣳ रयिम् ॥१८२०॥
translation: Multiform seed he laid in waters, lustre which gathered on the earth and there developed. In the mid-air establishing his greatness, he cries aloud, seed of the vigorous courser.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ऋतावानं महिषं विश्वदर्शतमग्निꣳ सुम्नाय दधिरे पुरो जनाः । श्रुत्कर्णꣳ सप्रथस्तमं त्वा गिरा दैव्यं मानुषा युगा ॥१८२१॥
translation: He hath, enduing thousand robes that suit him, as sacrifice upheld the light of Surya, Giver of ample gifts in hundreds, thousands, supporter of the heavens, earth’s Lord and ruler.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र सो अग्ने तवोतिभिः सुवीराभिस्तरति वाजकर्मभिः । यस्य त्वꣳ सख्यमाविथ ॥१८२२॥
translation: They gaze on thee with longing in their spirit, as on a strong-winged bird that mounteth sky-ward; On thee with wings of gold, Varuna’s envoy, the Bird that hasteneth to the home of Yama.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तव द्रप्सो नीलवान्वाश ऋत्विय इन्धानः सिष्णवा ददे । त्वं महीनामुषसामसि प्रियः क्षपो वस्तुषु राजसि ॥१८२३॥
translation: Erect, to heaven hath the Gandharva mounted, pointing at us his many-coloured weapons: Clad in sweet raiment beautiful to look on, for he, as light, produceth forms that please us.. 107
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तमोषधीर्दधिरे गर्भमृत्वियं तमापो अग्निं जनयन्त मातरः । तमित्समानं वनिनश्च वीरुधोऽन्तर्वतीश्च सुवते च विश्वहा ॥१८२४॥
translation: When as a spark he cometh ilear the ocean, looking with vulture’s eye as Law commandeth, His lustre, joying in its own bright splendour, maketh dear glories in the loftiest region.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्निरिन्द्राय पवते दिवि शुक्रो वि राजति । महिषीव वि जायते ॥१८२५
translation: Swift, rapidly striking, like a bull who sharpens his horns, terrific, stirring up the people. With eyes that close not, bellowing, sole hero, Indra subdued at once a hundred armies.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यो जागार तमृचः कामयन्ते यो जागार तमु सामानि यन्ति । यो जागार तमयꣳ सोम आह तवाहमस्मि सख्ये न्योकाः ॥१८२६॥
translation: With him loud-roaring, ever watchful victcr, bold, hard to overthrow, rouser of battle, Indra. the strong, whose hand bears arrows, conquer, ye heroes, now, now vanquish in the combat!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्निर्जागार तमृचः कामयन्तेऽग्निर्जागार तमु सामानि यन्ति । अग्निर्जागार तमयꣳ सोम आह तवाहमस्मि सख्ये न्योकाः ॥१८२७॥
translation: He rules with those who carry shafts and quivers, Indra who with his band brings hosts together, Foe-conquering strong of arm the Soma-drinker, with mighty bow, shooting with well-laid arrows. II Brihaspati. Indra
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नमः सखिभ्यः पूर्वसद्भ्यो नमः साकन्निषेभ्यः । युञ्जे वाचꣳ शतपदीम् ॥१८२८
translation: Brihaspati, fly with thy chariot hither, slayer of demons, driving off our foemen! Be thou protector of our cars, destroyer, victor in battle, breaker-up of armies!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: युञ्जे वाचꣳ शतपदीं गाये सहस्रवर्तनि । गायत्रं त्रैष्टुभं जगत् ॥१८२९
translation: Conspicuous. by thy strength, firm, foremost fighter, mighty and fierce, victorious, all-subduing, The Son of Conquest, passing men and heroes, kinewinner, mount thy conquering car, O Indra!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: गायत्रं त्रैष्टुभं जगद्विश्वा रूपाणि सम्भृता । देवा ओकाꣳसि चक्रिरे ॥१८३०
translation: Cleaver of stalls, kine-winner, armed with thunder, who quells an army and with might destroys it-- Follow him, brothers! quit yourselves like heroes, and like this Indra show your zeal and courage! III Indra. Brihaspati
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्निर्ज्योतिर्ज्योतिरग्निरिन्द्रो ज्योतिर्ज्योतिरिन्द्रः । सूर्यो ज्योतिर्ज्योतिः सूर्यः ॥१८३१
translation: Piercing with conquering strength the cow-stalls, Indra, pitiless hero with unbounded anger, Victor in fight, unshaken and resistless--may he protect our armies in our battles!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पुनरूर्जा नि वर्तस्व पुनरग्न इषायुषा । पुनर्नः पाह्यꣳहसः ॥१८३२॥
translation: Indra guide these! Brihaspati, and Soma, the guerdon and the sacrifice precede them; And let the banded Maruts march in forefront of heavenly hosts that conquer and demolish!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सह रय्या नि वर्तस्वाग्ने पिन्वस्व धारया । विश्वप्स्न्या विश्वतस्परि ॥१८३३॥
translation: Ours be the potent host of mighty Indra, King Varuna the Maruts, and Adityas! Uplifted is the shout of Gods who conquer, hightninded Gods who cause the worlds to tremble. IV Indra.Maruts
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यदिन्द्राहं यथा त्वमीशीय वस्व एक इत् । स्तोता मे गोसखा स्यात् ॥१८३४॥
translation: Bristle thou up, O Maghavan, our weapons: excite the spirits, of my warring heroes! Urge on the strong steed’s might, O Vyitra-slayer, and let the din of conquering cars go upward
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: शिक्षेयमस्मै दित्सेयꣳ शचीपते मनीषिणे । यदहं गोपतिः स्याम् ॥१८३५॥
translation: May Indra aid us when our flags are gathered: victorious be ther arrows of our army! May our brave men of war prevail in battle. Ye Gods, protect us in the shout of onset!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: धेनुष्ट इन्द्र सूनृता यजमानाय सुन्वते । गामश्वं पिप्युषी दुहे ॥१८३६॥
translation: That army of the foemen, O ye Maruts, which, striving in its. mighty strength, approaches, Hide ye and bury it in pathless darkness that not a man oF them may know the other!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आपो हि ष्ठा मयोभुवस्ता न ऊर्जे दधातन । महे रणाय चक्षसे ॥१८३७॥
translation: Bewildering the senses of our foemen, seize thou their bodies, and depart, O Agha! Attack them, set their hearts on fare with sorrows; so let our foes abide in utter darkness! 108
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यो वः शिवतमो रसस्तस्य भाजयतेह नः । उशतीरिव मातरः ॥१८३८॥
translation: Advance, O heroes, win the day, May Indra be your sure defence! Mighty and awful be your arms, that none may wound or injure you!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तस्मा अरं गमाम वो यस्य क्षयाय जिन्वथ । आपो जनयथा च नः ॥१८३९॥
translation: Loosed from the bowstring fly away, thou arrows sharpened by our prayer! Go to the foemen, strike them home, and let not one be left alive! VI Indra and others
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वात आ वातु भेषजꣳ शम्भु मयोभु नो हृदे । प्र न आयूꣳषि तारिषत् ॥१८४०॥
translation: Let ravens and strong-pinioned birds pursue them: yea, let that army be the food of vultures! Indra, let none escape, no sin-remover: behind them all let following birds be gathered!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उत वात पितासि न उत भ्रातोत नः सखा । स नो जीवातवे कृधि ॥१८४१॥
translation: This host of foemen Maghavan! that cometh on in warlike show-- Meet it, O Vritra-slayer, thou, Indra, and Agni, with your flames!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यददो वात ते गृहे३ऽमृतं निहितं गुहा । तस्य नो देहि जीवसे ॥१८४२॥
translation: There where the flights of arrows fall like boys whose locks are yet unshorn. Even there may Brahmanaspati, may Aditi protect us well, protect us well through all our days!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभि वाजी विश्वरूपो जनित्रꣳ हिरण्ययं बिभ्रदत्कꣳ सुपर्णः । सूर्यस्य भानुमृतुथा वसानः परि स्वयं मेधमृज्रो जजान ॥१८४३
translation: Drive Rakshasas and foes away, break thou in pieces Vritra’s jaws: O Vritra-slaying Indra, quell the foeman’s wrath who threatens us!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अप्सु रेतः शिश्रिये विश्वरूपं तेजः पृथिव्यामधि यत्सम्बभूव । अन्तरिक्षे स्वं महिमानं मिमानः कनिक्रन्ति वृष्णो अश्वस्य रेतः ॥१८४४
translation: O Indra, beat our foes away, humble the men who challenge us: Send down to nether darkness him who seeks to do us injury!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अयꣳ सहस्रा परि युक्ता वसानः सूर्यस्य भानुं यज्ञो दाधार । सहस्रदाः शतदा भूरिदावा धर्त्ता दिवो भुवनस्य विश्पतिः ॥१८४५
translation: Strong, ever-youthful are the arms of Indra, fair unassailable, never to be vanquished: These first let him employ when need hath come on us, wherewith the Asuras’ great might was overthrown. VIII Soma, Varuna
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नाके सुपर्णमुप यत्पतन्तꣳ हृदा वेनन्तो अभ्यचक्षत त्वा । हिरण्यपक्षं वरुणस्य दूतं यमस्य योनौ शकुनं भुरण्युम् ॥१८४६॥
translation: Thy vital parts I cover with thine armour: with immortality King Soma clothe thee! Varuna give thee what is more than ample, and in thy victory may Gods be joyful!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ऊर्ध्वो गन्धर्वो अधि नाके अस्थात्प्रत्यङ्चित्रा बिभ्रदस्यायुधानि । वसानो अत्कꣳ सुरभिं दृशे कꣳ स्वा३र्ण नाम जनत प्रियाणि ॥१८४७॥
translation: Blind, O my foemen, shall ye be, even as headless serpents are May Indra slay each best of you when Agni’s flame hath struck you down!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: द्रप्सः समुद्रमभि यज्जिगाति पश्यन्गृध्रस्य चक्षसा विधर्मन् । भानुः शुक्रेण शोचिषा चकानस्तृतीये चक्रे रजसि प्रियाणि ॥१८४८॥
translation: Whoso would kill us, whether he be a stranger foe or one of us, May all the Gods discomfit him! My nearest, closest mail is prayer, my closest armour and defence. IX Indra. All-Gods
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आशुः शिशानो वृषभो न भीमो घनाघनः क्षोभणश्चर्षणीनाम् । सङ्क्रन्दनोऽनिमिष एकवीरः शतꣳ सेना अजयत्साकमिन्द्रः ॥१८४९॥
translation: Like a dread wild beast roaming on the mountain thou hast approached us from the farthest distance. Whetting thy bolt and thy sharp blade, O Indra, crush thou the foe and scatter those who hate us!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सङ्क्रन्दनेनानिमिषेण जिष्णुना युत्कारेण दुश्च्यवनेन धृष्णुना । तदिन्द्रेण जयत तत्सहध्वं युधो नर इषुहस्तेन वृष्णा ॥१८५०॥
translation: Gods, may our ears hear that which is auspicious, may our eyes see that which is good, ye holy! Extolling you with still strong limbs and bodies, may we attain the age by Gods appointed!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स इषुहस्तैः स निषङ्गिभिर्वशी सꣳस्रष्टा स युध इन्द्रो गणेन । सꣳसृष्टजित्सोमपा बाहुशर्ध्यू३ग्रधन्वा प्रतिहिताभिरस्ता ॥१८५१॥
translation: Illustrious far and wide, may Indra bless us, may Pushan bless us, master of all riches! May Tarkshya with uninjured fellies bless us! Brihaspati bestow on us his favour!
